title: Technical Program Manager
description:
The TPM owns predictable, high-quality delivery across AbhiBus's technology programs. This is not a scrum-master role: you drive outcomes end to end, from planning through release to post-launch analysis.

You will be the connective tissue between engineering, QA, product and business stakeholders. You keep everyone aligned on scope, dates, risks and dependencies, so teams spend time building, not chasing status.

After every major release, you close the loop: measure impact, run retrospectives and post-analysis, and publish learnings across the organisation. As you grow, you will take on larger, multi-team programs.

Key responsibilities

Delivery ownership

  • Own the delivery plan for assigned programs across 2–3 squads: scope, milestones, timelines, owners and dependencies.
  • Break business and product goals into executable technical plans with engineering leads.
  • Track progress daily, surface slippage early, and drive decisions to keep releases on date.
  • Maintain a single, trusted source of truth for program status (roadmap, release calendar, risk register).
  • Manage cross-team dependencies across backend, frontend, mobile, QA, DevOps, data and partner integrations.

Scrum and agile execution

  • Run sprint ceremonies: planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, reviews and retrospectives.
  • Keep backlogs healthy and sprint-ready with Product, with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Track sprint health metrics (velocity, commitment vs completion, carry-over, cycle time) and act on trends.
  • Remove blockers quickly and escalate with clear options when needed.

Stakeholder coordination

  • Act as the single point of coordination between Tech, QA, Product, Design, Business and Operations.
  • Align stakeholders on priorities, trade-offs and scope changes; document decisions.
  • Publish crisp weekly status updates and present program status in leadership reviews.
  • Coordinate with external partners and vendors on integration timelines where needed.

Release and quality management

  • Run the release process for your squads: release readiness, go/no-go, deployment coordination and rollback plans.
  • Work with QA to ensure test plans, regression coverage and sign-off are in place before release.
  • Coordinate hotfixes and production incidents with engineering; ensure follow-ups are tracked to closure.

Post-analysis and publishing

  • Run post-release analysis for every major feature: delivery vs plan, quality, and business impact against agreed metrics.
  • Run blameless postmortems with engineering leads for incidents and missed deliveries; drive action items to closure.
  • Publish post-analysis reports and learnings across Tech, Product and Business.
  • Turn recurring learnings into process improvements, templates and checklists.
  • 2–5 years in software delivery, with 1+ year as a TPM, scrum master, delivery manager or project manager in a product company.
  • Strong technical grounding: can follow architecture discussions, APIs, microservices, mobile releases and CI/CD, and judge engineering estimates and risks.
  • Track record of shipping features across multiple teams on time in a fast-moving consumer or marketplace business.
  • Hands-on Scrum/Agile experience running ceremonies for at least one team.
  • Working knowledge of Jira (or similar), Confluence and roadmap/reporting tools.
  • Data-driven: comfortable defining success metrics and reading dashboards to analyse feature impact.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; can write clear status reports and post-analysis documents for leadership.
  • Ownership mindset: drives to outcomes, not just tracks tasks.

Good to have

Engineering background (B.E./B.Tech or equivalent), ideally with prior hands-on development or QA experience. Experience in travel, ticketing, e-commerce or marketplace platforms with partner/supplier integrations. Familiarity with mobile app release cycles (Play Store / App Store) and staged rollouts. Exposure to observability and analytics tools (Grafana, CleverTap or similar). Comfort using AI tools to speed up planning, reporting and analysis. Certifications such as CSM, PSM, PMP or SAFe (a plus, not required).

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Description -

Job Summary
• This role is responsible for data collection procedures, including accurate and relevant data for machine learning models, extracting and analyzing data from the primary and secondary database. The role ensures data integrity and compliance by performing data cleansing and data validations. The role performs root-cause analysis and recommends or executes corrective actions by implementing auto detect, auto dragonize and auto correct when data from related system problems occur. The role applies subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues within established guidelines and recommends appropriate alternatives.

Responsibilities
• Designs and establishes secure and performant data architectures, enhancements, updates, and programming changes for portions and subsystems of data pipelines, repositories or models for structured/unstructured data.
• Analyzes design and determines coding, programming, and integration activities required based on general objectives and knowledge of overall architecture of product or solution.
• Writes and executes complete testing plans, protocols, and documentation for assigned portion of data system or component; identifies and debugs, and creates solutions for issues with code and integration into data system architecture.
• Leads a project team of other data engineers to develop reliable, cost effective and high-quality solutions for assigned data system, model, or component.
• Collaborates and communicates with project team regarding project progress and issue resolution.
• Analyzes data inaccuracies, identifies opportunities and supports the development of automated solutions to enhance overall quality of the enterprise data.
• Identifies problematic areas and conducts research to determine the best course of action to correct the data; identifies, analyzes and interprets trends and patterns in complex datasets.
• Works cross-functionally with different departments to assess, define, and develop report deliverables.
• Represents the software data engineering team for all phases of larger and more-complex development projects.
• Provides guidance and mentoring to less experienced staff members.

Education & Experience Recommended
• Four-year or Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Statistics/ Mathematics, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
• Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in data analytics, data engineering, data modeling, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience.

Preferred Certifications

title: Network Administrator
description:
Job Description

SUMMARY


The Information Technology Site Systems Administrator II role requires an individual with a solid technical background and an ability to work with the IT & digital organization and operations management to align priorities and plans with key business objectives.

This position is responsible for providing required support for the enterprise network in a manufacturing environment, including but not limited to servers, telecom, telephony, and cybersecurity.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

·Utilize the Service Now application to coordinate and document support activities.

·Monitor and manage server performance, including file servers, database servers, web servers, and domain resources.

·Provide LAN support.

·On call for after-hours support of enterprise servers and related outages and support issues.

· Monitor and manage DHCP and WINS servers for the LAN/WAN

· Collaborate with IT Corporate to:

- Install and configure servers.

- Provide on-site support for new Projects.

- Assess near and long-term network capacity needs and design and implement strategic plans to make certain network capacity meets existing and future requirements.

- Implement network security solutions.

- Coordinate site implementations, upgrades, and updates activities.

· When required, work with third-party vendors for network and equipment installation.

· Create documentation for the knowledge base.

· Manage spare parts and equipment Inventory.

· Coordinate and evaluate vendors.

· Responsible for applying all EMS-related requirements, ISO9001/14001/50001/Green Spirit, according to the position.

·Repair and/or replace equipment, as necessary.

PREFERED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to communicate problems and solutions verbally and in writing to customers and management.
  • Ability to work independently and troubleshoot problems with speed and efficiency.
  • Ability to work closely with others in a team environment.
  • Knowledge in MS SQL server support/Windows Terminal Server/Clustering with MS Cluster Services a plus.
  • Virtual servers Hyper-V.
  • IIS Servers.
  • Experience with CISCO networking equipment.
  • File and Print servers.
  • Support and maintain Data Center equipment: HVAC, UPS, Emergency Power Generator.
  • Asset management.
  • Equipment disposal.
  • Monitor and provide local support for telecommunication infrastructure.
  • Experience in Structure cabling.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

    • Bachelor’s Degree in computer science.
    • 4+ years of network administration & management in a Windows Server environment.
    • 6+ years of progressively responsible technical support experience for end user or network computing.
    • Experience in operational field/factory environment
    • Good written and oral communication skills; good interpersonal skills
    • Experience in managing deployment of cybersecurity (desirable)
    • Self-motivated and able to handle multiple tasks.
    • Bilingual English - Spanish.
    • Network+ or CCNA certification is a plus
    • Project Management skills is a plus.

title: Airport Services Supervisor
description:
Job Description:

This Is How We Fly

At JSX, we’re not just a lifestyle carrier – we’re a lifestyle employer. Here, entrepreneurship meets determination, and excellence is our standard. We believe that the journey is just as important as the destination, and every day, we strive to create a Joyful, Simple eXperience for our Customers. Join us, and find your runway to growth, innovation, and success.


About the Role

The Airport Services Supervisor is responsible for leading daily Customer-facing airport operations while ensuring a safe, efficient, and consistently exceptional travel experience.


In this role, you'll oversee and support a team of Airport Service Concierges (ASCs), providing the coaching, direction, and resources they need to deliver outstanding hospitality. You'll maintain high standards across Customer check-in, boarding, lounge operations, and station appearance while helping your team navigate the demands of a fast-paced airport environment.


You'll work closely with Flight Crewmembers, Maintenance, station leadership, Fixed Base Operators (FBOs), and other business partners to coordinate seamless operations and support on-time performance. Whether you're resolving a Customer concern, responding to an operational challenge, or stepping in to assist during a busy departure, you'll lead by example and keep safety, service, and teamwork at the center of every decision.


This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who thrives on developing others, takes pride in operational excellence, and understands how thoughtful hospitality can turn first-time travelers into loyal JSX Customers.


A Day in the Life

In this role, you'll:


Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and support a team of Airport Service Concierges to deliver consistent, high-quality Customer service.
  • Provide real-time feedback, guidance, and hands-on support to strengthen individual and team performance.
  • Set clear expectations for professionalism, hospitality, operational readiness, and accountability.
  • Foster a positive, collaborative team environment that encourages Crewmember engagement and development.
  • Identify coaching opportunities and help Crewmembers build the skills and confidence needed to succeed.
  • Lead by example, stepping in to support frontline operations during high-volume periods, irregular operations, or other critical situations.

Customer Experience & Hospitality

  • Oversee Customer-facing airport activities to ensure a welcoming, seamless, and personalized travel experience.
  • Maintain high standards for lounge and gate cleanliness, organization, appearance, and premium amenities.
  • Ensure Customer areas are properly stocked, prepared, and ready to support daily flight operations.
  • Monitor Customer interactions and provide coaching to reinforce JSX's hospitality standards.
  • Address Customer questions, concerns, and service challenges with empathy, professionalism, and sound judgment.
  • Anticipate Customer needs and identify opportunities to enhance the overall airport experience.
  • Support efficient check-in, boarding, and departure processes while maintaining a strong focus on service quality.

Airport Operations & Coordination

  • Oversee daily Airport Services activities to support safe, efficient, and on-time flight operations.
  • Coordinate with Flight Crewmembers, Maintenance, FBOs, station leadership, and other business partners to support smooth aircraft turnarounds.
  • Monitor operational activity and adjust team priorities as flight schedules, Customer volumes, and station needs change.
  • Communicate important operational updates to Crewmembers and ensure timely coordination across departments.
  • Support the resolution of operational challenges while maintaining established safety and service standards.
  • Ensure Airport Services procedures are consistently followed throughout the Customer journey.

Safety, Security & Compliance

  • Maintain compliance with JSX policies, airport security procedures, and applicable aviation regulations.
  • Serve as a Ground Security Coordinator (GSC) in accordance with required training and certification.
  • Ensure Customer and baggage security screening activities are performed in accordance with established procedures.
  • Monitor the operational environment, identify potential hazards, and report safety or security concerns promptly.
  • Communicate relevant policy changes, security alerts, and regulatory updates to Airport Services Crewmembers.
  • Reinforce safety-sensitive responsibilities and ensure Crewmembers remain prepared to perform assigned duties.

Station Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor team performance, operational standards, and the overall Customer experience.
  • Identify opportunities to improve station efficiency, service consistency, and operational processes.
  • Collaborate with station leadership to address performance gaps and implement practical improvements.
  • Maintain accountability for the appearance, readiness, and professionalism of Customer-facing station operations.
  • Support special projects, operational initiatives, and additional station responsibilities as needed.

Why You'll Love This Role

  • Lead With Impact: Develop and inspire the Crewmembers who shape the JSX Customer experience every day.
  • Elevate the Customer Experience: Influence everything from the atmosphere of our lounges to the quality of service delivered during boarding and departure.
  • Be a Hands-On Leader: Stay connected to daily operations while coaching your team and solving real-time challenges.
  • Collaborate Across Aviation: Work alongside Flight Crewmembers, Maintenance, FBOs, and station leadership to support seamless operations.
  • Grow Your Leadership Career: Build valuable experience in team development, operational management, safety, and premium hospitality.
  • Make Every Day Different: Thrive in a dynamic airport environment where your leadership, adaptability, and problem-solving skills make a direct impact.

What Makes a Successful Airport Services Supervisor?

We're looking for someone who is:


  • A Strong Leader: You inspire confidence, set clear expectations, and lead by example while helping others succeed.
  • Customer-Focused: You understand the importance of exceptional hospitality and consistently look for ways to create memorable Customer experiences.
  • Safety-Conscious: You prioritize safety and security, follow established procedures, and hold your team accountable to regulatory and operational standards.
  • Detail-Oriented: You recognize that the little things matter, from lounge presentation to accurate execution of airport procedures.
  • Adaptable: You remain composed and effective when schedules change, unexpected challenges arise, or operational priorities shift.
  • Collaborative: You build strong working relationships and bring teams together to achieve shared operational goals.
  • Communicative: You provide clear direction, constructive feedback, and timely information to Crewmembers and business partners.
  • Accountable: You take ownership of station performance, follow through on commitments, and address challenges directly and professionally.
  • Proactive: You anticipate operational needs, identify opportunities for improvement, and take action before small issues become larger problems.
  • Entrepreneurial: You bring fresh ideas, challenge inefficient processes constructively, and seek innovative ways to strengthen the Customer experience and station operations.

Required Experience

  • In accordance with federal regulations, this role is open only to U.S. citizens. All candidates must successfully complete the required federal background checks and eligibility screenings. Applicants who do not meet these requirements will not be eligible for employment.
  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Minimum of two years of airport operations experience.
  • Strong Customer service and hospitality skills, with a commitment to delivering exceptional experiences.
  • Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to lead, coach, and support team members in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with Flight Crewmembers, Maintenance, FBOs, and other operational partners.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and respond effectively to operational changes.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain established safety, security, and service standards.
  • Current and valid driver's license.
  • Ability to lift 75 pounds or more.
  • Ability to perform intermittent physical activity, including bending, reaching, and standing for extended periods.
  • Flexibility to work early mornings, late nights, weekends, and holidays based on operational needs.
  • Ability to successfully complete required federal background checks and eligibility screenings.
  • Ability to comply with applicable DOT and FAA drug and alcohol testing requirements, including pre-employment and random testing.

Preferred Experience

  • Previous experience in a supervisory, team lead, or coaching role within airport operations.
  • Experience working in a premium hospitality, airline, or other Customer-focused service environment.
  • Familiarity with airport check-in, boarding, baggage handling, and aircraft turnaround procedures.
  • Experience coordinating with Flight Crewmembers, FBOs, and other aviation service providers.
  • Previous Ground Security Coordinator (GSC) training or certification.
  • Experience supporting safety and security compliance in an aviation environment.
  • Demonstrated success improving team performance, operational efficiency, or Customer satisfaction.

Important Safety and Security Requirements:

All Airport Services Crewmembers are certified as Ground Security Coordinators (GSCs), trained for Customer and baggage security screening, and are responsible for:


  • Monitoring the operational environment and reporting safety risks in real time
  • Ensuring compliance with updated policies, alerts, and regulatory guidance
  • Maintaining personal readiness for safety-sensitive duties
  • Participating in initial and random drug and alcohol screenings in accordance with DOT and FAA guidelines

Benefits & Perks

  • Health Benefits: New Crewmembers become eligible for coverage on the 1st of the month following the start date, with medical plans beginning at just $110/month. 100% employer-paid dental & vision, plus up to $2,100 annually for HSA contribution. Short-term and long-term disability coverage at no cost.
  • Travel Benefits: Enjoy free non-revenue standby travel on JSX, plus deeply discounted standby travel on other major domestic and international airlines for you and your qualifying immediate family.
  • 401(k) Match: 50% of your first 8%.
  • Generous PTO: Take time to recharge with our flexible PTO plan.

Additional Information

May perform other responsibilities as assigned. Responsibilities and duties may change when circumstances dictate, including emergencies, changes in workload, rush jobs, technical developments, or evolving business needs.

Ready to soar with us? Join JSX, where every day is a chance to be part of something eXtraordinary!

title: Life Pricing Manager
description:
About FWD Group

FWD Group (1828.HK) is a pan-Asian life and health insurance business that serves over 40 million customers across 10 markets, including BRI Life in Indonesia. FWD’s customer-led and tech-enabled approach aims to deliver innovative propositions, easy-to-understand products and a simpler insurance experience. Established in 2013, the company operates in some of the fastest-growing insurance markets in the world with a vision of changing the way people feel about insurance. FWD Group is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under the stock code 1828. For more information, please visit


In Singapore, FWD aims to change the way people feel about insurance by leveraging technology to deliver products and services that are relevant, easy to understand and always convenient for our customers. To this end, we have a direct-to-consumer (DTC) platform that allows customers to buy their preferred life and general insurance products directly from our website; as well as a network of preferred Financial Advisory (FA) firms for customers who want to speak with an advisor before committing to an insurance plan. Whatever their preference, we believe insurance should be simple, reliable and convenient.


If you are looking for a career where you can create a real impact and celebrate living, we invite you to join us on our exciting journey.

PURPOSE

Support the Head of Pricing in the pricing of life insurance products.


KEY ACCOUNTAIBILITIES

  • Develop actuarial pricing model for new or repriced products.
  • Perform pricing financial assessment and sensitivity testing to support the Team in launching competitive products whilst ensuring compliance to internal policies, regulatory requirements and industry guidelines.
  • Identify pricing risks and support Team Lead in developing solutions for alignment at the PMC.
  • Collaborate with wider business (including product development, IT, risk & compliance, etc) to ensure timely end-to-end product development and implementation with good audit trail.
  • Prepare internal (FWD local entities and FWD Group) and external product filing.
  • Work closely with Appointed Actuary in proposing assumptions for new products and justifications.
  • Pro-actively drive initiatives/projects to enhance overall pricing process efficiency and governance/controls.
  • Support discussion and negotiation on reinsurance, together with Product team
  • Assist in special quotations.
  • Guide/lead junior pricing actuaries to ensure quality and timely deliverable.

QUALIFICATIONS / EXPERIENCE

  • Qualified actuary from a recognized professional actuarial body is preferred.
  • Min 6 - 8 years of actuarial experience, with individual life product pricing experience.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITY

  • Strong knowledge on (i) Singapore RBC2 or similar regulatory framework, (ii) embedded value and (iii) IFRS17 would be an advantage.
  • Good knowledge of Life insurance products in the Singapore market would be an advantage.
  • Proficient in Prophet.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

What it's all about -

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. VCA's core client segments include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.


The VCA team in Paris is part of our FBL cluster and is looking for a Consulting Manager to join the growing team.


Specific Responsibilities include:

· Lead consulting initiatives and contribute to closing engagements by identifying potential opportunities with clients for future engagements.

· Participate with Visa internal teams in regular strategic & planning discussions.

· Address client inquiries and serve as the main contact point for clients and internal questions.

· Manage multiple priorities across various workstreams and projects simultaneously.

Your leadership as the TISO to ensure the critical assets (NARs) meet all regulatory requirements while aligning technical deployments, patch management governance with the patch management vendor management team to mitigate risk to the mainframe environment.

Applying all the mainframe governance, Kyndryl vendor management skills and Application support for the critical applications running on the Tandem platform. Take responsibilities of audit, compliance and DB tools integration to the Tandem platform.

What we’ll offer you

  • Best in class leave policy.
  • Gender neutral parental leaves
  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
  • Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and Term life Insurance

Your key responsibilities

  • Complete understanding of the Mainframe platform, hardware, software, security, subsystems like Network (TCP/SNA), File transfer protocols, CICS, DB2, IMS, TSO, Batch, JCL and REXX skills, Automation, Assembler code understanding.
  • Lead the Audit & Regulatory Support in TISO role reviewing, supporting and approving all the mainframe assets compliance related work bench items in dbUnity, RACER/dbGRC, Group Audit related CAF findings closure, preparation of all documentation and evidence for internal and external software audits to ensure zero non-compliance findings.

  • Coordinate all the Audits as point of contact for EY, GA ensuring all internal controls meet the audit findings, SOX requirements and provide necessary documentation for quarterly and yearly reviews.
  • Provide L3 operational support for IBM z/OS production environments, including monitoring, event triage, and service restoration within agreed SLAs.
  • Perform initial diagnostics for incidents at the system level and application level including connectivity issues, collect logs/evidence, drive root-cause analysis with resolver groups, and track remediation through to closure.
  • Participate in change and release processes for mainframe components and applications with the vendor-managed mainframe database service to ensure operational readiness, rollback plans, and post-implementation validation
  • Manage and govern the vendor providing mainframe database services, including SLA tracking, incident and problem escalation, change coordination, service reviews, and ensuring timely delivery of agreed actions and audit evidence
  • Support security/compliance activities on the platform by coordinating access reviews and privileged access processes (e.g., Top Secret/RACF), maintaining audit evidence, and responding to control/audit/regulatory requests in a timely manner

Your skills and experience

  • Relevant experience in Mainframe (IBM z/OS platform and the associated subsystems like TSO, CICS, DB2, IMS, Security, Network, File transfer protocols, Scheduling), Technology Operations and Mainframe Environment Support, including incident, problem, change, and service reporting in a 24x7 business-critical environment.
  • Working knowledge of other operating platforms like Unix, Tandem NonStop Guardian, TCP/IP Networking, Firewalls etc.,
  • Working knowledge of encryption at the hardware level (cryptography, Disk) and software level data in transit (File transfers), data at rest like DB2, IMS and VSAM concepts and tooling.
  • Understanding online and database subsystems (e.g., CICS, IMS, DB2) and the ability to partner effectively with application teams and system programmers during incidents and changes.
  • Experience with IT service management practices (ITIL) and ticketing tools; proven ability to run incident bridges, manage priorities, communicate clearly, and coordinate escalations with internal resolver groups and external vendors.
  • Experience with workload scheduling like OPC/TWS, automation tools like NetView and monitoring like Omegamon and comfort with operational reporting/analysis with desktop MS office.
  • Working knowledge of mainframe security and access controls (RACF, Top Secret) and experience supporting audits, evidence collection, and control attestation. Understanding of MFA (multi factor authentication in mainframe environment with AD, RADIUS, RSA etc.,
  • Understanding the TISO role in supporting Infrastructure NARs and the mainframe platform, following CSO guidelines, implementing secured Production environment with MFA and CyberArk toolset, Security event monitoring with Splunk and other CSO manged tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a continuous improvement mindset (automation/simplification where possible).

How we’ll support you

  • Training and development to help you excel in your career

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

title: EXECUTIVE, GENERAL PRACTITIONER REFERRAL
description:
1) GENERAL DESCRIPTION

The Executive (GP Focus) is responsible for supporting the Head of Business Growth & Marketing in achieving departmental objectives through targeted marketing activities aimed at General Practitioners (GPs). This role involves establishing and maintaining strong relationships with GPs, driving referrals, and promoting healthcare services to GPs within a defined catchment area. Additionally, the role may include duties as assigned by management from time to time.


2) JOB DESCRIPTION

GP Relationship Management & Engagement

  • GP Network Development
    Build, nurture, and maintain relationships with General Practitioners (GPs) in the local area (within a 10 to 20 KM radius). Act as the primary liaison between GPs and the hospital, facilitating communication and ensuring GPs are informed about hospital services and updates.
  • GP Visitations
    Conduct regular visits to GPs within the local catchment area to establish trust and strengthen referral pathways. Provide information about the hospital's specialist services, facilities, and any new healthcare programs.
  • GP Feedback & Issue Resolution
    Gather feedback from GPs regarding their experience with the hospital’s services, patient referrals, and any challenges they face. Work closely with internal departments (e.g., clinical, operations, billing) to address any issues or concerns raised by GPs.
  • GP Education & Support
    Organize informational sessions, workshops, or webinars tailored for GPs to keep them updated on new treatments, hospital capabilities, and specialist expertise. Ensure GPs are equipped with the necessary information to make referrals.

Marketing Support for GP Engagement

  • Promotional Materials for GPs
    Develop and distribute marketing materials, brochures, and informational content specifically designed for GPs, highlighting the hospital’s services and expertise.
  • Referral Program Development
    Work with the Head of Commercial & Marketing to create and implement a structured referral program that incentivizes GPs to refer patients to KPJ Klang Specialist Hospital. This may include organizing referral campaigns, loyalty programs, or educational sessions.
  • Targeted Marketing Campaigns
    Assist in the creation and execution of marketing strategies targeted specifically at GPs. This includes organizing events, seminars, and other engagement activities to raise awareness about the hospital’s services among the GP networks.
  • Performance Monitoring
    Monitor the performance of GP referrals and marketing initiatives. Track the number of patients referred by GPs and analyze data to evaluate the effectiveness of outreach efforts. Report findings to the Head of Commercial & Marketing.

New GP Recruitment & Network Expansion

  • GP Outreach & Recruitment
    Identify and target new GPs within the region who may not yet be part of the hospital’s referral network. Actively engage with these GPs to introduce the hospital’s services and establish long-term relationships.
  • Area Expansion
    Explore opportunities to expand the GP network beyond the immediate catchment area, especially in neighbouring districts where patient referrals can be increased.
  • Collaboration with GPs
    Work with GPs to develop collaborative programs or initiatives, such as shared health screening programs, wellness events, or preventive healthcare campaigns, to foster deeper engagement.

GP-Focused Event Coordination & Support

  • GP-Centric Events
    Plan, organize, and execute events specifically targeted at GPs. These may include clinical seminars, networking events, GP forums, and informational sessions that highlight the hospital’s capabilities and the expertise of its specialists.
  • Educational Workshops for GPs
    Coordinate educational workshops on key medical topics, hospital services, and healthcare advancements. Ensure these events align with the hospital’s strategic marketing goals and provide value to the GP community.
  • GP Conference Support
    Represent the hospital at GP conferences, medical fairs, and other healthcare events to promote KPJ Klang’s services. Coordinate hospital participation in these events and ensure promotional materials are available.

Internal Communication & Coordination

  • Cross-Departmental Collaboration
    Coordinate with the relevant departments (clinical, billing, operations, etc.) to gather all the necessary information for GP outreach efforts. Ensure GPs receive timely updates about treatment costs, specialist availability, and service improvements.
  • Internal GP Training Support
    Work closely with clinical teams to ensure that internal staff are knowledgeable about the GP referral process, enabling smooth collaboration between the hospital and GPs.
  • Competitor Analysis
    Monitor and gather information about competitors, specifically regarding how they engage with GPs. Report on competitors’ activities, promotions, and service offerings that may impact GP relationships.

Other Responsibilities

  • Actively participate in any new services or initiatives introduced by the organization to ensure smooth implementation and contribution to hospital growth.
  • Comply with all company policies, including health and safety policies, to maintain a safe and secure work environment.
  • Ensure conformance to all relevant policies and procedures, including ISO standards (ISO 22000:2005, ISO 9001:2008, ISO 14001:2004), OHSAS 18001:2007, HALAL requirements, and the Malaysian Hospital Accreditation Standards.
  • Always Adhere to Standard Service Practice (SSP) guidelines to ensure quality service delivery and patient care.
  • Ensure full compliance with all legal requirements related to hospital operations.
  • Uphold and implement processes that support the rights of patients and their families during care, regardless of age, race, language, religion, or social status.
  • Adopt and practice the Patient Safety Goals as recommended by the World Alliance for Patient Safety (2008), contributing to continuous safety improvement measures.
  • Perform any other duties as assigned by management to support the hospital’s operational and strategic goals.

3) JOB REQUIREMENT

  • Bachelor in Marketing, Business Studies/Management, Mass Communication or any related discipline.
  • Have interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Caring, honest, and responsible workers.
  • Willingness to work on schedule hours, shift and weekends, public holidays and anytime called during an emergency.
  • Passionate and commitment to patient centered care and continuous quality improvement.
  • High integrity, patience, and high attention to details.

title: Director - SN & Ent. Tools Operations Excellence
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.


Job Purpose


The ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools Service Operations Lead is responsible for ensuring the stable, compliant, and reliable operation of core systems and platforms within the ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools domain. The role oversees day-to-day platform operations and ensures that processes are followed, risks are managed, and changes are delivered safely. It maintains the operational performance of multiple platforms (e.g. ServiceNow), ensuring they meet agreed service levels and adhere to security and compliance expectations.

Operating at a senior level, the role provides leadership across operational teams, acts as the primary escalation point for platform issues, and partners with Product/Platform Owners, architects, engineering teams, and IT service functions to maintain platform stability and drive continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Provide operational leadership across core platforms, ensuring system stability, availability, and adherence to service levels, acting as the primary internal escalation point for product and domain teams on service performance and major incidents.
  • Govern incident, problem, change, configuration, and release processes for domain platforms, ensuring operational compliance with ITSM policies and control frameworks, and defining measurable outcomes for problem management (e.g., RCA closure time, recurrence prevention, defect trend reduction).
  • Define and maintain service readiness and runbook quality standards (e.g. ServiceNow Knowledge), ensuring escalation paths, support tasks, data handling, continuity steps, and deployment impacts are captured and validated before go-live.
  • Create and oversee service plans for new and enhanced products, coordinating with Product Owners, third-party partners, and platform/service teams to define SLAs, performance expectations, and support handover criteria.
  • Monitor platform performance, proactively identifying risks, trends, and recurring issues, and implement improvement actions to strengthen stability and user experience.
  • Coordinate with Platform Owners, engineering squads, solution architects, and service teams to ensure changes, integrations, upgrades, and releases are deployed safely and meet operational readiness standards.
  • Lead operational readiness assessments, ensuring documentation, support models, monitoring coverage, and non-functional controls are in place prior to deployment.
  • Own operational dashboards, KPIs, and reporting for the platforms, ensuring performance, risks, and issues are communicated to senior stakeholders.
  • Oversee root cause analysis for major incidents, ensuring sustainable fixes, clear remediation actions, and preventative measures are identified and delivered.
  • Maintain and continuously improve operational documentation, including runbooks, support procedures, configuration inventories, and architectural operational views.
  • Manage relationships with third-party vendors and managed service providers to ensure high-quality operational support and fulfilment of contractual obligations.

Education & Professional Qualifications


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Systems Engineering), or equivalent experience.
  • Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g., ITIL, Agile/Scrum, Service Management, DevOps Foundations)

Job Experience


  • Typically 18+ years of experience in platform operations (e.g. ServiceNow), system administration, service management, or technical delivery roles within complex environments.
  • Significant experience overseeing operational performance for multiple platforms or systems within a complex environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage ITSM processes, including incident, problem, change, release, and configuration management.
  • Proven ability to diagnose operational issues, lead root cause analysis, and drive sustainable improvements.
  • Experience coordinating with engineering, architecture, and product teams to ensure operational readiness and safe deployment of changes.
  • Experience producing and maintaining operational artefacts such as runbooks, support procedures, and readiness assessments.
  • Familiarity with operational KPIs, risk indicators, monitoring dashboards, and performance reporting.
  • Experience operating in Agile and/or DevOps environments supporting continuous delivery and operational stability.

Desirable Requirements


  • Operational oversight and ITSM governance for ServiceNow platforms – Provides senior oversight of day-to-day ServiceNow Platform & Enterprise Tools operations run by third parties, ensuring processes are followed, risks are managed, and changes are delivered safely so platforms remain stable, compliant, reliable, and within agreed service levels and security expectations.
  • Service readiness, runbook quality, and major incident management – Skilled at defining and enforcing standards for knowledge, runbooks, escalation paths, and support tasks, leading major incident response and ensuring safe deployments and service continuity.
  • Performance monitoring, RCA, and continuous improvement – Strong capability in owning operational dashboards, KPIs, and reporting, diagnosing recurring issues, leading root cause analysis, and driving sustainable remediation and trend reduction.
  • Cross-functional coordination for operational readiness and change – Proven ability to work with Platform Owners, architects, engineering squads, service teams, and third-party providers to ensure integrations, upgrades, and releases meet operational readiness standards.
  • Vendor and MSP relationship management for high-quality operations – Experienced in managing third-party vendors and managed service providers, ensuring contractual obligations, support quality, and operational performance expectations are met.

Preferred Skills:


  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, especially in complex operational scenarios.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to provide clarity during incidents and complex change cycles.
  • Strong understanding of security, compliance, and operational risk controls.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence without direct authority, and promote operational discipline.
  • Effective organisational skills, able to balance multiple priorities and manage time-sensitive escalations.

#AGTech


Skills

Capacity Planning, Cloud Based Services, Configuration Management (CM), Database Management, Disaster Recovery (DR), Financial Operations, Identity Access Management (IAM), Incident Management, Infrastructure Capacity Planning, IT Service Management (ITSM), Network Configurations, Network Troubleshooting, Operations Analysis, Performance Tuning, Platform Operations, Service Level Agreement (SLA), Services Management, System Administration, System Monitors, Technical Delivery, Vulnerability Management

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. title: Platform Engineer
description:
GM Performance Power Units - Concord, NC
Platform Engineer - Onsite
Job Summary
The Data Platform Engineer will develop, maintain and improve GMPPU’s enterprise data capabilities across business and manufacturing operations. The role is focused on hands-on delivery: engineering reliable data pipelines, developing Microsoft Fabric and OneLake, supporting agreed system data exchanges, and turning changing business requirements into sustainable technical solutions.
Working with the Business Systems Lead, application owners, software engineering, business analysts and functional stakeholders, the engineer will translate architectural direction into operational capability. This role is intended to provide dedicated engineering capacity so that enterprise architecture, strategic planning and stakeholder governance can remain with the Business Systems Lead.
Key Responsibilities

Develop and operate Microsoft Fabric and OneLake capabilities for business, manufacturing and finance data, including lakehouses, pipelines, notebooks and appropriate data processing services.
Build, test and maintain ingestion, transformation and publishing pipelines; implement reusable patterns and curated datasets for reporting, analytics and operational use.
Apply data modelling, orchestration, scheduling, error handling, reconciliation and performance optimisation to production data workflows.
Implement source control, deployment processes, monitoring, alerting, documentation and appropriate automated tests for platform changes.
Support secure access, environment configuration, capacity usage and cost awareness in collaboration with platform and security teams.
Engineer agreed data exchanges across ERP, PLM, MES and component lifecycle systems, including IFS, Teamcenter and RVG, in collaboration with system owners and the relevant integration/software engineering teams.
Translate interface requirements and source-to-target mappings into robust data extraction, validation and transformation processes, using approved APIs, events, connectors or scheduled transfers as appropriate.
Diagnose data flow failures, identify root causes and improve resilience, observability and supportability; escalate application-side issues to the accountable owners.
Support defined data exchange with specialist platforms, including Databricks and AWS, where business requirements justify it; avoid unnecessary duplication of datasets and processing.
Implement agreed data definitions, quality rules, lineage and reconciliation controls with business data owners and stewards.
Maintain technical data documentation, including mappings, pipeline specifications, dependencies and interface details, aligned with the enterprise data dictionary and architecture repository.
Apply enterprise standards for authoritative sources, access, security, change control and reusable engineering patterns.
Provide technical options, estimates and implementation advice to the Business Systems Lead; contribute to designs without owning overall enterprise architecture or business data policy.
Work directly with manufacturing, engineering, operations and finance stakeholders to understand emerging data needs and turn prioritised requirements into deliverable solutions.
Enable reliable data provision for Power BI and other approved consumption tools, working alongside reporting specialists rather than becoming the default report developer.
Improve existing manual data handling through automation and support testing, release, handover and continuous improvement of delivered solutions.
Balance new development with platform reliability, documentation and operational support.

Required Qualifications

Hands-on experience engineering data pipelines and operating cloud-based data platforms in a production environment.
Strong SQL and practical Python skills, with experience in data transformation, modelling and troubleshooting.
Experience with Microsoft Azure data services or Microsoft Fabric; ability to learn and apply Fabric rapidly where direct experience is limited.
Understanding of APIs, databases, integration patterns, data quality, access controls and data lifecycle management.
Experience using version control, testing, monitoring and structured deployment practices.
Ability to work independently with technical and non-technical stakeholders, explain trade-offs and document maintainable solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Data Factory, lakehouses, notebooks and Power BI semantic model integration.
ERP, PLM or MES data environments; familiarity with IFS, Siemens Teamcenter, RVG or equivalent enterprise applications.
Manufacturing data concepts such as part masters, bills of materials, serialization, as-built records, traceability and component lifecycle.
Dell Boomi or equivalent integration tooling; Databricks and AWS data exchange experience.
Automotive, motorsport or advanced manufacturing experience in a fast-changing delivery environment.

Success Measures

Become familiar with the existing business/manufacturing systems, current Fabric estate, key datasets and priority data flows.
Build or improve prioritised production data pipelines and reusable data processing patterns in Fabric.
Introduce practical monitoring, testing, documentation and support arrangements for the engineer’s delivered services.
Implement agreed quality and reconciliation controls for priority data elements and interfaces.
Deliver a small number of agreed business use cases end-to-end with stakeholders, with demonstrable reliability and handover.

Role Boundaries & Collaboration
The Business Systems Lead retains accountability for enterprise architecture, strategic platform direction, prioritization and stakeholder governance. Application owners retain accountability for their operational systems and transactional business processes. System-to-system integration ownership will be agreed by interface with the relevant software engineering and integration teams; this role contributes to technical engineering and delivery rather than assuming blanket ownership of all integrations. Business data owners and stewards remain accountable for definitions and data quality expectations.

Why Join Us
Ready to be part of a team that pushes boundaries both on and off the track? At GM Performance Power Units, we are developing a new era of performance for the Formula 1 grid. Joining us means entering a startup racing environment backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, giving you the rare opportunity to help build a world-class program from day one. We believe in rewarding innovation and powering potential. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a competitive and comprehensive package designed to support your performance, well-being, and future, helping you thrive at every level.
That includes access to:

Bonus scheme
Private healthcare
401(k) plan including company match
Employer-paid life insurance and disability coverage
32 days annual leave (including holidays)
Free financial advisor access
Employee Assistance Programs (EAP)
Subsidized on-site dining
On-site gym
Discounted GM vehicle purchase/lease program
Free on-site EV charging for personal GM vehicles

It’s all part of our commitment to creating a workplace that’s as high-performing and forward-thinking as the people who make it succeed.
Join us and help power what’s next.
You’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability and performance of a next-generation Formula 1 power unit. Our culture rewards precision, innovation, and the relentless pursuit of performance.

description:

title: Record Keeping Specialist
description:
At Rite-Hite, your work makes an impact. As the global leader in loading dock and door equipment, we design and deliver solutions that keep our customers safe, secure, and productive. Here, you’ll find innovation, stability, and the chance to grow your career as part of a team that’s always looking ahead.

Rite-Hite is seeking a detail-oriented Record Keeping Specialist to join our Order Administration team. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate customer, employee, and sales records within our Enterprise One system. You will process record additions and updates, maintain distribution lists and territory assignments, and provide administrative support to help ensure accurate information and efficient order processing across the organization.


What You'll Do


  • Process customer, salesperson, and employee record additions, updates, and maintenance requests in Enterprise One (JD Edwards).
  • Maintain accurate customer records, including account classifications, industry codes, salesperson assignments, and address information.
  • Create and update zip code territory assignments based on requests from Sales Management.
  • Update and correct customer records in partnership with Finance to support sales tracking initiatives.
  • Maintain distribution lists to ensure accurate delivery of automated documents, including order acknowledgements, invoices, and order status reports.
  • Work with Independent Representatives, Arbon Equipment, and internal teams to process record-related requests in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Provide backup support to the Distribution Administrative team with EDI processing as needed.
  • Assist the Order Administration department with additional projects and administrative tasks as assigned.

What You'll Bring


  • Associate's degree or 1–2 years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records and data.
  • Good organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple requests and priorities.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Basic math skills, including the ability to calculate percentages, discounts, and other business-related figures.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and follow written procedures, instructions, and business documentation.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with internal teams and business partners.

What We Offer

At Rite-Hite, we take care of our people – because when you’re supported, you can do your best work. Our benefits are designed to support your health, your future and your life outside of work:

  • Health & Well-being: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life and disability insurance. A robust well-being program with an opportunity to receive an extra day off and more.

  • Financial Security: A strong retirement savings program with 401(k), company match, and profit sharing.

  • Time for You: Paid holidays, vacation time, and personal/sick days each year.

Join us and build a career where you’re supported – at work and beyond.

Rite-Hite is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under federal, state, or local law. In accordance with VEVRAA, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for protected veterans. We are also committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace for the safety of our employees and customers.

title: Eläinlääkärin kesäsijaisuus 2027 - Seinäjoen Eläinsairaala
description:
Paikka: Seinäjoen Eläinsairaala
Aika: 1.5.-30.9.2027
Tehtävä: Eläinlääkärin kesäsijaisuus
Työsuhde: Kokoaikainen, määräaikainen

Etsimme eläinlääkärin sijaista ensi kesäksi 2027 Seinäjoen Eläinsairaalaan kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen ajalle 1.5.-30.9.2027.

Tarjoamme sinulle

Meillä saat ympärillesi lämpimän tiimin, perehdytyksen tehtäviin ja aidon kurkistuksen Seinäjoen Eläinsairaalan arkeen. Riippuen kokemuksestasi ja osaamisestasi, saat sijaistaa itsenäisesti tai kulkea toisen eläinlääkärin mukana. Meille on tärkeää, että kokemuksesi kesästä on hyvä ja että opit niitä asioita, joita toivot oppivasi. Kesän aikana pääset kartuttamaan kokemusta, josta on hyötyä opinnoissasi ja tulevalla urallasi. Kokeneet eläinlääkärimme ja klinikkaeläinhoitajamme ovat tukenasi koko kesän – kesäsijaisena et jää yksin.

Kesäsijaisena tarjoamme sinulle omien lemmikkien hoidon etuuden, rehuetuuksia sekä useita yhteistyökumppaneidemme tarjoamia etuja.

Tehtävän peruspalkkahaarukka on 3850-4150 €/kk. Peruspalkka määräytyy osaamisen ja alan työkokemuksen mukaan. Seinäjoen Eläinsairaala on päivystävä eläinsairaala, ja työ on vuorotyötä. Vuorotyöstä maksetaan lisät peruspalkan päälle.

Odotamme sinulta

Odotamme, että sinulla on eläinlääkärin praktiikkaoikeudet. Voit myös olla valmistunut eläinlääkäri. Odotamme sinulta myös tiimityöskentelyhenkistä ja positiivista otetta töiden tekemiseen sekä hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja. Aiempi työkokemus eläinsairaalassa tai -klinikalla nähdään etuna.

Lisätietoa tehtävästä antaa sairaalan johtaja Anumaria Keskinen, anumaria.keskinen@evidensia.fi

Paikka täytetään sopivan tekijän löydyttyä.

Seinäjoen Eläinsairaalassa työskentelemme joka päivä suurella sydämellä lemmikkien terveyden, hyvinvoinnin ja turvallisen hoidon eteen. Meiltä löytyy osaava ja jatkuvasti kouluttautuva henkilökunta sekä erityisosaamista. Olemme nykyaikaisesti varusteltu sairaala; Sairaalassamme on uudet hienot tilat, korkeatasoinen varustelu ja mahdollisuudet pitkälle vietyihin toimenpiteisiin ja diagnostiikkaan. Vastaamme mielellämme kysymyksiisi ja toivotamme sinut tervetulleeksi tutustumaan sairaalaamme!

title: Content Lead
description:
B2B Content Marketing Lead

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, strategic, and highly hands-on Content Lead to develop and execute our content marketing strategy, strengthen brand authority, and turn content into a measurable driver of business growth and qualified leads.

This role is ideal for a commercially minded content marketer who combines strong writing and content production skills with strategic thinking. You'll take ownership of the content function, from planning and creating content to distribution, performance tracking, and continuous improvement.

LinkedIn is our primary content channel, but you'll also work across website and SEO content, email marketing, case studies, thought leadership, sales enablement materials, and emerging formats such as webinars, videos, and podcasts.

You'll have the opportunity to shape and innovate our content approach, work closely with Australian-based leadership, including the Head of Growth Marketing and Chief Growth Officer (CGO), and manage and mentor one direct report.

Key Responsibilities

Content Strategy & Planning

  • Develop, own, and execute a content marketing strategy aligned with business objectives, brand positioning, and lead-generation goals.

  • Build and manage content roadmaps, editorial calendars, and integrated marketing campaigns.

  • Identify content opportunities across the customer journey, from awareness and consideration to conversion and retention.

  • Collaborate with Growth Marketing, Sales, and Client Success teams to ensure content supports commercial objectives.

  • Explore innovative content formats, channels, and approaches to strengthen audience engagement and brand authority.

Hands-On Content Creation & Execution

  • Personally create, write, edit, and manage high-quality content across multiple channels, including:

    • Organic LinkedIn posts and campaigns

    • Website copy, SEO blogs, and landing pages

    • Email marketing and nurture campaigns

    • Case studies, thought leadership, and sales enablement materials

    • Video, webinar, and podcast-related content

  • Maintain a consistent brand voice, messaging, and quality across all content.

  • Use AI-powered tools to streamline research, drafting, content repurposing, and optimisation.

  • Manage content production schedules and workflows to ensure timely delivery.

SEO, Distribution & Performance

  • Develop SEO-focused content initiatives, including keyword research, search intent, and content optimisation.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, designers, and external SEO or web agencies.

  • Support content distribution strategies to improve reach, engagement, and conversions.

  • Monitor and analyse content performance, including website traffic, LinkedIn engagement, audience growth, conversions, and lead generation.

  • Use data and insights to refine content strategies and improve business outcomes.

  • Identify opportunities to optimise existing content and scale successful initiatives.

Team & Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Manage, guide, and mentor a Digital Marketing & Communications Specialist.

  • Work closely with Australian-based leadership and cross-functional teams.

  • Balance strategic planning with hands-on execution while managing multiple priorities and stakeholders.

  • Provide regular updates and recommendations on content performance, opportunities, and improvements.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of content marketing experience, including exposure to B2B content marketing, preferably in a startup, scale-up, or high-growth environment.

  • Proven experience developing content strategies while remaining actively involved in writing, editing, and content production.

  • Excellent copywriting, editing, storytelling, and content development skills.

  • Strong experience creating and managing organic LinkedIn content, ideally for B2B audiences.

  • Experience producing multi-channel content, including blogs, website copy, email campaigns, case studies, and sales-related content.

  • Understanding of how content contributes to business growth, customer engagement, lead generation, and conversion.

  • Strong knowledge of SEO fundamentals, keyword research, and content optimisation.

  • Familiarity with content management and marketing platforms such as WordPress, HubSpot, or similar tools.

  • Confidence using AI tools to improve content quality, productivity, and efficiency.

  • Strong project management, organisational, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with Australian or international stakeholders.

  • Experience with SEO tools such as SEMrush.

  • Experience creating video-first content, webinars, podcasts, or other multimedia formats.

  • Previous experience managing or mentoring content or marketing professionals.

  • Experience using content analytics and campaign performance data to support commercial decisions.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Strategic but hands-on: You can develop a strong content strategy and personally execute it.

  • Commercially minded: You understand how content supports business growth and qualified lead generation.

  • Creative and proactive: You enjoy developing new ideas, experimenting with formats, and building initiatives from scratch.

  • Data-driven: You use insights and performance metrics to continuously improve results.

  • Collaborative and adaptable: You're comfortable working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications & Other Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field, or equivalent relevant qualifications.

  • Outstanding written and spoken English.

  • Full-time role based in Manila, working closely with Australian business hours.

What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days

Within your first three months, you'll be expected to:

  1. Develop an actionable content strategy and roadmap aligned with business priorities, brand positioning, and lead-generation objectives.

  2. Establish a consistent LinkedIn content program focused on improving audience engagement, brand visibility, and business opportunities.

  3. Strengthen content production workflows and deliver consistent, high-quality content across multiple channels.

  4. Build effective collaboration with Growth Marketing, Sales, Client Success, and other key stakeholders.

  5. Identify quick wins, test new content formats, and establish meaningful performance metrics to measure content effectiveness and commercial contribution.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to take real ownership of a growing content function, work directly with senior leadership, and help shape a content strategy that delivers measurable business results.

If you're an experienced content marketer who enjoys combining strategy, creativity, and hands-on execution, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and help turn content into a powerful driver of business growth.

title: Water Systems Operator
description:
Who we are

For more than 40 years, Reworld has been a leader in sustainable waste solutions, providing our customers with innovative solutions that help them achieve carbon-negative outcomes.

Our Vision

Reworld is leading the charge to a carbon-negative future through revolutionary sustainable materials management solutions that reduce, reuse, recycle and reimagine waste for the benefit of society and the environment.

Our Business

Reworld partners with businesses by offering cutting-edge engineering and innovative solutions, to help customers reduce, reuse, recycle and recover value from waste streams and meet or exceed their sustainability goals.

Our Value

Reworld's differentiator comes from our ecosystem of technology, facilities and partnerships, trusted by the world’s largest organizations to reimagine waste management for a smarter, more sustainable world.

All that we’re missing is you. Apply today!

About the role

As a Water Systems Operator, you will be responsible for the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of the boiler makeup and cooling water systems.

Position Responsibilities:

· Maintain the water system equipment including but not limited to cleaning strainers/baskets, replacing and repairing leaky fittings, assisting in changing our pumps, and maintaining clean Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

· Perform minor maintenance tasks and maintain reagent inventories; RE-Use systems, R/O and U/F, and various additional attached chemical systems.

· Coordinate and execute the off-loading procedures of all water treatment chemical deliveries.

· Monitoring boiler, steam, condensate chemistry, and water treatment equipment for performance to determine when things need to be cleaned, regenerated, and/or replaced.

· An Understanding of safety data sheets for all reagents and chemicals used in the daily performance.

· Keep chemical dikes and offloading trenches empty; maintain proper system logs, and periodic cleaning of raw water and RO heat exchangers.

· Understanding and following operating procedures for the system.

· Monitoring the demineralizers, pre-treatment, RO, and condensate polishing and circulating water systems.

· Must have excellent communication skills to effectively communicate with all shift personnel on the system status and operation.

· Perform testing of boiler water, steam, and cooling tower chemistry. Effectively complete preventive and proactive maintenance per the schedule to prevent breakdowns on equipment.

· Water washing, outage, and shift coverage support are also required.

· Additional duties as assigned to ensure safe and efficient facility operations.

Position Requirements & Qualifications:

· High School Diploma or equivalent

· Minimum of 3 years experience with high-pressure boilers and auxiliary systems. Previous water testing is a plus. Formal technical or utility training is preferred.

· Must have the ability to work a rotating shift schedule

Total Rewards & Compensation:

· Competitive Base Salary

· Day one employee benefits: competitive health insurance options, PTO, & retirement savings plan

Physical Demands of the Role:

· Ability to walk, stand, sit, and climb

· Ability to lift/carry 50lbs

· Ability to work from heights and in confined spaces

· Qualify to wear a full-face respirator

· Consistently work in various weather conditions

All Reworld positions require a candidate's ability to perform the duties and responsibilities of the role while upholding Reworld's Values, including (but not limited to) contributing to a safe and inclusive workplace, delivering results through trust, and building breakthrough capabilities.

Please note that Level, Title and/or Salary may be adjusted based on the applicant's experience or skills.

title: Compliance Auditor - Digitech - Remote
description:
The Sarnova Family of companies includes Digitech Computer, Bound Tree Medical, Tri-anim Health Services and Cardio Partners.

Digitech is a leading provider of advanced billing and technology services to the EMS transport industry. Since its founding in 1984, Digitech has refined its software platform to create a cloud-based billing and business intelligence solution that monitors and automates the entire EMS revenue lifecycle. Digitech leverages its proprietary technology to offer fully outsourced services that maximize collections, protect compliance, and deliver results for clients.

Summary:

The Compliance Auditor is responsible for conducting internal and external compliance reviews to ensure accurate EMS billing, regulatory adherence, and contractual compliance across a diverse client portfolio. This role performs recurring audits, supports third‑party review processes, and responds to investigative record requests from commercial and government payers. The position requires strong technical knowledge of ambulance billing, EMS clinical documentation, and Medicare/Medicaid regulations, along with the ability to manage detailed audit work while meeting strict deadlines.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Conduct monthly internal audits for clients with annual transport volumes exceeding 10,000 trips and quarterly internal audits for clients with lower transport volumes, in accordance with internal audit standards
Perform detailed back‑end reviews of billed claims to identify potential errors in manual or automated coding, QA review processes, or client documentation
Evaluate a representative sample of claims across all billed service levels by comparing account data to ambulance records, EMS protocols, and applicable Medicare and Medicaid regulations
Complete quarterly “medical necessity” audits for all clients by reviewing claims initially submitted as non‑covered or adjusted off, identifying potential clinical support that may justify billing
Return identified claims with potential medical necessity to QA or billing teams for further review and resubmission when appropriate
Facilitate third‑party Professional Claim Reviews required by client contracts or initiated at the client’s request, including preparing claim universes, gathering documentation, and securely transmitting records
Review draft third‑party audit reports, prepare rebuttals for disputed findings, and submit additional documentation and regulatory references to support appeals
Respond to time‑sensitive investigative record requests from Commercial payers, Medicare HMOs, and Medicaid HMOs, ensuring all requested documentation is complete and submitted by the required deadlines
Support on‑demand audits by organizing, reviewing, and securely transmitting records and assisting with follow‑up appeals when disallowed items are identified
Prepare detailed historical audit reports for clients with additional contractual audit requirements, including fee schedule validation, payment review, and regulatory compliance verification
Accurately document audit findings and maintain records to support compliance trends, reporting, and corrective actions
Manage competing priorities and adjust workflows as unexpected audit requests or special projects arise
Ensure consistent adherence to HIPAA regulations, internal compliance standards, and organizational policies
Additional job duties as assigned

Skills/Experience Required:

Education: High School Diploma or equivalent
Minimum of two years of recent, hands‑on EMS billing experience with strong exposure to multiple transport types and payer requirements
Extensive knowledge of ambulance coding, including all service levels and applicable modifiers
Strong working knowledge of CMS ambulance billing regulations, including medical necessity requirements, emergency and non‑emergency transport definitions, and payer‑specific billing guidance
Ability to interpret EMS run reports, including personnel credentials, treatments, procedures, and ePCR clinical documentation
Familiarity with EMS operational workflows, dispatch protocols, and documentation standards
Proven ability to identify documentation gaps, coding issues, or regulatory risks during claim review
Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and organizational skills
Ability to manage multiple audits simultaneously while meeting strict deadlines
Comfortable working independently while contributing effectively to a collaborative audit team
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and electronic document management, including compiling and managing PDF records and secure file transfers
