title: Senior/Principal Product Analyst - Corporate Functions
description:
About the Team:


Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

CGA & Corporate Secretariat Digital & Tech delivers digital solutions that support Corporate Government Affairs and the Corporate Secretariat. This team drives product roadmaps and manages platforms that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.


Job Purpose:

The Corporate Functions Product Analyst supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with both the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner, helping to shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The Corporate Functions Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the products supported.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner & partner with the business to realise product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.
  • Document as-is and to-be system processes, identifying opportunities for system, process, and workflow improvement, supported by impact analysis and basic data insights.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., security, performance, operability, accessibility), ensuring they are reflected in specifications and delivery plans.
  • Document functional, technical specifications needed to deliver new product, changes and support configuration or code delivery.
  • Support technical delivery teams by advising Developers and Test Analysts on expected system behaviour and acceptance criteria, informed by clear business and non-functional requirements.
  • Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
  • Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
  • Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
  • Support the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
  • Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).
  • Support the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner to identify and implement AI, automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
  • Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.
  • Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

Required Skills & Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
  • Business knowledge in a relevant functional domain & familiarity with associated technology platforms that enable them (e.g., IT, Internal & External Communications, Corporate Secretariat), with the ability to analyse business challenges using structured frameworks, model end-to-end processes (e.g., BPMN), and support delivery through familiarity with Agile practices (e.g., SAFe, Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
  • Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
  • Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
  • Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
  • Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g.Agile methodologies)


Preferred Skills:

  • Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
  • Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
  • Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
  • Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
  • Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.


Skills

Agile Kanban, Agile Methodology, Business Analysis, Corporate Secretarial Work, Documentations, Product Lifecycle, Product Ownership, Product Strategies, Requirements Gathering, Scrum (Agile), Sprint Planning, Stakeholder Management

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Senior Architect, Information Security, Azure
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.


Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.


How you will make an impact:


  • Experience and/or understanding of at least 3 cyber security domains (e.g., platform security, application security, network security, infrastructure, cloud security, data security and identity and access management).
  • Strong experience in designing secure Azure architectures across Landing Zones, networking (VNets, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Private Link, Front Door/WAF, DDoS Protection, hub-and-spoke/Virtual WAN), identity and RBAC (Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege) and data protection methods (Key management, encryption, TLS).
  • Experience with Azure Policy definition (initiatives, deny/audit effects, exemptions).
  • Strong understanding of Azure security, including workload protection across VMs, AKS, containers, App Service, Functions, storage, databases and AI workloads (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry).
  • Provide design and architecture guidance for enterprise level security initiatives, system integration, and tools within the Azure cloud security domain.
  • Develop defined information security best practices and architectural models to ensure compliance to enterprise-wide information security policies and standards.
  • Serve as the technical lead for enterprise class security initiatives.
  • Design and maintain secure architecture frameworks, patterns and Azure Policy guardrails for Azure solutions, including Landing Zones, networking, identity, RBAC and exposure management.
  • Serve as business liaison and lead advisor for multiple business units.
  • Working with customers throughout a delivery project life cycle from project management and architecture design to installation, configuration and documentation.
  • Stay abreast with the cyber security threat and solution landscape to bring innovative solutions to improve the Edwards security posture by continuously evaluating emerging threats.
  • Ability to present complex security concepts in a business-friendly language.
  • Incidental: Other duties as assigned by management

What you'll need (Required):


  • Bachelor's Degree in related field.
  • 12+ years of previous related experience in Information Security with solid performance in an architect role working with cross-functional teams.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience establishing security governance and guardrails with Azure Policy across enterprise Azure environments, complemented by designing secure architectures including Landing Zones, secure infrastructure and data access patterns, and logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, KQL).

What else we look for (Preferred):


  • Experience with CSPM/CNAPP platforms, exposure management, including attack-path analysis and prevention of public exposure of resources.
  • Understand cloud threats and mitigation techniques such as MITRE ATT&CK for Cloud and CIS Microsoft Azure Benchmarks.
  • Understand mitigating supply chain risks and attacks for cloud workloads and solutions.
  • Knowledge of cloud threat modeling with STRIDE methodology.
  • Experience with secure DevOps practices, including IaC (ARM, Bicep, Terraform).
  • Additional experience with infrastructure security of cloud platforms such as AWS and/or GCP, preferred.
  • Experience implementing industry good practices (e.g., NIST, ISO2700x, SANS) preferred
  • Certifications in related discipline preferred (e.g., CISSP, CCSP, Azure Security Engineer, Azure Cybersecurity Architect)
  • Proficient analytical and problem-solving abilities to identify and mitigate potential identity security risks.
  • Substantial knowledge and understanding of cybersecurity principles
  • Experience drafting technical documentation.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and customer focused skills.
  • Ability to interact professionally with all organizational levels and proactively escalate issues to appropriate levels of management in the organization.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strict attention to detail.
  • Good organization and time management skills.

title: Ruokapalveluvastaava, Vantaa
description:
Etsimme Vantaalle ruokapalveluvastaavaa huolehtimaan Kartanokosken koulun valmistuskeittiöistä. Tutustu ja jätä hakemuksesi tehtävään.

Työtehtävät

Ruokapalveluvastaavana huolehdit siitä, että Kartanokosken koulun ja päiväkodin oppilaat sekä henkilökunta saavat päivittäin maistuvan ja laadukkaan ruokailukokemuksen. Työskentelet kohteen omassa valmistuskeittiössä, jossa ruoka valmistetaan uunimetodilla.

Vastaat ruoanvalmistuksen lisäksi tilausten tekemisestä, ruokien esillepanosta, astiahuollosta sekä muista valmistuskeittiön päivittäisistä tehtävistä. Kohteesta toimitetaan päivittäin lounasta myös kahteen muuhun toimipisteeseen, joten työ tarjoaa sopivasti vastuuta ja monipuolisuutta.

Työskentelet osana ammattitaitoista ja hyvähenkistä tiimiä, johon kuuluu kokkeja, ruokapalvelutyöntekijöitä sekä astiahuoltaja. Arjessa jokaisella on omat vastuualueensa, mutta työtä tehdään joustavasti yhdessä toinen toista tukien. Kohteessa työskentelee myös esihenkilö, ja tukenasi toimii lisäksi alueen palveluohjaaja.

Pääset suunnittelemaan ja rytmittämään omaa työpäivääsi melko itsenäisesti annettujen aikataulujen puitteissa. Tässä tehtävässä yhdistyvätkin vastuullinen työote, toimiva tiimityö sekä mahdollisuus vaikuttaa oman työn sujuvuuteen.

Työtehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. Työajat sijoittuvat pääsääntöisesti arkipäiviin kello 7.00-16.00 välille.

Miksi meille?

Teemme Palmialla arjen palvelutyötä, jolla on suora vaikutus ihmisten jokapäiväiseen arkeen. Meillä olet osa kehittyvää, monipuolista ja osaavaa työyhteisöä, jossa avautuu säännöllisesti urapolkumahdollisuuksia esimerkiksi ruokapalveluvastaavasta ruokapalveluohjaajaksi. Työntekijöidemme urakehitystä tuemme tarjoamalla mahdollisuuden suorittaa ammattiosaamista tukevia oppisopimuskoulutuksia, kuten esimerkiksi lähiesihenkilötyön ammattitutkinnon.

Tarjoamme työsuhde-etuna Epassin, jota voit käyttää työmatka-, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointipalveluihin. Työterveyspalvelumme kattavat lakisääteisen työterveyshuollon lisäksi tuki- ja liikuntaelinsairauksien ja mielenterveyden sairauksien ennaltaehkäisevät palvelut.

Lue työnantajalupauksemme ja katso mitä ammattilaisemme kertovat työstään!

Menesty kanssamme

Edellytämme ruokapalveluvastaavaltamme aikaisempaa kokemusta vastuullisesta tehtävästä koulu- tai varhaiskasvatusympäristön ruokapalveluiden parista. Oletahan suorittanut sekä ravintola- ja cateringalan tutkinnon, että hygieniapassin. Tarvitset työssäsi erinomaista suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista osaamista, sekä vähintään perustasoisia IT- taitoja.

Arvostamme, että olet vastuuntuntoinen ja asiakaspalveluhenkinen ammattilainen. Katsomme eduksesi aikaisemman kokemuksen Aromi 14- järjestelmän käytöstä ja kaiken kartuttamasi osaamisen erikoisruokavalioiden parista.

Valitulta henkilöltä vaadimme voimassa olevan rikosrekisteriotteen (laki lasten- ja nuorten kanssa työskentelystä).

Kiinnostuitko?

Hae heti, sillä aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Hakuaika päättyy 6.12.2026. Huomioithan, että vastaanotamme hakemuksia ainoastaan sähköisen rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta. Emme käsittele sähköpostitse saapuneita hakemuksia.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat rekrytointitiimiltämme sähköpostitse osoitteesta rekrytointi@palmia.fi.

Ihmisten arjen sujuvaksi tekeminen on työtä, joka ei tule koskaan loppumaan. Palmia on merkittävä palvelualan toimija ja tarjoaa laajasti uramahdollisuuksia eri alojen tekijöille. Tarvitsemme jatkuvasti lisää ammattilaisia turvallisuus-, ruoka- ja ravintola-, siivous- sekä kiinteistö- ja talotekniikkapalvelujen tehtäviin. Tule meille jättämään oma kädenjälkesi!

Required Qualifications

  • Solid electronics engineering background with hands-on experience in hardware development, embedded systems, firmware development and product integration.
  • Strong project and program management capabilities, including planning, risk management, stakeholder management, scope control and execution within Agile and hybrid development environments.
  • Direct experience in IoT or connected product development, with a clear understanding of end-to-end solution development and delivery processes.

title: Senior Principal - Portfolio Value Realisation Manager
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.


Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.


Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Job Purpose


The Portfolio Value Realisation Manager ensures that the investments DPTF makes deliver measurable business value. The role operates the value framework. It defines how benefits are identified, baselined, measured and reported, ensures every funded initiative has a named benefit owner and a measurement schedule, and tracks realised outcomes against what was committed at the point of funding.


Benefit ownership sits with platform and product domain leadership. This role defines the method, secures the inputs, reports the position, and coaches and challenges benefit owners against the value they committed to. It works closely with the Investment & Portfolio Manager so that measurable outcomes are defined before funding, with the Technology Performance Manager so that value and performance are read together, and with Finance so that reported value reconciles with the financial picture.


Key Responsibilities

  • Operate the DPTF value framework, defining how benefits are identified, baselined, measured and reported across the portfolio.
  • Ensure every funded initiative has a benefit baseline, a named benefit owner in the domain, a measurement schedule and an agreed tracking method before funding is released.
  • Define the value KPIs and benefit OKRs against which investments and programmes are assessed, distinct from the delivery and service metrics owned by Technology Performance Management.
  • Measure and report realized business outcomes against committed benefits, capturing emergent value as well as variance to the original business case, and recommend the holding or release of funding tranches at stage-gates on the basis of realized value.
  • Track benefit delivery through and beyond initiative closure, so that value continues to be measured once delivery has finished.
  • Coach and challenge benefit owners in the platform and product domains against the value they committed to, holding them to it through evidence and transparency rather than direct authority.
  • Partner with the Investment & Portfolio Manager so that measurable outcomes and benefit profiles are defined at business case stage, not added once delivery is under way.
  • Provide value-based insight into portfolio prioritisation and re-prioritisation decisions, including where committed benefits are not being realised.
  • Work with Finance and Business Operations to reconcile claimed benefit against the financial position, so that value reporting withstands scrutiny.
  • Set the value measurement standards that federated Domain Portfolio Managers apply, so benefit data is consistent and comparable across domains.
  • Build value management capability across DPTF through guidance, templates and coaching, so that benefit ownership becomes embedded in the domains over time.
  • Use AI and analytics to accelerate benefit measurement, variance analysis and value reporting.

Experience Required

  • Overall 15+ Years of exp, typically 6-8 years in value or benefits management, portfolio management, investment planning, or business analysis roles within technology or digital functions.
  • Experience defining benefit baselines, measurement schedules and tracking methods across a portfolio of investments.
  • Demonstrated experience measuring and reporting realised outcomes against committed benefits, including where results fall short.
  • Experience defining KPIs and OKRs linked to business value rather than delivery activity.
  • Experience working with Finance to reconcile claimed benefit against the financial position.
  • Experience building capability in others through guidance, templates and coaching for benefit owners.
  • Familiarity with portfolio tooling and with AI-enabled analytics applied to benefit measurement and reporting.

Skills/Background


  • Strong analytical and financial literacy, able to interpret benefit, cost and value data and test whether claimed value is real.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to report an uncomfortable value position clearly and without apportioning blame.
  • Ability to coach and challenge senior stakeholders constructively and without formal authority.
  • Well organised, able to run recurring measurement cycles across a large portfolio.
  • Comfort operating where practice is immature and the method is still being established.

#AGTech


Skills

Agile Methodology, Benefits Management, Business Analysis, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Investment Planning, Portfolio Management, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. title: Associate Director, Service Ops Lead - People Services and Reward
description:
Job purpose:


  • Associate Director, Service Ops Lead - People Services and Reward is responsible for ensuring the stable, compliant, and reliable operation of select systems and platforms within the HR Digital & Tech domain. The role oversees day-to-day platform operations and ensures that processes are followed, risks are managed, and changes are delivered safely. It maintains the operational performance of multiple platforms (e.g. Workday), ensuring they meet agreed service levels and adhere to security and compliance expectations. The role also provides leadership across operational service teams and partner-delivered support services, ensuring effective service delivery, proactive issue management, continuous improvement, and strong coordination across business, technology, security, infrastructure, product, and vendor teams.
  • This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

Responsibilities:


  • Provide operational leadership across People Services and Reward platforms, ensuring system stability, availability, and adherence to service levels, acting as the primary internal escalation point for product and domain teams on service performance and major incidents.
  • Govern incident, problem, change, configuration, and release processes for domain platforms, ensuring operational compliance with ITSM policies and control frameworks, and defining measurable outcomes for problem management (e.g., RCA closure time, recurrence prevention, defect trend reduction).
  • Define and maintain service readiness and runbook quality standards (e.g. ServiceNow Knowledge), ensuring escalation paths, support tasks, data handling, continuity steps, and deployment impacts are captured and validated before go-live.
  • Create and oversee service plans for new and enhanced products, coordinating with Product Owners, third-party partners, and platform/service teams to define SLAs, performance expectations, and support handover criteria.
  • Monitor platform performance, proactively identifying risks, trends, and recurring issues, and implement improvement actions to strengthen stability and user experience.
  • Coordinate with Platform Owners, engineering squads, solution architects, and service teams to ensure changes, integrations, upgrades, and releases are deployed safely and meet operational readiness standards.
  • Lead operational readiness assessments, ensuring documentation, support models, monitoring coverage, and non-functional controls are in place prior to deployment.
  • Own operational dashboards, KPIs, and reporting for the platforms, ensuring performance, risks, and issues are communicated to senior stakeholders.
  • Oversee root cause analysis for major incidents, ensuring sustainable fixes, clear remediation actions, and preventative measures are identified and delivered.
  • Maintain and continuously improve operational documentation, including runbooks, support procedures, configuration inventories, and architectural operational views.
  • Manage relationships with third-party vendors and managed service providers to ensure high-quality operational support and fulfilment of contractual obligations.
  • Lead, mentor, and coordinate operational support teams and partner resources across areas such as service desk, platform support, infrastructure, cloud services, and application operations, ensuring clear accountability, timely delivery, and effective escalation management.
  • Collaborate with security, risk, compliance, infrastructure, product, and engineering teams to ensure access controls, data handling, cyber security requirements, operational controls, and compliance standards are embedded into day-to-day service operations.
  • Where required, support extended operational coverage, escalation, or on-call arrangements for critical incidents, major releases, or high-priority business events.

Required skills:


  • 15–19 years of experience in platform operations, enterprise application support, IT service management, system administration, or technical delivery within complex environments.
  • Strong experience supporting business-critical HR platforms such as Workday, Payroll, and Time systems.
  • Proven expertise in ITSM processes, including incident, problem, change, release, and configuration management.
  • Experience with enterprise tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps, monitoring, and knowledge management platforms.
  • Strong understanding of system integrations, cloud technologies, monitoring, security, access controls, compliance, resilience, and business continuity.
  • Proven ability to manage platform performance, troubleshoot operational issues, lead root cause analysis, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Experience partnering with engineering, architecture, and product teams to ensure operational readiness and safe deployment of changes.
  • Experience maintaining runbooks, support procedures, operational KPIs, risk indicators, dashboards, and readiness assessments.
  • Experience working in Agile/DevOps environments, supporting continuous delivery while maintaining platform stability.
  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience. ITIL, cloud, Agile/Scrum, or DevOps certifications are desirable.

Preferred skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, especially in complex operational scenarios.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to provide clarity during incidents and complex change cycles.
  • Strong understanding of security, compliance, and operational risk controls.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence without direct authority, and promote operational discipline.
  • Effective organisational skills, able to balance multiple priorities and manage time-sensitive escalations.
  • Strong leadership and coaching capability, with the ability to develop others, build collaboration, and create a high-performing service culture.
  • Strong vendor, stakeholder, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence outcomes and drive accountability across internal and external teams.
  • Ability to work flexibly across time zones and support critical service events, releases, or escalations where required.
  • Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and change


Skills

Configuration Management (CM), DevOps, Incident Management, IT Configuration Management, IT Service Management (ITSM), Major Incident Management, Microsoft Azure, Platform Operations, Workday Payroll

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

Partnering closely with HR business teams, we create solutions that simplify processes, enhance employee engagement, and enable strategic workforce planning. If you’re passionate about technology that empowers people, this is where you can make an impact.

Job Purpose:

The QA & Release Senior Manager is responsible for supporting quality assurance practices and coordinating release management activities across the HR Digital & Technology product portfolio. Working across all HR products, the role ensures that changes are tested to a consistent standard, release readiness criteria are met, and releases are coordinated and communicated effectively across product teams and stakeholders. The role supports the delivery of reliable, secure, and compliant changes by embedding quality activities throughout the delivery lifecycle and maintaining visibility of upcoming releases across the portfolio. Working closely with Product Owners, delivery teams, and service teams, the QA & Release Senior Manager helps ensure that quality is designed-in from refinement through to post-go-live, while supporting a structured and well-governed release process that protects service stability and business outcomes.


This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

Key Responsibilities:

Quality Assurance

  • Support the implementation of QA standards and test approaches across the HR product portfolio, ensuring functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing is carried out consistently across product teams.
  • Work with Product Owners and delivery teams to define acceptance criteria, test coverage expectations, and quality gates, ensuring requirements are testable and supported by clear pass/fail criteria.
  • Execute and coordinate test activities across product teams, including functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, and supporting user acceptance testing, ensuring defects are clearly documented and triaged.
  • Apply risk-based testing approaches to prioritise effort across critical services, high-transaction workflows, regulated processes, and cross-product integrations, escalating quality risks to senior stakeholders where required.
  • Support the adoption and maintenance of test automation, contributing to automated regression, API testing, and data integrity checks, and ensuring test scripts are maintained and reusable across releases.
  • Ensure non-functional requirements (performance, security, accessibility, operability) are clearly defined and tested prior to release, partnering with Security, Risk, and Compliance teams where required.
  • Manage defect lifecycle processes, ensuring issues are logged, triaged, prioritised, and tracked through to resolution, and that defect trends are analysed to inform continuous improvement.

Release Management

  • Maintain and coordinate the release calendar across the HR product portfolio, ensuring all product teams have visibility of upcoming releases, dependencies, and sequencing.
  • Support release readiness assessments by coordinating release checklists, confirming test completion, gathering signoffs, and ensuring documentation (release notes, runbooks, rollback plans) is complete and accurate prior to deployment.
  • Coordinate release communications across product teams, business stakeholders, and Service Operations, ensuring impacted parties are informed of release scope, timing, and any known risks or workarounds.
  • Support change control processes, ensuring releases follow required governance and approval workflows and that evidence of testing, risk assessment, and stakeholder sign-off is documented and auditable.
  • Support go-live and hypercare activities, monitoring for release-related incidents, coordinating triage across product teams, and ensuring issues are escalated and resolved in a timely manner.
  • Documents and tracks release outcomes and contribute to post-release reviews, capturing lessons learned, analysing release success rates, and identifying opportunities to improve release processes and reduce release-related incidents.
  • Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

Required Skills & Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, Information Technology, Project/Programme Management, or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of experience working in QA, testing, release management, or delivery support roles within technology or digital environments.
  • Experience executing and coordinating test activities including functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing across one or more platforms or products.
  • Experience supporting or coordinating release processes, including release scheduling, readiness assessments, and release communications.
  • Familiarity with defect management processes, including logging, triaging, and tracking defects through to resolution.
  • Exposure to test automation approaches, including contributing to or maintaining automated regression or API test scripts.
  • Awareness of change control, governance, and compliance requirements within enterprise environments.
  • Experience working within agile or product-based delivery environments and contributing to iterative planning, testing, and release practices.
  • Experience working across multiple teams or workstreams, coordinating testing or release activity to support aligned delivery.
  • Professional certifications desirable (e.g., ITSM, etc).

Preferred Skills:

  • Strong attention to detail, able to identify, document, and communicate defects and quality risks clearly and accurately.
  • Good communication skills, able to coordinate across multiple product teams and communicate release schedules, readiness status, and quality findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Organised and structured in approach, able to manage multiple concurrent testing and release activities, maintain accurate documentation, and track progress across product teams under time pressure.
  • Developing analytical skills, able to identify defect trends, assess test coverage, and contribute insights that support continuous improvement in quality and release practices.
  • Comfortable working in a matrixed environment, building relationships across product teams and coordinating activity without direct line authority.
  • Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and change


Skills

Knowledge Management, Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP), Penetration Testing, Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Assurance Analysis, Regression Testing, Release Management, Scripting, Test Automation Framework, Test Case Design, Test Management Tools, Tool Selection, User Acceptance Testing (UAT)

title: AI Applied Engineer (LLM)
description:
About Us

At Framna, we partner with ambitious brands to create digital products that make a meaningful impact.

We work across the full product journey, from strategy and UX to engineering and long-term growth, combining technical expertise with a strong product mindset. Together with our partners, we build solutions that users rely on every day.

Our culture is built on trust, ownership, and fearless collaboration. We challenge ideas, support each other, and keep learning-openly sharing feedback, staying flexible in how we work, and approaching each other with empathy. Because the best products are created by teams that move forward together.

About the Role

This role sits at the intersection of Applied AI Engineering and practical AI Research, with a very strong emphasis on prompt engineering, experimentation, and model evaluation.

While strong programming skills are required, your primary focus won't be building traditional business logic or infrastructure. Instead, you will concentrate on experimenting with off-the-shelf Large Language Models, designing and optimizing prompts, and systematically evaluating the quality of the outputs.

Your core responsibilities will include selecting the right models and methods, designing experiments, analyzing errors, and iteratively improving the accuracy of AI solutions used for document processing and data extraction.

You will be working on an AI-powered SaaS platform that automates every stage of the KYB process.

Preferred Skills & Qualifications

  • At least 7 years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or similar including at least 2 years developing and maintaining LLM-based solutions in production.

  • Hands-on experience evaluating LLMs: building ground-truth datasets, choosing metrics that fit the task (e.g. precision, recall, field-level accuracy), conducting deep-dive error analysis, and proving with data that a change genuinely improves the system rather than fixing one case and breaking others.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and practical experience integrating and working programmatically with LLM APIs to solve real-world business problems.

  • Proven experience designing, testing, and optimizing prompts, including working with structured outputs and mitigating hallucinations.

  • A research-driven way of working: faced with a new problem, such as a classification or extraction task, you can set a baseline, formulate hypotheses, design structured experiments, and benchmark models and approaches on measurable outcomes.

  • Hands-on experience extracting and classifying data from unstructured sources such as PDFs, scans, web pages and complex multi-language documents, ideally with multimodal (vision) LLMs. Strongly preferred.

  • Solid understanding of model uncertainty, output validation, and data traceability - specifically linking extracted information back to its exact source within a document.

  • Strong awareness of AI unit economics, latency, and throughput, with the ability to make informed model choices and optimize trade-offs (e.g., vision/image processing vs. text extraction).

  • Proven ability to work independently at a senior level with full ownership - taking initiatives from problem identification and experimentation through to implementation and final evaluation.

  • Strong command of Polish & English (both written and spoken).

What you will find at Framna

  • Real ownership and influence on the products you build

  • A focus on business value over technical perfection

  • Continuous feedback and open, honest communication

  • Regular 1:1s and a mentoring program to support your growth

  • Internal workshops and knowledge sharing across teams

  • Flexible working hours (you can start between 7:00–10:00)

  • Hybrid model with regular in-studio collaboration (Gdańsk, Wrzeszcz)

  • High-quality equipment, including MacBook and testing devices

  • Individual training budget

  • English classes in small groups

Plus the essentials:

  • Private medical care (Compensa) and MultiSport

  • Team gatherings and shared moments beyond work

If you are motivated by ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement, and you enjoy solving real problems with a team you can rely on - you will feel good at Framna.

Let’s build impactful products together.

You’ll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way.

Job Description

We are looking for a Tax Associate to join our Global Mobility team. This is an opportunity to build your career in international taxation, working with multinational clients and collaborating with colleagues across our global network.


What You’ll Do

As part of our Global Mobility team, you will support clients in managing the tax and social security aspects of their international workforce. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting multinational companies and their employees with tax matters arising from international assignments and cross-border employment.
  • Assisting with the preparation and review of individual income tax returns, ensuring accuracy and compliance with relevant regulations and deadlines.
  • Helping assess the local and international tax and social security implications of employee mobility.
  • Supporting the application of international tax treaties and the analysis of tax equalisation and tax protection arrangements.
  • Contributing to the review and implementation of global mobility policies and processes.
  • Researching tax and social security matters and preparing supporting analyses, reports and client documentation.
  • Assisting with tax calculations, compensation reviews and cost projections related to international assignments.
  • Coordinating with Vialto colleagues in other countries to support clients with cross-border matters and ensure a consistent approach.
  • Working alongside our compliance teams to help deliver accurate and timely services to clients.
  • Exploring technology-enabled tools and solutions that help improve the way we work and deliver services.


What You’ll Bring

We are interested in meeting candidates who are curious, analytical and motivated to develop their expertise in international taxation.

You will ideally have:

  • A degree in any related field, preferably with an interest in taxation.
  • 1–3 years of experience in tax, accounting or professional services. Recent graduates with a strong interest in Global Mobility are also encouraged to apply.
  • An understanding of Chinese tax principles; previous exposure to international taxation or social security matters will be an advantage.
  • Good written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate in an international environment.
  • Strong analytical and research skills, together with attention to detail.
  • Good organisational skills and the ability to manage different priorities and deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.
  • A collaborative and proactive mindset, with a genuine willingness to learn and take on new challenges.


What You’ll Gain at Vialto

Joining Vialto means becoming part of an international team where you can learn from experienced professionals and gain exposure to a wide range of mobility and tax matters.

You will have the opportunity to:

  • Develop your knowledge of Chinese and international taxation through practical, hands-on experience.
  • Work with multinational clients and gain exposure to complex cross-border situations.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across different countries and areas of expertise.
  • Build your technical, analytical and client-facing skills through ongoing learning and development.
  • Explore how technology and innovative solutions are shaping the future of Global Mobility.
  • Grow your career within a global business specialising in mobility services.

Additional Information

Location: Guangzhou, China
Work Model: In Office

title: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Seattle, WA
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it take to do the job!


As a Field Property Adjuster, you will deliver exceptional service to our policyholders by traveling to customers' homes to perform on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly. You may also handle virtual claims using tools such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. This role has a strong focus on water losses, as well as other perils such as minor fire, wind/hail, and miscellaneous property claims, ensuring customers receive expert guidance and resolution during challenging situations.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:


  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Reside north of the Seattle, WA area.
  • 3+ years of experience in property adjusting, water mitigation, or independent adjusting, along with estimating.
  • Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.
  • Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.
  • This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:


  • Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.
  • Residency within the northern Seattle, WA area is mandatory for this role.

You’re provided with comprehensive training:


  • The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work
  • Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job

** Please note, you will be required to attend 2-weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX **

Notice of Licensing Requirement:


  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Sign On Bonus:


  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

**Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:


Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:


Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

#LI-DL1

Active Listening, Communication, Critical Thinking, Customer Service, Insurance Claims, Multitasking, Organizing, Time Management, Working Independently, Xactimate

Compensation offered for this role is $68,000 - $113,000 and is based on experience and qualifications.

title: Lead Data Analyst
description:
About Fussy

Hey good smelling! We’re Fussy…about everything in our mission to banish single-use plastic from your bathroom. Having experienced exceptional growth over the past five years, we are now looking for a talented individual to join the team as Lead Data Analyst.

You’ll report to Mary, our CFO and work together to support and empower users across the business to use data to unlock insights. This is an exciting opportunity to join a scale-up through a significant period of growth. You’ll be a trusted partner to the leadership team and a champion for data led decision making! 💪🌍

What you’ll be doing 💼

  • Lead our data strategy at Fussy, championing data literacy and driving our data roadmap

  • Embed with teams (Growth, Marketing, Ops) to understand their goals and translate business questions into data requirements and analysis.

  • Develop and maintain reporting dashboards to track key business KPIs (Experience with DTC/E-commerce metrics: LTV, CAC, Retention Cohorts, and Attribution models)

  • Become an expert on our data and visualisation tool and using your knowledge to upskill others

  • Own, maintain and improve our data stack alongside our analytics engineer

  • Ensure the reliability and integrity of our data across all touch points, keeping data flowing to all business users and leading our data governance agenda.

  • Work with department leads to define and standardise KPIs, ensuring everyone is looking at a single source of truth.

While your primary focus will be on delivery and stakeholder alignment, you will work closely with our analytics engineer to contribute to our modern data stack, levelling up your technical skills toward Analytics Engineering.

Who you are 🤓

We’re big believers that great talent comes in all shapes, sizes and CVs. So if you’re excited by our mission, we want to hear from you. That said, we think you’ll smash this role if you bring the following skills:

Essential

  • At least 5 years experience in a dedicated Data or BI role, ideally within e-commerce, DTC, or international omni-channel businesses.

  • BI Tool Proficiency: (We use ThoughtSpot) Advanced experience with modern BI platforms (e.g., Looker/Look ML, ThoughtSpot, Tableau). You should know how to build more than just "pretty charts"—you will need to build functional, interactive tools.

  • AI literacy: you use AI tools to make your analysis faster and more repeatable

  • Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of translating vague business questions into concrete data requirements and KPIs.

  • Commercial curiosity with the ability to link data insights to business outcomes

  • Excel/Google Sheets: Still a staple for quick-turnaround ad-hoc analysis.

  • SQL: Confident using SQL to analyse data and draw insights

Nice to have

  • Cloud Data Warehousing: Familiarity with one of Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.

  • Analytics Engineering Exposure: Basic understanding of dbt or version control (Git)

  • The Modern Data Stack (MDS): Awareness of how data moves from source to warehouse to BI (Fivetran, Airbyte, etc.)

What we offer 🤝

We’re pretty proud of what we’ve built so far, and we know it’s the people who’ll get us where we’re going. Here’s what you’ll get:

  • A chance to say you helped save the planet, and smelt great doing it!

  • A salary of £70-80,000 depending on experience

  • Hybrid working with Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays in our Central London office

  • 33 days annual leave including flexible bank holidays + a day off for your birthday – we encourage you to take time off to switch off, rest and recharge.

  • Our WellHub membership with a range of fitness & wellbeing options - we care about our team’s wellness, from physical to mental health

  • Share options after probation - we grow, you grow.

Who we are 💪🌍

Fussy are on a mission to banish single-use plastic from the bathroom by designing simple, effective and convenient personal care products that are backed by science not buzzwords. Our first product, a refillable deodorant is now the UK’s top rated natural deodorant and has blessed the armpits of everyone from Holly Willoughby to some very well-known Dragons’. We have put in place the foundations of a world-class team of employees and advisors and this is a super exciting time to join as we are now looking to accelerate our growth into new products and territories. We as a brand have the responsibility, consumers have the power and it’s only together we can do this. Power to your pits!

title: Director, IBCM India
description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Director, IBCM India

Location: The Capital, Mumbai

Role Description

Deutsche Bank’s India IBCM team advises corporates and financial sponsors on strategic transactions, and capital raising opportunities.

We are seeking a Director to play a key role in originating and executing M&A transactions, in addition to supporting on LevFin and Capital Markets transactions. Based in Mumbai, the successful candidate will originate deals in HC/ FIG sectors by leveraging their client relationships, lead transaction execution and work closely with sector, product, and regional teams to deliver integrated advisory and financing solutions.

Key responsibilities

  • Drive origination by identifying opportunities, developing transaction ideas, and leading the preparation and delivery of client pitches in HC/ FIG sectors
  • Leading end-to-end execution of M&A transactions, overseeing transaction strategy, valuation, financial analysis, due diligence, negotiations and closing
  • Build and deepen relationships with corporates, financial sponsors, and other key stakeholders, positioning Deutsche Bank as a trusted strategic advisor
  • Work closely with sector and product teams on LevFin and Capital Markets opportunities, connecting clients with relevant advisory and financing capabilities
  • Serve as senior day-to-day contact for clients and coordinate with counterparties, legal counsels, and other advisors throughout the transaction lifecycle
  • Provide commercial judgement and analytical oversight across financial models, valuation analysis, and client materials
  • Lead and mentor junior bankers ensuring high-quality output, effective delegation, and strong execution discipline
  • Maintain rigorous standards of risk management, compliance and internal governance across origination and execution activities

Your skills and experience

  • Approx 11-12+ years of relevant investment banking experience in HC/ FIG sectors, with a strong track record of end-to-end M&A execution
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex transactions and manage multiple workstreams, deal teams and stakeholders
  • Strong commercial judgement, with the ability to translate sector insights and financial analysis into actionable strategic advice
  • Experience building senior client relationships and contributing to origination and business development
  • Strong technical capabilities in financial modelling, valuation, and transaction structuring
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the confidence to engage senior corporate executives, financial sponsors, and advisors
  • A collaborative, proactive approach with a strong sense of ownership and a commitment to developing junior talent
  • MBA or CA qualification

What we offer

Our benefits include

  • Competitive leave policy and gender-neutral parental leave
  • Childcare assistance, including 100% reimbursement in accordance with policy
  • Support for relevant professional certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive hospitalization insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and term life insurance
  • Complementary Health screening for employees aged 35 and above

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Fare Inspection Officer (Part Time)
description:
Join UTA's Fare Inspection team and play a key role in supporting a safe, fair, and welcoming transit system for thousands of riders each day. This position combines customer service, problem-solving, and policy enforcement, making a direct impact on the rider experience across our network.


As the Fare Inspection Officer, you will:

  • Perform duties related to passenger compliance, enforcement of fare policies, and enforcement of other applicable regulations and policies.
  • Maintain the integrity of the fare system and provide excellent customer service by enforcing ordinances and by-laws pertaining to fare inspections and other issues in a consistent, non-discriminatory manner.
  • Answer customer inquiries and maintain a courteous and friendly demeanor with all customers.
  • Appear before a Hearing Officer to present evidence and testimony regarding issued citations and/or other related issues.
  • Notify appropriate personnel of emergency situations at platforms or park-and-ride lots, requesting additional instruction or assistance as required.

This is a part-time position with a scheduled shift of either Monday–Wednesday, 5:00 AM to 1:00 PM, or Wednesday–Friday, 5:00 AM to 1:00 PM. Shift assignments are determined through a bid process based on seniority


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION/TRAINING/LICENSES

  • High school diploma required or equivalent.
  • Ability and willingness to enforce all rules and procedures applying to the riding public, and to deal effectively with people, situations and circumstances.
  • Two years in a customer service role providing face-to-face instructions and clarifying information, with demonstrated ability to solve problems and resolve customer inquiries.
  • Possesses a valid Utah Driver’s License, with no more than 4 moving violations in the past 3 years.
  • Cannot have more than 1 violation of driving under the influence of alcohol, any drug, or the combined influence of any alcohol or any drug within the last 10 years.
  • Training in CPR and emergency preparedness is a plus.

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

  • Must be able to complete and pass required training program by the end of probation period.
  • Strong personal and problem solving skills, to be informative, patient, tactful, diplomatic, respectful, unbiased and ethical.
  • Ability to:
    • Communicate with supervisors and customers and maintain good customer relations, both directly and over the phone/radio.
    • Read and understand training materials, enforcement policies, rules and regulations, and safety rules/directives.
    • Prepare legible written reports of incidents.
    • Work independently without supervision.
    • Perform the physical requirements of the job to include constantly walking and standing, maintaining stability while walking to include stairs on a moving train or bus, opening/pushing doors between rail cars, and working in inclement weather.
    • Conduct respectful, effective face-to-face communication with members of the public who can sometimes be hostile and abusive.
  • Ability to speak a second language is a plus.
  • May be required to work varying hours and/or shifts, including weekends, evenings and holidays.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.

- OR -

An equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

[UTA reserves the right to determine the equivalencies of education and experience.]


Pay Rate: $18.13 per hour

If interested, apply before: Monday, November 30th, 2026 @ 11:59 PM MST


As a part-time Administrative Employee, your Total Rewards Benefits Package will include:

  • 11 days of paid time off (6.5 vacation days and 4.5 sick days). Increase in paid time off with tenure at UTA.
  • 10 paid holidays and two (2) floating holidays per year.
  • Training, development, and career advancement opportunities.
  • Employee assistance program – includes counseling, legal services, financial planning, etc.
  • 457 Contribution Plan, available for immediate contributions and company matching.
  • Free transit passes for employees, their spouses, and their dependent children.
  • UTA Well – a comprehensive wellness program designed to support employees and dependents in their health and wellness goals.
  • Free on-site fitness facilities and discounted membership to VASA Fitness and EoS Fitness.
  • Discounted cell phone plans with T-Mobile and AT&T.
  • Pet insurance plan options (tailored plan coverage based on pet’s health and needs).

PM21

Utah Transit Authority is an Equal Opportunity Employer of all persons regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, covered veterans, sexual orientation, and gender identity. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply. Applicants needing an accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act for any part of the application process should contact UTA Human Resources at 801-287-2324. A minimum of two work days' notice prior to the need for the accommodation is required.

Utah Transit Authority is a drug-free workplace, subject to federal drug and alcohol testing regulations under 49 CFR Part 40, 655, and 219. All offers for employment are contingent upon a successful pre-employment drug test. If a pre-employment test returns a non-negative result, an application for employment may be rejected. All employees are subject to reasonable suspicion and post-accident testing for drug and alcohol use. All safety sensitive employees are subject to random testing for drug and alcohol use.

title: Associate Managing Director
description:
Make your next move an expert one.

At Colliers it’s not our success that sets us apart, it’s how we achieve it. Our people are passionate, take ownership and always do what’s right for our clients, people and communities.

Why Colliers?

Our enterprising environment needs your expertise to facilitate Colliers’ continued growth as an industry leader. Our nimble, decentralized culture can provide you with a wealth of opportunities to learn about our business and quickly gain experience to accelerate your career.

**This position is a hybrid role based out of the local office **


Purpose of Position


The Associate Managing Director is responsible for supporting the leadership, growth and overall performance of the Valuation & Advisory Services practice within an assigned market or specialty. The position combines valuation expertise, client relationship management, business development and team leadership while maintaining responsibility for delivering high-quality valuation and advisory assignments.


Essential Functions & Job Duties


Leadership & Operations

  • Support the strategic direction and day-to-day operations of the local Valuation & Advisory Services practice.
  • Provide leadership, mentorship and technical guidance to valuation professionals.
  • Assist with recruiting, onboarding, training and development of appraisal professionals.
  • Monitor workloads, workflow and assignment execution to ensure client deadlines and quality standards are achieved.
  • Collaborate with regional and national Valuation leadership on business objectives and operational initiatives.

Valuation & Advisory

  • Prepare, review and oversee complex commercial real estate appraisal and consulting assignments.
  • Provide technical valuation expertise across applicable property types and specialty practices.
  • Ensure appraisal reports comply with applicable professional standards and client requirements.
  • Maintain knowledge of current market conditions, valuation methodologies and industry trends.

Client Relations & Business Development

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
  • Identify opportunities to expand client relationships and generate new valuation and advisory assignments.
  • Participate in business development presentations, proposals and client meetings.
  • Leverage relationships within Colliers to identify cross-service opportunities.
  • Represent the organization within relevant commercial real estate and professional organizations.

Financial & Business Performance

  • Support achievement of office revenue and profitability objectives.
  • Monitor assignment pipelines, production levels and business-development activity.
  • Assist leadership with forecasting, budgeting and business planning.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and practice growth.

Required Education, Experience & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in real estate, Finance, Business, Economics or related field preferred.
  • Approximately 8-12+ years of commercial real estate valuation/appraisal experience appropriate for a senior leadership role.
  • MAI designation
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and reviewing complex commercial real estate valuations.
  • Proven client relationship and business-development capabilities.
  • Demonstrated leadership, mentoring and team-development skills.
  • Strong financial, analytical and commercial real estate knowledge.
  • Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to oversee multiple assignments and priorities simultaneously.

title: Rating Analyst
description:
The next part of your journey is right around the corner — with The Standard.

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

Job Summary


The Rating Analyst supports the underwriting process by analyzing broker-submitted bid specifications and existing plan designs to determine appropriate product options and pricing. This role applies sound business and underwriting judgment to evaluate routine insurance risks, calculate rates, and release binding proposals for basic cases. The Rating Analyst partners with underwriters on complex cases, contributes to key projects and business initiatives, and delivers responsive service through effective collaboration and communication with internal and external stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities


  • Analyze and evaluate broker-submitted specifications and existing plan designs to identify requested products, plan structures, and coverage options.
  • Apply underwriting guidelines and business judgment to determine appropriate plan designs, product options, census formatting, and calculated rates.
  • Prepare and release binding proposals for routine insurance risks in accordance with established business rules and underwriting authority.
  • Provide underwriting and rating support for large and complex cases, ensuring accuracy and adherence to company standards.
  • Collaborate with sales, service, and home office teams to deliver responsive customer service, resolve issues, and support strategic projects and business objectives.

Skills and Background You’ll Need


Education: Associate degree required. Bachelor’s degree preferred.

Experience: 2 years of experience applying critical thinking, analytical evaluation, and decision-making experience.

  • Strong analytical and decision-making skills with the ability to interpret information and identify solutions.
  • Ability to perform accurate mathematical calculations, including basic algebraic formulas.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Customer-focused approach with a commitment to delivering high-quality service.
  • Ability to apply underwriting guidelines, contract provisions, and applicable insurance regulations.
  • Experience in insurance, underwriting, rating, benefits administration, or a related analytical role; ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders.

Key Behaviors of a Successful Candidate


  • Driving Success: Acts with urgency, pursues ambitious goals and shows resilience in the face of obstacles and setbacks.
  • Adaptability: Sees possibilities in changing circumstances, accepts and understands change and alters behavior as necessary.
  • Customer Focus: Understands and anticipates both internal and external customer needs and develops customer-inspired solutions that exceed expectations.

Why Join The Standard?

We have built an enduring legacy of stability, financial strength and exceptional customer service through the contributions of the service-oriented people who choose to work at The Standard. To ensure we can attract and retain the best talent, when you join The Standard you can expect:

  • A rich benefits package including medical, dental, vision and a 401(k) plan with matching company contributions

  • An annual incentive bonus plan

  • Generous paid time off including 11 holidays, 2 wellness days, and 8 volunteer hours annually — PTO increases with tenure

  • A supportive, responsive management approach and opportunities for career growth and advancement

  • Paid parental leave and adoption/surrogacy assistance

  • An employee giving program that double matches your donations to eligible nonprofits and schools

In addition to the competitive salary range below, our employee-focused benefits support work-life balance. Learn more about working at The Standard.

  • Eligibility to participate in an incentive program is subject to the rules governing the program and plan. Any award depends on a variety of factors including individual and organizational performance.

The actual compensation for this role will be based on a combination of education and experience, knowledge and skills, position budget, internal equity, and market data.

Salary Range:

23.56 - 31.49

Positions will be posted for at least 5 days from original posting date.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability or veteran status or any other condition protected by federal, state or local law. title: Capio Psykiatri söker legitimerad sjuksköterska med inriktning psykiatri
description:
Om oss

Capio psykiatri Skåne söker sjuksköterskor med erfarenhet från psykiatri till Helsingborgs allmänpsykiatriska mottagning för vuxna. Vården sker enligt avtal med Region Skåne, det betyder att samma villkor gäller som i den offentliga vården.

Din roll

Arbetet som sjuksköterska hos oss innebär att självständigt arbeta med bedömningar, stödsamtal, hälsofrämjande samtal, undersökningar, provtagningar och behandlingar av patienter.

Vi erbjuder även olika typer av gruppverksamhet för våra patienter. Om du har en särskild kompetens, ett specialområde eller ett särskilt intresse är vi lyhörda och intresserade av att ta fram eller utveckla fler gruppverksamheter som möter våra patienters behov.

Vi är måna om att skapa delaktighet och utvecklingsmöjligheter för våra medarbetare. Vi arbetar aktivt för att säkerställa att våra medarbetare har rätt och god kompetens för det arbete de utför. Vår organisation bygger på den lokala enhetens självstyre med engagemang och delaktighet från medarbetare vilket leder till korta beslutsvägar. Samtidigt finns en större organisation i bakgrunden som ger stöd och möjlighet till utveckling och erfarenhetsutbyte. Vi har flera mottagningar inom organisationen och det finns därigenom ett gott kollegialt stöd och möjlighet till erfarenhets- och idéutbyte.

Vi erbjuder dig

Ett roligt och givande arbete med trevliga kollegor. Ett flexibelt arbete med hög delaktighet och ansvar. Vi arbetar med moderna digitala hjälpverktyg och regelbunden handledning samt kompetensutveckling utifrån behov.

  • Kollektivavtal och tjänstepension

  • Friskvårdsbidrag

  • Fri offentlig sjukvård

  • Förmånscykel

  • På fredagar äter vi gemensam frukost

  • Kompetensutveckling både intern och externt

  • Närvarande chef

Om dig

Du som söker är legitimerad sjuksköterska med erfarenhet av psykiatri, meriterande om du är specialistsjuksköterska, och trygg i både person och profession samt har ett patientfokuserat arbetssätt. Meriterande är också om du arbetat med behandlingar så som r-TMS eller ECT. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av kliniskt arbete vi psykiatriskmottagning alt. vårdavdelning. Som person är du positiv, trygg och empatisk och har förmågan att kunna organisera ditt arbete på ett effektivt sätt. Du har ett pedagogiskt förhållningssätt och ett helhetstänk med patientens behov i fokus.

Vår arbetsgrupp är ett glatt och engagerat team som präglas av god sammanhållning och en vilja att utvecklas. Vi respekterar och stöttar varandra och hos oss får man gärna komma med åsikter och nya idéer.

Hos oss får du en varierande vardag där din kompetens får komma till sin rätt. Detta kommer att passa dig som gillar moderna, tvärprofessionella arbetssätt och som ser vikten av ett samarbete där vi alla är lika viktiga och lyfter varandra. Vi tror att en högre grad av självstyre minskar stress och ökar välbefinnandet. Och om du mår bra gör du också ett bra jobb vilket såklart är det bästa för våra patienter.

Tillsvidareanställning, tjänstgöring dagtid måndag - fredag. Tillträde efter överenskommelse. 6 mån provanställning.

Ansökan

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Annonsen kan därför tas bort tidigare än planerat, så vänta inte - skicka in din ansökan redan idag.

I samband med anställning kan bakgrundskontroll och utdrag ur belastningsregistret komma att begäras.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Customer Service Desk Apprentice
description:
OCS are growing at rapid pace! Join the Future of Facilities Management now!

OCS UK & Ireland is a leading facilities management company with 50,000+ colleagues and a turnover in excess of £2bn. We deliver innovative, award-winning services within facilities management, hard services, cleaning, security and catering. Our mission is to make people and places the best they can be for our colleagues, customers and the communities we serve. Our commitment to doing business the right way is rooted in our TRUE values - Trust, Respect, Unity, and Empowerment.

It is such an exciting time to be part of the organisation as they enter a massive period of growth and aim to add an apprentice to their customer service desk team. Handling inquiries in person, via email, and on the phone. Your role is crucial in ensuring smooth communication between clients, management, and the supply chain
