Benefits:

  • Healthy perks: Fresh fruit every day

  • Financial security: Pension plan

  • Time off: Generous annual leave

Future prospects:

90% of QA apprentices secure permanent employment after completing: this is 20% higher than the national average.

Important information:

This vocational apprenticeship comprehensively supports your specific job role with this particular employer. Throughout your learning journey, you are fully supported by your dedicated QA skills coach and your mentor at work. They ensure you settle in, help you develop all the skills you need to be successful in your job role and pass your assessments, and can provide one to one support.

Starting with insights into your current potential, they plan your growth in a programmatic way, close skills gaps with immersive training and ensure what you learn is applicable to what you do. They talk you through the specifics on the qualifications you gain and how they align in particular to your day to day role.

On completion, as well as the valuable work experience you have gained, you get a nationally recognised qualification at SCQF Level 6.

If you are interested in starting your career and receiving a work based qualification at the same time APPLY NOW!

title: Principal Engineer – Micro-segmentation-1
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.


Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Principal Network Engineer to join our Cyber Engineering team and run our network segmentation and zero trust strategy, with Illumio Core as the foundation platform. As the Principal Network Engineer, you will be responsible for the architecture, deployment, automation, and L3 support of micro-segmentation across data center, cloud, and hybrid workloads, and for setting the technical standards other engineers build on. You will play a crucial role in reducing lateral movement risk and strengthening our security posture, moving applications from visibility to enforced, least-privilege policy while working closely with infrastructure, network, security, and application owners.

Responsibilities

  • Operate and maintain the Illumio Core Platform: PCE Administration, VEN deployment, label taxonomy (Role, Application, Environment, Location), and the end-to-end policy lifecycle.
  • Evaluate segmentation technologies and approaches: assess platform fit for incoming requirements, recommend the right solution or combination of controls, and advise leadership on technical direction.
  • Drive network segmentation and micro-segmentation: map application and east-west traffic dependencies using Illumination, and convert them into allow-list rulesets, scopes, and enforcement boundaries.
  • Execute phased enforcement (visibility, selective, full) with minimal business disruption, including change planning, validation, and rollback.
  • Maintain platform hygiene: keep workload labels accurate, manage the VEN lifecycle (pairing, upgrades, health, decommissioning), and retire stale or unused rules and objects.
  • Apply zero trust segmentation standards, policy models, and reference patterns aligned with BMS security architecture and the broader zero trust program, and drive adoption across teams.
  • Automate onboarding and policy management using the Illumio REST API with Python and PowerShell, and integrate with ServiceNow CMDB and SIEM platforms for workload context and flow telemetry.
  • Provide L3 support: troubleshoot policy and connectivity issues, perform blocked-traffic analysis, resolve VEN health issues, and support PCE upgrades and maintenance, including on-call escalation support on a rota basis.
  • Build dashboards and reports on coverage, enforcement percentage, policy drift, and risk reduction for security leadership and audit.
  • Partner with Infrastructure, Network, Cloud, and Application teams to align segmentation design, onboarding, and enforcement with application and business priorities.
  • Lead and govern the vendor team supporting Illumio operations: assign and prioritize work, review designs and deliverables, track SLAs and quality, and drive knowledge transfer and continuous improvement.
  • Work in a co-delivery model with onshore and offshore teams, communicating risk, policy impact, and progress clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Maintain runbooks, standards, and compliance evidence, and mentor engineers across the team through design reviews and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity or network security, including 4+ years in network segmentation and micro-segmentation, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-scale designs.
  • Hands-on experience and in-depth knowledge of network micro-segmentation: application dependency mapping, label and policy design, allow-list rulesets, and phased enforcement in production environments.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Illumio Core or an equivalent micro-segmentation platform, including PCE, VEN deployment, label design, rulesets, and enforcement boundaries in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of zero trust principles and their application to workload and network segmentation (NIST SP 800-207).
  • Solid networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VLANs, load balancers, east-west versus north-south traffic analysis) and working knowledge of Windows and Linux server environments.
  • Cloud security experience in AWS or Azure environments, including workload segmentation across hybrid infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with the Illumio REST API and scripting in Python and PowerShell for automation, onboarding, and reporting.
  • Proven L3 support skills, including policy troubleshooting, blocked-traffic analysis, and root cause analysis for connectivity impact, within change management and ITSM processes (ServiceNow).
  • Experience leading or technically directing vendor or third-party teams, including work allocation, deliverable review, SLA tracking, and escalation management.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong written and verbal communication and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Illumio certification or an equivalent segmentation vendor certification is good to have.
  • Experience with Illumio Endpoint or CloudSecure, or with containerized workloads.
  • Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code experience.
  • SIEM integration experience for flow and policy telemetry.
  • CISSP, CCSP, or a cloud security certification.
  • Experience in pharma, life sciences, or other regulated environments (GxP, SOX).

title: Senior Manager, Medical Affairs – Clinical Scientist
description:
Patients are at the heart of everything we do. As part of our Medical Affairs team, you’ll foster internal and external collaboration to generate and disseminate evidence-based clinical practices to help impact patient lives and advance the quality of care. Your scientific curiosity and passion for patients will help us grow our reach and develop innovative solutions for people fighting cardiovascular disease.


Patients with mitral and tricuspid heart valve disease often have complex conditions with limited treatment options. Transcatheter Mitral and Tricuspid Therapies (TMTT) business unit is boldly pursuing an innovative portfolio of technologies to address a patient’s unmet clinical needs. It’s our driving force to help patients live longer and healthier lives. Join us and be part of our inspiring journey.


This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional Clinical Scientist professional to join a team that is boldly designing transcatheter mitral and tricuspid therapies from the ground up. As a key member of the Medical Affairs Clinical Science team, the Senior Manager is responsible for providing scientific expertise throughout the development and implementation of clinical studies and clinical evaluations for a dynamic portfolio of products across TMTT. The Senior Manager will be an experienced medical device professional with strong scientific acumen and a commitment to putting patients first.

This position can be an onsite or a hybrid role based at Edwards Lifesciences’ corporate headquarters in Irvine, California, or can be a remote based role in the U.S.


You will make an impact by:

  • Contribute to strategy and planning of clinical science deliverables.
  • Lead clinical study design and clinical protocol development.
  • Independently author complex documents including clinical study protocols (pre-market and post-market), clinical study reports, annual progress reports, post-approval study reports, clinical evaluation plans, clinical evaluation reports, post-market clinical follow-up plans and reports, and other scientific documents (as appropriate).
  • Independently author complex regulatory responses.
  • Perform systematic literature reviews from initiation to completion (develop search strategies, manage associated documentation, and prepare literature summaries).
  • Independently review raw and summary clinical data for accuracy; resolve potential discrepancies.
  • Interpret safety and effectiveness results from pre-market and post-market data sources; conduct systematic data appraisals to support overall benefit-risk assessments.
  • Independently review and collaborate with cross-functional teams on the review, analysis, and interpretation of study results, including exploratory endpoints and assuring appropriate data review and accurate data reporting.
  • Summarize key data from clinical studies and published literature and provide updates to internal and external stakeholders (as appropriate).
  • Ensure documents comply with regulatory guidelines.
  • May travel up to 15% to attend scientific conferences or to travel to Edwards Lifesciences’ corporate headquarters in Irvine, California if remote.

What you’ll need (Required):

  • Bachelor's Degree in a related field with 10 years of related experience working in clinical science or medical/scientific writing; OR
  • Master's degree in a related field with 8 years of related experience working in clinical science or medical/scientific writing; OR
  • Doctorate degree (PhD, MD, PharmD) with 6 years of related experience working in clinical science or medical/scientific writing.

What else we look for (preferred):

  • Familiarity with the coronary interventional and/or structural heart environments and current treatment options or have other clinical and/or clinical trial experience.
  • Experience in the application of MEDDEV 2.7/1 and EU MDR for clinical evaluations.
  • Experience with FDA PMA applications.
  • Strong knowledge of statistics, study design methodologies, and clinical trial protocol development
  • Familiarity with Real World data analyses methodologies
  • Strong knowledge of scientific research methodology, device development process, GCP, ICH guidelines and Global (US FDA, EU MDR, Japan PMDA, China NMPA) regulations.
  • Experience working in a cross functional, collaborative environment and comfortable interacting with R&D engineers, regulatory specialists, statisticians, physicians, and support personnel.
  • Excellent communication skills and experience influencing and guiding stakeholders.
  • Experience conducting and interpreting statistical analyses of clinical or scientific data preferred.
  • Recognized as an expert in own subject area with specialized depth within current or previous organization(s).
  • Expert understanding of related aspects of clinical science and/or scientific/medical writing.
  • Expert knowledge of regulatory requirements and study execution.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated experience with maintaining current, in-depth product knowledge including current developments, clinical literature review, as well as therapeutic and product operation knowledge.
  • Strong knowledge of statistical analyses, study design methodologies, and clinical trial protocol development.
  • Advanced working knowledge with the use of MS PowerPoint, MS Word, MS Excel, EndNote, and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and scientific writing skills.

Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

For California (CA), the base pay range for this position is $145,000 to $205,000 (highly experienced).

The pay for the successful candidate will depend on various factors (e.g., qualifications, education, prior experience). Applications will be accepted while this position is posted on our Careers website.

description:
Mandarin Oriental, Desaru Coast is looking for a Guest Relations Agent to join our Front Office Department.

Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.

Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences.

Mandarin Oriental, Desaru Coast is a rainforest retreat on Desaru Coast, where jungle meets the sea and Malaysian nature, culture, and connection come alive in a perfect balance of calmness and vibrancy. Experience the enduring legacy of award-winning Kerry Hill Architects, where the spirit of tropical modernism comes to life in Mandarin Oriental, Desaru Coast’s final design. Nestled between rainforest and sea, each suite and villa is a study in quiet luxury, thoughtfully framed by nature and attuned to the rhythm of the land.

About the job

Attend to guests courteously and deal promptly with their requests and queries. Have Detailed information about the hotel and city. Check on VIP guest movements, complete their pre-registration formalities.

As Guest Relations Agent you will be responsible for the following duties:

  • Providing a warm welcome upon arrival, escort, room orientation and accommodating special guest requests.
  • Be efficient in assisting guests throughout their stay with any requirements
  • Ensures that the Guest Services Desks are well manned, operationally prepared and stocked at all times.
  • Being proactive and committed to deliver unique and everlasting memories to guests.
  • Verify that all required supporting documents are properly attached.
  • Check all updated registration cards ensuring that the information is complete, all necessary documents attached, and sufficient payment guarantee has been taken.
  • Block any rooms with special requests the evening prior to the arrival date.
  • Coordinate and arrange amenities based on guest booking details, preferences, and special occasions (e.g., birthdays, anniversaries, VIP guests).
  • Communicate closely with Housekeeping at all times about room allocation changes, pending departures, room moves and waiting guests.
  • Follow up on any outstanding departures and to ensure that late check-outs are charged according to policy.
  • Coordinate Room Moves and communicate them to all necessary departments.
  • Communicate closely with allocated front office teams about VIP room allocation changes as well as with Accounts about billing and cashiering.
  • Coordinate with in room dining/ housekeeping and Butlers for the delivery of assigned amenities. Replenish them on a daily basis until the guest's departure.
  • Be aware of the departmental budget and assist in maximizing room revenue and controlling departmental expenses.
  • Action the Room Discrepancy Report in close communication with Housekeeping.
  • Communicate closely Prepare registration cards, welcome booklets and keys for group arrivals and organize the smooth check-in.
  • Maintain seamless interaction with guests in order to facilitate guest recognition, obtain preferences, anticipate guest needs and proactively action all their requests & requirements. Also maintain the privacy of guest information and details.
  • Answer all calls according to the set standard in the department training manual.
  • Ensure that all requests are handled in a timely manner and to follow up with guests for satisfaction in a service provided.
  • Prepare and carry out shift handover and to ensure that the desk is left tidy and that all tasks have been completed as per shift checklist before the end of day.
  • Log and keep the immediate supervisor fully informed of all challenges, negative feedback or unusual matters of significance
  • Maintain a full & comprehensive knowledge of the products and services available in the state, other Desaru Peace Holdings Club properties and the local area.
  • Carry out guest registration, cashiering and other administrative tasks as per the standards
  • Abide by all hotel and company policies and procedures including Health & Safety policies, Grooming standards, punctuality/ attendance procedures and Quality standards
  • Any other duties as may reasonably be requested by the management
  • Overseeing VIP guests, arrivals and departures.
  • Should possess detailed information about the Hotel, city as well as the competition.
  • Detailed information regarding arrivals and room requirements.
  • To be extremely knowledgeable about any festivities/ holidays of arriving guests and wish and prepare for Guests accordingly.
  • Guest Relation will be responsible for any letters, cards during Guest stay (Get Well soon/ Recovery Service/ Congratulations ... etc.) according to Guest nationalities.
  • To take care of all the invitations — Repeater’s Event and any resort events invitation, including dinner/ Management Cocktail according to Guest’s nationalities.
  • Personalizing any menu for Romantic/ BBQ, Candlelit/ HM dinners.
  • Preference Planner should be well executed according to Guest request in order to achieve a high level of Guest satisfaction upon arrival in the Resort.
  • Prepare pre-arrival letters and GM cards also departure letters and any other required notes as needed.
  • Maintain guest history and ensure all preferences are recorded on the GRM system.
  • Arrange for special occasions setup and amenities, in coordination with the in-room dining, chefs and butlers to create everlasting memories for guests.
  • Always try to find the right opportunity to upsell Villas, Events, Excursions consistently and any potential revenue generated activities to our Guests.
  • Maintain all guest folios in the manner instructed and type out necessary guest likes and dislikes to the appropriate fields on the profile.
  • Collect Guest feedback during guest departure along with his likes and dislikes.
  • Perform basic cashier activities as and when required.
  • Ensure that all check-ins and check-outs are handled smoothly without unnecessary delay or discomfort to any guest.

As Guest Relations Agent, we expect from you:

Educational Background

  • Must be a High School graduate
  • A minimum of 1 year experience working in a similar role in five-star hotel environment.

Skills

  • Previous experience as Guest Relation Agent in a similar hotel
  • Fluent in writing and spoken English, other languages is a plus.
  • Good guest interaction skills
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Good knowledge in HCM is essential with proficiency in MS Office Applications.
  • Outgoing personality with ability to communicate with guests and colleagues
  • Excellent English communication skills

Our commitment to you

  • Learning & Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.
  • MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the #MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.
  • Heath & Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.

We’re Fans. Are you?

title: Planner Maintenance
location: Lake Orion, Michigan, United States of America
description:
Job Description

GM DOES NOT PROVIDE IMMIGRATION-RELATED SPONSORSHIP FOR THIS ROLE. DO NOT APPLY FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU WILL NEED GM IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP NOW OR IN THE FUTURE. THIS INCLUDES DIRECT COMPANY SPONSORSHIP, ENTRY OF GM AS THE IMMIGRATION EMPLOYER OF RECORD ON A GOVERNMENT FORM, AND ANY WORK AUTHORIZATION REQUIRING A WRITTEN SUBMISSION OR OTHER IMMIGRATION SUPPORT FROM THE COMPANY (e.g., H-1B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc.).

This job may be eligible for relocation benefits.

Work Arrangement

Onsite: This role is categorized as onsite. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Orion, MI on a full-time basis.

The Role

The Paint Maintenance Planner is responsible for developing, scheduling, and coordinating predictive, preventive, and corrective maintenance activities to ensure optimal performance of highly automated manufacturing equipment. The Maintenance Planner supports production uptime, equipment reliability, and continuous improvement initiatives in a fast-paced automotive assembly environment. This role champions the spare parts process to include reviews and procurement and also supports project activities. The Maintenance Planner must be able to work autonomously with occasional guidance from supervision. Innovation is a must as well as independent judgment. Work is performed with hourly and salaried employees and 3rd party support organizations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate and support skilled-trades activities throughout the day; develop upcoming work and training schedules for Paint Maintenance.
  • Attend and lead Paint Maintenance and Paint start-up meetings; review carryover work, production needs, safety concerns, and priorities.
  • Plan, schedule, and improve preventive-maintenance work, repair plans, manpower coverage, and weekend/holiday trades coverage.
  • Maintain and use Maximo/CMMS data, calendars, workflows, work orders, PM plans, and closure information to improve maintenance effectiveness.
  • Coordinate trades training, onboarding support, required physicals, GK training, corporate training, and coverage for scheduled development activities.
  • Lead or support safety observation tours, pre-task planning, incident follow-up, layered audits, lockout/audit activities, and safety escalation.
  • Support TPM/PMP, PMET, maintenance-efficiency reviews, TIP/OEE activities, BPD reviews, problem solving, and continuous-improvement projects.
  • Maintain Paint Maintenance SharePoint files, standardized work, reports, records, and communication needed for effective shift-to-shift execution.
  • Partner with production, engineering, quality, materials, and leadership on process changes, production tryouts, spare parts, purchasing/SAP, warranty recovery, and point-of-use materials.
  • Coach and support team members, participate in employee development, and complete special projects assigned by the Area Manager.

Success Measures

  • Safe, prepared, and properly resourced maintenance execution with strong pre-task planning and follow-through.
  • Accurate, timely maintenance plans, work orders, PM data, training schedules, and shift communication.
  • Improved equipment availability, maintenance efficiency, PM effectiveness, and closure of critical carryover work.
  • Consistent compliance with Orion Paint standards, GMS processes, safety requirements, and environmental expectations.

Core Knowledge and Capabilities ( Required Qualifications):

  • 3+ years experience in Maintenance Planning, Preventive Maintenance, reliability, downtime reduction, and work prioritization.
  • Experienced in Paint-shop equipment and operations, process-control plans, quality alerts, containment, PFMEA/MFMEA, and product-quality standards.
  • Maximo/CMMS, Microsoft Office/email, SharePoint, Kronos/timekeeping, SAP/materials processes, and maintenance reporting.
  • Proven Leadership experience
  • Safety, hazardous materials, environmental requirements, ergonomics, PPE, emergency response, and escalation processes.
  • Clear communication, meeting leadership, coaching, cross-functional collaboration, structured problem solving, and continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in Global Manufacturing Systems including SPQRCE, BPD, TIP, TPM, layered audits, standardized work, safety observation tours, and pre-task planning.


GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc).

title: Team Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Team Manager within one of our John Lewis stores, you are integral to delivering the unique John Lewis difference. You will lead your teams to ensure that every customer has an outstanding experience, drive commercial results within your areas of responsibility, and allocate your team of Partners (employees) effectively.

Working in our store as a Team Manager, you'll thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where every day brings something new. Working alongside the leadership team, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving sales, delighting customers and Partners, and maintaining a safe, fully compliant store.

In addition to your contractual pay, any time worked between 22:00 - 06:00 will attract Night Premium at a rate of £4.75 per hour. This will also apply to existing Partners who have enrolled onto Enhanced Hours Premium arrangements.



Due to the nature of this role, applicants must be 18 years or over to apply.

Key Responsibilities


As a Team Manager, your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

- Actively role modelling the partnership behaviours and inspiring a team of Partners through clear communication by managing the full Partner lifecycle, supporting them with talent development. Including addressing performance concerns promptly.
- Being directly accountable for performance within your area of responsibility. Making sure processes are followed, brand standards are delivered and that you use operational strategies to drive success.
- Ensuring the store is compliant and safe for our customers and partners
- Utilise tools provided to effectively allocate resources to meet our customer needs.
- Championing diversity, inclusion and wellbeing.


Essential skills/experience you'll need

- Experience of leading a team in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment with a proven track record as a specialist in people and driving a culture of empowerment.
- Regulatory Compliance Management (as required)
- Competent in using human resource tools and systems (e.g Workday or Tableau)
- Ability to analyse data and insights and translate them into actionable strategies.


Desirable skills/experience you may have:

- Experience in hiring, key-holder operations, and duty management
- Experience in managing disciplinary and grievance procedures
- A proven track record of successful identification and delivery of commercial opportunities and outcomes.





Closing Date:

November 25, 2026


Pay:

£32,000.00 - £45,600.00 Annual


Contract Type:

Permanent


Hours of Work:

Varied hours of full time work (37.5 hours per week) across seven days to include early starts, late finishes, evenings and alternative weekends between the hours of 05:45 to 20:10.


Job Level:

Partnership Level 8

Where You'll Be Working:

Cheadle (John Lewis & Partners), Wilmslow Road, Cheadle, Cheshire, SK8 3BZ

ABOUT THE PARTNERSHIP

We’re the largest employee owned business in the UK and home of our cherished brands, John Lewis and Waitrose. We’re not just employees, we’re Partners, driven by our purpose to build a happier world. As we look to our future, there’s never been a more exciting time to join us.

We’re ruthlessly focused on being brilliant at retail. We continue to innovate, adapt and diversify. Never Knowingly Undersold on price, quality and service in John Lewis and passionately serving food-lovers in Waitrose.

As Partners we all share the responsibility of ownership and in its rewards. We use our voices to contribute to our success, working together through the good and challenging times, holding true to our behaviours and treating everyone with kindness and respect.

We all own making the Partnership somewhere we belong. Embracing our differences and creating an environment where we’re free to be ourselves and can THRIVE. Growing ourselves individually, and as a collective.

As Partners, we make all the difference. And, we all own it.

Important points to note:

It’s important to note that some of our roles are subject to pre-employment vetting (which may include DBS checks for successful candidates). If required, you’ll be informed and provided with information about vetting during the recruitment process and we encourage you to complete any vetting documents quickly to avoid delays. Any DBS checks required will be carried out by a third-party registered body and financial probity checks may also be required for some of our roles. ​

We also recommend that you apply as soon as possible as vacancies can close early if we see a high number of applicants.

We want all of our Partners to have a good work-life balance and we support flexible working. This might mean flexible or compressed hours, job sharing or shorter hour contracts, where possible. Please discuss this further with the hiring manager during your interview.

title: Business Banking Lead Relationship Liaison
description:
Overview:

Part of a team of professionals assigned to portfolio and risk management, service and sales support activities associated with the Business Banking Sales Division. Serve as a strong leader to both operational and sales partners, facilitating seamless communication and collaboration between teams for enhanced synergy and efficiency. Achieve operational expertise and serve as a subject matter expert for M&T’s policies and procedures. Provide coaching and mentorship to team members, enhancing their skillsets.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Oversees the development and enhancement of team expertise in loan accounting systems, internal policies, procedures, and systems/applications, applicable regulatory guidelines, and ensuring comprehensive issue resolution.
  • Provides strategic oversight of compliance with M&T Credit Policy, business financial documents, business banking loans, and additional legal documentation to ensure robust asset management.
  • Leads the communication efforts among credit underwriting, external attorneys, internal legal, document preparation departments, and others as may be needed to facilitate timely loan closing and proactively resolve complex issues.
  • Mentors and coaches team members, fostering collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to address discrepancies/issues found during due diligence, loan documentation, loan closing and review processes. Drives escalation of significant issues as appropriate. Partners with sales leadership to evaluate and process exception requests, guiding deviations from standard business practices.
  • Lead regular one-on-one meetings with Relationship Manager(s) to prioritize and strategize ongoing portfolio management activities and new loan requests, while facilitating cross-business line cluster meetings.
  • Play a key role in the client facing team by overseeing transaction requests, documentation collection, fraud support, error resolution, and managing escalations.
  • Conduct thorough research on client and bank issues, proposing comprehensive solutions and evaluating potential trade-offs while identifying risks and presenting effective mitigants.
  • Monitor and manage the portfolio’s outstanding assets, such as, but not limited to maturing loans, exception pricing, annual reviews, and covenant compliance, ensuring proactive oversight.
  • Delegate tasks to ensure uninterrupted workflow and enhance team efficiency.
  • Provide coaching and mentorship to team members, enhancing their skills in risk identification and mitigation alongside the relationship team, fostering a collaborative environment.
  • Assume additional responsibilities as needed, including leading the training and mentoring of new team members, identifying opportunities for process improvements, and driving projects aimed at enhancing efficiency.
  • Ensure comprehensive understanding and adherence to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies, and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite. Proactively identify and escalate risk-related issues to senior management.
  • Maintain and strengthen M&T internal control standards by overseeing the timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators and ensuring compliance.
  • Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand.
  • Undertake additional related duties as assigned, providing strategic oversight and guidance as necessary.

Education and Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • In lieu of a bachelor’s degree, minimum of 3 years of banking/financial industry experience.

Education and Experience Preferred:

  • Ability to work as a team member with tact and diplomacy.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment, excels in time sensitive situations, and has the ability to deliver results with tight deadlines for various assignments.
  • Proficient personal computer skills, including Adobe DC, Sales force, Microsoft Word, and Excel.
  • Proficient in banking systems, policies, procedures, regulation along with broad knowledge of state and courthouse filings.
  • Experienced in lending operations to include business banking loan approvals, financial statements, and loan documentation.

Physical Requirements:

M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $30.16 - $50.26 Hourly (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation.

Location

Rockville, Maryland, United States of America

title: Cloud and Data engineer
description:
Company Description Peritos Solutions helps organizations turn advanced cloud and data technologies into measurable business outcomes. As an AWS Advanced Tier Partner and Microsoft Solutions Partner across Data & AI, Infrastructure, and Digital & App Innovation, the company focuses on cloud transformation, AI/ML, IoT, DevOps, and data analytics. With over 200 successful projects in sectors such as finance, healthcare, and real estate, Peritos Solutions is trusted by enterprises and high-growth startups for tailored, outcome-driven solutions. A global delivery model with expert teams across Australia, New Zealand, and other regions enables the company to solve real business challenges with scalable, secure, and modern architectures. Team members work on impactful solutions ranging from hazard analytics to AI-powered platforms and cloud data environments that drive agility and innovation.

Role Description The Cloud and Data Engineer role is a contract, on-site position based in Brisbane , Australia Daily responsibilities include designing, building, and maintaining cloud-native data pipelines and platforms on AWS and/or Azure, ensuring reliable data ingestion, transformation, and storage. The role involves implementing data models, optimizing data warehouses and lakes, and collaborating with architects and stakeholders to align solutions with business and technical requirements. The Cloud and Data Engineer will support analytics and reporting workloads, contribute to performance tuning and cost optimization, and apply best practices in security, governance, and DevOps for cloud-based data solutions.

Qualifications

  • Strong data engineering skills, including building and maintaining data pipelines, integration workflows, and cloud-based data services.
  • Experience with data modeling and data warehousing, including designing schemas and optimizing storage for analytics workloads.
  • Hands-on expertise with Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes and tools, including developing scalable, automated transformation jobs.
  • Proficiency in data analytics, including enabling BI tools, dashboards, and analytical queries to support data-driven decision-making.
  • Experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud services for data and infrastructure; familiarity with DevOps practices such as CI/CD and IaC is beneficial.
  • Strong skills in SQL and at least one programming language commonly used in data engineering (e.g., Python, Scala).
  • Knowledge of data security, compliance, and governance best practices in cloud environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and communicate complex technical concepts in clear, accessible language.

Note we are offering a max of 80k+ Super

title: Senior Principal - EUC / MDM Platform Architect
description:
Business Introduction
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Job Purpose

Be the definitive technical authority for how 50,000+ employees across [X] countries experience and interact with their devices. This role owns the architecture, reference designs, technical standards and engineering direction for the entire end user computing estate — laptops, desktops, mobiles, tablets, virtual desktops, meeting rooms, and specialised or regulated endpoints.

Where the Director owns delivery, budget and people, the Principal Architect owns what good looks like technically and holds the organisation to it. This is a hands-on-capable role: the expectation is to prototype, prove and pressure-test designs personally, not solely to review other people's slides.

The Principal Architect is accountable for ensuring the estate is secure by design, cloud-native, automatable, cost-efficient and — critically — genuinely pleasant to use. They are the person who says no to architecture that will not survive contact with 50,000 users, and who can explain why in terms both engineers and executives accept.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the target-state architecture for end user computing: platform selection, device management topology, identity integration, application delivery, security control placement and telemetry.
  • Produce and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, technical standards and architecture decision records (ADRs) — with trade-offs made explicit rather than buried.
  • Define the technical roadmap that underpins the EUC strategy: platform migrations, deprecations, convergence of fragmented tooling, and the sequencing that makes it deliverable.
  • Continuously evaluate the market — modern management, AI PCs and on-device inference, cloud PC/DaaS economics, zero-trust endpoint models — and separate genuine capability from vendor narrative.
  • Act as the design authority for all endpoint change: chair or sit on the EUC architecture review board, approve significant designs, and hold veto on standards deviation.
  • Set and police the exception process — make the right path the easy path, and make deviations visible, time-bound and owned.
  • Review and assure supplier and MSP technical designs; ensure partners build to the organisation's architecture rather than their own delivery convenience.
  • Set engineering standards for configuration-as-code, packaging, testing, release management and rollback across the endpoint estate.
  • Prototype and prove new capability in a lab before it reaches production; build the reference implementation the engineering teams then industrialise.
  • Mentor and technically develop senior engineers and platform leads; raise the ceiling of the whole team, not just your own output.
  • Partner with Cyber Security to embed zero-trust principles at the endpoint: device trust and attestation, conditional access, least privilege, application control, EDR and DLP placement.
  • Architect for regulated and validated environments — GxP-qualified endpoints, computer system validation (CSV/CSA), data residency and privacy obligations, and audit/SOX ITGC evidence generation as a designed-in property rather than a manual scramble.
  • Own the technical response to endpoint-relevant threat scenarios and drive architectural remediation of systemic vulnerabilities.
  • Architect the digital employee experience (DEX) telemetry model: what is measured, how it is collected, where it lands, and how it drives automated remediation.
  • Design for self-healing and self-service by default; treat every recurring ticket category as an architectural defect until proven otherwise.
  • Translate architecture into business consequence for senior stakeholders — cost, risk, productivity, time-to-value.
  • Represent EUC architecture in enterprise architecture forums, security governance, and vendor executive briefings.

Professional Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional expertise.
  • Relevant certifications desirable (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Expert, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Jamf Certified Expert, TOGAF, CISSP or SABSA).

Area of Specialisation

  • End user computing architecture at global enterprise scale — platform selection, device management topology, identity integration, application delivery and telemetry.
  • Modern endpoint management (Intune/MECM) and macOS management (Jamf), including co-management, hybrid-to-cloud-native migration and staged ring-based rollout.
  • Endpoint security architecture and zero-trust design — device trust, conditional access, application control, EDR/XDR, DLP and secure baselines.
  • Regulated and validated endpoint environments — GxP-qualified endpoints, CSV/CSA, data residency and audit/SOX ITGC evidence generation designed in.

Experience Required

  • Overall 15 years and 12+ years in IT infrastructure or end user computing, including 5+ years in a principal, lead or enterprise architect capacity with recognised design authority.
  • Architecture ownership for an endpoint estate of 20,000+ devices across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions.
  • Expert-level, hands-on-derived command of modern endpoint management (Intune/MECM) and macOS management — sufficient to build the reference implementation personally, not only to specify it.
  • Demonstrable advanced scripting and automation portfolio; evidence of configuration-as-code applied to a production endpoint estate.
  • Working fluency in enterprise endpoint security and zero-trust architecture, with a track record of co-designing controls alongside a Cyber Security function.
  • Led the architecture of at least one large-scale endpoint platform migration or transformation through to production, including the failures and what was learned from them.
  • Able to produce architecture documentation of a standard that withstands external audit and supplier scrutiny.
  • Proven credibility with both senior engineers and executive stakeholders, in English, in a global matrixed organisation.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, approximately [5–15]% of the time.

Desirable:

  • Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — with practical GxP/CSV/CSA and Annex 11 / 21 CFR Part 11 exposure.
  • Architecture for specialised endpoints: laboratory instrument workstations, manufacturing and shop-floor devices, clinical and field devices, kiosks, shared and multi-user workstations.
  • Leading a major platform transformation: SCCM-to-Intune migration, Windows 10→11 at scale, MSP transition, or M&A integration/divestment of an endpoint estate.
  • Sustainability-aware design — device longevity, power management, refurbishment and Scope 3 implications of architectural choices.
  • Accessibility and assistive technology designed into the standard build rather than bolted on.
  • Network fundamentals relevant to endpoints — SASE/ZTNA, split tunnelling, Wi-Fi 6/7, certificate-based network access.
  • Contribution to the wider community — open-source tooling, conference speaking, published technical writing, vendor customer advisory boards.

Skills/Background

  • Deep technical breadth across Windows and macOS internals, modern endpoint management, identity, endpoint security, application delivery, virtual desktop / cloud PC, and mobile — with the judgement to know where tenant-wide standardisation matters and where a business exception is defensible.
  • Advanced PowerShell and at least one general-purpose language (Python, C#, Go) applied to real automation, not toy scripts.
  • Configuration-as-code and GitOps discipline — version-controlled endpoint configuration, CI/CD for policy and package deployment, automated testing and staged ring-based rollout as the default way endpoint change is delivered.
  • API-first integration — Microsoft Graph, ServiceNow, MDM and security tool APIs; designing integrations that survive vendor change.
  • Telemetry and data craft — designing measurement into the estate, with competence in the query languages and platforms the data lands in (KQL, Log Analytics, Power BI or equivalent).
  • Architectural discipline — reference designs, ADRs, HLD/LLD, and the ability to write clearly enough that others can build from it and external auditors can accept it.
  • Trade-off reasoning — cost, risk, experience, security and operability weighed explicitly; comfortable being the person who quantifies the uncomfortable option.
  • Scale intuition — designing for 50,000 devices, unreliable networks, disconnected users, and the long tail of exceptions that always exists.
  • Technical leadership without authority — landing decisions across engineering, security, service delivery and vendors by credibility and evidence.
  • Executive communication — making architecture legible and decision-ready for non-technical leadership.
  • Constructive challenge — able to disagree with a Director, a vendor or a security architect and keep the relationship intact.

#AGTech


Skills

Cloud Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Design Thinking, Endpoint Encryption, Endpoint Security, End User Services, Financial Operations, Jamf Pro, Network Protocols, Network Security, Zero Trust

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. title: Principal Engineer, Data, Knowledge & Agentic AI Engineering
description:
About the Role


GSK R&D and Digital & Tech's collective goal is to deliver GSK impact, including the acceleration of the discovery and development of medicines and vaccines to patients. The Labs and CMC Tech function is central to this mission, driving the reimagining and business transformation of our global laboratory and CMC processes. We are actively transitioning from managing raw scientific data to generating structural scientific knowledge—the foundation for how R&D will discover future medicines in a technology-enabled ecosystem.

The Labs CMC Data, Agentic and Knowledge Engineering (DAKE) group architects the data, agentic and knowledge foundations upon which critical R&D processes and scientific workflows depend. Crucially, our operating model relies on a hybrid workforce: AI agents function as "digital workers" to execute hands-on engineering tasks. They generate pipelines, test and deploy them, monitor them in production and remediate failures.

Reporting into the Associate Director, Data, Knowledge & Agentic AI Engineering, the Principal Engineer, Data, Knowledge & Agentic AI Engineering, independently owns a specific Labs & CMC data domain. The role designs pipelines for complex scientific use cases, owns the quality of what digital workers deliver in that domain, and keeps its context accurate and audit ready. It also contributes reusable components to the platform and works collaboratively to raise technical quality across the team.


Why This Role Exists


  • Owns a Labs & CMC data domain end-to-end, with clear accountability for the pipelines, models and datasets digital workers build and operate in it, and sound independent judgement on design choices.
  • Makes digital workers more effective in that domain by improving the frameworks, tools and evaluations they use, so manual intervention falls measurably over time.
  • Delivers quality-assured scientific data to AI systems through data contracts, governed context and quality frameworks that hold up to the strict auditability mandates of life sciences.

Key Responsibilities


Domain Level Data and Agentic Engineering

  • Design pipelines for complex Labs & CMC use cases and direct digital workers to build and operate them, with clear, defensible architectural trade-offs.
  • Own the quality of agent-generated work in your scientific domain: review, test and approve it within the remit our operating model sets, and escalate what falls outside it to senior engineering leadership.
  • Improve how digital workers operate in your domain by refining the frameworks, tools and evaluations they use, iterating on reliability signals so manual intervention falls measurably over time.

Context & Semantics

  • Own the context for your Labs & CMC domain in the governed context layer: definitions, contracts, lineage and governance documentation that humans and digital workers rely on.
  • Contribute reusable components to the broader Labs and CMC context layer, such as metadata enrichment, classification or lineage capture, that other scientific domains can adopt.

Data Quality & Governance

  • Build an end-to-end data quality framework for your domain, encoding standards directly into the context layer with lineage tracking and governance documentation that passes audit.
  • Apply privacy, IP, and consent controls in AI data pipelines, and manage sensitive R&D data appropriately across the data lifecycle.

AI Data Infrastructure & Lifecycle

  • Design and build feature stores, vector databases or retrieval infrastructure for production AI systems within Labs & CMC, with data contracts that give each AI consumer consistent, quality-assured inputs.
  • Manage training datasets, evaluation sets and data versioning for AI projects in production, and contribute to evaluation dataset design with a clear view of how data decisions affect scientific model quality.

Platform & Infrastructure

  • Build cloud data infrastructure independently using infrastructure as code, and contribute reusable components to the team's shared data platform to reduce setup time for new Labs and CMC projects.
  • Design observability into pipelines from the start, and resolve infrastructure issues with minimal disruption to scientific consumers. Own incident response for your domain, with clear post-incident analysis and follow-through.
  • Raise team technical quality through code review and documentation, working closely with senior engineers and domain scientists to translate ambiguous requirements into well-scoped designs.

Basic Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines and data models.
  • Deep SQL and Python, with strong hands-on expertise in modern warehouses or lakehouses and in orchestration and transformation frameworks, such as Databricks, BigQuery, Airflow, dbt or Spark.
  • Experience designing and operating at least one AI agent or LLM-powered tool inside a data workflow, and fluent, daily use of AI coding assistants and agents with sound judgement on what to accept, change or reject.
  • Experience designing and building feature stores, vector databases or retrieval infrastructure for production AI systems, including data contracts for at least one AI consumer.
  • Experience managing training datasets, evaluation sets and data versioning for at least one AI project in production.
  • A track record of building data quality frameworks and lineage for a domain, and of applying privacy, consent and compliance controls in AI data pipelines.
  • Experience building cloud data infrastructure independently with infrastructure as code, with observability designed in from the start.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Led the design and delivery of a component of a larger data platform.
  • Experience with agentic systems in production: multi-step tool use, evaluations, guardrails and observability applied to operational data problems.
  • Experience with quality frameworks and with catalogue, metadata or lineage tooling.
  • Experience in regulated or high-stakes data environments, such as life sciences, labs, CMC, or healthcare, where strict data integrity is a mandate

Education


  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Data Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior Product Manager - Engineering, EHS & Sustainability
description:
Job Purpose:

The Senior Product Manager - Engineering, EHS & Sustainability is accountable for maximising the value of a coherent product family or business capability domain supporting Engineering (asset management and capital projects management), EHS, or Sustainability by translating business strategy, process needs and user outcomes into a clear product vision, roadmap and investment plan. Operating within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Product Domain Lead, the Product Manager balances business value, user experience, technical feasibility, cost, risk, compliance and operational sustainability throughout the product lifecycle.

The Senior Product Manager works closely with Product Owners, Business Process Owners, Architects, Engineers, Service Managers, Data and Cyber Security teams and external partners. The role sets product outcomes and priorities, guides delivery choices and ensures that Product Owners have sufficient strategic context and decision guardrails to manage backlogs and releases effectively. The Product Manager remains accountable for the overall coherence of the product roadmap and for demonstrating that investment is improving business performance, adoption, reliability and user experience.

The role also identifies opportunities for simplification, standardisation, automation and responsible use of data and AI. Recommendations should remain capability-led and technology-agnostic, with solutions selected because they deliver the required outcome and can be integrated, secured, validated, supported and sustained within the enterprise environment.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Business Process Owners, functional leaders and users to understand strategic priorities, process pain points and unmet needs and translate these into clear product outcomes.
  • Define and maintain the product vision, strategy and roadmap for an assigned product or capability area, aligned to domain strategy and enterprise technology direction.
  • Develop outcome-based investment proposals and contribute to business cases by defining value hypotheses, costs, benefits, risks, assumptions, dependencies and measures of success.
  • Set prioritisation guardrails for Product Owners and make roadmap trade-offs based on value, cost, urgency, risk, compliance, operational continuity, capacity and technical dependencies.
  • Guide Product Owners and delivery teams so that epics, features and releases remain aligned to product outcomes and do not become disconnected collections of requirements.
  • Partner with Solution and Enterprise Architects to assess solution options and ensure designs are secure, integrated, scalable, supportable and aligned to architecture and data standards.
  • Establish and review product performance measures covering adoption, process outcomes, stability, service effort, user experience, delivery flow and benefit realisation; use insights to adjust priorities.
  • Ensure product initiatives comply with required governance for cyber security, data protection, quality, validation, change control, service readiness, continuity and records management.
  • Lead product-level vendor and solution evaluations using transparent, capability-led criteria and contribute to commercial decisions, supplier performance reviews and lifecycle planning.
  • Manage product risks, technical debt, dependencies and obsolescence, ensuring decisions and escalations are documented and addressed through the appropriate governance forums.
  • Drive adoption and operational readiness by ensuring business change, training, support model, documentation, release communications and onboarding needs are reflected in plans.
  • Promote iterative, user-centred and data-led ways of working and create a culture focused on measurable outcomes, learning, simplification and continuous improvement.
  • Identify and prioritise AI opportunities based on business value, user needs, data readiness, technical feasibility, risk and total cost of ownership.
  • Define the product vision, roadmap, outcomes and investment case for AI-enabled capabilities across Engineering, EHS and Sustainability.
  • Lead AI initiatives from discovery and experimentation through delivery, adoption, scaling and benefits realisation.
  • Define measurable success criteria for AI products, including business outcomes, adoption, user experience, output quality, reliability and operational impact.
  • Ensure AI-enabled products meet responsible AI, cybersecurity, privacy, validation, human-oversight and service-readiness requirements.

Basic qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Professional certifications in product management, agile delivery, portfolio management, finance or change leadership are desirable.
  • Typically 5+ years of experience in product management, digital transformation, technology delivery, business systems, manufacturing technology, supply chain technology or a related discipline
  • Proven experience developing a product vision and roadmap for a product, platform or defined capability area.
  • Proven experience in the following business domains:
  • Engineering: Plant Maintenance, Calibration, Validation; Content Management, Capital Project Management
  • EHS: Incident& Accident Management, Occupational Health, Industrial Hygiene, Chemical Compliance;
  • Sustainability: Energy Efficiency, Renewable and Clean Energy, Waste Management
  • Experience translating business priorities and user needs into product outcomes, investment proposals and delivery priorities.
  • Experience working with Product Owners and cross-functional delivery teams throughout discovery, design, delivery, release, adoption and operation.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritise based on value, cost, risk, compliance, operational impact, resource capacity and technical dependencies.
  • Experience defining product measures and using adoption, process, stability, service and user-experience insights to improve performance.
  • Experience contributing to business cases, forecasting costs, tracking benefits and supporting funding decisions.
  • Experience operating within governance requirements covering architecture, cyber security, data protection, quality, validation, change and service readiness.
  • Experience evaluating suppliers or solution options and managing vendor contributions to product outcomes.
  • Experience influencing senior functional stakeholders in a global matrix organisation.
  • Experience developing product strategies, roadmaps or business cases for AI-enabled, data-driven or advanced analytics products.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams spanning Product, Engineering, Data/ML, Cyber Security, Compliance and business SMEs.
  • Experience taking AI-enabled features from discovery and experimentation through release, adoption and scale-up.
  • Experience defining value hypotheses, success measures and acceptance criteria for AI use cases.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools, such as Copilot, AI assistants, analytics or experimentation platforms, to support product discovery, backlog refinement and stakeholder communication.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Strong strategic thinking with the ability to convert ambiguous business challenges into clear product choices and roadmaps.
  • Strong communication, facilitation and influencing skills across business, technical and operational audiences.
  • Commercial and financial acumen, including the ability to evaluate cost, value, benefits, risk and total cost of ownership.
  • Ability to use data and evidence to challenge assumptions, prioritise investment and evaluate product performance.
  • Working understanding of enterprise architecture, integration, data, cyber security, validation, service and operational resilience.
  • Ability to create alignment across teams with different objectives, cultures, geographies and levels of technical knowledge.
  • Strong judgement, accountability and escalation discipline, with a clear understanding of decision rights.
  • Commitment to technology-agnostic, capability-led evaluation and to simple, reusable and supportable solutions.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools in day-to-day product work (e.g. copilot tools, AI assistants, analytics platforms, experimentation tooling) to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement, and stakeholder communication.
  • Experience leading cross-functional squads (product, engineering, data/ML, security, compliance) to deliver AI-driven features from discovery through scale-up.
  • Strong understanding of generative AI, machine learning, intelligent automation and analytics from a product-management perspective.
  • Ability to assess whether a business problem is appropriate for AI or would be better addressed through process simplification, rules, automation or conventional technology.
  • Ability to translate Engineering, EHS and Sustainability needs into clear AI product outcomes, use cases and roadmap priorities.
  • Understanding of AI-specific product risks, including inaccurate outputs, poor data quality, inappropriate automation, limited explainability and user over-reliance.
  • Ability to define and use business, adoption, quality, risk and operational measures to evaluate AI product performance

title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Data & Cloud Modernization
description:
Job Description


Vacancy Status: This posting is for a new vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications.

AI Disclosure: As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Markham Elevation Centre or the Oshawa Elevation Centre at least three times per week.


The Team & Opportunity


The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.


We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.


The ideal candidate is a strategic, hands-on technology leader with a track record of operating and modernizing complex enterprise data environments. They can lead multidisciplinary teams across data engineering, business analysis, data quality, and governance; align business and technology stakeholders around a clear modernization roadmap; and deliver large-scale migration while protecting the reliability of existing services. They understand how to build trusted, well-governed data foundations that enable enterprise-wide analytics and AI adoption.


The Role

As the Senior Manager, Enterprise Data & Cloud Modernization, you will lead the team responsible for the day-to-day health and continued operation of the existing enterprise data warehouse, as well as its modernization and migration to a cloud-based environment. You will set direction, establish delivery and operational priorities, and ensure the platform evolves to meet the needs of GM Canada and the wider enterprise.

You will lead a multidisciplinary team comprising three Data Engineering, Cloud Migration & Platforms Engineers; one Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration; one Data Validation & Data Quality Analyst, Enterprise Data; and one Data Governance Analyst. You will bring these capabilities together into a coordinated operating model that delivers reliable services, high-quality and well-governed data, and a successful migration. The cloud implementation may be Azure/Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or another direction based on platform and business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the vision, strategy, roadmap, and operating priorities for the enterprise data environment, balancing current service needs with modernization and migration objectives.
  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team across data engineering, business analysis, data validation and quality, and data governance; clarify accountability, establish expectations, and support professional growth.
  • Maintain the reliability, availability, performance, security, and supportability of the existing enterprise data warehouse and its critical data pipelines.
  • Lead the planning and execution of the enterprise data warehouse migration to a cloud-based environment, including scope, sequencing, dependencies, risks, resourcing, milestones, and business readiness.
  • Direct modernization of data architecture, platforms, pipelines, processes, and controls to improve scalability, automation, resilience, maintainability, and cost effectiveness.
  • Establish a practical transition strategy that protects business continuity, manages legacy and cloud coexistence, and ensures migrated workloads and data meet agreed operational and business requirements.
  • Ensure migration outcomes are validated through appropriate testing, reconciliation, data-quality controls, business acceptance, and production-readiness reviews.
  • Set expectations for engineering standards and practices, including architecture, automation, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, testing, observability, incident response, and documentation.
  • Establish and oversee data-quality practices that monitor completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and schema conformance across source, pipeline, and warehouse data.
  • Lead data governance practices that support clear ownership, stewardship, definitions, metadata, lineage, access controls, classification, retention, and responsible use of enterprise data.
  • Build trusted relationships with business leaders, GM Canada stakeholders, enterprise data consumers, technology partners, security and risk teams, and global platform organizations.
  • Translate business priorities into a sequenced and measurable data roadmap, ensuring stakeholder needs and downstream impacts are represented in decisions.
  • Oversee requirements management, backlog priorities, sprint and release planning, delivery tracking, risk and issue management, and cross-team dependencies.
  • Establish clear measures of success for platform health, service reliability, migration progress, data quality, governance, delivery outcomes, and customer or business impact.
  • Ensure operational procedures, support models, escalation paths, service expectations, runbooks, and knowledge transfer are in place for both legacy and cloud environments.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and data-informed decision-making across the team.
  • Guide the development of secure, trusted, discoverable, and well-documented data foundations that can support analytics, artificial intelligence, and enterprise-wide AI adoption.
  • Communicate progress, decisions, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to senior stakeholders and delivery partners.

Required Qualifications and Skills


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Significant progressive experience leading enterprise data, data engineering, data platforms, technology modernization, or related functions.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and delivering complex, enterprise-scale data or technology initiatives.
  • Experience operating and modernizing enterprise data warehouses and production data platforms, preferably including Oracle-based environments.
  • Proven ability to lead large-scale data platform or warehouse migrations, from assessment and planning through implementation, validation, and operational transition.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, data integration, ETL/ELT, cloud data platforms, data quality, and enterprise data operations.
  • Experience establishing governance, security, privacy, quality, reliability, and operational practices for business-critical data environments.
  • Ability to set strategic direction while maintaining sufficient technical depth to evaluate architecture, delivery approaches, risks, and trade-offs.
  • Strong business and financial judgment, with the ability to prioritize work and resources against enterprise outcomes and operational needs.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and influencing skills, including the ability to align senior business and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong change leadership skills and the ability to guide teams and stakeholders through complex modernization while sustaining current operations.
  • Experience with Agile or iterative delivery models, portfolio or roadmap planning, and management of complex cross-functional dependencies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and risk-management capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience leading an on-premises Oracle data warehouse migration to Azure, Azure Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or a comparable cloud data platform.
  • Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, BigQuery, Synapse, or equivalent enterprise data and lakehouse technologies.
  • Familiarity with cloud platform engineering, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, data pipeline automation, and cloud operations.
  • Experience establishing data observability, automated data-quality controls, reconciliation practices, and operational scorecards.
  • Experience leading data governance and stewardship programs, including cataloging, lineage, classification, data ownership, and access management.
  • Experience modernizing data platforms and operating models to support advanced analytics, machine learning, or enterprise AI use cases.
  • Experience working in a large, matrixed, regulated, or security-sensitive enterprise environment.
  • Familiarity with enterprise tools and practices for Agile delivery, service management, documentation, and operational monitoring.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $131,000 to $180,900. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.



GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need gm immigration sponsorship now or in the future.

title: Cleaning Rack Operator
description:
UTLX

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

Are you mechanically inclined, safety-focused, and looking for a hands-on career in a dynamic industrial environment? Union Tank Car Company is seeking applicants to become a member of our production team at our full-service rail tank car repair shop in Cleveland, TX. We are seeking a skilled Cleaning Rack Operator to perform inspections and testing on railroad tank cars and related components. This position plays a critical role in ensuring the safety, quality, and structural integrity of railcar equipment using advanced inspection methods and technologies.

UTLX is a trusted industry leader, recognized for its regulatory, engineering, and commercial expertise, and is the preferred railcar and services provider for many customers nationwide. Owned by the Marmon Group and Berkshire Hathaway, UTLX is headquartered in Chicago's financial district, near major public transportation hubs. ULTX offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, along with the opportunity to be a part of a collaborative, safety-focused team that values enthusiasm, craftsmanship, professional growth and continuous improvement.

Position Summary:

The Cleaning Rack Operator is an entry‑level position responsible for safely cleaning, testing, and preparing rail tank car interiors by operating cleaning and monitoring equipment, with comprehensive on‑the‑job training, while following confined‑space, environmental, safety, and quality regulations in an industrial outdoor setting. Duties may vary, and employees may be asked to perform additional job functions as needed.

Primary Responsibilities:

Primary responsibilities and/or essential functions include, but are not limited to:

  • Review cleaning and testing procedures prior to performing assigned work and before entering tank cars
  • Learn, follow, and comply with confined space entry procedures and all applicable safety policies
  • Verify calibration of testing equipment to ensure accurate readings, including LEL meters, oxygen content meters, pH meters, and Draeger meters
  • Connect and operate high‑pressure air, steam, and water hoses, along with cleaning rack equipment
  • Perform manual cleaning of tank interiors as required
  • Operate and monitor testing equipment throughout the cleaning process
  • Ensure cleaning procedures and equipment comply with company standards and EPA regulations
  • Maintain a clean, organized work area and promptly report potential safety hazards

Required Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent, or ability to pass a Combined Basic Skills Assessment Test
  • Demonstrated job‑related computational skills and ability to read gauges, rulers, and applicable measuring devices
  • Ability to work effectively and efficiently both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions with minimal supervision
  • Ability to read, interpret, and adhere to safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, procedure manuals, and other work-related documentation
  • Strong focus on safety and quality.
  • Ability to work any shift, including overtime, in accordance with the union contract
  • Dependable and reliable attendance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in an Industrial Repair or Manufacturing environment.
  • Rail industry experience
  • Tank car knowledge or experience

Work Environment & Schedule:

  • Work is performed in an industrial railcar repair environment involving regular exposure to challenging physically demanding and environmental conditions.
  • Duties may be performed outdoors in varying weather conditions
  • Exposure to dirt, dust, fumes, smoke, heat, and noise is common
  • Job requires moderate to heavy physical exertion, including lifting, climbing, working at heights, and working in confined spaces
  • Must be able to enter tank cars through 20‑inch manway openings
  • Manual dexterity and physical coordination required for tool and equipment operation
  • Potential exposure to hazardous materials due to leaks or spills
  • Must comply with all required personal protective equipment (PPE) and safety protocols
  • On-site work arrangement: 5 days a week, with overtime as required.
