title: Mechanical Supervisor
description:
Who we are

For more than 40 years, Reworld has been a leader in sustainable waste solutions, providing our customers with innovative solutions that help them achieve carbon-negative outcomes.

Our Vision

Reworld is leading the charge to a carbon-negative future through revolutionary sustainable materials management solutions that reduce, reuse, recycle and reimagine waste for the benefit of society and the environment.

Our Business

Reworld partners with businesses by offering cutting-edge engineering and innovative solutions, to help customers reduce, reuse, recycle and recover value from waste streams and meet or exceed their sustainability goals.

Our Value

Reworld's differentiator comes from our ecosystem of technology, facilities and partnerships, trusted by the world’s largest organizations to reimagine waste management for a smarter, more sustainable world.

All that we’re missing is you. Apply today!

About the role

As a Mechanical Supervisor at Reworld, you’ll lead the mechanics who repair and install plant equipment. Reporting to the Senior Maintenance Manager, you’ll ensure their work is planned, budgeted, inspected, and completed safely and on time.


You’ll have the opportunity to improve preventive maintenance, solve mechanical problems, and develop your team through training and cross-training. Your work will help keep the plant operating reliably.


You’ll oversee daily maintenance, work orders, spare parts, and emergency response, including work involving rotating equipment and gas or steam turbine generators. You’ll bring a high school diploma or GED, at least five years of industrial mechanical maintenance experience, and familiarity with this equipment.

Responsibilities


  • Direct daily Maintenance Department work, assign jobs, and schedule mechanics to maintain coverage for equipment breakdowns.
  • Assess equipment and facilities for repair needs; inspect completed installations and repairs.
  • Plan and oversee repair, preventive, and predictive maintenance, including work orders and backlogs.
  • Maintain repair logs, track mechanics’ work, and ensure adequate spare-parts inventory.
  • Process timecards and administer performance management and corrective action in accordance with company policy.
  • Select, train, cross-train, and manage mechanics to build a technically capable team.
  • Ensure maintenance work follows company safety and environmental practices.

Requirements


  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • High school diploma or GED and at least five years of industrial mechanical maintenance experience.
  • Experience developing and implementing a preventive maintenance system and related measures.
  • Familiarity with maintaining gas and/or steam turbine generators and rotating equipment.
  • Ability to organize work, lead a team, manage time, and take ownership of repair and preventive maintenance projects.
  • Knowledge of industrial safety practices, hazard recognition, and occupational safety precautions.
  • Ability to identify root causes and make sound decisions.
  • Ability to meet the role’s physical requirements, including working at heights and in extreme conditions, climbing, and using required protective equipment, including a respirator.
  • Availability for emergency call-outs and on-call duty.
  • Experience with Microsoft Excel, Word, Project, PeopleSoft/ALM asset management, or other data management software is a plus.

All Reworld positions require a candidate's ability to perform the duties and responsibilities of the role while upholding Reworld's Values, including (but not limited to) contributing to a safe and inclusive workplace, delivering results through trust, and building breakthrough capabilities.

Please note that Level, Title and/or Salary may be adjusted based on the applicant's experience or skills.

Pay Transparency

The range below reflects Reworld’s reasonable estimate of base pay for this role based on primary posting location. It is expected that most qualified candidates in this location will fall within the posting range. The final salary offered for this role will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to: experience, education, geographic location, skills and competencies, travel requirements and/or union contracts (if applicable). Pay ranges are reviewed from time to time and may be modified in the future.

title: Per-Diem Radiographer
description:
SUMMARY:

Performs routine diagnostic radiology procedures, to include outpatient, emergency department, intraoperative, portable, C-arm, inpatient and fluoroscopic exams. Provides routine radiology services to patients of all ages, including neonates, children, adolescents, adults, and geriatric patients.


Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization's values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence as these values guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Demonstrates understanding of Hospital’s Mission, Vision and Values.
  • Demonstrates understanding of job description, performance expectations, and competency assessment plan.
  • Demonstrates a commitment toward meeting and exceeding the needs of our customers and consistently adheres to our Customer Service Standards.
  • Completes mandatory education- Hospital-wide- Department-specific- Job-specific
  • Complies with department policies, procedures and protocols- reviews policies and procedures- reviews Employee Handbook- reviews protocols for charges
  • Maintains current CPR certification.
  • Participates in department and interdepartmental quality improvement activities.
  • Provides safe environment for patients, employees and visitors: -Utilizes lead shielding protective devices and radiation monitoring devices (badges), as appropriate.- Utilizes radiation exposure coning devices, as appropriate.- Practices aseptic techniques and infection control procedures.- Practices radiation safety at all times.- Demonstrates ability to transport patients safely and efficiently, as needed.- Utilizes lead markers at all times.- Conducts visual checks of equipment prior to each use to ensure safe condition
  • Performs arthrograms and myelograms.Performs C arm procedures and x-rays in the OR.
  • Prepares room and assists radiologists for fistulagrams and cystograms.
  • Performs GI’s, SBFT’s, and IVP’s.- Adult GI, SBFT, IVP- Child GI, SBFT, IVP
  • Prepares contrast and barium materials:- contrast/barium administration for adults- contrast/barium administration for children.- contrast/barium administration for infants.
  • Provides technical assistance to radiologists and OB/GYN’s for hysterosalpingograms.
  • Demonstrates ability to load, unload and process films through processor.
  • Demonstrates ability to perform processor QC, as necessary.
  • Processes images through the CR Unit and demonstrates ability to utilize the workstation.
  • Demonstrates competency in using the digital PAC system in retrieving and merging images
  • Operates C-Arms and various portable x-ray units.
  • Introduces self to patient, confirms patient’s name and exam to be done.
  • Explains procedure to the patient:- explains exam to adult- explains exam to adolescent- explains exam to child
  • Sets appropriate technique factors for properly exposed radiographs for all age groups-adult, children & infants.
  • Utilizes immobilization or securing devices- pigostat for infant- papoose board for child- bed rails/other devices for adults
  • Monitors patient’s condition during examinations.
  • Stocks and cleans work area.
  • Performs all office functions, to include RIS/SMS order entries and scheduling.
  • QA’s and verifies patients in the RIS.
  • Moves film appropriately within the RIS system.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:


  • High school graduation, or equivalent, and satisfactory completion of formal radiologic technology training of two years duration.
  • Ability to meet the requirements for registry by the American Registry of Radiologic Technologist (ARRT).
  • Holds a valid State of Rhode Island Radiograher License.
  • Current CPR certification.
  • Must be able to stand/ squat1-3 hours and walk 3-7 hours, frequent twisting and moderate bending and lift over 50 lbs with good body mechanics.
  • Must be able to use both hands/wrists and perform frequent fine motor skills with moderate repetitions.
  • Requires accurate near and far vision at 20/40, accurate depth perception and discriminate between red-green and blue-violet.
  • Must hear whisper at eight feet

title: Senior CoreValve Therapy Development Specialist - Tucson, AZ
location: Tucson, Arizona, United States of America
description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 30 Nov 2026


Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

Join Medtronic's CoreValve Structural Heart team and help transform the future of heart care. We are pioneering innovative TAVR therapies that provide minimally invasive treatment options for patients with aortic valve disease. Our team is driven by a shared mission to improve patient outcomes, expand access to life-saving care, and make a meaningful impact on patients' lives around the world.

The Principal CoreValve Therapy Development Specialist provides technical, clinical, educational and sales support to ensure safe adoption and growth of the Medtronic CoreValve System and future catheter-based therapy technologies. The CoreValve Therapy Development Specialist works closely with implanting teams and the Medtronic Catheter-based Therapies (CBT) and CVG field organizations to drive procedural and practice success.


  • Provide expert clinical and technical support for TAVR and TAVI procedures, supporting valve preparation and deployment, and ensuring adherence to trial protocols, instructions for use, and best practices to optimize patient outcomes.
  • Collaborate and educate with physicians, hospital staff, and Medtronic partners to deliver education, conduct in-services, drive safe program growth, communicate clinical evidence, and support territory business plans and sales objectives.

CoreValve Therapy Development Specialists must have the ability to work outside of normal business hours. Territory for this role: Tucson, AZ. Candidates must reside within the assigned territory and be able to travel to multiple customer accounts throughout the region up to 80% of the time; a valid driver's license, active insurance is required for this role. In addition, the final candidate must have a driving record that meets company standards.


POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

The following responsibilities are to be performed as appropriate in clinical trial case support and/or case support following commercial approval, depending upon the approval status of the product at the time.

  • Deliver clinical and technical leadership for TAVR procedures, including case planning, procedural support, CT reconstruction and measurement analysis, and expertise across imaging modalities and hemodynamic monitoring.
  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of TAVR technology, clinical data, competitive products, and industry trends while partnering with internal stakeholders to support innovation and future product development.
  • Partner with therapy consultants, managers, and cross-functional partners to execute territory business plans, support growth initiatives, identify opportunities, and communicate market intelligence.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with physicians, administrators, and healthcare teams by delivering exceptional customer support, resolving issues, and ensuring a high level of service within assigned accounts.
  • Manage operational and compliance activities, including inventory support, vendor credentialing requirements, product complaint reporting, quality initiatives, and onboarding and mentoring new team members.
  • Operate effectively in demanding clinical settings requiring the use of computers and CT reconstruction software, independent mobility, the ability to lift up to 20 pounds, and extended periods of computer-based work.
  • Maintain safety and readiness in environments with exposure to radiation, bloodborne pathogens, and infectious diseases, including wearing required PPE and lead aprons for procedures averaging 2-3 hours.
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications

  • A High School Diploma plus 11+ OR associate’s degree and 9 + OR Bachelor’s degree and 7+ years clinical or sales experience; selling or supporting interventional cardiology, vascular or surgical products, with at leas
  • 3+ years of such experience in an industry setting

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or science
  • Experience with wires, balloons, catheters, stents
  • Exceptional understanding of cardiac and vascular anatomy, physiology, and pathology
  • Experience communicating product’s market advantages to physicians and hospital administration
  • Experience teaching and educating medical personnel, peers and technical support personnel
  • Imaging interpretation experience (TTE or Trans Esophageal Echocardiography (TEE), CT, Angiograms)
  • Echocardiology background highly preferred

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

Physical Job Requirements

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. We have the experience, knowledge, and flexibility to design service offerings and create system enhancements tailored to our customers’ needs throughout the 13 states in which we operate. This position is responsible for the calibration, gas sampling, testing, operation, and maintenance of measurement facilities in assigned area, likely to provide support in adjacent areas, along with project support. The role is responsible for over-protection systems, maintaining and inspecting valves, flow control valves, pressure control valves, valve actuators, remote capabilities to various types of equipment and maintaining gas conditioning equipment and various analyzers.

The position is also responsible for environmental, health, safety, and reliability support for natural gas transmission, including recognizing and reporting abnormal and safety-related operating conditions, accident and near-miss reporting, emergency response, regulatory compliance activities, and equipment repair. title: Senior Databricks Data Engineer
description:
Senior Databricks Data Engineer

Our Company

N2IA Technologies is a consulting company specializing in acquisition/contracting support, cost/FinOps, and technology optimization for federal clients. We deliver tailored strategies, robust software solutions, and streamlined operations to help organizations achieve their goals. At N2IA, we are committed to developing innovative financial and compliance-based solutions that address evolving business and regulatory needs. If you are passionate about accounting, financial accuracy, and supporting government programs, N2IA is the place for you.

Overview

N2IA is seeking a Senior Databricks Data Engineer to build, refine, and maintain the core data pipelines on the Databricks Lakehouse Platform that enable enterprise AI, analytics, and mission systems. This role is essential for making data accessible, reliable, and usable across the agency. You will work with cloud engineers, data architects, and AI developers to ensure data is clean, connected, secure, and optimized for advanced analytics and AI/ML workflows. This role is remote supporting a Quantico, VA customer and onsite work is required at the client site full-time.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows on Databricks using Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables (DLT), and the medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture across cloud and on-prem systems.
  • Develop and orchestrate workflows using Databricks Workflows/Jobs.
  • Implement data quality checks, validation, lineage tracking, and metadata management using Unity Catalog and Lakehouse Monitoring / DLT expectations.
  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure datasets meet requirements and are discoverable through Unity Catalog.
  • Automate ingestion and transformation processes using Databricks-native patterns such as Auto Loader, Structured Streaming, and the COPY INTO command.
  • Support API strategy, data modeling, and domain-driven data structures within the Lakehouse.
  • Troubleshoot pipeline issues and optimize Spark jobs and clusters for performance and cost (e.g., Photon, cluster sizing, Z-ordering, liquid clustering, and workload tuning).

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of hands-on data engineering experience building production pipelines on Databricks.
  • 10+ years of technical professional experience.
  • Strong proficiency with Apache Spark (PySpark and Spark SQL), Delta Lake, and the Databricks Lakehouse Platform.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks on Azure and/or AWS (e.g., Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, or similar orchestration tooling).
  • Experience with Unity Catalog for data governance, access control, and lineage.
  • Experience integrating structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Knowledge of SQL, schema design, data modeling, and cloud-based storage patterns (e.g., Delta tables, cloud object storage).
  • Secret clearance.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Databricks certification (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate/Professional).
  • Experience supporting AI/ML pipelines, vectorization, or embedding generation, ideally using MLflow, Databricks Mosaic AI, Model Serving, or Vector Search.
  • Experience with Delta Live Tables and streaming pipelines (Structured Streaming / Auto Loader).
  • Azure, AWS, or multi-cloud data ecosystem familiarity.
  • Experience with data governance, access controls, or sensitive data protection (Unity Catalog, row/column-level security).
  • Exposure to DevOps/CI-CD patterns for data workflows (e.g., Databricks Asset Bundles, Repos, Terraform).
  • MuleSoft implementation experience.

N2IA is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

Summary of Duties and Responsibilities:

Interested in helping researchers navigate compliance requirements so they can focus on discoveries that make a difference?


If so, the Office of Research Ethics (ORE) at Iowa State University is seeking exceptional candidates to fill the role of Conflicts of Interest and Commitment (COIC) Administrator. This individual will be classified as a Research Administrator I.


What You'll Do:

With guidance from the Assistant Director, the COIC Administrator will support the institution’s COIC program. The incumbent will:

  • Review conflict of interest and commitment (COIC) disclosures and supporting documentation; provide guidance to employees, supervisors, and investigators regarding disclosure requirements.
  • Assist with COIC program activities, including monitoring disclosure compliance, supporting management plan implementation, tracking required training, and preparing materials for review meetings.
  • Gather and maintain information related to COIC reviews, management plans, and research compliance requirements.
  • Support the administration of research security software systems by assisting users, processing documentation, and maintaining accurate records.
  • Evaluate documentation and information for completeness and compliance with university, state, and federal research requirements.
  • Educate and assist researchers and other university personnel regarding research security, disclosure, training, and certification requirements.
  • Communicate with principal investigators, university offices, and other stakeholders regarding the status of compliance-related activities.
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation to support research security and conflict of interest compliance programs.

In performing these duties, the successful candidate will have:

  • Understanding of research compliance;
  • Knowledge of regulations applicable to the conduct of research in a higher education setting;
  • Ability to learn COIC regulations and research security program requirements;
  • Ability to read and understand technical documents;
  • Attention to detail;
  • Customer service experience;
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills;
  • Critical thinking skills; and
  • Ability to work in a collaborative team environment as well as independently.

The successful candidate must reside in the state of Iowa on or before their start date. This position offers the flexibility to work on-site in Ames or in a hybrid work arrangement.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting research compliance, research administration, regulatory compliance, or related programs; ideally in a higher education environment.
  • Experience reading and interpreting technical, regulatory, legal, or policy-related documents.
  • Demonstrated experience working with federal regulations, sponsor requirements, or research compliance frameworks applicable to academic research.
  • Experience reviewing, tracking, and maintaining records, documentation, or compliance-related information.
  • Experience working with electronic compliance, case management, or Software as a Service (SaaS) systems.

About the Office of Research Ethics at Iowa State University:
The Office of Research Ethics (ORE) promotes an ethical research environment that fosters honesty, integrity, and a sense of community. The research administrators within the office ensure that University research conducted on or off the ISU campus, including collaborative research with other institutions, is conducted in compliance with university, local, state, federal, and funding agency regulations. title: Associate Director, Product Owner - Workplace Experience
description:
Job Purpose:
The Associate Director, Product Owner - Workplace Experience is responsible for maximising the value of our Workplace Experience products within the Legal, Compliance & WREF domain by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the WREF Product Manager and Senior Director of Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Workplace Experience Product Owner guides Product Analysts and works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the Dir, WREF & Corporate Security Product Manager and Senior Director of Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech.
  • Own and manage the Product backlog (e.g. Jira, ADO etc) for Workplace Experience products, ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
  • Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the Dir, WREF & Corporate Security Product Manager and Senior Director of Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech.
  • Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Product Analysts and working with Engineers, Architects, and Testers, and third party vendors to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
  • Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
  • Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
  • Ensure product changes follow required digital & tech management system (DTMS), security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.
  • Support Solution Architects to assess design options and manage cross-Product dependencies, including third-party contract, interface, and integration impacts, and sequencing needs to support interoperability and consistent business outcomes.
  • Act as an escalation point for the Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by the Dir, WREF & Corporate Security Product Manager
  • Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile (i.e. SaFe, Scrum etc), iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact.
  • Partnering with the Director, WREF & Corporate Security Product Manager, ensure Digital & Tech support WREF strategy for delivering intelligent services, with a particular focus on workplace experience and knowledge analytics & insights.
  • Own Appspace globally as our workplace experience product and ensure a bold data lead roadmap exists that continues to drive value in our employee experience offering at sites


Required Skills:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience
  • Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).
  • 15 to 19 Years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
  • Knowledge of Workplace, Real Estate & Facilities – particularly Workplace Experience digital strategies
  • Must have knowledge of Smart Workplace applications such as Appspace and experience of deploying this to multiple sites globally
  • Understanding of product performance measures and KPIs, with the ability to drive improvements in product adoption, cycle time, stability, support effort, and overall user experience.
  • Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
  • Experience working within Real Estate & Facilities technology
  • Experience deploying Appspace in a multi-site, global environment
  • Experience developing roadmaps for Workplace Experience technologies
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
  • Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
  • Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
  • Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
  • Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.
  • Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices.

Preferred Skills:

  • Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions.
  • Skilled in coaching and guiding Product Analysts and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations.
  • Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.
  • Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant.
  • Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately.


Skills

Automation, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, Digital Solutions, Digital Strategy, Product Management Leadership, Product Strategies, Services Management, Smart Buildings, Stakeholder Management, Workplace Technology

title: Software Engineer - Ethernet System Test
location: Warren, Michigan, United States of America
description:
Job Description

The Role:

We are looking for a talented and motivated candidate to join our team in our journey of defining and executing the backbone of our company's future—the next generation Vehicle Electrical and Software Architecture. The Mechatronics Infrastructure organization is looking for a Software Engineer who will develop test scripts, execute test cases on infrastructure software builds across a family of microcontrollers, triage daily test results, and collaborate with our software and integration teams in the software quality lifecycle from defect root-cause through complete validation. The role will interface with both physical and virtual network test assets. The system functionality in scope covers the data-link layer, gPTP, ARP, TCP/IP stack, SOME/IP, Service Discovery, as well as several custom protocols for dynamic network configuration. The role will cross-collaborate with teams working on embedded software, system specifications, virtual models, test automation infrastructure, and architecture analysis. This is an excellent opportunity to make an impact to the infrastructure software quality of a brand-new embedded vehicle platform while building expertise on a full-stack automotive Ethernet solution.


What You'll Do:

  • Develop and maintain Python scripts and libraries to automate the test execution of key networking functions as mentioned in the role summary
  • Validate test scripts in HIL and virtual test execution environments
  • Deploy scripts to the overall test execution pipeline
  • Monitor daily test results, perform root-cause analysis, and debug
  • In close collaboration with system engineers, develop and iterate on behavioral technical specifications that define system functionality and test scenarios
  • Support software quality assurance efforts for key vehicle program milestones
  • Use AI tools and automation workflows towards to increase efficiency in development, root-cause analysis, and triage

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications):

  • Bachelor of Science in Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related experience.
  • 2 years of experience
  • Advanced Python programming knowledge
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Github, Jenkins, BlueFlag, and related platforms.
  • Experience developing software, troubleshooting computer networks, and analyzing logs.
  • Knowledge of some computer networking protocols, network architecture, and communication standards (examples include networking stacks like TCP/IP and SOME/IP).
  • Knowledge of and experience with software development lifecycle and testing methodologies.
  • Strong teamwork skills to collaborate effectively with peers, cross-functional teams, and stakeholders.
  • Strong knowledge of Git and other version control systems.
  • Use of modern AI tools

What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Other programming languages like C/C++ or Rust
  • Experience with automotive Ethernet switches and networks based on 100/1000BASE-T1 and 10BASE-T1S.
  • Advanced knowledge of the internals of the data-link layer components (for example, switch internals and communication software stack).
  • Master of Science in Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related experience.

INTEGRATE: Collaborate with and provide support to cancer center clinical programs and departments, ensuring that pharmacy is fully integrated into our multi-disciplinary, individualized patient care, and total cancer care philosophies.

Provide leadership to staff and the cancer center in the understanding of new trends and developing strategies to incorporate new concepts into Moffitt practice. title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Bij BBTG bouwen we software die werkt: oplossingen die live gaan en aantoonbare impact maken. Van digitale producten die miljoenen mensen gebruiken tot complexe systemen in het hart van organisaties. Je werkt in BBTG teams waarin je richting geeft aan technische keuzes. Met moderne technologie, bewezen engineering practices en veel aandacht voor developer experience helpen we organisaties echte techbedrijven te worden.


Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Java Software Engineer geef je richting op technisch en architectuurniveau binnen complexe projecten. Je combineert hands-on development met het adviseren over technologiekeuzes, ontwikkelstrategieën, softwarearchitectuur en bewaakt de kwaliteit.


Verder:

  • Zorg je dat best practices worden toegepast (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development);
  • Vertaal je business- en technische vraagstukken naar schaalbare oplossingen;
  • Stimuleer je Developer Experience binnen de teams;
  • Ben je een inhoudelijke sparringpartner binnen het team, je helpt het technische niveau structureel te verhogen.


Softwareontwikkeling als teamsport

We hebben een passie voor softwareontwikkeling en zien het als een teamsport. Je werkt met gedreven, hoogopgeleide en betrokken software engineers in BBTG teams samen.


Kennisdeling zit verweven in ons werk. Denk aan code reviews, pair programming, kennisfestival, LunchLabs en hackathons. Zo blijf je jezelf technisch ontwikkelen en leer je continu van andere engineers.


Onze impact

Je werkt aan software die dagelijks door grote groepen mensen wordt gebruikt. Een aantal voorbeeld projecten waar we nu aan werken zijn:


  • Transitie van iDEAL naar Wero: bij onze duurzaamste klant in de financiële sector zorgen we met een team van 4 ervoor dat de opvolger van iDEAL wordt geïmplementeerd (Java, Angular);
  • Toekomst van het spoor: Ons team van 6 bouwt aan de software die bepaalt hoe treinen in de toekomst gaan rijden. Geen voorgekauwde taken, maar volledige creatieve vrijheid van A tot Z (Java, Kubernetes en Angular/TypeScript);
  • Integratie in de energietransitie: Als Integratie Specialist met volledige creatieve vrijheid richten wij ons binnen dit project op development, architectuur en het direct met de klant uitdenken en bouwen van nieuwe functionaliteiten en de technische invulling hiervan (Java).


Je bouwt dus niet alleen systemen, maar oplossingen die zichtbaar impact maken in de maatschappij.


We werken ook met andere technologieën zoals C#, Python, TypeScript en frameworks als Angular en React. Qua cloudtechnologie werken we met Azure en AWS.


Voordelen aan werken bij BBTG:

Er is veel aandacht en ruimte voor ontwikkeling. Als Senior Java Software Engineer krijg je bij BBTG de kans om technisch de diepte in te gaan én impact te maken buiten je eigen project. Je werkt aan complexe vraagstukken, helpt andere engineers groeien en bouwt mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van AI Powered Software Delivery.


Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

  • Veel vrijheid om je werk en je persoonlijke ontwikkeling op jouw manier vorm te geven;
  • Een Technology Officer en mentor die niet bepaalt waar jij naartoe groeit, maar actief met je meedenkt over de route;
  • Alle ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen in technische diepgang én leiderschap;
  • Een gezonde work-life balance, met genoeg flexibiliteit om je werk ook met de rest van je leven te laten samenwerken;
  • Een contract voor onbepaalde tijd;
  • Een leasebudget of mobiliteitsvergoeding. Jij kiest wat bij je past;
  • Netto vergoedingen voor je mobiele telefoon en internet thuis;
  • Een goede pensioenregeling.


Jouw toolkit:

Je ziet kansen voor verbetering en neemt het initiatief om samen met je team nieuwe technieken of methodieken uit te proberen. Verder heb jij:

  • Een technische bachelor, master en/of PhD op zak;
  • Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring opgedaan met Java;
  • Een onderzoekende houding waarbij je kritische vragen stelt en het leuk vindt om buiten de gebaande paden naar oplossingen te zoeken;
  • Een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.


Over het team

We vinden teambuilding en een goede, informele werksfeer erg belangrijk. Ons cluster telt zo’n 50 collega’s en we werken vanuit een prachtig kantoor in Driebergen-Rijsenburg. Zo heb je regelmatig check-ins met iemand van het MT wandelend door de bossen. We organiseren activiteiten zoals onze boekenclub, wekelijkse crossfit, zomerfeesten, wijnproeverijen, padel, boulderen, wintersport en de Stelvio op in Italië.


Wil je meer weten of eerst even vrijblijvend sparren? Dat kan altijd! Solliciteer direct via LinkedIn of mail naar recruitment@bbtg.com.

title: Data Analyst - Commercial
description:
Role and Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the collection, extraction, cleansing and validation of commercial data across Ergomed, PrimeVigilance and ADAMAS, working with business data owners to resolve discrepancies and ensure reliable reporting inputs.
  • Prepare and deliver weekly commercial reports to agreed deadlines, highlighting key movements, trends, exceptions and areas requiring leadership attention at Group, business and regional levels.
  • Prepare and maintain standard monthly commercial reporting packs, combining validated metrics, performance against agreed targets, trend and variance analysis across all three businesses.
  • Design, build and maintain Microsoft Power BI data models, dashboards and reports, providing consistent Group-level views and business-specific drill-downs with appropriate access controls and reliable refresh processes.
  • Analyse commercial performance, including pipeline, business wins, conversion rates and performance against targets, to identify trends, explain variances and provide decision-useful insights, clearly distinguishing findings from assumptions.
  • Partner with global and regional stakeholders to define reporting requirements, agree priorities and translate business questions into practical analytical outputs, balancing common reporting standards with the needs of each business.
  • Create executive-ready reporting and presentations in PowerPoint using think-cell, translating complex datasets into clear charts, concise narratives and consistent visual formats for leadership reviews.
  • Support market, customer and competitive analysis through targeted secondary research and available data, prioritising activities that inform commercial reporting and leadership decisions across the three businesses.
  • Maintain common KPI definitions, reporting documentation, data mappings, version control and quality checks; reconcile outputs with approved source data and document business-specific differences to support consistent, traceable reporting.
  • Deliver ad hoc analysis in response to leadership and business requests, clarifying the question, scope and deadline and communicating findings, assumptions and limitations clearly without compromising scheduled reporting commitments.
  • Work collaboratively across Business Development, Marketing, Finance, Operations and relevant systems teams across businesses and regions to align reporting inputs, validate interpretation and support adoption of reporting tools.
  • Drive the agreed modernisation of existing reporting, moving manual and fragmented outputs towards scalable Power BI dashboards, automated data preparation and reusable executive reporting templates; test and validate changes before transition and document improvements.
  • Follow applicable requirements for data access, confidentiality, data protection and appropriate data use.

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Business, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent relevant practical experience in data analytics, reporting or business intelligence.

Approximately 2–4 years of relevant experience in commercial data analysis, reporting or business intelligence, including hands-on development of Power BI dashboards and preparation of recurring management reports.

Experience producing executive reporting and presentations using PowerPoint and think-cell. Experience supporting stakeholders across multiple businesses, regions or functions and improving manual reporting processes. Experience in life sciences or a professional services environment is desirable.

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.

  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.

  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.

  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.

  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.

  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

title: ASL Operations, AS
description:
Job Description:

Job Title- ASL Operations, AS

Location- Bangalore, India

Role Description

  • Our purpose as a business is to be dedicated to our clients’ lasting success and financial security. We want to be a bank that creates a positive impact for clients, employees, investors, and society. This is made possible by our people. As you'll discover, our culture supports this - diverse, international, and shaped by a variety of different perspectives. We are driven by a shared sense of purpose. At every level agile thinking is nurtured and rewarded with support and provided with opportunities to excel together.
  • Agency Service Lending Operations (ASL Ops) is a process of lending out securities of DB London clients and DB America clients, which is held by the client’s custodians as and when instructed. However, for some clients DB is the custodian as well, for rest we provide the services.
  • The Agency lending team is responsible for day-to-day Static, Recon and Cash/Collateral settlements for its onshore partners DBAG, London and DBAG, New York. This team is based in India on 3 locations Jaipur, Pune and Bangalore.
  • The ASL client base is comprised of institutional clients (pension funds, insurance companies, central banks, etc.) which hold large / long balances of these securities.
  • Agency Securities Lending (ASL) is a portfolio management tool that institutional clients can use to generate an attractive risk-adjusted portfolio return on their fixed income and equity portfolios as well as cash positions.

What we’ll offer you

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy

  • Best in class leave policy
  • Gender neutral parental leaves
  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
  • Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and Term life Insurance
  • Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities

  • Monitoring of daily exposure management for equity trades for both underlying clients and counterparts. Booking cash collateral in and out from counterparties. Monitoring of same day equity trades ensuring settlement, releasing instructions for same day trades into the market, amending trades as per desk requests, processing of crest loans.
  • Supervision on the aged equity trades to ensure settlement, amending trades as per desk requests, performing reconciliations tasks, processing of crest returns.
  • Monitor all collateral bookings made by Fixed Income and Equity collateral through to settlement. Bond settlements only
  • Daily exposure management for equity trades for both underlying clients and counterparts. Booking collateral in and out from counterparties. Re-allocating between ASL clients
  • Collateral management vs all Triparty Non-Cash deals. This includes monitoring the settlement of collateral where we have new deals booked on VD pending release.
  • Collateral management vs all Bi-Lat deals (Cash and NC) on a T+1 basis. Agreeing re-prices with counterparty and ensuring all ASL clients are fully covered.
  • Manage staff on a daily basis, distribute work, assign responsibilities, ensure appropriate staff motivation levels and continuous learning.
  • Effectively manage risk and foster an environment where team is fully aware of Operational Risk management.
  • Cross train available resources to ensure 100% backup within the areas under control
  • Escalate all issues properly, in time, to the appropriate level, to avoid any adverse impact on the business.

Your skills and experience

  • Analyst (0-3 years), Senior Analyst (3-7 years) preferably in Banking / Finance Service Industry/Agency Securities Lending
  • Domain knowledge of Settlements / Payments, corporate actions, Cash reconciliation, Billing & Invoice generation, Reconciliation, Loan servicing would be added advantage.
  • Good written & verbal communication skills.
  • MS Office skills (especially MS excel)
  • Ability to provide high transaction productivity and high level of attention to detail.
  • Flexibility to work in shifts.

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

How we’ll support you

  • Training and development to help you excel in your career
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

About us and our teams

Please visit our company website for further information:


We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration
description:
Job Description


Vacancy Status: This posting is for a new vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications.

AI Disclosure: As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Markham Elevation Centre or the Oshawa Elevation Centre at least three times per week.


The Team & Opportunity


The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.

We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.

The ideal candidate combines strong business analysis and stakeholder engagement skills with experience in enterprise data environments and complex technology change. They are comfortable working across business stakeholders, data engineering, software, governance, and data quality teams to clarify needs, manage requirements and delivery processes, and help lead large-scale migration work while supporting the continuity of existing data services.

The Role


As a Business Analyst, Enterprise Data & Cloud Migration, you will serve as a primary interface between stakeholders across GM Canada and the internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams. You will translate business needs into clear requirements, delivery priorities, processes, and documentation that enable teams to maintain the existing enterprise data environment and deliver its migration to a cloud-based implementation.

This role combines business analysis, delivery coordination, and change management responsibilities. You will manage requirements and documentation, support process definition and improvement, facilitate sprint planning and backlog activities, and coordinate stakeholders through complex, interdependent work. You will play a critical role in migration planning and execution, helping teams assess impacts, manage dependencies and risks, validate outcomes, and maintain business continuity. The cloud implementation may be Azure/Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or another direction based on platform and business requirements.

Key Responsibilities


  • Act as the primary point of contact and day-to-day interface between GM Canada stakeholders and internal data, software, governance, and data quality teams.
  • Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, data, reporting, and operational requirements.
  • Translate stakeholder needs into clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and delivery priorities.
  • Coordinate discovery of the existing enterprise data environment, including business processes, data flows, interfaces, dependencies, consumers, controls, and operational procedures.
  • Support the ongoing operation of the legacy enterprise data environment while coordinating enhancements, issue resolution, and stakeholder communications.
  • Help lead large-scale, complex migration efforts by coordinating business and technical workstreams, requirements, dependencies, risks, decisions, testing, and readiness activities.
  • Work with technical teams to assess the business and operational impacts of migrating data, processes, interfaces, reports, and downstream consumers to a cloud-based environment.
  • Facilitate requirements traceability from business needs through design, development, testing, release, and post-implementation validation.
  • Coordinate data validation, reconciliation, business acceptance, and sign-off activities to confirm migrated data and capabilities meet business needs.
  • Create, maintain, and manage project and operational documentation, including requirements, process maps, decision logs, data definitions, meeting outcomes, test scenarios, release materials, and user guidance.
  • Define and improve processes, workflows, roles, and handoffs across business and technical teams, including processes for data quality, governance, issue management, and change delivery.
  • Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, prioritization, demos, and retrospectives in partnership with product owners and delivery teams.
  • Track progress, milestones, actions, decisions, risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies; communicate status and escalate blockers to the appropriate stakeholders.
  • Support data governance and data quality practices by coordinating ownership, definitions, standards, controls, issue resolution, and business approvals.
  • Coordinate stakeholder engagement and change readiness, ensuring affected teams understand upcoming changes, impacts, timelines, and required actions.
  • Collaborate with data architects, engineers, developers, analytics teams, product owners, and business partners to ensure proposed solutions align with business outcomes and enterprise standards.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery practices, documentation standards, stakeholder communications, and operational processes.

Required Qualifications and Skills


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, Project Analyst, or in a similar role supporting data, software, technology, or enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Experience eliciting, analyzing, documenting, and validating requirements across multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Experience working with data platforms, data warehouses, databases, reporting, data integration, or related enterprise technology.
  • Experience supporting complex technology change, migration, modernization, or transformation initiatives, including coordination across multiple teams and dependencies.
  • Strong documentation skills, including requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, meeting outcomes, decisions, and status reporting.
  • Experience supporting Agile delivery, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, estimation, and delivery tracking.
  • Ability to understand and communicate data flows, interfaces, system dependencies, business processes, and impacts across upstream and downstream teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify gaps, clarify ambiguity, assess impacts, and organize complex information.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication for business and technical audiences.
  • Strong facilitation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align teams with differing priorities.
  • Proficiency with collaboration and delivery tools such as Jira and Confluence, or comparable tools.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, timelines, and priorities.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience supporting enterprise data warehouse or data platform migrations, particularly from on-premises Oracle environments to cloud platforms.
  • Familiarity with Azure Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or comparable cloud data and analytics platforms.
  • Experience supporting large-scale or complex migrations involving data, ETL/ELT processes, reports, interfaces, or downstream consumers.
  • Experience with data governance, data quality management, metadata, data cataloging, lineage, or master/reference data practices.
  • Experience defining migration approach, scope, business impacts, dependencies, readiness criteria, and validation or reconciliation plans.
  • Familiarity with SQL and the ability to review queries, data structures, mappings, and reconciliation results.
  • Experience coordinating user acceptance testing, defect triage, business sign-off, and post-release validation.
  • Experience working in a large, matrixed, or regulated organization with formal security, privacy, risk, or change-management practices.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Lucidchart, Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, or equivalent requirements and process-mapping tools.


Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $97,800 to $146,600. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.




GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need gm immigration sponsorship now or in the future.

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the selected candidate is expected to report to a specific location at least 3 times a week {or other frequency dictated by their manager}.

title: Associate Director, Product Owner - Comp, Benefits /Well-Being
description:
Job Purpose:


  • Associate Director, Product Owner - Comp, Benefits /Well-Being is responsible for maximising the value of Reward Products by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the HR product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Dir, Reward Product Manager and SD, People Services + Reward Digital & Tech. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Comp, Benefits and Wellbeing Product Owner guides delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.
  • This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

Key Responsibilities:


  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the Dir, Reward Product Manager and SD, People Services + Reward Digital & Tech.
  • Own and manage the Product backlog for Tech managed products within the portfolio, ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
  • Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the Dir, Reward Product Manager and SD, People Services + Reward Digital & Tech.
  • Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
  • Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
  • Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
  • Ensure new and existing follow required security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant stakeholders where required.
  • Support Solution Architects to assess design options and manage cross-Product dependencies, contract/interface impacts, and sequencing needs to support interoperability and consistent business outcomes.
  • Act as an escalation point for the HR Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by the Dir, Reward Product Manager and SD, People Services + Reward Digital & Tech.
  • Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile (i.e. SaFe, Scrum etc), iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact

Required skills:


  • 15 to 19 years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
  • Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
  • Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
  • Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
  • Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
  • Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.
  • Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.

Preferred skills:

  • Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions.
  • Skilled in coaching and guiding Associate Product Owners and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations.
  • Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.
  • Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant.
  • Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately.
  • Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and change


Skills

Agile Methodology, Automation, Change Controls, DevOps, Digital Solutions, Microsoft Azure, Product Delivery, Product Management, Workday Benefits, Workday Compensation, Workday HCM

title: Sr. Coordinator Quality Control - tMart
description:

What you need to be successful

title: CHAPS & International Payments Test Lead – Banking
description:
Hello!

At MBC by Izertis, we are continuing to grow, and we are now looking for a CHAPS & International Payments Test Lead with strong experience in test management and leadership within banking payment transformation programmes, to join an exciting international project in the financial services sector.

About MBC

May Business Consulting is an international consulting firm providing advisory services in digital transformation, change management, efficiency, and control. We take a fully client-focused approach, proactively engaging in every project to maximise the value we deliver.

We have offices in Spain and the United Kingdom.

We work on international projects with financial institutions, fintech companies, and startups.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Test Lead with a strong background in banking and financial services, specialising in CHAPS, international payments, ISO 20022, and SWIFT messaging.

The successful candidate will be responsible for leading, planning, and coordinating testing activities across CHAPS and International Payments workstreams, ensuring high-quality delivery, regulatory compliance, and effective collaboration between technology teams, business stakeholders, and external suppliers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage the testing strategy and test plans for CHAPS and International Payments transformation initiatives.

  • Define and coordinate all testing phases, including System Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), End-to-End Testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Dress Rehearsals, and Production Verification Testing.

  • Coordinate testing activities across technology teams, business operations, shared services, third-party vendors, and external delivery partners.

  • Coordinate test data requirements and ensure the availability of appropriate testing environments.

  • Assess release readiness, support Go/No-Go decisions, and contribute to successful production deployments.

Requirements:

  • Extensive experience in Test Management within banking or financial services.

  • Proven track record of leading large-scale payments testing programmes.

  • Strong knowledge of CHAPS and international payment processing, including ISO 20022 and SWIFT messaging.

  • Hands-on experience managing System Integration Testing (SIT), End-to-End Testing, and UAT.

title: Vice President, Communications Review Group (CRG), GCIB Business Controls, GCIB Business Controls Japan
description:
Job Description:

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

Our Global Corporate & Investment Banking (GCIB) business focuses on building long-term relationships with more than 6,000 large U.S. and multinational corporations, financial institutions and financial sponsors. We provide strong advisory expertise, capitalizing on powerful mergers and acquisitions, corporate banking, treasury, debt and equity product expertise to deliver integrated financial solutions.

Role Overview

The Communications Review Group (CRG) is the first-line Business Control team responsible for monitoring written electronic communications across GCIB, identifying, detecting, documenting and escalating potentially inappropriate activity to the appropriate control partners. CRG operates across surveillance execution and related operational controls globally. This role is for Asia-based member of CRG and the anchor of the team’s APAC coverage, with particular focus on Japan. Beyond in-language review coverage for the regional population, ownership of recurring surveillance and escalation reporting, contributing across the team’s control workstreams, and represents CRG governance forums and with regional stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Communication Monitoring and Escalation

  • Perform daily lexicon-based review of flagged written electronic communications for multiple jurisdictions and provide back-up coverage across the wider APAC population.
  • Analyze flagged messages, determine whether activity is potentially problematic, escalate to the appropriate stakeholders, and follow open escalations through to closure within established timelines and aged-reporting constructs.
  • Document review, escalation and outcome with clear, well-supported write-ups.
  • Identify emerging risk themes in-region, including use of non-approved communication channels and applications, non-approved AI and transcription tools, confidential or proprietary information sharing, potential market manipulation, and conduct or policy concerns.
  • Design and execute targeted reviews covering business-specific and region-specific risk topics, and support enhanced and supplemental monitoring programs.
  • Monitor daily message review volumes and support allocation and out-of-office coverage across the team to ensure that unreviewed and timely review message thresholds are met.

Regional Coverage, Reporting and Program Contribution

  • Act as CRG representative in region and the primary point of contact for bankers, COOs and control partners on communications monitoring matters.
  • Serve as coordinator for APAC-based reviews, supporting consistency of judgment, quality of escalation write-ups and smooth daily coverage, and mentor and develop junior reviewers.
  • Own and deliver recurring surveillance and escalation reporting, including weekly and management-level reporting, highlighting focus areas of risk, trends and themes.
  • Prepare executive-ready materials and metrics for senior management and governance forums, and represent GCIB CRG at committees, forums and meetings as required.
  • Contribute broadly across the team’s control workstreams and program deliverables. These span lexicon design and testing, quality assurance, metrics and reporting, targeted reviews, voice recording monitoring, regulated population oversight, Business Electronic Communications, communication-related privacy and data controls, procedures and documentation governance, process management, issues, audits, assessments and regulatory requests, complaints, learning and development, and operational excellence including AI and automation initiatives.
  • Provide translation and interpretation of Japanese-language communications and source documents where escalation, reporting or partner review requires it.
  • Maintain effective working relationships with US and Singapore teammates across time zones, and with Compliance, Employee Relations, Legal and the business.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Native-level Japanese and native-level English, written and spoken. The role requires substantive review of Japanese-language communications and clear escalation write-ups, procedures and executive reporting in English.
  • Experience in electronic communications surveillance, compliance, business controls, audit, or a comparable risk function within a financial institution.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a control process or program deliverable end to end, with evidence of building or improving a routine rather than solely operating one.
  • Sound judgment on what constitutes a potentially problematic communication, with the confidence to escalate and the discipline to ask when unclear.
  • Ability to operate independently with minimal direction and to drive deliverables to completion across time zones.
  • Ability to collaborate across a wide span of stakeholders including bankers, senior management, risk partners and auditors, and to represent the team in governance forums.
  • Control-focused mindset and a good understanding of regulatory, conduct and reputational risk.
  • Proven ability to develop executive-ready presentations, reporting and metrics.
  • Strong attention to detail and a high standard for quality work product, sustained in a high-volume review environment.
  • Effective time management and prioritization, with the ability to deliver across planned and ad hoc priorities and to flex during periods of high workflow.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, highly matrixed global environment.
  • Highly proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word.

Preferred

  • Additional language capability, particularly Chinese (Mandarin or Cantonese), Korean, Thai, Bahasa or another APAC language, or a European language.
  • Knowledge of the Japan regulatory environment and local record-keeping, privacy and communications expectations.
  • Familiarity with surveillance and case management tools (for example Proofpoint, Surveil-X, Bloomberg Vault) and with voice recording and monitoring concepts.
  • Experience with lexicon development, tuning or false-positive reduction.
  • Experience with quality assurance sampling, independent testing or audit response.
  • Data analytics, automation or visualization capability (for example Tableau, workflow bots).
  • Experience building or deploying control processes and control changes, or drafting procedures and job aids.
  • Understanding of the Business Electronic Communications (BEC) program or equivalent off-channel communications control frameworks.

Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.


About Sunrun

Since 2007, Sunrun has grown into America's #1 home solar and battery company. We got here by putting our people’s safety and growth first. That’s why we created the Power+ program: to invest in your skills. We train you to work across different teams—from qualifying homes for solar, to installing, to inspecting the final work, and servicing existing systems. This versatility helps limit reduced hours and enhances job security in an industry affected by seasons. It also means you can solve customer problems in one visit, keeping you safely off the road and moving your career forward.


Overview
The Electrical Foreperson will provide leadership and technical expertise for a solar installation crew. The Electrical Foreperson is responsible for the Safety, Quality, Customer Service, and Productivity of each assigned solar installation project. The Electrical Foreperson is a working field position that leads a team of 3 to 6 members to successfully complete residential and small commercial projects.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the successful installation of residential solar projects
  • Organize, lead, and train crew members to complete projects within established guidelines and timeframes
  • Ensure attention to detail with an emphasis on safety, quality, customer service, and productivity
  • Effectively manage all aspects of the construction workflow of the project to drive productivity
  • Ensure that there is adequate materials and equipment to safely and efficiently complete projects
  • Effectively maintain project documentation and photo requirements
  • Demonstrate knowledge of OSHA standards related to photovoltaic installations and enforce safety practices and standards
  • Check on progress of installers every hour throughout the installation to ensure the installation process
  • Follow Construction Job Flow Procedures
  • Develop a positive working dynamic within installation crew and branch co-workers
  • Analyze and resolve worker problems and recommend solutions
  • Maintain consistent and appropriate interface with customer throughout construction phase
  • Perform weekly vehicle inspection for proper tire pressures, oil level, working lights, etc
  • Obtain customer payments and deliver to management as required
  • Ensure accuracy of your own and crew's time sheets
  • Provide construct-ability feedback to management
  • Maintain excellent lines of communication
  • Perform service calls when necessary
  • Additional duties assigned as needed


Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Must possess a valid Journeyman License/Electrician Certification or equivalent per local and state requirements, e.g. wireman license
  • Knowledge of the NEC and applicable codes and standards. Carry and maintain up-to-date NEC code book
  • Ability to perform all installation duties of the Installer and Lead Installer
  • Have CPR and First Aid Certifications up to date and keep maintained for purposes of continued employment (class costs are reimbursable by the company)
  • Physically capable of performing work duties
  • Professional appearance and customer interaction
  • Have a strong work ethic, high level of craftsmanship/workmanship with strong attention to detail
  • Basic computer knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Word
  • Possess strong mechanical/construction skills
  • Have excellent verbal communication and documentation skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Have good people skills, able to manage, motivate and discipline when necessary
  • Experience with electrical work involving wiring up to 600 VDC and 480 VAC
  • Maintain a valid Driver’s License
  • 5% travel required


Physical Demands

  • Ability to transport materials and equipment to complete assigned job tasks (up to 50 pounds frequently and up to 100 pounds with assistance)
  • Ability to work on rooftops with various angles and surfaces which requires frequent bending, twisting, squatting, climbing, kneeling, crawling, turning, standing, and balance
  • Ability to work in confined spaces such as attics, basements, and crawl spaces which requires kneeling and crouching
  • Ability to work in outdoor weather conditions including but not limited to: excessive noise, extreme heat, extreme cold, wet environment, and humidity
  • Ability to frequently utilize hand functions requiring fine motor skills including but not limited to: fine manipulation, grasping, and pinching
  • Ability to work within the safe range of equipment such as ladders, fall protection harnesses and other personal protective equipment
  • Ability to work while wearing heavy protective equipment such as arc flash suits, gloves, and face shields
  • Ability to work and maintain balance on roofs and other areas of height
  • Ability to work in the sun and possibly low light conditions
  • Ability to walk on rafters, roof tiles, and roof shingles without damage
  • Ability to distinguish colors such as red, black, yellow, white, green
  • Ability to hear verbal commands and warnings
  • Ability to work with chemicals using appropriate protection

description:
