title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Edmonton, Alberta | Full-Time | Leadership Position
Technology that supports exceptional patient care
At MIC Medical Imaging, technology is essential to how we deliver safe, efficient and reliable diagnostic imaging services. From the systems our teams depend on every day to the infrastructure connecting our clinics, we need technology that is secure, resilient and ready to support a growing organization.
We are looking for an experienced IT Manager to lead the day-to-day delivery of MIC's technology infrastructure and operations.
Reporting to the Director of Technology and Innovation, the IT Manager will provide leadership to MIC's IT team and oversee the reliable and secure operation of our infrastructure, endpoints and core technology services. This role will also manage our day-to-day relationship with our managed service provider and other technology partners.
This is an opportunity for an experienced technology leader who enjoys being close to the work, developing people, solving complex operational issues and building the technology foundation that a healthcare organization needs to grow.
What you'll be responsible for
Infrastructure & OperationsYou'll oversee the technology services that keep MIC connected and operational, including networks, connectivity, firewalls, internet services, telephony and unified communications, compute, virtualization, storage, cloud environments, identity and access, backup and recovery, monitoring, capacity and infrastructure lifecycle planning.
Endpoint Engineering & ManagementYou'll lead the management and evolution of MIC's endpoint environment, including application packaging, endpoint architecture, automation, security baselines, deployment tooling and device lifecycle.
Operational SecurityWorking collaboratively with MIC's privacy and security stakeholders, you'll ensure sound operational practices are in place for access management, vulnerability remediation, patching, asset management, recovery and other technical security controls.
Managed Services & Vendor ManagementYou'll lead the day-to-day relationship with MIC's managed service provider and technology vendors, with accountability for service levels, ticket performance, escalations, after-hours coverage, administration and access to specialist technical expertise when required.
Team Leadership & Capability DevelopmentYou'll lead and develop MIC's IT team by establishing clear priorities, assigning work, coaching and supporting team members, strengthening documentation and cross-training, and building appropriate succession and coverage across infrastructure and endpoint responsibilities.
Service Reliability & Continuous ImprovementYou'll monitor technology performance, identify recurring issues and risks, and translate MIC's operational priorities into practical technology improvements. You'll ensure material risks related to service, security, capacity and technology lifecycle are identified and escalated appropriately.
What you bring

A post-secondary degree or diploma in information technology, computer science, engineering or a related discipline. Equivalent combinations of education and progressive experience will also be considered.
At least 7 years of progressive IT infrastructure or operations experience, including 3 or more years leading technical staff or technology service functions.
Experience supporting complex, multi-site technology environments.
Demonstrated accountability for infrastructure, endpoint platforms, operational security and vendor or managed-service performance.
Experience in healthcare, diagnostic imaging or another regulated, high-availability environment is strongly preferred.
Working knowledge of ITIL practices, including incident, problem and change management.
Experience with disaster recovery, cybersecurity controls, technology lifecycle management and business continuity.
Hands-on familiarity with Microsoft enterprise technologies, networking, virtualization, cloud platforms, endpoint management and automation.
Experience managing technology budgets, contracts, licensing, warranties and vendor relationships.
The ability to remain calm, practical and decisive when technology issues affect clinical or business operations.

What will make you successful at MIC
You're someone who understands that great IT isn't simply about technology. It's about making sure people can do their jobs effectively and patients can continue to receive care.
You can move comfortably between strategic priorities and operational realities. You know when to dig into a technical issue, when to delegate, when to involve a vendor and when a risk needs to be escalated.
You build strong teams, create accountability and develop processes that make the technology environment more reliable rather than more complicated.
And in a healthcare environment where downtime matters, you understand the importance of reliability, security, responsiveness and follow-through.
The role
The position is based in Edmonton and requires travel to MIC facilities and partner locations as needed. The IT Manager will occasionally work outside regular business hours to support planned maintenance, implementations, major incidents or restoration of clinical services.
The position participates in MIC's operational escalation model and may provide technical on-call leadership in accordance with the approved support model.
Why MIC?
MIC Medical Imaging is an Alberta-based diagnostic imaging organization with a long history of providing exceptional medical imaging services to patients and referring healthcare professionals.
You'll be joining MIC at an important time in our evolution. As we continue to grow and strengthen our technology capabilities, this position will play a key role in ensuring our technology foundation is reliable, secure, scalable and ready for what comes next.
If you're an experienced IT leader who enjoys developing people, improving technology operations and seeing the direct impact of your work on a healthcare organization, we'd like to hear from you.
Apply today and help build the technology foundation that supports MIC's people, patients and future.

Human Resources and Financial Management

Workday), pay dates, legislation changes (i.e. minimum wage, overtime, etc.).Manages, reconciles, and oversees execution of a large annual budget, which includes decision-making and spending authority over staff salaries, professional development, and program operation costs (e.g. Front Desk services, general program administration for the business unit, and contracted services).

title: Senior-Principal Product Analyst - Legal Ops
description:
About the Team:

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech delivers digital solutions that support Legal & Compliance and Workplace Real Estate & Facilities (WREF). This team drives product roadmaps and manages platforms that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward


Job Purpose:

The Senior-Principal Product Analyst - Legal Ops supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with the Legal Operations Product Owner, IP Product Owner and Solution Architect, they help shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The Legal Operations Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the Product.


This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the Legal Operations Product Owner and IP Product Owner to realise the Product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.
  • Document as-is and to-be system processes, identifying opportunities for system, process, and workflow improvement, supported by impact analysis and basic data insights.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., security, performance, operability, accessibility), ensuring they are reflected in specifications and delivery plans.
  • Document functional and technical specifications needed to deliver changes and support configuration or code delivery by providing clear design inputs; maintain configuration repositories and version updates where applicable.
  • Support technical delivery teams by advising Developers and Test Analysts on expected system behaviour and acceptance criteria, informed by clear business and non-functional requirements.
  • Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
  • Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
  • Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
  • Support the Legal Operations Product Owner and IP Product Owner to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
  • Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).
  • Support the Legal Operations Product Owner and IP Product Owner to identify and implement automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
  • Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.
  • Follow all DTMS policies and procedures to ensure a compliant product portfolio across the Legal Operations and Intellectual Property systems
  • Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

Required Qualification & Skills:

  • 10 to 14 years of professional experience with Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
  • Typically 10+ years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
  • Experience supporting Legal Operations and IP systems in a highly regulated industry
  • Experience with technologies such as Ironclad, NetDocs, Anaqua, Harvey, Legora would be highly advantageous
  • Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
  • Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
  • Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
  • Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
  • Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. SAP certification in related area, Agile methodologies)

Preferred Skills:

  • Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery
  • Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
  • Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
  • Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
  • Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.


Skills

Agile Methodology, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), Digital Solutions, Legal Documents, Legal Technology

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Principal Reimbursement Analyst
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

The Pelvic Health (PH) business within Medtronic is focused on expanding patient access to therapies that address overactive bladder (urinary incontinence) and fecal incontinence. Medtronic has been the leader in this space with sacral nerve stimulators and with our newest portfolio in the implantable tibial neurostimulator technology space. The Reimbursement function partners with commercial, clinical, health economics, government affairs, and market access teams to secure reimbursement, funding, and adoption pathways across Europe, supporting the establishment of innovative therapies as standards of care.

The Principal Reimbursement Analyst leads the development and execution of reimbursement and health economic strategies that support market access, funding, and adoption of Pelvic Health therapies across Europe. In Pelvic Health, there is a unique experience in bringing a first-in-kind technology with the Medtronic implantable tibial neurostimulator technology and provide greater value positioning and adoption for sacral nerve stimulation. This role partners with regional and global stakeholders to generate evidence, shape value propositions, support Health Technology Assessment (HTA) submissions, and advance reimbursement pathways for innovative medical technologies. This remote role may be based in the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy, or other appropriate Western European locations. Expected travel is approximately 20% of working time across the region.

Primary Responsibilities


  • Lead reimbursement and market access strategies for Pelvic Health (PH) therapies across European markets.
  • Shape evidence generation plans by providing reimbursement and health economics input into clinical study design, healthcare utilization measures, and patient-reported outcomes.
  • Develop health economic analyses, including cost-effectiveness, cost-utility, cost-of-illness, and budget impact models supporting reimbursement and funding submissions.
  • Create regional value dossiers, value propositions, and economic tools supporting Health Technology Assessment (HTA), Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG), and payer funding requirements.
  • Partner with marketing, clinical, pricing, government affairs, and market access teams to align evidence-generation and reimbursement priorities.
  • Define and communicate clinical and economic evidence to internal and external stakeholders through reimbursement submissions, scientific publications, and educational initiatives.
  • Monitor reimbursement and healthcare policy developments across Europe, identifying market access risks and opportunities that inform business strategy.

Required Qualifications


  • Experience developing and executing reimbursement, market access, health economics, Health Technology Assessment (HTA), or healthcare funding strategies within the medical device or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Experience developing reimbursement submissions, funding applications, or market access strategies for healthcare technologies.
  • Experience conducting health economic analyses, outcomes research, or economic model development.
  • Knowledge of European reimbursement, healthcare funding, and Health Technology Assessment (HTA) systems.
  • Fluency in English.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Master's degree, Master of Public Health (MPH), Master of Public Policy (MPP), Master of Business Administration (MBA), Doctor of Philosophy (PhD), or Medical Doctor (MD).
  • Experience supporting medical device and implantable device therapies and/or diligence/submission in reimbursement strategies for new technologies.
  • Additional European language proficiency, peer-reviewed publications, or experience developing multi-country reimbursement strategies within Europe.

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

Benefits & Compensation

title: Sunday Assistant (Leven)
description:
Millions of bargain-hunters. Endless pre-loved items. One meaningful purpose.

Retail store assistant (with keyholder responsibility)

£12.71 per hour plus benefits

Department: ​Trading​

Contract: ​Permanent​

Location: Leven Shop

​​At Cancer Research UK, we exist to beat cancer.​

​​We are professionals with purpose, beating cancer every day. But we need to go much further and much faster. That’s why we’re looking for someone talented, someone who wants to develop their skills, someone like you. ​

We’re looking for a motivated retail assistant to join Cancer Research UK’s trading team. You’ll be acting as an ambassador for Cancer Research UK and taking responsibility for the shop on a Sunday.

What are you looking for?

  • A working knowledge of what makes great customer service.
  • Experience of working in a lively and vibrant environment.
  • Adaptability in changing situations, including being able to work effectively independently and as part of a team.

[Download the Candidate Pack]

For more information on this career opportunity please visit our website or contact us at recruitment@cancer.org.uk.

For more updates on our work and careers, follow us on: Linked In, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

Our vision is to create a charity where everyone feels like they belong, benefits from and participates in, the work we do. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and cultures, in particular those from ethnic minority backgrounds who are currently under-represented.

We want to see every candidate performing at their best throughout the job application process, interview process and whilst at work. We therefore ask you to inform us of any concerns you have or any adjustments you might need to enable this to happen. Please contact recruitment@cancer.org.uk or 020 3469 8400 as soon as possible.

title: Associate Investment Strategy - 12 Month FTC
description:
The Financial Services division comprises the advisory and investment management services. Central to the division’s activities is the creation and oversight of its investment process which includes asset allocation and investment selection. Evelyn Partners’ investment methodology has been continually refined over a long period of time to cater for our clients’ broad range of circumstances and requirements. Accordingly, our services include personalised as well as bespoke portfolios, and centrally managed portfolios for clients with similar investment needs. We invest in a wide range of markets and investments, and different approaches may be appropriate through the economic cycle or according to client preference. As long-term stewards, the sustainability of the investments that make up our client portfolios has always been an important consideration. Our belief is that a collegiate approach to investment decision-making results in the best client outcomes. This includes three key components: -

• A fully integrated research function: the individuals who have responsibility for investment recommendations also provide investment and relationship management

• the asset allocation team which provides macro and quantitative inputs and plays the leading role in drawing together the different elements of investment recommendations

• And a management structure where oversight of the process is led by experienced and practicing Investment Managers from across the business. One of the key drivers of consistent investment returns is the application of a structured macro-economic view to asset allocations of all our clients’ investment portfolios.

Fixed term contract: This role is a 12 months fixed term contract with the possibility of extension

Asset Allocation & Investment Strategy

title: Director, HR Domain Architect
description:
About the Team:

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Our HR Digital & Tech team transforms how GSK attracts, develops, and retains talent through innovative technology solutions. From managing global HR platforms to delivering data-driven insights, this function ensures our people have the tools and experiences they need to thrive. Partnering closely with HR business teams, we create solutions that simplify processes, enhance employee engagement, and enable strategic workforce planning. If you’re passionate about technology that empowers people, this is where you can make an impact.

Job Purpose:

The Director, HR Domain Architect defines and governs the architectural framework for the HR Digital & Tech Domain, ensuring that technology decisions support business goals and enable the successful delivery of domain Products, such as Workday, Payroll & Time, etc. The role partners with senior stakeholders to guide solution direction, establish domain standards and principles, and provide architectural leadership across solutions delivered within the domain. The HR Digital & Tech Domain Architect ensures that products are designed in a way that is scalable, interoperable, and aligned to agreed business and technology objectives.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and maintain the architectural framework, standards, and schematics for the HR Digital & Tech Domain, including domain-specific principles, patterns, data flows, and interface models.
  • Introduce and govern a Domain Standards Catalogue (e.g., principles, reference patterns, SLAs, reusable assets), ensuring lifecycle ownership, version control, and adoption across delivery teams.
  • Partner with senior Business and IT stakeholders to guide domain technology decisions, ensuring alignment to business goals, risk appetite, and product delivery priorities.
  • Partner with VP Global HR D&T, Data and Digital Enablement Director and HR Tech Tower Leads to define long term architecture simplification and consolidation strategy
  • Partner with HR Tech Delivery Director on key architecture decisions and delivery of top priority projects
  • Lead business case development for new technology investments, ensuring alignment with key stakeholders and funding submission.
  • Provide architectural guidance to Solution Architects and delivery teams, enabling consistent design approaches; define reusable domain contracts and interface specifications with versioning, observability, and interoperability requirements.
  • Produce and maintain architecture artefacts for the domain (e.g., reference architectures, models, integration schematics, contract definitions, security patterns) required to support delivery and operational readiness.
  • Support compliance and governance processes (e.g. Architecture Review Board, Change Advisory Board), including architecture review checkpoints, exemption criteria, design sign-off, and updates to the domain technical debt register.
  • Assess architectural compliance and technical debt trends within the domain, contributing actionable recommendations to improve scalability, reliability, maintainability, and product lifecycle sustainability.
  • Maintain a regular cadence with Enterprise Architecture, Enterprise AI, Cyber Security, and Product Teams to align on standards, resolve cross-domain design challenges, and support enterprise-level use cases and digital ecosystem interoperability.
  • Track and report key architecture KPIs for the domain (e.g., pattern adoption, application rationalisation, exemptions closed, technical debt reduction, readiness score, contract/interface reuse index).
  • Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
  • 19 to 25 years in architecture or technical design roles, including experience applying architecture principles within a product or domain context.
  • Demonstrated ability to define architectural patterns, standards, or frameworks.
  • Experience reviewing and guiding solution designs to ensure alignment with architectural requirements.
  • Practical experience documenting domain models, interface specifications, and other architectural artefacts.
  • Exposure to evaluating technology decisions and advising stakeholders with clear architectural rationale.
  • Experience collaborating with business and product teams to anchor architecture to value and delivery needs.
  • HR Domain experience
  • Experience on workday, skills platform, learning platforms, SAP SuccessFactors, Microsoft azure.
  • Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g., TOGAF, cloud certifications).

Preferred Skills:

  • Strong analytical and conceptual modelling skills.
  • Ability to communicate architectural concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to challenge and influence design decisions constructively.
  • Strong documentation and design-modelling skills.
  • Awareness of emerging technologies and ability to apply them within the context.
  • Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and change
  • Very detailed oriented


Skills

Architecture Governance, HR Systems Implementation, Human Resources (HR) Technology Solution Integrations, Human Resources Integration, Reference Architectures, Solution Architecture, Stakeholder Management, The Open Group Architecture Framework (TOGAF), Workday HCM

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Inclusion at GSK:

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. title: MEL Intern, Kenya
description:

title: Delegate Relationship Executive - German Speaking
description:
WHO WE ARE:

Great Events by Great People.

We are CloserStill. We run more than 100 market-leading, B2B events and gatherings focused on the Business Technologies, Healthcare and Future Transport and Infrastructure sectors.

We are committed to excellence and innovation in our business operations and in our brands. Resulting in widespread recognition, including numerous accolades and prestigious awards for our events like the London Vet Show and Learning Technologies to Tech Show and DevLearn, we were honoured to have been named in The Sunday Times Top 100 Best Companies to work for three consecutive years, from 2018 to 2020.

But we are nothing without our "CloserStillians". We are committed to building an environment for our workforce to excel.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

loserStill Media is offering an exceptional opportunity to launch your career in the events industry - and we're looking for someone fluent in German to join us. This is a competitive, fast-paced, and genuinely fun role that will give you skills and knowledge that stay with you throughout your career.

We believe in growing our own talent. We promote from within and nurture our people before looking externally. The proof? A significant number of our current London team - including many of our senior leaders - started right here in our Delegate Sales team.

During your time with us, you'll work alongside experienced events professionals, learning what it takes to succeed in this dynamic industry. You'll also be part of a cohort of like-minded peers, all going through the same journey, with opportunities to build lasting professional and personal relationships.

THE ROLE:

Delegate Sales is the team that delivers event audiences. We work across all teams at CloserStill to ensure the right people - key decision-makers and industry leaders - attend our world-class events. Your fluency in German will be a key asset as you connect with German-speaking clients across Europe.

What a typical day looks like:

  • The day starts with a team meeting where you'll set your personal target for the day

  • We use 'Power Hours' throughout the day - 2 in the morning, 2 in the afternoon - dedicated time when we're on the phones, engaging with clients and driving registrations

  • Plenty of time between Power Hours to recharge in our communal breakout space with coffee or tea

  • Just after lunch, another team huddle to check progress and share what's working

  • Throughout the day, you'll use our bespoke CRM system (unique to CloserStill) to manage client relationships and track your progress - valuable experience you'll take with you as you grow

  • You'll input client details, work information, and payment details accurately into our event registration system

  • You'll also use platforms like LinkedIn to attract clients and build your professional network

  • The day ends with a final team meeting to celebrate wins and see if you've smashed your personal target

This isn't just about making calls - it's about building relationships, developing commercial awareness, and becoming an expert in your event's industry.

ABOUT YOU:

We're looking for someone with:

  • Fluent in German (written and spoken) - this is essential

  • A risk-taking attitude - someone who isn't afraid to make decisions, weigh up options, and collaborate with specialists across the business

  • A strong work ethic - you understand why hard work matters and you're willing to put in the effort to succeed

  • Adaptability - you can take in new information quickly and apply it effectively in a fast-moving environment

  • Quick thinking - able to respond well under pressure and think on your feet

  • Team player mentality - you work well with others across a multi-faceted business

  • Independence - comfortable working autonomously when needed

  • Industry awareness and self-awareness - curious about the world around you and reflective about your own development

No sales experience required - just energy, resilience, and a willingness to learn. If you're fluent in German and ready to start an exciting career in events, we want to hear from you.

We do not usually offer sponsorship for this role

CloserStill Media reserves the right to request a DBS or credit check should the role require it.

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION:

CloserStill Media embrace diversity in all its forms and are committed to continuing to develop a diverse and inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment based on merit without attention to age, ethnicity, religion or beliefs, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status or disability status.

We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage, don't hesitate to get in touch with our HR team at hr@closerstillmedia.com.

title: #742 - Sr Kotlin Engineer
description:
BlueCloud is a Snowflake Elite Partner and the 2026 CoCo Catalyst Snowflake Partner of the Year. We help enterprise organizations move from fragmented legacy systems to unified, AI-ready Snowflake platforms — delivering data migration, engineering, governance, BI & analytics, and AI/ML solutions 40–50% faster than traditional approaches.

With 450+ Snowflake consultants, 200+ enterprise transformations under our belt, and a 100% Snowflake focus, we combine advisory-led thinking with AI-powered accelerators to turn months of work into weeks of results. Our clients span Financial Services, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Retail, Manufacturing, Energy, and more — and the outcomes speak for themselves: 97% faster reports, 40% fraud reduction, $1.5M in client savings, and 10× client growth.

We don't just strategize — we execute.

We’re seeking an experienced Kotlin/JVM engineer to join our client's Code Standards team. The ideal candidate has deep Kotlin/JVM and Gradle expertise and a passion for language and tooling ecosystems, especially around dependency management, build system upgrades, linters/static analysis, and cross-version compatibility.

You will contribute to projects that shape how engineers write and ship Kotlin services at scale — including upgrades to supported language versions, modernization of build tooling, and standardization of open-source practices across repositories.

Key Responsibilities

  • Audit and update dependencies, removing deprecated or bespoke internal packages in favor of open source equivalents.
  • Implement and extend build tooling to align with our client's next-generation service-oriented architecture and repository structure.
  • Contribute to per-package or per-module testing and standardization efforts, ensuring that the Kotlin services can safely upgrade to new language versions without regressions.
  • Add linters, tooling and guardrails to help developers be successful and follow best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and design review, reinforcing the Code Standards vision of “open-source quality at our client's scale.”

Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of professional experience writing Kotlin, with significant experience in modern Kotlin application development.
  • Deep familiarity with Gradle and Kotlin build systems, including dependency resolution, modularization, and version alignment.
  • Strong understanding of library versioning strategies, including open source and semantic versioning practices.
  • Practical experience integrating linting, formatting, and static analysis tools into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Solid foundation in testing infrastructure (unit, integration, and matrix testing) and how it applies to version migration.
  • Experience identifying and replacing deprecated or unmaintained dependencies with modern, community-supported alternatives.
  • Ability to work effectively in a distributed environment and deliver maintainable, readable, and well-documented code.

Preferred Experience
  • Proven experience managing or upgrading language versions and modernizing large or legacy Kotlin codebases.
  • Prior work on large-scale refactors or language upgrades (e.g., Kotlin 1.x → 2.x, or JVM major version transitions).
  • Experience with multi-language ecosystems, particularly Python.
  • Familiarity with modern open-source Kotlin standards (Kotlin DSL, multiplatform projects, structured concurrency, coroutines, etc.).
  • Previous contributions to developer productivity or platform engineering initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

  • Able to independently take ownership of Kotlin migration or tooling initiatives within your first 2 weeks.
  • Kotlin services are modernized to support new language versions and dependency patterns safely and efficiently.
  • Legacy internal systems are replaced with open source or commercially supported alternatives that reduce long-term maintenance burden.
  • Engineers experience faster, more predictable builds, and development flows as a direct result of your contributions.

We are looking for someone who is experienced in building lasting relationships and is passionate about making meaningful contributions to our team. Don't be mistaken, this is a challenging career path but also highly rewarding. Are you up for the challenge? If so, stop reading and start applying.

title: Senior Distinguished Engineer - EPT
location: Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States of America
description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 24 Nov 2026


Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

Senior Distinguished Engineer

Careers That Change Lives

The Cardiac and Vascular Group brings all of our cardiac and vascular businesses together into one cross-functional, collaborative operating unit to employ the full breadth of our talent, technologies, products, services, and solutions to address the needs of customers and patients across the globe.

Cardiac Rhythm and Heart Failure offers devices and therapies to treat abnormal heart rhythms, as well as cardiac diagnostic and monitoring solutions.

The Platform Architect (PCS Patient Monitors Platform Architect) is accountable for ensuring all software architecture-related changes consider the entire PCS ecosystem and that all necessary changes to other platforms are accounted for.

The person in this role operates as a strategic technology leader who connects technology decisions to business outcomes and helps shape the future direction of our digital health platforms, including our cloud, data, AI, patient-facing, consumer, and caregiver-facing platform strategy.

This position is in Mounds View, MN. within the Electrophysiology Therapies (EPT) unit. At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. We are working on-site 4 days per week as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary. This role will require less than 10% of travel to enhance collaboration and ensure successful completion of projects.

We believe that when people from different cultures, genders, and points of view come together, innovation is the result —and everyone wins. Medtronic walks the walk, creating an inclusive culture where you can thrive.

A Day in the Life:

In general, the following responsibilities apply for the Senior Distinguished Engineer role. This includes, but is not limited to the following:

Architectural Vision and Strategy

  • Sets the technical architectural vision, design, and technology choices for Patient Monitor solutions in the PCS ecosystem, crossing the software and hardware stack.
  • Scope includes the portfolio of products that belong to Patient Monitors Platform.
  • Focuses on the longer-term strategic direction for one or more Products.
  • Develops and maintains the architectural and technology roadmap.
  • Defines the pathway and incremental steps to achieve an architecture or technology vision.
  • Works directly with senior business leaders to ensure technology choices align well with business decisions and highlights emerging changes in our ecosystem and the larger world that can impact our business and technology choices.

Options, Value, and Risk

  • Provides well-informed recommendations with multiple options, using POCs and other means of establishing validated learning in critical aspects of the architecture and design.
  • Provides business/customer value and ROI for different architectural and technology options.
  • Identifies and documents technical risks and strategies for mitigation.
  • Is accountable for the technical viability of quality solutions that work within the given cost, scope, and schedule while maximizing progress toward the vision and balancing technical debt.
  • Maps technical decisions and risks to business outcomes with business partners in order to understand and describe the economic impact.

Governance, Documentation, and Regulatory

  • Gains support and approval for architecture and design, which often involves collaboration with multiple stakeholders.
  • Delivers and maintains architecture documents and presentations needed for review and team guidance.
  • Leads solution architects relative to overall Architecture and Governance.
  • Works with Regulatory on the technical impact of emerging and existing legislation with various implications (e.g., DiGA, GDPR, CCPA, ISO62304, ISO 82304, IEC 81001-5-1, etc.).
  • Establishes best practices for medical device software development and recruitment.

Collaboration and Influence

  • Collaborate with Product Technology Leaders, Business Marketing Leaders, System Engineers, Product Owners, HFUX, fellow Architects, and technical leaders to solve complex engineering and business challenges.
  • Works with IT and the CIO office in order to integrate and impact corporate level technical initiatives.
  • Comprehends how the Product(s) relate to the rest of the HW, SW, and manufacturing ecosystems and influences the rest of the SW ecosystem through other Platform Architects.
  • Works with other teams in the formulation and review of their work, providing critical thinking and additional options that improve the work of the wider team.
  • Translates highly technical results into easily understood recommendations that will influence senior stakeholders across multiple business units.
  • Works with Product Leaders to define vision by providing a voice of technical possibility, feasibility, and sequencing options.
  • Mentors and develop more junior engineers and architects.

Responsibilities may also include the following:


  • Designs, develops, documents, tests, maintains, and debugs applications software and systems that contain logical and mathematical solutions.
  • Conducts multidisciplinary research and collaborates with equipment designers and/or hardware engineers in the planning, design, development, and utilization of electronic data processing systems for product and commercial software.
  • Ensures software standards are met.

The Successful Candidate Will Have:

  • Technical breadth and depth across IOT/embedded hardware, mobile application development, cloud development, data, AI, and cybersecurity, and the ability to learn existing platform technologies.
  • Comfort managing the lifecycle of large complex legacy systems, especially in modernizing and integrating them into an evolving ecosystem.
  • Strong systems thinking, with the ability to connect architecture choices to customer, business, and engineering outcomes.

Qualifications –


Must Have - Minimum Requirements


TO BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE, PLEASE BE SURE THE MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS ARE EVIDENT ON YOUR RESUME

· Bachelor’s degree in science, technology, engineering, or math and minimum of 15 years of technical work experience OR advanced degree in science, technology, engineering, or math, with 13 years of technical work experience


Nice to Have:


  • Proficient in C/C++/C#, MAUI/.NET, Swift, Kotlin, Java, JavaScript, Python, HTML, XML, and YAML.
  • Proficient in architecting, building, and deploying systems in AWS.
  • Experience delivering technically and organizationally complex features into production in a secure manner.
  • Embedded systems experience (all of these in an embedded context)
  • Embedded Android and Linux OS
  • Device lifecycle management (provisioning, software updates)

Together, we can change healthcare worldwide. At Medtronic, we push the limits of what technology, therapies and services can do to help alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. We challenge ourselves and each other to make tomorrow better than yesterday. It is what makes this an exciting and rewarding place to be.

title: Mammography Per-Diem
description:
SUMMARY:

Performs mammographic examinations, to include screening and diagnostic, breast needle localizations, and specimen radiographs. In addition, performs routine diagnostic radiology procedures, for patients of all ages, to include: neonates, children, adolescents, adults, and geriatric patients.


Brown University Health employees are expected to successfully role model the organization's values of Compassion, Accountability, Respect, and Excellence as these values guide our everyday actions with patients, customers and one another.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Interviews patients to obtain accurate medical history, physician address and enters data into mammography system.
  • Demonstrates ability to differentiate between a screening and diagnostic mammogram based upon clinical indication and patient history and checks discrepancies with Radiologist when necessary.
  • Demonstrates ability to perform all views required for screening and diagnostic mammography, to include: - Cranialcaudal- Mediolateral- Oblique- coned down compression- Magnification- “Tail “- “Twist”- Augmentation- BB localization of dermal lesions- Other views as requested by radiologist
  • Sets up room using aseptic techniques for special exams, i.e. biopsies, localizations and assists radiologists in breast localizations, utilizing sterile technique.
  • Performs and documents all QA/QC tests as mandated by the State of Rhode Island, FDA, and ACR underneath of senior mammography technologist.
  • Assists patients in requesting information on breast cancer and provides patients with printed literature on mammography and ACS recommended guidelines and reading procedure.
  • Checks and reviews the technical quality of all mammography images and understands:- effects of KV- Film/screen combination- Compression- Positioning- Processing- Proper selection of AEC modes and manual techniques per patient.
  • Demonstrates ability to evaluate images and take additional films, as necessary.
  • Demonstrates knowledge of procedures to report equipment-related problems to proper authority.
  • Checks equipment and mammography accessories (compression paddle, grids, etc.) to ensure they operate properly and reports failures to lead technologist.
  • Provides reassurance to patients, as necessary.
  • Reviews patient schedule and coordinates patient flow with other mammo tech to insure optimum use of schedule.
  • Maintains adequate inventory of supplies

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school graduation, or equivalent, and satisfactory completion of formal radiologic technology training of two years duration.
  • ARRT registered.
  • Holds a valid State of Rhode Island Radiographer license.
  • At least 3- 6 months experience as a Radiologic Technologist, performing routine diagnostic radiology exams.
  • ARRT Registered in Mammography or registry eligible, with a commitment to taking and successfully passing the registry within one year.
  • Current CPR certification.
  • Must be able to stand/walk 3-7 hours, squat 1-3 hours per day with frequent bending and twisting and lift 10-35 lbs with good body mechanics.
  • Must be able to use both hands/wrists with extensive deviation and frequent fine motor movement with repetition.
  • Near/far vision accurate at 20/40 and moderate depth perception with minimal color discrimination.
  • Must hear whisper at three feet.

$39.56-$65.28

description:
Job Summary
The Learning and Development (L&D) Specialist plays a key role in delivering and supporting enterprise learning initiatives. This roles bridges program design and execution – curating training materials and resources and managing content within the LMS. The Specialist partners closely with business leaders, subject matter experts (SME) and internal learning and talent development team to ensure learning programs drive performance and engagement.

Job Responsibilities
Learning Design & Delivery

Collaborate with business leaders, SMEs and cross-functional teams to determine the scope, requirements and timeline for each training/course.
Conduct training needs assessments by collecting information pertaining to procedures, processes, and reports to understand job-specific functions and tasks.
Develop alpha, beta and final versions for instructor led training (ILT), online learning training (OLT) and e-learnings in alignment with strategic business outcomes.
Co-design training materials such as job aids, mock scenarios, facilitator and participant guides, scripts and surveys.
Facilitate live and/or virtual training sessions, as requested.

Analysis & Reporting

Generate reports on user engagement, course completion and other relevant metrics.
Analyze, interpret and prepare feedback from trainings to determine learning effectiveness for stakeholders.

Learning Content & Experience Management

Develop, organize and upload learning content into Learning Management System (LMS).
Partner with Learning & Talent development teams to prepare materials and ensure readiness for training delivery.

Governance & Compliance

Maintain learning records in compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements.
Support audits and data governance standards for learning systems.
Ensure accessibility, data privacy, and security best practices are upheld.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

Stay current on emerging learning technologies and experience design best practices.
Recommend system enhancements, process improvements, and new tools to improve learning delivery and user engagement.

Qualifications
Required:

Associates or Bachelor’s degree in HR, Training, Education, Construction or related field.
2-5 years of relevant experience in designing and delivering learning programs and materials.
Knowledge using learning management systems (LMS), Articulate 360, Camtasia and Microsoft Office.

Preferred:

Familiarity with Monday.com or similar Project Management software.
Understanding of adult learning principles and/or digital learning trends.
Strong facilitation and presentation skills (in-person and virtual).

Skills

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and project management skills.
Detail-oriented problem solver with the ability to manage multiple priorities efficiently.
Strong interpersonal and consultative skills to collaborate across teams.
Continuous learner who embraces innovation and process improvement.

title: Consultant Integrated Health Solutions

Flexible, self-motivated, ability to multi-task and to meet the deadlines

Excellent communication (verbal and written), interpersonal and leadership skills

title: Associate Director - Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability
description:
Job Purpose

The Associate Director - Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability is responsible for maximising the value of a specific Product by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Senior Product Owner, Engineering, EHS & Sustainability guides Product Analysts and works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the Product Manager and Product Domain Lead.
  • Co-create the product vision and roadmap with the business and own the value case, including the expected benefits and how they are measured.
  • Own and manage the Product backlog, ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
  • Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the Product Manager or Product Domain Lead (clear RACI boundary).
  • Lead the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Product Analysts and working with Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
  • Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
  • Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
  • Ensure product changes follow required security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.
  • Shape design trade-offs with Solution Architects, and scout emerging capability on the product platforms, bringing a short ranked opportunity list into backlog refinement.
  • Act as an escalation point for the Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by the Product Manager and Domain Lead.
  • Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile, iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact.
  • Own and prioritise the AI product backlog, translating Engineering, EHS and Sustainability needs into clear AI use cases, epics, features and acceptance criteria.
  • Define the business value and success measures for AI use cases, including adoption, user experience, process improvement, quality, risk reduction and support effort.
  • Lead AI-enabled product delivery across business stakeholders, engineers, architects, data specialists, security, quality and third-party providers.
  • Ensure responsible and compliant use of AI, including appropriate human oversight, data protection, security, validation, traceability and regulated change controls.
  • Monitor AI product performance after release, using operational metrics, user feedback and evaluation results to identify improvement priorities.

Basic qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
  • Typically 5+ years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
  • Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
  • Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
  • Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
  • Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
  • Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.
  • Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices.
  • Experience owning or delivering an AI, Generative AI, advanced analytics or intelligent automation product.
  • Experience translating business problems into prioritised AI use cases, product requirements and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience leading cross-functional delivery involving business SMEs, architects, engineers, data teams, security and compliance functions.
  • Experience defining and monitoring AI product KPIs, evaluation criteria, adoption measures and benefits realisation.
  • Experience delivering technology products in a regulated or highly controlled environment, with appropriate governance, validation and change control.
  • Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).

Preferred qualifications:

  • Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions.
  • Skilled in coaching and guiding Product Analysts and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations.
  • Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.
  • Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant.
  • Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately.
  • AI product management: Ability to identify, assess and prioritise AI use cases based on business value, feasibility, data availability, risk and cost.
  • Generative AI understanding: Good working knowledge of large language models, Generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents and human-in-the-loop solutions.
  • AI evaluation: Ability to define acceptance criteria and performance measures covering accuracy, relevance, consistency and user value.
  • Responsible AI and risk management: Understanding of privacy, security, transparency, human oversight and risks such as unsupported or misleading outputs
  • Stakeholder communication: Ability to explain AI capabilities, limitations and trade-offs clearly to business and technology stakeholders.

You will work closely with diverse teams of engineers, scientists, and product partners who share your curiosity and commitment to quality. We value clear communication, collaboration, and a hands-on approach to building reliable, responsible AI systems. - Translate complex research and business needs into clear, well-documented modelling solutions.

title: Lead Embedded Hardware Engineer
description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.


Learn about our benefits designed for you to thrive at work and at home.


We boldly go.


Where is the work:

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

What’s in it for you:

Are you ready to shape the future of sustainable, intelligent climate technology? As our next Lead Embedded Hardware Engineer at Thermo King, you will pioneer modern embedded controls hardware architectures and development practices across our product lines and steer the creation of our next-generation solutions. In this pivotal technical leadership role, you will take full ownership of functional, technical, and integration architectures for embedded controls hardware, ensuring robust connectivity with Thermo King’s internal ecosystems as well as the external systems and devices relied on by our customers, dealers, and partners. You will partner with the architecture team and cross-functional colleagues, set the benchmark for world-class controls solutions and champion end-to-end development from concept through execution.

What you will do:

  • Serve as technical expert for embedded controls hardware architecture technology stack definition, leading analysis and improvements to design simplicity, modularity & re-use to provide embedded controls hardware capabilities across Thermo King products
  • Create and govern architecture standards, cybersecurity, wireless electronics, and modularity component roadmaps across product models, platforms, and regions with key engagement activity with Product management, Product Platform engineering, Telematics, and Controls teams
  • Evaluate and select appropriate embedded controls hardware technologies and platforms for solution development. Lead tradeoff analysis and recommendations, preparing and presenting architectural reports to senior management
  • Create embedded controls hardware design process standard work guidelines, templates/tools (ie, system diagrams, calculation spreadsheets, error checking, etc…) to improve product development cycle time, promote consistency across teams, and to enable rapid innovation with a high degree of reuse
  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to controls hardware engineering teams; supporting the design, review, and implementation of controls hardware electronics components
  • Ensure embedded controls hardware meets all functional, security, regulatory (e.g., wireless, cybersecurity compliance), and quality requirements for industrial and transportation environments

title: Associate Director - SAP Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Business Introduction
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Job Purpose

The Principal SAP Infrastructure Engineer builds and runs both the Cloud and On-Prem SAP Infrastructure platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
  • Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
  • Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
  • Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
  • Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
  • Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
  • Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
  • Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
  • Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
  • Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
  • Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

Professional Qualifications

  • Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
  • Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

Area of Specialisation

  • Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
  • Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

Experience Required

  • Overall 15 years and typically 8-10 years in cloud and SAP infrastructure, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
  • Proven experience in cloud infrastructure management, preferably with ERP systems.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on either Azure or Google Cloud
  • Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on VMware
  • Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
  • Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
  • Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
  • Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

Desirable:

  • Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert)

  • Knowledge of networking, security, and compliance in cloud environments.

  • Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

Skills/Background

  • Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
  • Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
  • Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
  • Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
  • Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

#AGTech


Skills

API Management, Application Infrastructure, Automation, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Platform Development, Reliability Engineering, SAP Infrastructure, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Spvr, Electrical and Instrument
description:
Who we are

For more than 40 years, Reworld has been a leader in sustainable waste solutions, providing our customers with innovative solutions that help them achieve carbon-negative outcomes.

Our Vision

Reworld is leading the charge to a carbon-negative future through revolutionary sustainable materials management solutions that reduce, reuse, recycle and reimagine waste for the benefit of society and the environment.

Our Business

Reworld partners with businesses by offering cutting-edge engineering and innovative solutions, to help customers reduce, reuse, recycle and recover value from waste streams and meet or exceed their sustainability goals.

Our Value

Reworld's differentiator comes from our ecosystem of technology, facilities and partnerships, trusted by the world’s largest organizations to reimagine waste management for a smarter, more sustainable world.

All that we’re missing is you. Apply today!

About the role

The Electrical and Instrumentation (E&I) Maintenance Supervisor leads electrical and controls maintenance at a power-generation plant. Reporting to the Maintenance Manager, this role plans and oversees work on electrical generation and distribution systems, instrumentation, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), data-acquisition systems, and related equipment.


At Reworld, this work helps keep an essential facility safe and reliable while supporting our mission to recover value from waste. You’ll work closely with Maintenance, Operations, and Engineering to strengthen preventive maintenance, resolve equipment problems, and develop the maintenance team.


You’ll supervise maintenance personnel, set daily work priorities, manage the backlog, coordinate planned and unplanned outages, and report on work completion and costs. You’ll also serve as a backup to the Maintenance Manager when needed. The plant operates 24/7, so you may be required to provide scheduled on-call coverage and weekend, night, outage, or other assigned shifts.


Core Activities and Responsibilities


  • Plan and schedule daily, weekly, and monthly electrical and instrumentation maintenance work.
  • Supervise maintenance personnel, assign work, and provide technical and safety direction.
  • Coordinate priorities, equipment issues, and schedule changes with Operations.
  • Manage the maintenance backlog and report on work completion, productivity, and performance.
  • Develop, execute, and assess preventive maintenance activities.
  • Plan electrical and instrumentation jobs, including scope, labor, materials, time, and cost estimates.
  • Support maintenance and troubleshooting of electrical distribution equipment, PLCs, instrumentation, controls, and data-acquisition systems.
  • Coordinate maintenance work during outages and respond to changing plant conditions.
  • Use technical manuals and vendor resources to identify repair procedures and parts.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reliability, reduce downtime, and control repair costs.
  • Conduct safety audits, participate in safety programs, and assist with incident investigations.
  • Serve as a backup to the Maintenance Manager when needed.

Qualifications


  • At least 3 years of power-plant maintenance experience.
  • Hands-on knowledge of industrial electrical generation and distribution systems.
  • Experience with industrial PLCs, instrumentation and controls, and data-acquisition systems.
  • Experience with electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic controls used on industrial process equipment.
  • Experience supervising maintenance personnel and coordinating work with Operations.
  • Strong maintenance planning, scheduling, job execution, and backlog-management skills.
  • Experience using a computerized maintenance management system, such as Maximo or PeopleSoft.
  • Ability to prepare maintenance reports, spreadsheets, timesheets, and work records.
  • Ability to address employee performance and disciplinary matters professionally.
  • Project management and Continuous Emissions Monitoring Systems (CEMS) experience are preferred.

Physical Demands and Work Environment


  • Must be able to wear a full-face respirator while performing physical work.
  • Must be able to walk, stand, kneel, squat, and climb throughout an industrial plant.
  • Must be able to access multiple plant levels and enter boilers, with or without scaffolding, to inspect equipment and monitor work.
  • May assist with lifting or equipment repairs.
  • Must work safely in an operating power-generation environment and be available for scheduled on-call, weekend, night, outage, or other assigned shift coverage.

All Reworld positions require a candidate's ability to perform the duties and responsibilities of the role while upholding Reworld's Values, including (but not limited to) contributing to a safe and inclusive workplace, delivering results through trust, and building breakthrough capabilities.
