title: Senior/Principal Product Analyst – Compliance
description:
About the Team:

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech delivers digital solutions that support Legal & Compliance and Workplace Real Estate & Facilities (WREF). This team drives product roadmaps and manages platforms that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

Job Purpose:

The Senior /Principal Product Analyst - Compliance supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with the Compliance Product Owner and Solution Architect, they help shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The Compliance Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the Product.


This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the Compliance Product Owner to realise the Product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.
  • Document as-is and to-be system processes, identifying opportunities for system, process, and workflow improvement, supported by impact analysis and basic data insights.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements for Compliance Products (e.g., security, performance, operability, accessibility), ensuring they are reflected in specifications and delivery plans.
  • Document functional and technical specifications needed to deliver changes and support configuration or code delivery by providing clear design inputs; maintain configuration repositories and version updates where applicable.
  • Support technical delivery teams by advising Developers and Test Analysts on expected system behaviour and acceptance criteria, informed by clear business and non-functional requirements.
  • Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
  • Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
  • Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
  • Support the Compliance Product Owner to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
  • Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).
  • Support the Compliance Product Owner to identify and implement automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
  • Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.
  • Follow DTMS to ensure compliant product portfolio for our Compliance products
  • Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team’s ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

Required Skills & Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
  • Experience supporting and deploying systems for a Compliance function including Enterprise Risk Management systems, third party risk management systems, privacy systems, data products support risk analytics & monitoring
  • Experience with technologies such as Certa, OneTrust would be advantageous
  • Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
  • Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
  • Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
  • Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.
  • Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. SAP certification in related area, Agile methodologies)

Preferred Skills:

  • Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
  • Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
  • Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
  • Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
  • Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.

title: Manager, Global Security Operations Center
description:
Reporting to security leadership, the Manager, GSOC Operations is responsible for Enterprise-wide, day-to-day leadership, performance, and modernization of the 24/7/365 Global Security Operations Center. The role combines strong operational management with a builder mindset: improving how the GSOC works, integrating technology and processes, simplifying workflows, strengthening service delivery, and developing a high-performing team.


This is a hands-on manager role for a leader who is comfortable running today’s operation while actively building tomorrow’s. The successful candidate should be curious, action-oriented, technologically fluent, and motivated by measurable improvement. The role is expected to turn strategy into practical execution through disciplined operating rhythms, better use of data, thoughtful automation, strong cross-functional integration, and continuous improvement.


What Success Looks Like

  • Creates a consistent, accountable 24/7 operation with clear standards, ownership, escalation paths, and management visibility.
  • Builds a culture where employees identify problems, propose solutions, learn new tools, and continuously improve the way work is performed.
  • Moves the GSOC from manual and fragmented workflows toward integrated, technology-enabled operations with better data, automation, and decision support.
  • Turns operational data into useful performance measures, trends, dashboards, and management actions.
  • Improves the speed, quality, consistency, and usability of alerts, incident documentation, communications, and executive reporting.
  • Creates repeatable processes for evaluating, piloting, implementing, and optimizing new GSOC technology.
  • Develops supervisors and operators so the organization has stronger bench strength, clearer career paths, and greater operational ownership.

Responsibilities

  • Lead daily GSOC operations and directly manage assigned supervisors and/or operators, ensuring appropriate staffing, readiness, accountability, service quality, and operational continuity.
  • Own operational execution during security incidents, emergencies, and business disruptions, including escalation, stakeholder notification, resource coordination, documentation, and leadership awareness.
  • Establish clear operating rhythms for shift handoffs, incident review, quality assurance, performance review, training, change management, and continuous improvement.
  • Set measurable service, quality, accuracy, responsiveness, and documentation standards; use metrics and trend analysis to identify gaps and drive corrective action.
  • Simplify and standardize policies, protocols, SOPs, escalation processes, emergency response plans, and operational documentation so they are practical, current, and consistently followed.
  • Identify high-friction, repetitive, or low-value work and redesign processes using workflow automation, system integration, AI-enabled capabilities, better data practices, or elimination of unnecessary steps.
  • Partner with internal technology teams and vendors to evaluate, test, implement, integrate, and optimize GSOC platforms, including access control, video management, alarm monitoring, mass notification, incident management, intelligence, communications, reporting, and workflow tools.
  • Serve as the operational product owner for GSOC capabilities: define business requirements, represent operator needs, prioritize improvements, support testing and adoption, and verify that technology produces measurable operational value.
  • Develop dashboards and management reporting that provide visibility into workload, incident trends, response performance, quality, service levels, system health, and improvement opportunities.
  • Promote interoperability and reduce duplicate entry, disconnected tools, manual reconciliation, and information gaps across GSOC workflows.
  • Use structured problem-solving and root-cause analysis to address recurring operational failures, process breakdowns, technology issues, and quality concerns.
  • Create a disciplined test-and-learn environment for modernization initiatives, with clear objectives, success measures, user feedback, implementation ownership, and post-launch review.
  • Lead training, coaching, performance management, workforce development, and succession planning for GSOC personnel. Build technical confidence and change readiness across the team.
  • Support crisis management and business continuity activities, including executive briefings, response documentation, exercises, after-action reviews, and corrective-action tracking.
  • Partner closely with Global Threat Management and other security functions on threat monitoring, intelligence, travel security, executive protection coordination, and escalation.
  • Coordinate effectively with Corporate Communications, Legal, Safety, Facilities, Information Technology, Human Resources, regional security teams, vendors, and other business partners during incidents and improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain strong operational resiliency, including remote operations capabilities, communications equipment, critical hardware/software, continuity plans, and other essential resources.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and provide management support during significant incidents, technical disruptions, staffing issues, and other operational needs.
  • Prepare concise operational reports, incident summaries, recommendations, and executive briefings that clearly identify the issue, impact, decision needed, and next action.
  • Perform other duties, projects, and operational assignments as directed by security leadership.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Emergency Management, Criminal Justice, Homeland Security, International Affairs, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • Approximately 7+ years of progressively responsible experience in corporate security, emergency management, intelligence, law enforcement, public safety communications, crisis management, a security operations center, or a comparable 24/7 operational environment.
  • At least 2 years of demonstrated supervisory or people-management experience, including coaching, accountability, scheduling, performance management, and employee development.
  • Experience coordinating security incidents, emergency response, crisis communications, organizational escalations, or other time-sensitive operational events.
  • Working knowledge of security operations technologies such as access control, video management, alarm monitoring, mass notification, incident management, intelligence, communications, and reporting platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience improving processes, implementing new workflows, introducing technology, or delivering measurable operational efficiencies.
  • Ability to translate an operational problem into clear requirements, work across technical and non-technical teams, and drive implementation through adoption.
  • Comfort working with operational metrics, dashboards, data visualization, workflow automation, and modern collaboration/productivity tools.
  • Strong judgment, problem-solving, written communication, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills in high-pressure environments.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Ability to work nontraditional hours, adjust schedules, participate in an on-call rotation, and provide support during emergencies or significant incidents.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a GSOC, command center, emergency communications center, high-volume operational center, or similarly complex environment.
  • Hands-on experience with process mapping, Lean/continuous-improvement methods, project delivery, system implementation, workflow automation, analytics, or AI-enabled operational tools.
  • Experience integrating multiple operational systems or improving data flow between platforms.
  • Experience leading pilots, technology evaluations, user acceptance testing, implementation, training, and post-launch optimization.
  • Experience creating practical business cases or benefit measurements for operational improvements.

Leadership Profile

  • Builder and integrator: naturally connects people, processes, technology, and data rather than treating them as separate workstreams.
  • Bias for action: moves from problem identification to ownership, testing, implementation, and measurement.
  • Technology-forward: enjoys learning how systems work and is energized by automation, integration, analytics, AI, and better user experiences.
  • Operationally credible: understands that modernization must improve reliability and service without losing control of a 24/7 operation.
  • Challenger mindset: respectfully questions legacy practices, unnecessary complexity, duplicate work, and “we have always done it this way” thinking.
  • Practical change leader: can bring operators and stakeholders along, translate change into clear benefits, and turn new processes into sustained habits.
  • High ownership: follows through, communicates early, measures results, and is comfortable being accountable for outcomes.

The anticipated base salary for this position is $101,700-$127,100. This role may also qualify for annual incentive and/or comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including without limitation, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and if applicable, the location of the position.

  • Demonstrated people management and development skills in a service/account management role.
  • Exceptional communication (written and verbal), influencing, negotiating, listening, and interpersonal skills to effectively develop productive working relationships with internal/external peers and other professionals across organizational lines.

  • Ability to take part in active strategic discussions.

title: Extrusion Operator II
location: Beverly, Massachusetts, United States of America
description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 4 Dec 2026


Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

In this role, you will be responsible for operating, monitoring, and optimizing excretion-related processes in a highly regulated medical manufacturing environment. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills, a commitment to quality, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.


This position reports onsite in Danvers, MA and works on a first shift schedule (M-F 6:00 AM – 2:30 PM).


Key Responsibilities:


  • Sets up and operates plastic extrusion equipment to manufacture miniature, precision tubing to established quality standards to meet production demands.
  • Assists engineering team in development of extrusion tooling, equipment and material.
  • Knows process of screw and tool design, resin characteristics, temperature control, automated feedback loops, and ancillary downstream equipment such as burst testers.
  • Troubleshoots, repairs and conducts maintenance on extrusion equipment.
  • Ensures materials necessary for extrusions are dried to specifications.
  • Mixes, blends, or colors of raw materials as required.
  • Writes and executes equipment qualifications on all new or modified tooling or equipment to test and qualify items and provide documented proof that operations are within established parameters.

Must Have: Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum of 1 year related experience.


Nice to Have: Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in a manufacturing or production environment, preferably in the medical device or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Strong understanding of equipment operation, troubleshooting, and preventive maintenance.
  • Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to strict hygiene protocols.
  • Basic computer skills for data entry and documentation.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Experience working in a GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) environment.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma principles.

title: Global Clinical Study Delivery Graduate Programme, Poland, 2027
description:
Join the GSK’s R&D Global Clinical Study Delivery Graduate Programme – Poland 2027: Help us get ahead of disease together


Education required: BSc degree from an accredited college/university, preferably in medical or biological science or discipline associated with clinical studies (for example life sciences or pharmacy). Graduation by August 2027


Language requirement: Written and spoken fluency in English and Polish


Other requirements: Willingness to be geographically mobile (domestic) throughout rotations


Location: Warsaw/Poznan


Expected Start date: September 2027


Application deadline: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and this role will close once we have received enough applications. We recommend you apply as soon as possible.


Assessment Centre Date : January/February 2027


Are you a talented and driven student or graduate eager to make an impact on billions of lives? Apply for the Global Clinical Study Delivery Graduate programme at GSK today!

GSK is a global biopharma company with a special purpose – to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Getting ahead means preventing disease as well as treating it, and we aim to impact the health of 2.5 billion people around the world in the next 10 years.

Our success absolutely depends on our people. We want GSK to be a place where people feel inspired, encouraged, and challenged to be the best they can be. A place where they can be themselves – feeling welcome, valued and included. Where they can keep growing and look after their wellbeing. So, if you share our ambitions, join us at this exciting moment in our journey to get ahead together.

With over 300 years of innovation, we’re a science-led global healthcare company that discovers, develops and manufactures innovative medicines and vaccines. Join us and help millions of people do more, feel better, live longer.

Are you ready to use your skills to deliver high-quality clinical trials?

If so, you could be suited to this role! Together we can design, plan and deliver clinical trials across a range of therapeutic areas, delivering medicines and vaccines to our patients.

Ahead together with tailored training and career development

We’ll tailor your training and development to suit your talents and ambition, as well as our business needs, setting you up for success in your chosen niche. The skills you learn on our Graduate programme can be used across many areas of our business and, potentially, many countries. There’s no limit to how far you can go with us – it’s up to you to prove yourself.

Over the next two years, the Graduate Programme will challenge and support you to grow both professionally and personally. You will have fascinating rotations to explore study management for Specialty Medicines (Rx) and Vaccines (Vx) projects for potential opportunities in Global Clinical Study Delivery team.

If you are a graduate with the passion to take accountability for designing, planning and executing the delivery of global Phase I to IV clinical trials to ensure it is delivered on time, to a high quality, within budget and all in line with company standards and scientific requirements, then this is a role for you!

You will have the opportunity to operate as a Study Manager (SM) and contribute to deliver the clinical study to time, cost and quality, ensuring inspection readiness by taking an oversight over project conduction. You will have a broader impact on the business, by driving continuous improvement initiatives within their remit of expertise, sharing best practices across business, with a focus on increasing operational delivery efficiency. You will also build close collaborations with other SMs, Global Study Managers (GSMs), Global Study Leads (GSLs) and Study Delivery Specialists (SDSs) to share best practices, experience and support process improvement.

You will have had the opportunity to develop key skills in study management along with gaining experience of working with functional subject matter experts to help you succeed as a SM.

What will you do?

  • Manage study execution of trial(s) in line with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) from start-up through close-out in accordance with study budget and timelines with the focus on setting up, maintaining and ensuring completeness of internal systems/databases/tracking tools and project plans
  • Work in collaboration with the GSM, GSL and SDS to provide end to end operational and administrative support for study delivery activities
  • Monitor study conduct and progress, identify, resolve and escalate risks/issues which may impact delivery of the study to the necessary quality, timeline and budget objectives
  • Interact, collaborate and communicate with other study team members across different functions to ensure all issues, risks and successes with study delivery are reviewed and/or shared as they occur
  • Support the Clinical Team in quality and data oversight to ensure inspection/audit readiness, including clinical documentation management and oversight of electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) completeness
  • Facilitate and maintain interactions and meetings with internal and external vendors to ensure the successful delivery of assigned studies.
  • Set up and maintenance of clinical trial management systems and tracking tools
  • Prepare and update of study documents and study plans
  • Learn about the drug clinical development process
  • Gain broad experience across the field of clinical research and variety of therapeutic areas
  • Learn to manage projects in agile way, make decisions and prioritise tasks

What are we looking for?

  • Passion for science and for bringing medicines and vaccines to patients
  • Self-motivation, proactiveness and a strong drive for continuous learning and development
  • Demonstrates strong communication and collaboration skills to support decision-making, solve problems and achieve shared outcomes.
  • Strong teamwork and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively with a range of people.
  • Creative and critical thinking, with the confidence to propose new ideas and appropriately evaluate and manage risk
  • Adaptability and resilience, with the ability to perform effectively under pressure and in a changing environment
  • Focus on delivering high-quality results through effective planning and organising
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and adapt to changing needs.

What do we offer you?

  • A competitive salary
  • An annual bonus based on company performance
  • Employee recognition programs, which reward exceptional achievements
  • Access to robust healthcare and well-being programs
  • A tailored, robust development plan aligned to your career aspirations and business needs, delivered by coaching and mentoring by managers and peers, and through virtual and in person courses
  • On-the-job experience
  • Thriving Employee Resource Groups, with a focus on inclusion
  • 2 volunteering days per year, called “Together Days”
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Private medical package with additional preventive healthcare services for employees and their eligible counterparts
  • Sports cards (Multisport/Medicover)
  • Supportive community and integration events

Let’s do this!

You’ll find hints, tips and guidance on our recruitment process on our website
You can also visit our Early Careers FAQ page for answers to common questions: Frequently asked questions | GSK


Learn more about the application process Application process | GSK

After submitting your application, you will be asked to complete our GSK Digital Assessment. The GSK Digital Assessment will give you the opportunity to demonstrate your skills through engaging exercises, while providing us with insights into your unique approach to work.

This will help us better understand how your strengths, behaviors, and skills align with the role and the positive impact you could bring to our team.

Top tip: Make sure you save this job description for reference throughout the process, it will really help you prepare for the different stages in your application.

You can learn more about GSK and our careers here

Our Graduate Programmes are designed to accelerate the development of graduates who don’t have significant previous professional work experience in the area to which they are applying. Of course, many graduates who join the program have worked while studying or after graduation.


If you’ve already developed substantial experience working in a professional role in your sector, while you would be able to apply for this program, you may also want to look at direct entry roles in our businesses, as these may be the best way to build on your existing skills and expertise and develop a career at GSK.


Apply now!

Need help with your application?

If you require any support or adjustments during the recruitment process for any reason, including those related to a disability, please let us know at ww.earlycareers@gsk.com.

title: Lead Data Analyst - Marketing
description:
At Rite-Hite, your work makes an impact. As the global leader in loading dock and door equipment, we design and deliver solutions that keep our customers safe, secure, and productive. Here, you’ll find innovation, stability, and the chance to grow your career as part of a team that’s always looking ahead.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Marketing Measurement, Attribution & Advanced Analytics

  • Owns the North American marketing measurement framework: KPI/TTI definitions, funnel stage definitions (MQL, SQL, opportunity, closed-won), source-of-truth reporting hierarchies, digital marketing and campaign performance reporting, and a cadence of weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reviews.
  • Designs, builds, and continually evolves marketing attribution, including multi-touch attribution across paid, organic, email, and direct channels; marketing-sourced vs. marketing-influenced pipeline and revenue; and channel/campaign contribution to sales outcomes.
  • Leads advanced attribution and predictive work as appropriate (including marketing mix modeling (MMM), lead scoring, propensity modeling, forecasting, cohort and segmentation analysis) to quantify marketing’s contribution to business results and inform investment decisions.
  • Owns lead generation reporting end-to-end: lead volume and quality by source, cost per lead, cost per opportunity, marketing-sourced pipeline, marketing-influenced revenue, funnel conversion rates and velocity, and time-to-close by channel.
  • Serves as the analytics partner for Performance Marketing and Demand Generation on the digital marketing stack (GA4, Google Search Console, GTM, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, BrightEdge, and comparable platforms) including performance analysis, tracking and attribution setup, and testing frameworks.
  • Acts as the internal analytics liaison to external agency partners (e.g., SEA/SEO agency), holding partners accountable to measurement standards, reporting quality, and business outcomes.
  • Performs hands-on ad hoc analysis in Excel and SQL to answer high-priority business questions, using advanced techniques (pivot modeling, statistical analysis, scenario modeling) to move from data to insight to recommendation.
  • Translates ambiguous business questions from marketing and executive leadership into structured analytical work; delivers findings with clear implications, options, and recommendations — not just numbers.

Data Infrastructure, Reporting & Analytics Enablement

  • Architects the flow of marketing data into and through the Databricks data lake — identifying required sources, defining ingestion and transformation requirements, and validating outputs — in close partnership with Rite-Hite’s Data Analytics and IT teams.
  • Integrates Salesforce CRM data with marketing platform data (Pardot, Sitecore AI, GA4, paid media platforms, SEO tools, etc.) to build a unified prospect-to-customer view that enables accurate attribution, lead gen reporting, and full-funnel analysis.
  • Cleanses, structures, tests, and validates marketing data — anomaly detection, quality audits, reconciliation across systems — to ensure downstream reporting and analysis are trusted by marketing, sales, and finance stakeholders.
  • Develops and maintains Tableau dashboards and self-service reporting for the marketing team, balancing depth for analysts with clarity for executives.
  • Establishes analytics standards, documentation, and definitions across the marketing function; contributes to the broader data analytics team’s standards where marketing intersects with enterprise data.
  • Provides informal technical leadership and mentorship to more junior analysts across marketing and data analytics; supports adoption of analytical best practices without direct authority.
  • Manages own projects and deliverables in Asana, balancing multiple priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment while maintaining quality and accuracy.

EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in analytics, statistics, computer science, mathematics, marketing, business, or a related field required.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in marketing analytics, data analytics, or a closely related discipline, with a demonstrated focus on marketing-specific analytics (digital marketing performance, lead generation, campaign measurement, revenue attribution).
  • Deep experience with marketing attribution, including multi-touch attribution, marketing-sourced vs. marketing-influenced revenue, and end-to-end MQL-to-revenue funnel measurement in B2B.
  • Experience working in a data lake or cloud data warehouse environment (Databricks preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM data, marketing automation platforms (Pardot preferred; Marketo, HubSpot, or comparable acceptable), and the digital analytics stack (GA4, Google Search Console, GTM).
  • Direct experience with predictive analytics or machine-learning models in a marketing context (lead scoring, propensity, forecasting) preferred; and marketing mix modeling (MMM) or comparable advanced attribution methodologies preferred.
  • Experience with Sitecore AI (or a comparable enterprise DXP/CMS) and its associated analytics preferred.

KNOWLEDGE / SKILL REQUIREMENTS

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

  • Advanced SQL, Excel, Tableau proficiency.
  • Working proficiency in a scripting language for analytics (Python or R.
  • Deep working knowledge of the Salesforce CRM data model, including leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, campaigns, and standard/custom objects relevant to marketing attribution and reporting.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven ability to translate complex analytical work into clear, direct, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to build cross-functional trust.
  • Ability to influence adoption of measurement standards, definitions, and analytical approaches.
  • Comfort working independently in unstructured territory.
  • Data-informed mindset with storytelling approach.

Location: Milwaukee, WI / Rite-Hite Headquarters

In-office Requirement: Minimum three days

Travel: Up to 10% required.

What We Offer

At Rite-Hite, we take care of our people – because when you’re supported, you can do your best work. Our benefits are designed to support your health, your future and your life outside of work:

  • Health & Well-being: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus life and disability insurance. A robust well-being program with an opportunity to receive an extra day off and more.

  • Financial Security: A strong retirement savings program with 401(k), company match, and profit sharing.

  • Time for You: Paid holidays, vacation time, and personal/sick days each year.

Join us and build a career where you’re supported – at work and beyond.

title: Analyst III, Configuration Management (CMDB & Discovery) (Remote-LATAM)
description:
Spoiler: This is where your next big move begins.

What this Journey Looks Like
At Pearster, we connect talented professionals from around the world with exciting opportunities at international companies. We are a dynamic, people-oriented team passionate about building meaningful professional connections and creating a positive employee experience.

We are looking for a Senior Configuration Management Analyst (CMDB & Discovery) to join our growing international team and support the administration, governance, and continuous improvement of enterprise Configuration Management processes.

This role combines ServiceNow CMDB administration, Discovery, Service Mapping, ITSM governance, and cloud infrastructure management. You will be responsible for ensuring accurate, complete, and reliable configuration data across complex enterprise environments, supporting critical IT operations and service management processes.

We are looking for someone with strong technical expertise in ServiceNow CMDB, Discovery, and Configuration Management, along with excellent analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve data quality, operational visibility, and ITSM efficiency.

What You'll Lead and Build

  • Define and maintain CMDB standards, policies, Configuration Item (CI) classifications, ownership models, and lifecycle processes.

  • Lead the administration, governance, and continuous improvement of the ServiceNow Configuration Management Database (CMDB).

  • Coordinate Configuration Control Board (CCB) meetings and drive the resolution of configuration data quality issues.

  • Administer, configure, and optimize ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, MID Servers, discovery patterns, and integrations.

  • Identify and resolve discovery gaps across infrastructure, cloud environments, networks, databases, and enterprise applications.

  • Troubleshoot discovery failures, CI identification issues, and reconciliation conflicts to ensure accurate configuration records.

  • Maintain accurate service maps, CI relationships, and dependencies across enterprise technology environments.

  • Monitor CMDB health and implement controls to improve data completeness, correctness, compliance, and overall reliability.

  • Proactively identify and remediate duplicate CIs, outdated records, missing ownership information, and orphaned relationships.

  • Develop dashboards, reports, and performance metrics to monitor CMDB effectiveness and support governance decisions.

  • Support discovery and configuration governance across AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud environments.

  • Improve visibility and tracking of external-facing assets, including public IP addresses, DNS records, URLs, and third-party hosted services.

  • Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud, Security, Network, Database, and Application teams to maintain accurate enterprise asset information.

  • Ensure CMDB data effectively supports Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, and Service Management processes.

  • Identify opportunities to automate configuration management activities and improve operational efficiency.

  • Provide technical guidance, training, and consultation on Configuration Management best practices.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, governance standards, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.

  • Work closely with international stakeholders to drive CMDB maturity, data integrity, and continuous process improvement.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Advanced English (C1) – excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • 5+ years of experience in Configuration Management, ServiceNow CMDB administration, Discovery, or related ITSM roles.

  • Degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow CMDB, including configuration governance, CI lifecycle management, and data quality processes.

  • Experience administering ServiceNow Discovery and/or Service Mapping, including MID Servers, discovery patterns, and integrations.

  • Solid understanding of CMDB Health, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE), and configuration data reconciliation.

  • Strong knowledge of ITIL Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM) principles and best practices.

  • Experience defining and maintaining CI classifications, ownership models, relationships, and configuration standards.

  • Familiarity with AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud infrastructure environments.

  • Good understanding of Windows, Linux, networking, databases, and enterprise infrastructure technologies.

  • Experience troubleshooting discovery issues, duplicate configuration items, and data integrity challenges.

  • Ability to develop reports, dashboards, and KPIs to monitor CMDB performance and data quality.

  • Experience integrating CMDB processes with Incident, Problem, Change, and Asset Management.

  • ITIL Foundation Certification (required).

  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams.

  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and make sound decisions in complex technical environments.

  • Strong ownership mindset, organizational skills, and commitment to continuous improvement.

  • Experience working with international teams in dynamic enterprise environments.

Benefits that Move you Forward.

We’re here to amplify your brilliance, not contain it.

  • Work from anywhere with true flexibility and freedom.

  • Earn in USD with compensation that matches your expertise.

  • Recharge confidently with dedicated paid time off.

  • Advance your career with fully covered international certifications.

  • Access coworking spaces worldwide whenever you want a professional setup.

  • Strengthen your English and expand your global reach.

  • Connect and have fun with activities that unite our international team.

  • Feel appreciated with personalized gifts and a thoughtful welcome kit.

  • Grow our community and earn through our referral program.

At Pearster, your journey matters, and we’re here to help you go further than you imagined.

Vancouver, Hybrid

As a Business Analyst within our Global Financial Systems team, you will support Colliers’ North American finance platforms by translating business, system, reporting and data needs into clear requirements and practical solutions. Working in an Agile environment, you will partner with Finance stakeholders, the Product Manager, data and reporting teams, and technical delivery partners to improve Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance, OneStream, IBM Planning Analytics / TM1 and related platforms.

Who We Are:

Swarthmore Dining is dedicated to serving our community with nutritious and satisfying food in a welcoming environment every day. Our mission is to offer a diverse menu that features high-quality ingredients, emphasizing locally grown and sustainably produced products whenever possible. We are committed to inclusive dining by ensuring vegetarian, vegan, and accommodations for dietary restrictions are always available. As a self-operated dining program encompassing Residential Dining, 3 retail locations, and catering, we pride ourselves on providing a work-life balance that is often difficult to find in the restaurant industry. Join us at Swarthmore Dining to be a part of a vibrant community committed to quality, sustainability, and exceptional service in a state-of-the-art kitchen setting.

The Opportunity:

As a member of the Dining Services department, the Culinary Assistant will work in any of the following stations depending on the schedule or need of the department roles: grill cook, grill assistant, salad prep, deli, prep cook. Working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, having a passion for food, enjoying being part of an energetic team and the opportunity to make a difference in the student’s dining experience on Swarthmore’s campus.

Possess exceptional customer service skills and have the ability to work in a fast-paced environment. Able to work independently and as part of a team. This person is able to prioritize and multitask. Prepare grilled food, deli meats, salad bar items and catering foods in accordance with the instructions, specifications and recipes provided. Prepare and provide food in a safe and timely manner. Required to have knowledge of cooking temperatures and knowledge of operating grill equipment and must keep the work area clean and sanitized at all times. This is a full-time, 9-month position, scheduled to work between the months of August-May.

  • Provides prompt, efficient, and friendly service to a diverse clientele.

title: Global Head of Legal eDiscovery - Director
description:
Job Description:

Job Title Global Head of Legal eDiscovery

Corporate Title Director

Location New York, NY

Overview

In this role, you will be responsible for providing strategic legal advice, leadership, and oversight to senior management and all global businesses and functions on electronic discovery (eDiscovery), data, and emerging technology issues for a global financial services organization and will lead a team consisting of seasoned attorneys and other professionals. We are seeking an experienced lawyer to manage the eDiscovery function, with accountability for strategy, governance, and delivery across the discovery lifecycle. This role runs the global Legal eDiscovery function and acts as the senior subject-matter expert for eDiscovery and eDiscovery-related risks within the Bank.

In this leadership role, you will provide legal guidance and counsel on the requirements, issues, best practices, and technology solutions for all phases of the discovery process including information governance, cross-border data transfers, collection, and review. You will be working with attorneys in the Bank’s global Legal Department on litigation, regulatory enforcement, and other legal proceedings that include discovery-related activities; in addition to the Bank’s Legal Department, you will also work closely with the Bank’s technology function, outside counsel, and external technology and review service providers on eDiscovery requirements, best practices, and technology solutions. This role requires excellent judgment and the ability to provide advice while managing multiple tasks and responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.

What We Offer You

  • A diverse and inclusive environment that embraces change, innovation, and collaboration
  • A hybrid working model, allowing for in-office / work from home flexibility, generous vacation, personal and volunteer days
  • Employee Resource Groups support an inclusive workplace for everyone and promote community engagement
  • Competitive compensation packages include health and wellbeing benefits, retirement savings plans, parental leave, and family building benefits
  • Educational resources, matching gifts, and volunteer programs

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and develop a team of eDiscovery attorneys and other professionals, oversee eDiscovery vendors, and partner with technology, global data privacy, records management, legal operations, and business stakeholders
  • Define and maintain the Bank’s global eDiscovery strategy, governance framework, operating model, policies and procedures, controls and best practices; ensure consistent execution across regions while accommodating jurisdictional requirements, and set clear objectives for continuous improvement and innovation in eDiscovery and information governance
  • Provide practical and strategic legal guidance on global litigation, regulatory enforcement, and other proceedings across the discovery lifecycle, including early case assessment, collection scoping and strategies, search and review strategies and tools, Enterprise Skills Initiative and discovery protocols, and data production, as well as overseeing the Bank’s legal hold and preservation program
  • Partner with the Bank’s technology function on legal requirements and best practices for data identification, preservation, and collection in ongoing and anticipated matters, and advise on eDiscovery requirements for new data types and systems
  • Partner with outside counsel and external eDiscovery technology and review providers on collection, search, review, and production in ongoing and anticipated matters; manage providers, negotiate pricing and contracts, maintain playbooks and best practices, and evaluate and select technology solutions
  • Ensure the defensible use of new technologies for preservation and collection and design AI-enabled workflows and other technology solutions to improve efficiency, accuracy, and cost savings

How You’ll Lead

  • Will lead various initiatives on a broad range of eDiscovery and data related legal issues in matters globally
  • Will partner with various senior leaders across the Bank on emerging eDiscovery and other technology related topics
  • Provide advice to senior Legal Department management on legal eDiscovery requirements, best practices and technology tools and solutions
  • Collaborate with colleagues globally in the Bank’s Legal Department, technology function and other infrastructure functions

Skills You’ll Need

  • Qualified lawyer with extensive experience in eDiscovery with a focus on global Financial Services
  • Extensive experience advising on eDiscovery at a major law firm and/or in an in-house counsel role
  • Strong knowledge of eDiscovery processes, including legal holds and data collection and preservation, framework, and advanced review technologies in an international context, with prior experience successfully leading a team
  • Admission to the New York State Bar or otherwise qualified to practice law in New York as registered in-house counsel
  • Excellent judgment and ability to advise on legal risks and requirements within a business context
  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs

Skills That Will Help You Excel

  • Experience overseeing or advising on a successful preservation and defensible disposal program
  • Ability to translate legal advice and requirements to IT professionals and other non-lawyers in a useable and practical manner, and ability vice versa to translate IT issues and requirements to lawyers in a useable and practical manner.
  • Ability to collaborate, cooperate and work well with others in a supportive and respectful manner
  • Ability to handle and strategically prioritize numerous projects and tasks
  • Experience operating in a fast-paced business environment

Expectations

It is the Bank’s expectation that employees hired into this role will work in the New York office in accordance with the Bank’s hybrid working model.

Deutsche Bank provides reasonable accommodations to candidates and employees with a substantiated need based on disability and/or religion.

The salary range for this position in New York City is $170,000 to $308,000. Posted salary ranges do not include incentive compensation or any other type of remuneration.

title: Head of Compliance and AFC, Taiwan - Director
description:
Job Description:

Details of the Division and Team:

As 2nd Line of Defense (LOD) functions, Compliance and AFC seek to protect the licenses of Deutsche Bank (“DB” or the “Bank”) to operate by promoting and enforcing adherence with laws, regulations, rules, expectations of regulators, the standards of self-regulatory organizations, and codes of conduct / ethics in connection with the Bank’s regulated activities, and driving a culture of compliance and ethical conduct in the Bank. Compliance and AFC also seeks to provide independent, proactive and forward looking challenge and advice to senior managers as well as all employees.

The Head of Compliance and AFC Taiwan is responsible for the management of Compliance and Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Terrorism Financing, Sanctions & Embargoes, Anti-Fraud, Bribery & Corruption (AFC) risks for Taiwan .

The Head of Compliance and AFC for DB Taipei Branch ( DBTB) is a position registered with the Banking Bureau of Taiwan and SFB ( under securities licenses).

The Head of Compliance and AFC supports DBTB ( including CCO) for all of its regulatory obligations and in compliance with all related laws, regulations and regulatory expectations.

The Head of Compliance and AFC Taiwan is responsible for ensuring that all relevant policies, procedures, systems and controls are implemented effectively, all relevant legal, regulatory and DB Group requirements are met and any Compliance and AFC-related risks are appropriately assessed ( via Country Risk Assessments )and mitigated where deficient. The role-holder is also responsible for the identification, assessment, advice on, monitoring, control and reporting on the applicable laws, rules and standards relevant to the DB activities in Taiwan.

The Head of Compliance and AFC Taiwan is the direct point of contact for regulators and all DB employees in Compliance and AFC matters in Taiwan.

What we will offer you:

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce is better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its center.

You can expect:

  • Annual health checkup – cost borne by company (once a year)　(above 40years old is TWD10,000 & less than 40 years old is TWD5,000)
  • EAP – free and confidential counseling, online work-life resources
  • Annual leaves entitlement
  • Better Maternity leave

Your key responsibilities:

  • Support senior management and employees of Deutsche Bank in understanding and managing compliance and AFC risks:
  • the application of DB’s ethical standards and professional principles
  • general compliance with the relevant laws, rules, regulations, directives and DB Group standards across the activities and business operating model of the assigned country, that fall under the Compliance and AFC risks’ types
  • Responsible for the development and implementation of Compliance and AFC policies and procedures to ensure all local laws and regulations are complied with and to ensure all Global Compliance and AFC policies are implemented within the Branch
  • the prevention and escalation of issues, incidents and breaches relating to Compliance and to AFC Management and Taiwan CCO
  • the implementation of processes and procedures regarding abuse of assets, systems, information or procedures, for example those involving Confidential Information and Price Sensitive Information (PSI)
  • Implementation of Cross-border compliance policies and cross-border related matters.
  • Report regularly to governance functions (e.g. Leadership meeting) and, where necessary, Regulatory Authorities on Compliance and AFC matters, amongst others, indicating whether:
  • any significant risk exposures and material incidents of non-compliance have been identified
  • appropriate measures have been taken to address any gaps or deficiencies
  • the Compliance frameworks (structure and processes) are adequate, effective and in line with legal, regulatory and Deutsche Bank Group requirements.
  • Undertake and be actively involved in proactive and reactive management and escalation of all Compliance and AFC risks, issues and breaches, for example, conducting risk assessments.
  • Monitor and test compliance with laws, rules, regulations and internal controls in accordance with agreed policy and methodology; report and manage any findings or issues, and support management in their identification of appropriate remedial action plans.
  • Participate in, and provide Compliance and AFC support to, relevant projects ensuring adherence to related standards, mitigation of associated risks and strong stakeholder consideration particularly focused on the client or customer.
  • Liaise with Compliance and AFC senior management within DB Group to ensure appropriate reporting and escalation of issues and/or incidents.
  • Support a compliance aware culture, including regular and appropriate local education, training and awareness by leveraging related global initiatives.
  • Participate in local and global Compliance and AFC projects instigated by Deutsche Bank Group.
  • Act as a direct contact point for Deutsche Bank employees to confidentially raise concerns in relation to Compliance and AFC matters or when improper or illegal activities are suspected (e.g. conflicts of interest, money laundering, market abuse, suspicious transaction etc.).
  • Provide local and regional support to the Regional and Global Compliance and AFC management teams (including BLCs) , as and when required.
  • Develop and maintain the Internal Control Framework to ensure adequate monitoring and control measures are implemented, report on any findings and advise management on remedial actions to take.
  • Ensure local implementation of any country, regional or global Compliance and AFC projects and programs in conjunction with the relevant regional leads.
  • Responsible for the local AFC Risk Analysis.
  • Provide input for MI reports requested by Regional and Global Compliance or AFC Management.
  • Work closely with DB Audit team under their audit program as well as local assessments
  • Ensure all regulatory and audit findings are monitored via GFMS and remediated on time with no delays
  • Coordinate and work with different stakeholders within Deutsche Bank Group to conduct assessments or examinations and/or respond to enquiries raised and requested by the regulators.

Your skills and experience:

  • At least 10 years’ experience, ideally in a similar senior position with extensive experience in Compliance and AFC or a control related function within an international organization/bank in the Financial Services industry
  • A strong track record in risk and regulatory matters, ideally including:
  • Solid understanding of Compliance and AFC risks and typologies in order to identify areas or instances of potential Compliance and AFC risks and to address them appropriately
  • Extensive previous relationship/ dealings with local regulators ( BB, SFC and FSC)
  • Extensive experience required under the various appropriate regulations/laws and related circulars.
  • Excellent understanding of financial products including IB and CB
  • Crime function expertise - and should be considered a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in the Financial Crime area on relevant financial acts and regulation
  • Proven leadership ability, including skills to build, develop and coach a team.
  • Able to absorb issues arising from a wide span of control and demonstrate sound judgment
  • Excellent at managing people and relationships
  • Excellent at advising senior management with great skill, with a high level of executive presence, knowledge and stature to provide advice that will be respected and valued by business unit leaders, corporate leaders and other constituencies
  • Strong at influencing thinking and behaviors broadly across the organization, with the highest level of integrity and the ability to balance commercial objectives with the exercise of independent and prudent judgment
  • Able to raise sensitive or potentially contentious issues in a constructive manner to reach appropriate solutions
  • Excellent at setting clear objectives and driving for results, for example facilitating the creation of processes, systems, and disciplines that embed behaviors in the organization that ensure compliance
  • Able to identify issues and solutions or opportunities, as well as to build efficacy in compliance programs
  • Able to motivate employees, building teams and fostering relationships that engender a sense of shared objectives and accountability. The ability to recruit, develop, and retain team members while operating successfully in a matrix environment is critical
  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

How we’ll support you:

  • Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
  • Training and development to help you excel in your career

title: Risk Counsel
description:
OVERVIEW


We are currently seeking a Risk Counsel for our Chicago, IL Regional Office.


The Risk Counsel is an entry-level role that oversees and manages litigation and claims within the Company’s insured Portfolio. In doing so, they work hand in hand with our insurance partners and outside counsel to drive solutions and manage the insured claim portfolio. The Risk Counsel position will also be responsible for underwriting Owner contracts as necessary and relaying analysis to upper management about contractual risk shifting.


As a fourth-generation, family-owned business, Walsh recruits individuals who are seeking a small company feel with a large company backing. Walsh is a successful fast-growing company at the forefront of technology and is committed to being the employer of choice to our employees and the builder of choice to our customers.

There are many compelling reasons why exceptional people should consider a career with our company:

  • Challenging, complex work
  • Creative and innovative problem-solving environment
  • Supportive, communicative managers who reward hard work
  • Opportunities for growth, training, and development
  • Flexibility in career path & progression
  • Opportunities to work and live all over the United States

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Monitor and oversee all pending litigation which involves insurance coverage, including but not limited to General Liability, Auto Liability, Builder’s Risk, and Equipment claims.
  • Analyze claims/litigation to effectively participate in decisions related to resolution strategy
  • Manages all vendors involved in the claims processes.
  • Participating in mediations and negotiating settlements
  • Review and provide analysis on coverage implications of pending matters, including the management of coverage litigation where necessary
  • Ensure claim files are properly documented in Origami Risk Management System.
  • Ensure adherence to company policies and bidding procedures related to contractual underwriting
  • Identify to senior staff and project sponsorship all contractual risk that does not fall into Walsh’s acceptable risk profile.
  • Perform all legal related tasks to protect the interest of the company and mitigate risk.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Juris Doctorate from an accredited law school, license to practice law in good standing in at least one (1) state
  • 1-2 years of legal experience, with special consideration for construction related experience
  • Minimal physical requirements, ability to travel as necessary
  • Salary $110,000 - $125,000

title: Personal Injury Protection Adjuster - PST/MST/CST- Remote
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

Are you a strong communicator who enjoys solving problems, helping others, and making a meaningful impact every day? We're seeking a Personal Injury Protection Adjuster to join our team and support customers through the medical claims process following an auto accident.

This is an excellent entry-level opportunity for individuals with strong critical thinking, time management, and customer service skills who are looking to build a rewarding career in claims. Insurance experience is helpful but not required. We provide training and support to help you succeed.

In this role, you'll work directly with customers, healthcare providers, and other stakeholders to review medical claims, determine coverage, evaluate bills, and ensure claims are handled fairly, accurately, and compassionately.

What You'll Do


As a Personal Injury Protection Adjuster, you will:


  • Guide customers through the medical claims process with empathy, professionalism, and care.
  • Investigate and evaluate Personal Injury Protection (PIP) and Medical Payments (Med Pay) claims.
  • Review medical bills, treatment records, wage loss documentation, mileage reimbursements, attendant care requests, and other related expenses.
  • Determine claim eligibility, coverage, and reasonableness of medical expenses.
  • Communicate claim decisions clearly and professionally to customers and other parties involved.
  • Maintain accurate claim documentation and detailed file notes.
  • Establish and manage claim reserves based on claim facts and treatment patterns.
  • Identify potential medical management opportunities and refer suspicious activity when appropriate.
  • Manage multiple claims simultaneously while meeting quality, service, and productivity expectations.
  • Utilize digital tools and technology to provide efficient and seamless customer experiences.



Preferred Qualifications:

  • Personal Injury Protection (PIP)/MedPay claim handling experience.
  • 2 years of insurance claim handling/adjusting.
  • Complex liability claim handling.
  • Experience using Mitchell DecisionPoint.
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

Remote Home-Based Work:

This position is a permanent remote home-based role. Your home office does not need to be near an Allstate office, but it does need to be in the United States.


Location: Candidates located in the Central, Mountain, or Pacific time zones are preferred. This position is not available to candidates in California, Washington, Alaska, Hawaii, or Puerto Rico.


Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8-hour shift scheduled between 7:00 a.m. and 6:30 p.m. Central Time.


When you work from home full time, you’ll need:

  • A home office – a dedicated workspace in your residence that is private and free from distractions.
  • A minimum internet bandwidth of 50 MB down/5 MB up.
  • Appropriate work surface and seating.

What will Allstate provide?

  • A technology bundle that includes all equipment needed to perform your work from home (laptop, monitors, headset, keyboard, mouse).
  • Connectivity reimbursement of $80 per month to offset some of the cost of internet.

Training:

  • The first approximately 6-9 weeks of employment are dedicated to onboarding, licensing (if applicable), and role-specific training designed to prepare you for success in the role. Successful candidates must be able to attend required training sessions, actively participate in virtual learning activities, and successfully complete the training program.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.
  • Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign-on Bonus:

  • You may be eligible for a $1000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role. This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.
  • Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Allstate Benefits:

  • Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:
  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

description:

Be part of an exceptional health care experience. Join the inspired, passionate team at Lehigh Valley Health Network, a nationally recognized, forward-thinking organization offering plenty of opportunity to do great work.

These recognitions highlight LVHN's commitment to teamwork, compassion, and technology with an unrelenting focus on delivering the best health care possible every day.


Whether you're considering your next career move or your first, you should consider Lehigh Valley Health Network.

Coordinates all aspects of patient registration, insurance verification, and scheduling for patients. Conducts patient interviews by phone and in-person for the purpose of establishing an account, gathering demographic, insurance, and clinical information to ensure appropriate patient scheduling and optimal financial clearance. Collects out of pocket fees and completes accurate registration.

  • Secures signatures to ensure timely reimbursement as well as ensures consents are signed specific to service being rendered.
  • Reviews daily schedule for complications affecting department flow and confers with colleagues and physicians as needed to anticipate and resolve problems.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Knowledge of medical terminology.

Lift and carry 7 lbs., continuous sitting >67%, frequent keyboard use/repetitive motion, frequent fine motor activity/wrist position deviation.

title: Test Engineer
description:
Role focus: Plan and coordinate testing activities, manage test samples, support failure analysis, evaluate results, and communicate findings within multidisciplinary project teams and to customers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Test planning using established planning tools (Excel, MS Project, Smartsheet). Monitoring project milestones and initiating escalations in accordance with the Testing process when planned test deadlines are at risk. Ensuring effective communication and information flow throughout the process.

  • Ordering required test samples and prototype parts through the Prototype Parts Coordinator.

  • Incoming inspection and preparation of test samples. Internal and external supply of test specimens to test facilities and test benches. Documentation of delivery condition and initiation of complaints in cases where test samples do not meet specified requirements. Feedback and coordination with the Prototype Parts Coordinator.

  • Execution of development and product release testing. Definition of test objectives, procedures, acceptance criteria, and evaluation methods based on customer specifications and other internal and external requirements. Reliable process management using order administration software. Ensuring effective coordination and information flow with test facilities and test preparation teams.

  • Support in the inspection, evaluation, and analysis of test samples from both internal and customer testing programs. Application of measurement equipment during inspections. Evaluation and preparation of test results.

  • Support in conducting failure investigations and root cause analyses in collaboration with the Materials Laboratory. Preparation of laboratory investigation requests and evaluation of test and analysis results (target versus actual comparisons) together with the Materials Laboratory.

  • Analysis, evaluation, and presentation of test results in technical reports, working documents, and presentations. Identification and communication of key findings.

  • Presentation and representation of test results to customers. Presentation content is reviewed and approved by the supervisor or Project Manager prior to customer communication.

  • Determination of testing costs using established planning tools, including Master Cost Lists and Test Cost Sheets. Support of Customer and Supplier Change Management activities.

  • Participation in multidisciplinary project teams. Primary contact for project team members (PL / TPL / CQE / SQE) regarding project-related testing topics.

title: Associate Director, Product Owner - Corporate Security
description:

Associate Director, Product Owner - Corporate Security is responsible for maximising the value of the Corporate Security products within across the Legal, Compliance & WREF domain by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Dir, WREF & Corporate Security Product Manager and Senior Director of Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech. The Corporate Security Product Owner guides Product Analysts and works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the Dir, WREF & Corporate Security Product Manager

  • Partner with the Director, WREF & Corporate Security Product Manager to ensure digital & tech supports Corporate Security strategy to protect GSK places, people and products. Ensure the technology in this space is top quartile and has bold data lead roadmaps

Required Skills & Qualifications :

  • 15 to 19 Years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
  • Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
  • Experience working within Corporate Security technology domain.
  • Experience deploying C-Cure 9000
  • Experience of Cloud infrastructure hosting for Security systems
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
  • Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
  • Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
  • Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
  • Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.
  • Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices.

Preferred Skills:

  • Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions.
  • Skilled in coaching and guiding Product Analysts and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations.
  • Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.
  • Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant.
  • Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately.


Skills

Access Control (AC), CCTV Surveillance, CCURE 9000, Cloud Hosting, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, Digital Solutions, Physical Security, Product Delivery, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Video Surveillance System

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.
