title: Senior Principal - Product Owner - EUC/MDM
description:
Business Introduction
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Job Purpose

Own the product for how 50,000+ employees across [X] countries get, use and are supported on their devices — with particular depth on the mobile estate: iOS and Android, corporate-owned and BYOD, standard knowledge-worker devices and the field, clinical, lab and manufacturing devices that behave nothing like them.

This is a product role, not a project role. The Senior Product Owner owns the vision, the backlog and the outcomes — deciding what gets built and why, in what order, and being accountable for whether it actually improved anything. Success is measured in adoption, effort saved and experience improved, not in tickets closed or features shipped.

The role sits between three constituencies that rarely agree: employees who want their devices to just work, Security who want them locked down, and Finance who want them cheaper. Turning that tension into a prioritised, defensible backlog is the core of the job.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and articulate the product vision for end user services and mobile device management — a clear statement of what the service will be in 18 months and why that matters to the business.
  • Maintain a rolling roadmap that balances new capability, technical debt, security and compliance obligations, and experience improvement; keep it honest about capacity.
  • Translate the EUC strategy and architecture direction into a sequenced, deliverable product backlog.
  • Own the business case and benefits realisation for product investment; be accountable for the value claimed, not just the spend approved.
  • Own, refine and prioritise the product backlog as the single source of truth for the squad; make prioritisation calls transparently and defend them.
  • Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from and testers can verify — specific about the outcome, not prescriptive about the solution.
  • Lead sprint planning, refinement, review and retrospective alongside the Scrum Master; accept or reject work against acceptance criteria.
  • Manage dependencies across adjacent squads — identity, security, networking, service management — and escalate early when they threaten delivery.
  • Own the release and change approach for user-visible change, including pilot rings, communications and rollback triggers.
  • Be the voice of the employee in every prioritisation conversation, and hold the evidence to back it: research, telemetry, ticket analysis and direct observation.
  • Run continuous discovery — user interviews, shadowing in the field and on the shop floor, surveys, usability testing — with the populations who are least like head office.
  • Convert digital experience (DEX) telemetry and service desk data into prioritised, root-cause-addressing backlog items; treat every recurring ticket category as a product defect until proven otherwise.
  • Own adoption: define what good adoption looks like before launch, measure it after, and act when it does not materialise.
  • Own the product for the mobile estate: enrolment and provisioning experience, BYOD vs. corporate-owned models, app catalogue and distribution, and the employee-facing side of mobile security policy.
  • Own the BYOD proposition end to end — the privacy commitment, the employee terms, the enrolment journey and the trust that makes people willing to participate.
  • Manage the mobile OS release cycle as a recurring product event: annual iOS and Android major releases, beta assessment, compatibility validation and controlled rollout.
  • Own the product relationship with mobile carriers, MDM platform vendors and app suppliers.
  • Build and maintain relationships across business units, regions and functions; run a stakeholder forum or product council that makes trade-offs visible rather than fought in private.
  • Partner with Cyber Security to land control changes in ways employees will accept and comply with — security outcomes delivered through good product design rather than mandate.
  • Engage works councils, employee representatives and Privacy where mobile telemetry, BYOD or device monitoring is in scope.
  • Report on product performance to senior stakeholders in outcome terms.

Professional Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.
  • Product ownership certifications desirable (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe POPM, Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), ITIL v4 Foundation, Microsoft Endpoint Administrator Associate).

Area of Specialisation

  • Product ownership at scale for end user services and mobile device management, with direct working familiarity with an enterprise MDM/UEM platform (e.g., Microsoft Intune).
  • Mobile estate strategy across iOS and Android, corporate-owned and BYOD, standard knowledge-worker devices and specialised field, clinical, lab and manufacturing devices.
  • Digital employee experience (DEX) and service-desk-driven product improvement, using telemetry and ticket analysis to prioritise root-cause fixes.

Related Experience Required

  • Overall 15 years and 12+ years in technology delivery, including 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager with genuine backlog authority (not a business analyst writing another team's requirements).
  • Product or service ownership serving 10,000+ users across multiple countries.
  • Demonstrable hands-on product experience in end user computing, digital workplace or mobile device management — including direct familiarity with an enterprise MDM/UEM platform.
  • Sustained experience owning a backlog for a cross-functional agile squad, through multiple release cycles, in a scaled delivery environment.
  • Track record of using user research and quantitative telemetry to drive prioritisation, with a specific example of a decision the data changed.
  • A demonstrable product outcome delivered and measured — adoption, experience, effort or cost — not merely a feature shipped.

  • Works council and employee-representation engagement, particularly on BYOD, mobile telemetry and device monitoring.
  • Mobile app product experience — internal app store curation, in-house mobile app lifecycle, MAM policy design.
  • Experience delivering a major platform migration or transition as a product owner — MDM platform change, MSP transition, or BYOD programme launch.
  • Service design or UX research background; journey mapping and service blueprinting.
  • Carrier and telecom management — mobile contracts, eSIM, international roaming, expense management.
  • AI-enabled workplace tooling product experience — Copilot, virtual agents, AI-assisted support deflection.
  • Accessibility and assistive technology as a designed-in part of the device proposition.
  • Sustainability — device longevity, refurbishment and circular IT built into the product roadmap.

Skills/Background

  • Deep product craft across backlog ownership, outcome-based requirements, continuous discovery, and value definition and measurement.
  • Endpoint management platform fluency (Microsoft Intune or comparable MDM/UEM tooling) — enough to have credible conversations with engineers and challenge estimates.
  • Understanding of endpoint security fundamentals — conditional access, compliance policy, encryption — and the trade-offs each imposes on the user.
  • Fluency in agile delivery tooling (Azure DevOps, Jira, ServiceNow) — able to run a backlog others can actually read.
  • Influence without authority — landing decisions across engineering, security, service delivery, regions and vendors through evidence and relationship.
  • Communication — equally credible in a sprint refinement and in a steering committee; able to translate technical constraint into business consequence.
  • Comfort with conflict — the role exists at the intersection of security, cost and experience, and someone is always disappointed.

title: Data Engineer - 12 month fixed term contract
description:
We're looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join BlueScope on 12 month fixed term contract to play a hands on role across complex technology and transformation initiatives.

Working within a collaborative project environment, you'll design and deliver data pipelines, migration solutions and trusted data sets that bring together information from multiple systems and enable reliable enterprise reporting and decision-making.

What you’ll be doing

  • Design, build and test scalable data pipelines and ETL processes.
  • Develop reusable, trusted data sets for enterprise reporting and analytics.
  • Use SQL and Python for data transformation, cleansing, reconciliation and modelling.
  • Integrate data sourced from APIs, databases, cloud platforms and enterprise applications.
  • Support complex data migration actiivities, including rehearsals, cutover, reconciliation and hypercare.
  • Establish strong data quality, validation, monitoring and exception-management controls.
  • Work with technical and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into practical data solutions.
  • Apply DataOps principles such as source control, automated testing and CI/CD practices.
  • Support the transition of project solutions into sustainable BAU environments.

You'll bring 5+ years' experience in data engineering, data integration, software development or a similar technical environment, together with strong SQL capability and practical Python experience.

You'll be comfortable working with complex data, multiple source systems and modern cloud data platforms. Experience with Microsoft Azure, Databricks and/or Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Spark, Delta Lake, Git, Azure DevOps and Power BI will be highly regarded.

Most importantly, you'll enjoy working in project based environments, solving complex data problems and partnering with technical and business teams to deliver practical outcomes.

A career at BlueScope provides the opportunity to make a difference - to you, to your team, to our customers, to transforming products, processes and brands, and to an organisation intent on shaping a better built environment for all our communities. At BlueScope, you will:

title: Lead Software Engineer, Workday Time Tracking & Absence
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.


Key Responsibilities

· Own the end-to-end solution design, configuration and governance of Workday Time Tracking and Absence. This includes time entry, time calculation rules, schedules, time off plans, leave of absence, accruals and eligibility rules.

· Act as the design authority for time and absence. Set configuration standards and best practices, review designs, and approve solutions built by the team and implementation partners.

· Lead discussions with business stakeholders to gather requirements, challenge them and turn complex needs into scalable technical solutions. This includes global, regional and country-specific requirements.

· Make sure time and absence solutions follow local labor laws, leave regulations and internal policies, working with HR, Legal and Compliance as needed.

· Manage how time and absence connect with Payroll (for example, time-to-pay and absence-to-pay), Benefits, Core HCM and third-party systems, so data flows correctly from start to finish.

· Lead Workday biannual release readiness for time and absence: impact assessment, regression testing strategy, adopting new features and communicating changes to stakeholders.

· Build and maintain the roadmap for the modules, finding opportunities for automation, AI-enabled capabilities, process simplification and a better employee and manager experience.

· Plan, prioritize and deliver multiple projects and enhancements on schedule, within budget and to quality standards, using Agile methods.

· Act as the escalation point for complex production issues. Lead root-cause analysis and put permanent fixes in place to make the platform more stable.

· Set and maintain documentation standards for design documents, technical specifications, test plans, runbooks and user guides.

· Oversee the work of implementation partners and managed service providers, so deliverables meet BMS quality and compliance standards.

· Lead, coach and mentor engineers and analysts, assign and review their work, and help build capability within the team.

· Explain complex technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and senior leaders.

· Work with other IT leaders and enterprise architecture to keep time and absence solutions aligned with the overall IT strategy, security and data governance standards.

Qualifications & Experience

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

· 7+ years of hands-on experience in Workday Time Tracking and Absence configuration and support, including at least 2 years in a lead or solution-owner role.

· Experience with at least one end-to-end Workday Time Tracking and/or Absence implementation, or a major redesign, in a global, multi-country organization.

· Deep knowledge of time calculation rules, time off and leave of absence setup, accruals, eligibility, business processes and the related security.

· Good understanding of how time and absence connect with Workday Payroll or third-party payroll, Benefits and Core HCM. Working knowledge of Workday reporting, calculated fields and EIB/integrations.

· Working knowledge of labor law and leave compliance in multiple countries.

· Proven ability to lead teams, mentor engineers and manage implementation partners or vendors.

· Excellent project management skills, including managing several projects and priorities at once.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of solving complex production issues and finding their root cause.

· Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including working with senior business and IT leaders.

· Experience with Agile development methods and tools.

· Workday Time Tracking and Absence certification required; Workday Payroll or HCM certification is a plus.

· Exposure to AI, automation or Workday Extend is preferred.

description:

$0.00-$0.00

Summary:

Please send your resume with a cover letter to Jamie Strain at jstrain@ehealthinformation.ca with the position title in the subject line. Although we appreciate the interest of all candidates, only candidates invited for interviews will be contacted. No phone calls please.



JOB DESCRIPTION

Posting #RI-26-051

Posting Period – November 18 to December 2, 2026

POSITION: Postdoctoral Fellow

Synthetic Data Generation

New Position

TERM: Full-time (1.0 FTE) - 1 year contract, with possibility of renewal

SALARY: From $75,000 - $80,000 annually. Will be commensurate with skills and experience.

REPORTS TO: Dr. Khaled El-Emam, Senior Scientist

The Children’s Hospital of Eastern Ontario Research Institute Inc. (“CHEO RI”) is the research arm of the Children’s Hospital of Eastern Ontario – Ottawa Children’s Treatment Centre (“CHEO”) and an affiliated research institute of the University of Ottawa.

We respectfully acknowledge that CHEO RI is located on the unceded, traditional territory of the Algonquin Anishinabek People, who have lived on and cared for this land since time immemorial. We honour their enduring presence and the ways their culture and stewardship have shaped and continue to nurture this land. CHEO RI also recognizes and values the historic and ongoing contributions of all First Nations, Inuit, and Métis peoples.

CHEO is a deeply trusted institution and workplace, widely regarded as a cornerstone of our community. CHEO RI advances this legacy by generating new knowledge and evidence to support CHEO in delivering world‑class care to children and youth. Our mission is to connect exceptional talent and innovative technologies to pursue life‑changing research for every child, youth, and family in our community and beyond.

CHEO RI has an immediate requirement for a Postdoctoral Fellow.

The CHEO Research Institute is fully integrated within the Faculty of Medicine at the University of Ottawa, which comprises several research-intensive Departments supporting a vibrant research and educational environment with multiple strong foci in multiple health-related fields. Several health-related students and medical trainees complete portions of their education and training at CHEO.

The Electronic Health Information Laboratory (EHIL) was formed in 2004 at the CHEO Research Institute and is headed up by Dr. Khaled El Emam. EHIL conducts multi-disciplinary research to enable data sharing for secondary purposes and data-driven simulation. It is located at the Children’s Hospital of Eastern Ontario Research Institute. Our research results get applied in practice relatively quickly, so we get rapid feedback from practice to continue improving our work.

The research topic is synthetic data generation (SDG) and protection using statistical methods, machine learning, deep learning, and generative models. This includes developing SDG methods for different types of health data, evaluating the utility and disclosure risk of synthetic datasets, developing utility and privacy metrics. The research also focuses on developing and comparing methods for annotating clinical and health-related text, including AI-assisted approaches, and evaluating privacy risks in generative models, such as memorization and information leakage.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Under the general supervision of Dr. Khaled El-Emam, the Postdoctoral Fellow will:

  • Conduct research on synthetic data generation for complex health datasets, including structured data and free text, using statistical methods, machine learning, deep learning, and generative models.
  • Develop, implement, and compare methods for generating and evaluating synthetic clinical data and free text, including approaches based on language models.
  • Develop and evaluate approaches for annotating clinical and health-related text, including manual, automated, and AI-assisted annotation methods.
  • Compare annotation tools and methods, including their accuracy, consistency, efficiency, and suitability for different types of text and annotation tasks.
  • Evaluate the privacy of trained generative models and their outputs, including model memorization, information leakage through generated responses, and related privacy risks.
  • Prepare manuscripts, technical reports, presentations, and other research outputs.

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILL AND ABILITIES

  • A recent PhD in statistics, computer science, applied mathematics, engineering, epidemiology or a similar discipline.
  • Good knowledge of statistical and machine learning techniques and their evaluation
  • Previous work training different types of deep learning models / architectures.
  • Good knowledge of NLP methods, including text processing, annotation, classification, and text generation.
  • Knowledge of privacy risks in machine learning and generative models, including memorization and disclosure of sensitive information through model outputs.
  • Good knowledge of R and/or Python, and ideally PyTorch and/or Tensorflow;
  • Ability to set priorities with competing and shifting demands;
  • Willingness to learn and adapt to new policies, procedures and requirements;
  • Ability to be flexible with working hours to meet deadlines.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Possibility to work in a hybrid work model (remote and on-site).

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

  • Eligible to work in Canada;
  • Compliance with CHEO RI’s occupational health, immunization, and health‑surveillance requirements, as applicable to the role and work environment.
  • Completion of a Police Record Check, in accordance with institutional and regulatory requirements.

TO APPLY

Please send a complete CV and cover letter to Jamie Strain, by email quoting the posting number to: jstrain@ehealthinformation.ca.

We value diverse and non-traditional career paths and perspectives, and value skills such as resilience, collaboration, and relationship-building. CHEO Research Institute Inc. – Human Resources Department

researchhr@cheo.on.ca

401 Smyth Road

Ottawa (Ontario) K1H 8L1, CANADA

DESCRIPTION DE POSTE

Numéro d’affichage - #RI-26-051

Période d’affichage – du 18 novembre au 2 décembre, 2026

POSTE: Boursière ou boursier de recherches postdoctorales

Production de données synthétique

Nouveau position

DURÉE: Temps plein, (1,0 ETP), contrat d’un an avec possibilité de renouvellement

SALAIRE: De 75 0000$ - 80 000$ par an, sera proportionnel au compétences et l’expérience

RELÈVE DE: Dr. Khaled El-Emam, scientifique principal

L’Institut de recherche du Centre hospitalier pour enfants de l’est de l’Ontario Inc. (« IR du CHEO ») est l’organisme de recherche du Centre de traitement pour enfants du Centre hospitalier pour enfants de l’est de l’Ontario situé à Ottawa (« CHEO ») et un institut de recherche affilié de l’Université d’Ottawa.

Nous reconnaissons, en tout respect, que l’IR du CHEO est situé sur le territoire traditionnel non cédé du peuple anichinabé algonquin, qui y vit et en prend soin depuis des temps immémoriaux. Nous rendons hommage à leur présence durable et aux façons dont leur culture et leur intendance ont façonné ce territoire et continuent de l’enrichir. De plus, l’IR du CHEO reconnaît les contributions historiques et actuelles des Premières Nations, des Inuits et des Métis, et y accorde une grande importance.

Le CHEO est un établissement et un milieu de travail digne de confiance et largement reconnu comme pilier de notre collectivité. L’IR du CHEO fait fructifier cet héritage en générant de nouvelles connaissances et données probantes pour appuyer le CHEO dans la prestation de soins de calibre mondial aux enfants et aux jeunes. Notre mission est de réunir des talents exceptionnels et des technologies novatrices pour poursuivre des recherches qui ont une incidence sur la vie de chaque enfant, jeune et famille de notre collectivité et ailleurs.

L’Institut de recherche du CHEO a immédiatement besoin d’une boursière ou d’un boursier de recherches postdoctorales.

L’IR du CHEO est entièrement intégré à la Faculté de médecine de l’Université d’Ottawa, qui comprend plusieurs départements à forte densité de recherche appuyant un milieu dynamique de recherche et d’éducation avec de multiples centres d’intérêt dans plusieurs domaines liés à la santé. Plusieurs étudiantes et étudiants du domaine de la santé et stagiaires en médecine font une partie de leurs études et de leur formation au CHEO.

L’Electronic Health Information Laboratory a été créé en 2004 à l’IR du CHEO et est dirigé par Khaled El Emam. Ce laboratoire effectue des recherches multidisciplinaires pour permettre le partage de données à des fins secondaires et la simulation axée sur les données. Il est situé à l’IR du CHEO. Nos résultats de recherche sont appliqués relativement rapidement dans la pratique, de sorte que nous recevons rapidement une rétroaction pour continuer à améliorer notre travail.

Le sujet de recherche est la production de données synthétiques et la protection à l’aide de méthodes statistiques, d’apprentissage automatique, d’apprentissage profond et de modèles génératifs. Il s’agit notamment d’élaborer des méthodes de production de données synthétiques pour différents types de données sur la santé, d’évaluer l’utilité et le risque de divulgation d’ensembles de données synthétiques ainsi que d’élaborer des mesures de l’utilité et de la protection des renseignements personnels. La recherche se concentre également sur l’élaboration et la comparaison de méthodes pour annoter le texte clinique et lié à la santé, notamment par des approches assistées par l’IA, et sur l’évaluation des risques d’atteinte à la vie privée dans les modèles génératifs, comme la mémorisation et la fuite d’information.

RESPONSABILITÉS

Sous la supervision de Dr. Khaled El Emam le boursière ou boursier de recherches post doctorales effectuera ce qui suit:

  • Effectuer des recherches sur la production de données synthétiques pour des ensembles de données complexes sur la santé, notamment des données structurées et du texte libre, en utilisant des méthodes statistiques, l’apprentissage automatique, l’apprentissage profond et des modèles génératifs.
  • Élaborer, mettre en œuvre et comparer des méthodes de production et d’évaluation de données cliniques synthétiques et de texte libre, notamment des approches fondées sur des modèles de langage.
  • Élaborer des approches pour annoter le texte clinique et lié à la santé, notamment à l’aide de méthodes d’annotation manuelles, automatisées et assistées par l’IA, et les évaluer.
  • Comparer les outils et méthodes d’annotation en évaluant leur exactitude, leur uniformité, leur efficacité et leur pertinence pour différents types de texte et de tâches d’annotation.
  • Évaluer la confidentialité des modèles génératifs formés et de leurs résultats, notamment la mémorisation des modèles, la fuite d’information par les réponses générées et les risques connexes liés à la protection des renseignements personnels.
  • Préparer des manuscrits, des rapports techniques, des présentations et d’autres résultats de recherche.

QUALIFICATIONS, COMPÉTENCES ET CAPACITÉS

  • Doctorat récent en statistique, en informatique, en mathématiques appliquées, en génie, en épidémiologie ou dans une discipline semblable.
  • Bonne connaissance des techniques statistiques et d’apprentissage machine et de leur évaluation.
  • Formation professionnelle antérieure sur différents types de modèles/architectures d’apprentissage profond.
  • Bonne connaissance des méthodes de traitement automatique des langues, dont le traitement de texte, l’annotation, la classification et la génération de texte.
  • Connaissance des risques d’atteinte à la vie privée liés à l’apprentissage automatique et aux modèles génératifs, notamment la mémorisation et la divulgation de renseignements sensibles au moyen de résultats de modèles.
  • Bonne connaissance de R ou Python (PyTorch ou TensorFlow, un atout).
  • Capacité d’établir des priorités face à des demandes concurrentes et changeantes.
  • Volonté d’apprendre et de s’adapter à de nouvelles politiques, procédures et exigences.
  • Capacité à faire preuve de souplesse en ce qui concerne les heures de travail afin de respecter les échéances.

CONDITIONS DE TRAVAIL

  • Possibilité de travailler dans un modèle hybride combinant le télétravail et la présence sur site selon les besoins.
  • undefined

AUTRES EXIGENCES

  • Autorisation de travailler au Canada.
  • Conformité aux exigences de CHEO RI en matière de santé au travail, de vaccination et de surveillance de la santé, telles qu'elles s'appliquent au rôle et à l'environnement de travail.
  • Réalisation d'un contrôle des antécédents judiciaires, conformément aux exigences institutionnelles et réglementaires.

POUR POSTULER

Veuillez envoyer un CV complet et une lettre de présentation à Jamie Strain par courriel à l’adresse suivante: jstrain@ehealthinformation.ca.

Nous accordons de l’importance aux parcours de carrière et aux perspectives diversifiées et non traditionnelles et nous valorisons les compétences telles que la résilience, la collaboration et l’établissement de relations. Nous invitons les membres des minorités racialisées, les peuples autochtones, les personnes handicapées, les personnes ayant des orientations sexuelles minoritaires et des identités de genre ainsi que les autres personnes qui possèdent les compétences et les connaissances nécessaires à présenter leur demande afin de collaborer de manière productive avec des communautés diverses.

title: Co-op Training Coordinator & LMS Administrator
description:
Who We Are


At the heart of GFL lies our greatest asset – our people. Known affectionately as “Team Green,” we are united under a shared purpose of providing sustainable solutions that enable our customers and communities to be Green for Life. Working at GFL is more than a job—it is an opportunity to make a difference and grow along the way.


The Role


Green for Life (GFL) Environmental Inc. is seeking a highly organized, tech-savvy, and detail-oriented Co-op Training Coordinator & LMS Administrator to join our Enterprise Training team. In this role, you will partner directly with the Training Coordinator and Instructional Designers to manage day-to-day Learning Management System (LMS) operations, coordinate virtual and in-person training logistics, and maintain learning repositories.

This role offers hands-on experience in corporate Learning & Development (L&D), learning technologies, and enterprise program administration within a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who thrives on maintaining data accuracy and can manage competing priorities with minimal direction.


How You’ll Make an Impact


  • LMS Administration & Publishing: Upload, test, configure, and publish eLearning courses (SCORM/xAPI files), videos, and job aids onto GFL’s Learning Management System (e.g., Docebo), ensuring proper version control and user access.
  • Training Logistics & Scheduling: Coordinate end-to-end logistics for Instructor-Led Training (ILT) and Virtual Instructor-Led Training (VILT) sessions, including managing training calendars, sending calendar invites, tracking attendance, and distributing pre- and post-session materials.
  • Learner Support & Troubleshooting: Act as the first point of contact for employee LMS inquiries, troubleshooting enrollment issues, course completion discrepancies, and basic platform navigation.
  • Reporting & Data Analytics: Pull, clean, and format training completion reports, attendance logs, and learner feedback metrics in Excel/Google Sheets to support stakeholder reporting and compliance tracking.
  • Content Repository & Documentation Management: Maintain a centralized, well-organized library of training assets, facilitator guides, and source files on Google Drive/LMS. Assist with formatting job aids and updating minor text or branding in training decks.
  • Project & Stakeholder Coordination: Support the Enterprise Training team with tracking project timelines, taking meeting notes/action items, and drafting clear communications (emails, announcements, and newsletters) to promote new training launches.

Knowledge, Skills, and Qualifications


Essential Qualifications


  • Education: Currently enrolled in a post-secondary co-op program in Human Resources, Business Administration, Educational Technology, Instructional Design, Communications, Masters of Education or a related field.
  • Technical Proficiency: Intermediate proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) and Microsoft Excel (e.g., VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, data filtering for reporting).
  • LMS & Authoring Exposure: Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (such as Docebo, Cornerstone, or SuccessFactors) or course authoring tools (Articulate 360, Camtasia, Canva) is a strong asset.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to write clear, professional emails and simplify technical instructions for end-users.
  • Attention to Detail: Meticulous organizational skills when managing user enrollments, file structures, and compliance data.
  • Self-Driven & Adaptable: Proven ability to work independently, take initiative on next steps, and maintain accuracy in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

Assets


  • Bilingualism: Proficiency in both English and French (written and verbal) is considered an asset.
  • AI & Emerging Tech: Familiarity with using Generative AI tools to assist with drafting communications, summarizing notes, or formatting content.



We thank you for your interest. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.


GFL is committed to equal opportunity for all, without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic. If you are interested in applying for employment and need special assistance or an accommodation to apply for a posted position, please contact myworkdayrecruitment@gflenv.com

title: Graduate Admissions Specialist
description:
At the University of Waterloo, we create and promote a culture where everyone can reach their full potential. As an employee, you get support & opportunities that empower you to advance your career. Explore how we can bring big ideas to life, together. The University is a welcoming workplace for those of all abilities, interests, and expertise. 2026-03704


Time Type:

Full time

Staff

Admissions

Employment Type:

Department:

Hiring Range:

Posting Information:
This posting is for an existing vacancy.

There is a qualified internal in the role

Internal posting deadline Thursday November 26th at 11:59 PM

Job Description:

Primary Purpose

The Graduate Admission Specialist is the key liaison with the Departments and Faculties for the evaluation of admission recommendations, production of offers of admission, tracking conditions of admission and decisions, management of admission records and communications with prospective students and applicants, monitoring special applications and admissions sanctioned through University agreements with international institutions or governments and collaborative or joint programs with other universities. The incumbent is responsible for preparing procedures, and training and mentoring administrative departmental staff and faculty on best business practices for application and admission requirements, programs and agreements, and on the use of complex and evolving student system.


Key Accountabilities

Assessment, verification and final decision on recommendation for Offer of Admission

  • Assesses the application file, verifying adherence to Senate regulations and guidelines pertaining to graduate studies, and has final signing authority on the recommendation for admission on behalf of the Associate Director, Graduate Admissions. These decisions are impactful and binding, and require extensive and comprehensive knowledge of a vast number of education systems, complex combinations of qualifications (education/work experience/test scores) for non-standard admissions, as well as the exercise of sound and unbiased judgment. Due to the variety of programs, international agreements and funding schemes, the Specialist must carefully review the unique Department details of the Offer of Admission contract letter for accuracy, to protect the student, department and University.
  • Detect potentially fraudulent documentation submitted as part of the application/admission process. These potentially fraudulent documents are investigated in a confidential and professional manner, and involve contacting source institutions and referees.

Management of admissions records and communications in a complex student database

  • The application and admission records management and systems are complex for applying rules for admission, interpreting appropriate changes of status and conditions for admission for final decisions, establishing accurate data, identifying, testing and resolving systems issues. Data at the application and admission stage has an impact on the University as coding affects the Graduate Records and Graduate Financial Aid areas, and externally, the Ontario Ministry of Advanced Education and Skills Development (MAESD) and Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC). Application and admission data are utilized for planning and reporting purposes by: Departments, Faculties, Graduate Studies and Postdoctoral Affairs, Enrolment Growth Working Group, Institutional Analysis and Planning and external agencies.

Training and Advisement

  • Provides effective direction and leadership to faculty and administrative staff on an ongoing basis throughout the year. This includes expert advice to a group or one-on-one training regarding academic regulations, application/admission procedures and use of the student system.
  • Initiates, builds, and maintains documentation of current and new business practices related to the processing of applications and admissions. Updates and maintains admissions resources and procedures for departmental use.
  • Attends webinars and off-campus workshops designed for admissions personnel for training with international credential evaluation and document analysis.
  • Stays informed and knowledgeable about all aspects of programs, applications, admissions, student life and other issues related to counselling graduate applicants, admitted students and departments.
  • Provides superior, empathetic customer service in all oral and written communications, relaying negative decisions, managing confidential issues, and providing appropriate, equitable and informed decisions.

Business Process and Improvements/Research & Policy Development

  • With consideration of the highly competitive interuniversity academic environment, the Specialist reviews policy, procedural and system initiatives, provides input and recommends progressive improvements to the management of admissions. The activities for admissions require meticulous attention to the application and recommendation evaluation processes, approval of admission offers and communications, ensuring that quality standards are achieved. This includes planning and implementing strategies for continuous improvement of processes in admissions. Research from credential workshops may result in changes to admission policies and procedures.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • University degree is required, but in select cases, equivalent education and experience may be considered.

Experience

  • Knowledge and experience with applications, admissions and self-service, document retrieval and workflow in a complex student-software system.
  • Previous customer service experience required in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proven expertise on international education systems, degree and grade equivalencies, and document verification processes.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Proven attention to detail and ability to follow established processes.
  • Ability to exercise sound and impartial judgment, sensitive to the wide array of cultural and socioeconomic backgrounds of applicants and students.
  • Embraces supportive mentorship, professional quality, respectful communication, creativity, positive energy, and synergy in their work.
  • Demonstrates effective and professional communication skills such as email correspondence as well as verbal communication with students, staff and faculty.
  • Ability to prepare and present technical instructions (write or create technical instructions, verbal instruction: train and teach, produce instructional videos).
  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship building skills with the ability to relate to faculty and staff.
  • Aptitude to support students from various cultural backgrounds with tact and diplomacy
  • Exhibits ability to work within a team structure, and negotiate and manage conflict.
  • High degree of organizational skill, interpersonal acumen and problem solving ability is required to provide oversight in balancing multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Capacity to work with confidential and sensitive information.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and problem solve independently as well as part of a team.
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to new technologies.
  • Advocate for change: Facilitates groups or teams through the problem-solving and creative-thinking processes related to implementation of new approaches, systems, structures, and methods.
  • Extensive knowledge of University policies and Graduate Studies regulations and practices related to applications and admissions.
  • Technical skills required include Advanced MS Word, Advanced Excel, Intermediate PowerPoint, PeopleSoft Quest, OnBase, SharePoint


Equity Statement

The University of Waterloo acknowledges that much of our work takes place on the traditional territory of the Neutral, Anishinaabeg, and Haudenosaunee peoples. Our main campus is situated on the Haldimand Tract, the land granted to the Six Nations that includes six miles on each side of the Grand River. Our active work toward reconciliation takes place across our campuses through research, learning, teaching, and community building, and is coordinated within the Office of Indigenous Relations.

The University values the diverse and intersectional identities of its students, faculty, and staff. The University regards equity and diversity as an integral part of academic excellence and is committed to accessibility for all employees. As such, we encourage applications from candidates who have been historically disadvantaged and marginalized, including applicants who identify as First Nations, Métis and/or Inuk (Inuit), Black, racialized, a person with a disability, women and/or 2SLGBTQ+.

title: Junior Data Scientist
description:
Junior Data Scientist

Our Company

N2IA Technologies is a consulting company specializing in acquisition/contracting support, cost/FinOps, and technology optimization for federal clients. We deliver tailored strategies, robust software solutions, and streamlined operations to help organizations achieve their goals. At N2IA, we are committed to developing innovative financial and compliance-based solutions that address evolving business and regulatory needs. If you are passionate about accounting, financial accuracy, and supporting government programs, N2IA is the place for you.

Position Overview

N2IA Technologies is seeking a Junior Data Scientist to support data analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning initiatives for federal government programs. Working with senior data scientists and other team members, this individual will help prepare datasets, evaluate program and operational questions, develop analytical models, and communicate findings that support government decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collect, clean, organize, and validate data from multiple sources supporting federal customer programs.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends, relationships, anomalies, and data quality concerns.
  • Write Python or R code and SQL queries to support repeatable analysis.
  • Assist with feature engineering and the development, testing, and evaluation of statistical and machine learning models.
  • Support analysis of program performance, operational outcomes, and resource needs under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Create charts, reports, and briefing materials that explain findings to technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Document data sources, preparation steps, assumptions, methods, and results to support reproducibility and customer review.
  • Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, subject matter experts, and government stakeholders to understand requirements.
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback to improve analytical quality.
  • Follow applicable customer requirements for data handling, privacy, security, and access controls.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • Zero to two years of relevant experience in data science, analytics, statistical modeling, or machine learning. Relevant internships, research, and academic projects will be considered.
  • Hands-on experience using Python or R to clean, analyze, and visualize data.
  • Foundational SQL skills, including filtering, joining, and aggregating data.
  • Working knowledge of statistics and probability, including descriptive statistics, regression, and hypothesis testing.
  • Foundational understanding of machine learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, training and test datasets, and model evaluation.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and address common data quality issues, including missing values, inconsistent formats, and duplicate records.
  • Ability to explain analytical methods and findings through clear written communication and visualizations.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn through collaboration and feedback.
  • Ability to follow established procedures for handling sensitive information and documenting analytical work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Internship, research, or project experience involving real-world datasets and a clearly defined analytical problem.
  • Hands-on experience with Python libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, Matplotlib, or Seaborn, or comparable R packages.
  • Familiarity with Git or similar version control tools and Jupyter notebooks or comparable development environments.
  • Experience creating dashboards or reports using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, Databricks, or distributed data processing tools such as PySpark.
  • Exposure to federal government programs through employment, internships, research, or academic projects.
  • Familiarity with financial analysis, acquisition, contracting, or operational analytics.

N2IA is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

title: Principal Engineer – Micro-segmentation-2
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.


Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Principal Network Engineer to join our Cyber Engineering team and run our network segmentation and zero trust strategy, with Illumio Core as the foundation platform. As the Principal Network Engineer, you will be responsible for the architecture, deployment, automation, and L3 support of micro-segmentation across data center, cloud, and hybrid workloads, and for setting the technical standards other engineers build on. You will play a crucial role in reducing lateral movement risk and strengthening our security posture, moving applications from visibility to enforced, least-privilege policy while working closely with infrastructure, network, security, and application owners.

Responsibilities

  • Operate and maintain the Illumio Core Platform: PCE Administration, VEN deployment, label taxonomy (Role, Application, Environment, Location), and the end-to-end policy lifecycle.
  • Evaluate segmentation technologies and approaches: assess platform fit for incoming requirements, recommend the right solution or combination of controls, and advise leadership on technical direction.
  • Drive network segmentation and micro-segmentation: map application and east-west traffic dependencies using Illumination, and convert them into allow-list rulesets, scopes, and enforcement boundaries.
  • Execute phased enforcement (visibility, selective, full) with minimal business disruption, including change planning, validation, and rollback.
  • Maintain platform hygiene: keep workload labels accurate, manage the VEN lifecycle (pairing, upgrades, health, decommissioning), and retire stale or unused rules and objects.
  • Apply zero trust segmentation standards, policy models, and reference patterns aligned with BMS security architecture and the broader zero trust program, and drive adoption across teams.
  • Automate onboarding and policy management using the Illumio REST API with Python and PowerShell, and integrate with ServiceNow CMDB and SIEM platforms for workload context and flow telemetry.
  • Provide L3 support: troubleshoot policy and connectivity issues, perform blocked-traffic analysis, resolve VEN health issues, and support PCE upgrades and maintenance, including on-call escalation support on a rota basis.
  • Build dashboards and reports on coverage, enforcement percentage, policy drift, and risk reduction for security leadership and audit.
  • Partner with Infrastructure, Network, Cloud, and Application teams to align segmentation design, onboarding, and enforcement with application and business priorities.
  • Lead and govern the vendor team supporting Illumio operations: assign and prioritize work, review designs and deliverables, track SLAs and quality, and drive knowledge transfer and continuous improvement.
  • Work in a co-delivery model with onshore and offshore teams, communicating risk, policy impact, and progress clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Maintain runbooks, standards, and compliance evidence, and mentor engineers across the team through design reviews and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity or network security, including 4+ years in network segmentation and micro-segmentation, with demonstrated ownership of enterprise-scale designs.
  • Hands-on experience and in-depth knowledge of network micro-segmentation: application dependency mapping, label and policy design, allow-list rulesets, and phased enforcement in production environments.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Illumio Core or an equivalent micro-segmentation platform, including PCE, VEN deployment, label design, rulesets, and enforcement boundaries in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of zero trust principles and their application to workload and network segmentation (NIST SP 800-207).
  • Solid networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, VLANs, load balancers, east-west versus north-south traffic analysis) and working knowledge of Windows and Linux server environments.
  • Cloud security experience in AWS or Azure environments, including workload segmentation across hybrid infrastructure.

title: VCA Cards Benefits Operations Lead
description:
About Us
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Overview:

Visa Consulting & Analytics (VCA) is Visa's consulting division, serving Visa's clients (including card issuers, acquirers and merchants) and solving their strategic problems focused on improving performance. Drawing on our expertise in strategy consulting, payments, data analytics, marketing, operational and macroeconomics, VCA drives high impact and tangible financial results.

Cards benefits team within VCA manages the deployment of cards benefits programs for Visa’s clients in AP. This is to support Visa’s clients with differentiated card propositions and stay relevant to and drive preference amongst consumers.


As a Senior Manager, Operations – Card Benefits, you will define and drive the regional operations strategy for Visa’s card benefits program. You’ll lead transformation initiatives that establish scalable operating frameworks, enhance delivery performance, and strengthen cross-market collaboration. This role is ideal for a strategic operator and people leader who thrives in ambiguity, brings structure to complexity, and inspires a team to achieve sustainable, high-impact outcomes.

This role involves a significant component of cross-functional work and will require the Senior Manager to work closely with the VCA market teams, Product, Sourcing and partners to streamline operations across AP.


What a Senior Manager does at Visa:

In this role, you are expected to:

  • Shape and Scale Operations: Lead the transformation of Visa’s card benefits operations across Asia Pacific, designing scalable frameworks, automation opportunities, and governance models to support long-term growth.
  • Own Client Onboarding and Delivery: Oversee onboarding for new clients, managing vendor relationships, contracts, and financial processes—including POs, renewals, and top-ups—to ensure seamless implementation.
  • Operational Intelligence and Insight: Define and implement analytics and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into performance, benefits utilisation, and commercial optimisation opportunities.
  • Drive Financial Discipline: Oversee billing, revenue, and expense recognition, ensuring accurate and efficient financial management across multiple markets.
  • Vendor and Partner Leadership: Build and manage strategic vendor partnerships, driving consistency, efficiency, and value across service delivery.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with key internal stakeholders—such as finance, sourcing and legal—to optimise processes and enhance operational outcomes.
  • Build Capabilities and Lead Talent: Recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing operations team, championing a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Strategic Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to regional leadership and market leads on operational strategy, cost optimization, and delivery excellence. Ensure at all times timely and relevant communication.
  • Lead Through Ambiguity: Navigate complex, evolving business contexts with agility and composure, bringing clarity, alignment, and focus to teams and stakeholders.
  • Champion Innovation: Lead or support special projects that modernise processes, expand services, and enhance client and cardholder experiences across Asia Pacific.
  • Client Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for market teams and issuing/acquiring/merchant/fintech bank clients across assigned markets, building trusted, long-term partnerships and ensuring high levels of satisfaction and retention
  • Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate closely with internal teams - including product, operations, sourcing, and legal to ensure seamless onboarding, implementation, and ongoing delivery of benefits services
  • Kssue Resolution: Proactively address and resolve client concerns, operational challenges, or service escalations to maintain strong relationships and protect the company’s reputation.

Projects you will be a part of:

You’ll spearhead the delivery of Visa’s premium card benefits helping issuers enhance customer value, deepen engagement, and differentiate in competitive markets.

  • Work with the Consulting and Product team to operationalize card benefits program that can help us transform the way issuer and Visa drive PV and engagement amongst Visa cardholders
  • Development and maintenance of relationships with merchants and third-party suppliers
  • Negotiation of terms and agreements to secure relevant benefits for Visa’s clients at compelling terms to ensure card benefits provision drives payment volume as well as Value Added Service revenue.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders within VCA, Regional Products & Solutions, and in-market counterparts to align benefits with business goals and strategies
  • Monitor and evaluate the performance of secured benefits, report on these findings and make recommend changes to strategy as may be necessary to clients
  • Manage the budget, financial planning and forecasting for benefits.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

What you will need:

  • Minimum 8+ years of experience in financial services or consulting or loyalty programs across operations and execution
  • Minimum 6+ years of strong experience utilizing analytical and project management skills
  • Ability to build and maintain professional relationships, with proven negotiation and communication skills, used to secure deals and offers, ideally from merchants and third parties
  • Strong team player internally and with clients, working independently to coordinate cross functional activities, obtaining critical support from multiple stakeholders
  • Proven ability to define operational strategy and build scalable processes for long-term success
  • Deep experience managing vendors, contracts, and commercial negotiations, including rate setting and performance review
  • Strong financial acumen to manage budgets, forecasts, and multi-market billing accuracy
  • Demonstrated success as a people leader, fostering high-performing, collaborative, and empowered teams.

What will also help:

  • Master’s Degree in business, engineering or a related field
  • Experience in consulting, managed services, or large-scale operations within payments or financial services
  • Familiarity with card products, loyalty programs, or premium benefit ecosystems
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office and analytical tools
  • Proven experience leading automation, transformation, or process redesign initiatives

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

The mission of the Business Analyst is to deliver accurate, high-quality solutions that bring our clients' government pricing requirements to life. You will guide clients through their implementation, gathering and documenting requirements and translating them into functional design specifications and system configuration in ICyte. You’ll build test plans and scripts from those designs, then execute and support testing to confirm every calculation works as intended. You’ll also develop SOPs and deliver end-user training and support, so client teams are ready to own the solution with confidence.

What you’ll do to thrive in this role:

  • Configure assigned price type calculations in ICyte based on design guidance from senior team members
  • Design and execute test cases for assigned calculations using established approaches, validating results against client methodology and expected outcomes
  • Investigate calculation variances from methodology, data, or configuration, resolving routine issues and escalating complex variances to senior team members
  • Review new client pricing and contracting scenarios and provide input on configuration approaches to senior team members
  • Assist clients with contract configuration or other system changes needed to support new scenarios, including testing of those changes
  • Contribute to project plans, status reports, and other project documentation, keeping the team informed on progress of assigned work
  • Contribute to engagement deliverables by completing assigned components with consistent, high-quality output
  • Communicate issues, progress, and questions clearly with internal team members, and support routine client interactions
  • Propose improvements to internal practices, processes, and tools, and own small improvement initiatives

What you’ll bring to the table:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, technology or related fields and/or equivalent experience
  • Solid experience in pharmaceutical Medicaid and Government Pricing methodologies, including price type calculations, bundled sales, and discount reallocation
  • Solid experience across the full software development lifecycle (requirements, design, build, test, implement), with a track record of contributing to successful systems implementations or upgrades.
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Experience in Pharmaceutical commercial contracting (chargebacks, purchase-based rebates, utilization-based rebates), preferred
  • Experience with Model N Flex or Model N Powered by N, strongly preferred

What IntegriChain offers:

  • Mission driven: Work with the purpose of helping to improve patients' lives!
  • Excellent and affordable medical benefits + non-medical perks including Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and much more!
  • Robust Learning & Development opportunities including over 700+ development courses free to all employees

IntegriChain is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law. IntegriChain is an equal opportunity employer; committed to creating a community of inclusion, and an environment free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

description:

The role conceptualizes, designs and develops analytics models in addressing complex business problems, discovering insights and identifying opportunities that are of value to internal and external business stakeholders, typically using a hypothesis-driven approach. The role codes, tests, debugs and documents complex programs, and enhances existing programs to ensure that data processing production systems continue to meet user requirements.

title: Principal - SAP Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Business Introduction
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Job Purpose


The SAP Infrastructure Engineer builds and runs both the Cloud and On-Prem SAP Infrastructure platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, insourced at the grades covered by this description while engineering at G7b and below is delivered through managed service partners, so the role integrates and assures partner components as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.


Key Responsibilities

• Build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.

• Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.

• Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.

• Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.

• Adopt engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.

• Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.

• Work with principal engineers and partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.

• Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.

• Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.

• Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.

• Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.


Education & Professional Qualifications

• Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).

• Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).


Related Experience Required

• Overall 10 Years and typically 5-7 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.

• Experience in cloud infrastructure management, preferably with ERP systems. Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on either Azure or Google Cloud. Strong knowledge of SAP hosted on VMware

• Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.

• Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.

• Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.

• Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.


Skills/Background

• Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.

• Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.

• Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.

• Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.

• Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.

• Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.


#AGTech


Skills

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Kubernetes, Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Platform Engineering, SAP on Azure, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Technical Leadership, Terraform (Software), Virtualization

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Inclusion at GSK:

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Field Services Engineer (Baltimore) - Cranial and Spinal Imaging
location: State of Maryland, United States of America
description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 15 Dec 2026


Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

In this exciting role as a Field Services Engineer, you will be supporting maintenance and repairs of The Mazor™ robotic guidance system and The O-arm™ surgical imaging system within our Surgical Solutions Portfolio for spinal and cranial procedures.


You’ll play a critical role in supporting clinicians and ensuring patients have access to the technology they depend on. When these systems are down, procedures can be delayed and care can be impacted. You are the person who shows up, diagnoses the issue, and gets things back up and running—often under time pressure and in high-stakes environments.


You’ll work hands-on with complex, high-value equipment, requiring strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills to keep systems performing at their best in real clinical environments.


This position covers Maryland, Washington DC, Pennsylvania, and other areas as required. You'll manage your own schedule and prioritize service calls across your territory.


No two days look the same. You might:


  • Travel to a hospital site to troubleshoot a system issue
  • Diagnose faults at the component level and implement a fix
  • Perform preventative maintenance to avoid future disruptions
  • Work directly with clinical staff to understand problems and restore functionality

Primary Responsibilities:


  • Travel to sites to work as a member of the local team to provide efficient repair / installation support to all accounts within assigned area.
  • Installs, operates, maintains, repairs, and modifies equipment on designated equipment.
  • Performs a variety of maintenance and technical support on products such as equipment, integrated systems and subsystems, and software at customer and/or field locations.
  • Analyzes and evaluates products and related performance.
  • Troubleshoots and diagnoses malfunctions to eliminate problems in minimal time.
  • Support future product integrations by performing upgrades and or configuration updates to existing and future imaging/navigation equipment.
  • Lead and participate in product technical repair and clinical use training with domestic, international and 3rd party staff members.
  • Provide testing and validation support to the manufacturer’s organization, as applicable.
  • Keeping accurate records of discussions or correspondence with customers including all assigned complaints, follow-up actions, root cause analysis and final resolution within the complaint tracking system.

Minimum Qualifications:


  • High School Diploma or equivalent required
  • 4 years technician, clinical field service or clinical customer support experience.

Preferred Qualifications:


  • Reside in the Baltimore metro area.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Bioengineering, engineering or technology field.
  • Previous experience as Technician/Field Services within medical device industry.
  • Experience with orthopedic anatomy, surgical protocol and medical terminology.
  • Ability to troubleshoot with technical skills, creativity and high discipline.
  • Familiarity with most commonly used test equipment (i.e.: dosimeter, power supplies, DVM's, signal generators, flow meters, etc.)
  • Ability to read and understand schematics and engineering drawings.
  • Familiar with the FDA 21 CFR, CGMP for Medical devices.
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills with the ability to communicate complex technical issues in an easy to understand manner.
  • Responsive problem solver and action oriented in resolving customer issues and meeting customer requirements.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

title: Engineer I, Test Automation
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care.


We are looking for a highly motivated Tosca Automation Test Engineer with 3–4 years of experience in test automation and strong expertise in Tricentis Tosca development for web applications. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable automation solutions and be capable of handling complex web application automation challenges.

The candidate must possess strong technical skills in web object identification, custom control development, and Tosca automation framework design. Experience with Tosca Cloud is desirable, while JD Edwards (JDE) automation development experience and salesforce will be considered a significant advantage.


How you’ll make an impact:

  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts using Tricentis Tosca.
  • Automate functional, regression, smoke, integration, and end-to-end test scenarios for web applications.
  • Create reusable automation components, modules, and libraries following Tosca best practices.
  • Develop and maintain custom controls/modules for complex and non-standard web UI elements.
  • Analyse application changes and update automation assets accordingly.
  • Troubleshoot object recognition, synchronization, and execution issues.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts, Developers, Product Owners, and QA teams to understand requirements and create effective automation solutions.
  • Participate in test planning, test design, execution, defect tracking, and reporting activities.
  • Support automation execution through Distributed Execution or Elastic Grid Execution.
  • Ensure automation assets are maintainable, scalable, and aligned with enterprise automation standards.

What you’ll need (Required):

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Tricentis Tosca.
  • Proven experience automating web applications.
  • Ability to develop custom controls and custom automation solutions for web applications.
