title: Regional Brand Lead Americas - Vice President
description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Regional Brand Lead Americas

Corporate Title: Vice President

Location: New York, NY

Overview

As Regional Brand Lead, Americas, you will be a senior member of Deutsche Bank’s Global Brand Office and our lead brand representative across the Americas, with a particular focus on the United States. You will shape and advance Deutsche Bank’s brand presence in the region, translating our global brand strategy into relevant, distinctive and commercially meaningful initiatives. You will work closely with senior regional stakeholders and global colleagues, combining strategic brand leadership, market insight and strong creative judgement. At the same time, you will bring the perspectives, opportunities and cultural dynamics of the Americas into the continued development of Deutsche Bank’s global brand agenda.

What We Offer You

  • A diverse and inclusive environment that embraces change, innovation, and collaboration
  • A hybrid working model, allowing for in-office / work from home flexibility, generous vacation, personal and volunteer days
  • Employee Resource Groups support an inclusive workplace for everyone and promote community engagement
  • Competitive compensation packages including health and wellbeing benefits, retirement savings plans, parental leave, and family building benefits
  • Educational resources, matching gift and volunteer programs

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Deutsche Bank’s brand agenda across the Americas, translating our global brand strategy into relevant and impactful regional priorities, programs and initiatives
  • Act as a trusted brand advisor to senior regional stakeholders, connecting brand opportunities and challenges with business priorities and helping create a coherent brand presence across the region
  • Bring market intelligence, stakeholder insights, competitive developments and cultural trends from the Americas into the Global Brand Office, contributing to the continued evolution of our global brand strategy and positioning
  • Lead the development and activation of regional brand programs, campaigns, partnerships and experiences, working with internal teams and external agencies to deliver distinctive, high-quality work
  • Provide strong creative direction and brand judgement across channels and touchpoints, balancing global consistency with the cultural and commercial realities of individual markets
  • Champion Deutsche Bank’s brand standards and governance across the region, while using brand, reputation and market insights to identify opportunities to strengthen relevance, differentiation and long-term brand equity

How You’ll Lead

  • Serve as the Global Brand Office’s senior representative in the Americas, building trusted relationships with regional business and functional leadership and influencing decisions without relying on formal authority
  • Connect regional stakeholders, global Brand colleagues and external partners, creating alignment around priorities and ensuring effective collaboration across a complex global organization
  • Provide strategic and creative direction on brand initiatives, confidently challenging established thinking where needed and helping teams turn strategy into distinctive, effective work

Skills You’ll Need

  • Extensive experience in brand strategy, brand management or integrated marketing, including responsibility for significant brand programs, campaigns or initiatives
  • Strong knowledge of the US market and broader Americas landscape, with the ability to translate market, audience, competitive and cultural insight into brand strategy and action
  • Demonstrated experience translating global brand strategies into effective market-level programs while maintaining consistency across markets and touchpoints
  • Proven ability to advise and influence senior stakeholders and navigate complex, matrixed organizations with multiple business and functional priorities
  • Strong experience working with creative, media and/or brand agencies, with the strategic and creative judgement to assess, challenge and improve brand work
  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs

Skills That Will Help You Excel

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex brand and business topics clear and compelling
  • Strong commercial judgement and curiosity about financial services, business, culture and the forces shaping client expectations
  • A combination of strategic thinking and hands-on execution, comfortable moving from senior-level conversations to making the work better
  • Collaborative and internationally minded, with the ability to build strong partnerships across cultures, disciplines and geographies
  • High creative standards and a genuine interest in how brands can create distinctive experiences, stories and connections with their audiences

Expectations

It is the Bank’s expectation that employees hired into this role will work in the New York City office in accordance with the Bank’s hybrid working model.

Deutsche Bank provides reasonable accommodations to candidates and employees with a substantiated need based on disability and/or religion.

The salary range for this position in New York City is $125,000 to $198,000. Actual salaries may be based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s skill set, experience, education, work location and other qualifications. Posted salary ranges do not include incentive compensation or any other type of remuneration.

title: Business Analyst till gasturbintillverkare
description:
Om företaget

Företaget möter den ökade efterfrågan på energi i över 90 länder och bidrar till att skydda vårt klimat. Med över 94 000 anställda genererar de elektricitet för 16% av världens befolkning och strävar efter hållbar, pålitlig och ekonomiskt överkomlig energi genom innovativa teknologier. Företaget utvecklar gasturbiner och kraftanläggningar för global användning och har en omfattande serviceorganisation. Med 3000 medarbetare i Finspång och en årlig omsättning på cirka 10 miljarder kronor är företaget en betydande aktör inom energiteknik.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker nu en Business Analyst med fokus på Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) till ett team i Finspång. I den här rollen får du en viktigt position i utvecklingen och förvaltningen av system och information genom hela produkternas livscykel. Du blir en central del av teamet bakom MGTLife-plattformen där du bidrar till att utveckla system, data och processer utifrån verksamhetens behov, både idag och i framtiden.

I rollen kommer du att arbeta nära flera olika funktioner inom Engineering, Service och IT där du tillsammans med verksamheten identifierar förbättringsmöjligheter, analyserar behov och driver utvecklingen av effektiva och hållbara lösningar.

Du blir en del av Data Analysis & Lifing-teamet som arbetar med erfarenheter och data från den installerade maskinflottan för att stödja den kontinuerliga utvecklingen av gasturbinsprodukter och tjänster. Teamet arbetar tvärfunktionellt mellan Engineering och Service med fokus på att förbättra produkternas tillförlitlighet, optimera underhållsstrategier och stärka det datadrivna tekniska beslutsfattandet. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta nära både teknik och verksamhet i en internationell miljö där din kompetens bidrar till utvecklingen av produkter genom hela deras livscykel!

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

  • Ta en aktiv roll i MGTLife-plattformsteamet och bidra till plattformens utveckling, underhåll och kontinuerliga förbättringar

  • Samarbeta med tvärfunktionella team för att identifiera, samla in och analysera verksamhetens behov och krav

  • Kartlägga och utveckla processer kopplade till produkternas livscykel för att förbättra effektivitet, informationskvalitet och datatillförlitlighet

  • Omsätta verksamhetens behov till nya eller förbättrade IT-funktioner och arbetssätt

  • Identifiera utvecklingsmöjligheter och ta fram rekommendationer som bidrar till ökad produktkvalitet och bättre verksamhetsbeslut

  • Fungera som länk mellan verksamheten och IT för att säkerställa att systemlösningarna skapar verkligt verksamhetsvärde

Din profil

Vi söker dig som har:

  • En ingenjörsexamen eller motsvarande utbildningsbakgrund

  • Erfarenhet av systemutvecklingsprojekt och implementering av nya IT-funktioner

  • Erfarenhet av Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)-system och tillhörande processer

  • Förståelse för samspelet mellan IT-system, data och gemensamma utvecklingsinitiativ

  • God kommunikativ förmåga och ett kund- och verksamhetsorienterat förhållningssätt

  • Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska, kunskaper i svenska är meriterande

Ansökningsförfarande
Tjänsten är initialt ett konsultuppdrag via oss på Skill. Det innebär att du är anställd hos oss på Skill och har ditt uppdrag hos kund i Finspång.

Urvalet kommer att ske löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum så vänta inte med att skicka in CV och personligt brev till oss idag. Vid eventuella frågor eller funderingar, kontakta ansvarig rekryterare Emelie Svedstam, emelie.svedstam@skill.se alt. 011-470 53 00.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Electrical Technician - Engineering - Jumeirah Messilah Beach
description:

Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 30 properties across the Middle East, Africa, Europe and Asia. Jumeirah Messilah Beach Hotel and Spa offers easy access to Kuwait’s Central Business District, airport and major attractions. The beachfront resort features 316 rooms and suites, 80 residential suites and 12 villas, seven restaurants, cafés and lounges, a Talise Spa, 200-metre private beach, two swimming pools and a children’s play area. title: Supply Chain Data Analytics Analyst
description:
X-energy LLC conducts a thorough recruiting process and will never issue offers without interview to discuss qualifications and responsibilities. All applications will be submitted via our company career page, . We will never ask you to provide payment information as part of the recruiting process. If anyone claiming to represent X-energy directs you in a manner otherwise, please contact us at .

Job Description

X-energy LLC is hiring a Supply Chain Data Analytics Analyst to support its team. The Supply Chain Data & Analytics role drives operational excellence through data-driven insights and strategic reporting infrastructure. This role has a dual mandate: (1) analyze current procurement data to identify and resolve bottlenecks impacting PO cycle time, enabling immediate process improvements, and (2) design and implement the reporting architecture for Supply Chain that will support long-term performance optimization. This role will transform raw data into actionable intelligence that accelerates X-energy's supply chain performance.


Job Profile Tasks/Responsibilities

Current State Analysis & Immediate Impact

  • Conduct deep-dive analysis of existing procurement data to identify root causes of PO cycle time delays.
  • Map current-state process flows and quantify time/cost impact of bottlenecks across the S2O lifecycle.
  • Develop visibility dashboards and reports that enable operational teams to prioritize improvement actions.
  • Partner with Procurement, AP, and business units to implement quick-win process changes based on data insights.
  • Track and measure the impact of interventions on key performance indicators (KPIs).

Ariba Reporting Infrastructure & Data Governance

  • Design and build Ariba reporting framework, including standard reports, dashboards, and KPI scorecards.
  • Define data governance policies, including data quality standards, metadata definitions, and access controls.
  • Configure Ariba reporting modules and integrate with business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.).
  • Establish baseline metrics and targets for post-go-live performance measurement.
  • Create user documentation and training materials for self-service reporting.

Continuous Improvement & Strategic Insights

  • Transform Ariba transactional data and metadata into strategic insights (spend analytics, supplier performance, compliance trends).
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization, cost reduction, and risk mitigation through trend analysis.
  • Develop predictive analytics capabilities to forecast procurement performance and supply chain risks.
  • Lead regular business reviews with stakeholders to communicate insights and drive data-informed decisions.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement through transparency, accountability, and data literacy.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with IT, Procurement leadership, and business units to understand reporting requirements.
  • Translate business needs into technical specifications for reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Serve as subject matter expert on procurement metrics, benchmarking, and industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with Ariba implementation team to ensure reporting requirements are incorporated into system design.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
  • Typically 5 years of experience in procurement analytics, supply chain analytics, or business intelligence.
  • Strong proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools (Excel, Power BI, Tableau, SQL).
  • Demonstrated ability to extract insights from complex datasets and communicate findings to non-technical audiences.
  • Knowledge of data governance principles and best practices.
  • Strong business acumen with ability to connect data insights to operational outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SAP Ariba reporting and analytics modules
  • Advanced degree (Master's) in Analytics, Data Science, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • Proficiency in statistical analysis tools (R, Python) or advanced analytics techniques.
  • Experience in manufacturing, construction, or project-based industries
  • Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) and procurement system integrations.
  • Certification in data analytics, business intelligence, or supply chain management (CSCP, CPSM).
  • Experience with procure-to-pay (P2P) processes and procurement KPIs (cycle time, maverick spend, supplier performance, etc.).
  • Experience with Claude code.
  • Experience collaborating with project controls teams and developing reports for EVM metrics.

title: Senior Principal - Atlassian + Tooling Product Owner
description:
Business Introduction
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Job Purpose

The Atlassian & Tooling Product Owner is responsible for maximising the value of Enterprise Tooling (i.e. Atlassian) by translating business needs into a prioritised backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Senior Director of SNOW Platform & Enterprise Tools. They work closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to product strategy. The Atlassian & Tooling Product Owner guides Product Analysts and works with delivery teams to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven, and data-informed, while overseeing iterative delivery that improves product performance, adoption, and operational readiness.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements, and define product outcomes that support business priorities, within guardrails set by the Senior Director of SNOW Platform & Enterprise Tools.
  • Own and manage the Product backlog (e.g. Jira, Confluence etc), ensuring requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) are well-defined and supported by minimum data inputs (e.g., cost drivers, user volumes, risk/sensitivity, process impact, dependencies).
  • Make prioritisation decisions for the Product backlog based on value, cost, risk, business continuity, and resource capacity, escalating only where strategic trade-offs are required by the Senior Director of SNOW Platform & Enterprise Tools.
  • Lad the Product team’s delivery activities, guiding Product Analysts and working with Engineers, Architects, and Testers to ensure solutions are fit-for-purpose, secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned to architectural standards.
  • Drive operational readiness by applying a delivery readiness checklist covering support model requirements, training needs, continuity planning, configuration/runbook documentation, release notes, and user onboarding.
  • Define and maintain the Product performance dashboard, tracking adoption, cycle time/throughput, stability/defects, UX signals (e.g., CSAT, SUS, completion rates), and support effort; use performance insights to drive continuous improvement.
  • Ensure product changes follow required security controls, risk assessments, data handling policies, and regulated change processes, obtaining approvals from relevant SMEs where required.
  • Support Solution Architects to assess design options and manage cross-Product dependencies, contract/interface impacts, and sequencing needs to support interoperability and consistent business outcomes.
  • Act as an escalation point for the Product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding decisions within agreed financial, risk, and architectural guardrails set by Senior Director of SNOW Platform & Enterprise Tools.
  • Contribute to the improvement of delivery practices within the Product, promoting agile (i.e. SaFe, Scrum etc), iterative, value-driven, and data-led ways of working, including meaningful measurement of benefits and operational impact.

Key Relationships/Customers

Business Stakeholders

  • Business Process Owners
  • Business Users / Power Users / Key Users

IT Stakeholders

  • Senior Director of SNOW Platform & Enterprise Tools.
  • Solution Architect
  • Product teams

Other

  • Third-party providers

Education & Professional Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
  • Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. Agile Methodologies, CPM).

Area of Specialisation

Knowledge of functional domains within Global Functions (e.g., HR, Finance, Legal, etc) and familiarity with the technology platforms that enable them (e.g., ServiceNow, Atlassian).

Understanding of product performance measures and KPIs, with the ability to drive improvements in product adoption, cycle time, stability, support effort, and overall user experience.


Experience Required

  • Overall 15 and Typically 5+ years of experience working in product delivery, digital solutions, business systems, or process-led technology roles.
  • Proven experience defining and prioritising functional requirements (e.g., epics, features, user stories) and managing a product backlog.
  • Experience working within Enterprise HR Technology, Service Management, Corporate Systems, Legal & Compliance etc)
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
  • Demonstrated ability to make prioritisation decisions based on business value, process impact, risk, cost, and technology constraints.
  • Experience leading delivery teams or analysts through the product lifecycle, from refinement and design through testing, release, and adoption.
  • Familiarity with enterprise governance requirements such as change control, security, data protection, and regulatory/compliance considerations.
  • Exposure to continuous improvement approaches (e.g., automation, process simplification, user-centred enhancements) that uplift product adoption, stability, or user experience.
  • Experience working within agile delivery environments and using iterative planning, delivery, and release practices.

Desirable Requirements:

  • Confluence and Jira product and administration expertise – Strong hands-on knowledge of Atlassian tooling, including instance configuration, governance standards, and day-to-day administration across multiple environments.
  • Enterprise demand and stakeholder management – Skilled at managing diverse business and tech stakeholders, prioritising requests, and aligning usage patterns and configurations with enterprise standards and roadmap.
  • Licensing, contract, and fiscal management ownership – Proven ability to manage Atlassian licensing models, optimise entitlements, and oversee contract and cost controls to keep the platform within budget.
  • Governance and adoption in a federated model – Able to define and enforce usage guardrails, templates, and best practices while supporting local teams’ needs and driving consistent, compliant adoption across the enterprise

Skills/Background

  • Strong communication and influencing skills, able to explain technology constraints clearly and support stakeholders in making informed product decisions.
  • Skilled in coaching and guiding Product Analysts and delivery team members to ensure requirements, documentation, and solutions meet business needs and compliance expectations.
  • Able to interpret business processes, user feedback, and operational data to identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, and improved user experience.
  • Comfortable working within structured governance, security, and data protection requirements, ensuring product changes remain controlled, supportable, and compliant.
  • Strong analytical mindset, able to weigh value, risk, complexity, and cost to make prioritisation decisions and sequence backlog items appropriately.

#AGTech


Skills

Agile Delivery, Agile Methodology, Atlassian Confluence, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, JIRA Tool, Process Diagrams, Product Management, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Software Development, Stakeholder Management, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Property & Facility Supervisor
description:

title: Data Architecture Governance Lead (f/m/x)
description:
Job Description:

DB Global Technology is Deutsche Bank’s technology centre in Central and Eastern Europe. Since its set-up in 2013, Bucharest Technology Centre (BEX) has constantly proven its capacity to deliver global technology products and services, playing a dynamic role in the Bank’s technology transformation.

We have a robust, hands-on engineering culture dedicated to continuous learning, knowledge-sharing, technical skill development and networking. We are an essential part of the Bank’s technology platform and develop applications for many important business areas.


Group Architecture team drives the development of a clear target state architecture for the organisation, together with the governance processes, supporting tools, standards and frameworks required to deliver this. This requires strong collaboration and buy-in across the Bank, working closely with federated business, infrastructure teams and CIOs.

Group Architecture play an important role in the delivery of the Strategy and impact the entire breadth of the Bank’s business, building out the Data Strategy and associated knowledge base.


As Data Architecture Governance Lead, you will play a pivotal role in the delivery of the Data components of the IT and Data Strategy. In this role, you will own the Enterprise Data Model (EDM), facilitate the Data Architecture Oversight Forum (DAOF), and establish the feedback loops necessary to ensure business domains adhere to enterprise data standards. By driving key regulatory commitments and robust process controls, you will help define the Data Architecture roadmap, enabling the secure and scalable adoption of modern technologies such as Cloud, AI, and Data Mesh architectures.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the maintenance, governance, and evolution of the Enterprise Data Model (EDM), overseeing releases, conducting impact assessments, managing data class ownership controls, and ensuring high-quality documentation.
  • Facilitate and support the operation of the Data Architecture Oversight Forum (DAOF) and ensure seamless integration with the wider Architecture Governance Framework (AGF), including Key Deliverable (KD) reviews.
  • Maintain Data Architecture work instructions and execute operational effectiveness attestations to ensure robust governance, control, and alignment with broader enterprise data strategy outcomes.
  • Collaborate across Group Architecture to maintain and evolve the broader governance, control, and assurance capabilities required to support the department’s operating model.
  • Define and drive the data architecture standards and requirements necessary to enable AI, while identifying use cases that advance the data strategy, governance tooling, and data mesh deployment.

Skills

  • Proven leadership and mentorship capabilities, with a track record of guiding cross-functional, global teams, fostering a collaborative culture, and driving high performance across matrixed environments.
  • Outstanding analytical and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex, ambiguous business requirements into robust and structured technical solutions.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise data management principles, including data governance frameworks, data quality management, metadata management, and data integration.
  • Proficiency in designing and implementing scalable, secure enterprise solutions, leveraging advanced data modelling, Data Mesh principles, and Data Product patterns to ensure high performance and reliability.
  • Proven track record of delivering large-scale, data-centric initiatives and defining target enterprise architectures within highly regulated sectors (e.g., financial services).
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, build consensus, and drive strategic change at the senior leadership level across diverse geographic locations.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to optimise workflows and solve business challenges, combined with strong critical judgment to ensure the responsible, secure, and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.


Well-being & Benefits

Emotionally and mentally balanced: We support you in dealing with life crises, maintaining stability through illness, and maintaining good mental health.

  • Empowering managers who value your ideas and decisions. Show your positive attitude, determination, and open-mindedness.
  • A professional, passionate, and fun workplace.
  • A modern office with fun and relaxing areas to boost creativity.
  • Continuous learning culture with coaching and support from team experts.
  • A culture where you can openly speak about mental health.

Physically thriving: We support you in managing your physical health by taking appropriate preventive measures and providing a workplace that helps you thrive. For example, Private healthcare and life insurance with premium benefits for you and discounts for your loved ones, healthier ways of working and check-ups.

Socially connected: We strongly believe in collaboration, inclusion and feeling connected to open up new perspectives and strengthen our self-confidence and well-being.

  • 24 days holiday, loyalty days, and bank holidays (including weekdays for weekend bank holidays).
  • Hybrid working model with 40% remote work.
  • Options for flexible working hours.
  • Enjoy retailer discounts, cultural and CSR activities, workshops, and more.

Financially secure: We support you in meeting personal financial goals during your active career and for the future.

  • Competitive income, performance-based promotions, and a sense of purpose.
  • Meal vouchers, bonuses for referrals

Interested in more: discover what our employees value in the Well-being & Benefits hub!

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Fixed Income Trading - Director
description:
Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Fixed Income Trading Director is responsible for driving trading strategy, managing risk, and delivering liquidity solutions across primary and secondary markets. This role combines deep market expertise with leadership in revenue generation, inventory management, and regulatory compliance. The Director partners closely with Institutional and Retail Sales teams, provides strategic trade ideas, and ensures operational excellence in trade execution and reporting. Additionally, this position plays a key role in mentoring team members and shaping Fifth Third’s competitive position in fixed income markets.

Please see below for specific responsibilities and requirements for this role.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:

The responsibilities for this role are below; you may support projects of varying complexity based on skill and organizational priorities.

  • Execute Fixed Income Trades across assigned sectors to support Institutional and Retail Sales representatives, ensuring timely and accurate execution.
  • Develop Revenue-Generating Strategies by providing innovative trade ideas and market insights to Sales teams.
  • Manage Inventory Positions within established policy limits, balancing risk and profitability.
  • Maintain Broker Relationships with national and regional dealers to optimize liquidity and market access.
  • Ensure Regulatory Compliance by filing required reports and adhering to all applicable regulations and internal policies.
  • Oversee Trade Processing and clearing system accuracy for all executed transactions.
  • Provide Product Expertise through formal training sessions and daily collaboration with Sales teams.
  • Contribute to Strategic Initiatives that enhance trading capabilities and client service delivery.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • 10 years of experience in Banking, Investment Banking, M&A, or Capital Markets (strong Analyst performance required for internal promotion).
  • Securities Industry Essentials (SIE), Series 7, and Series 63 licenses (or ability to obtain within company policy).

REQUIRED SKILLS:

Qualified candidates will bring professional proficiency, generally acquired through 10 years of relevant work or internship experience in finance, accounting, or a related field.

  • Deep knowledge of fixed income instruments, market dynamics, and trading strategies.
  • Expertise in risk management, inventory control, and regulatory compliance.
  • Advanced proficiency in Bloomberg and trade processing systems.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify market opportunities and optimize execution.
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills with internal teams and external counterparties.
  • Ability to lead projects and mentor team members in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

SKILLS FOR SUCCESS:

Successful candidates will demonstrate a higher degree of proficiency (typically from 10 years of practical experience or advanced academic exposure) across the following areas:

  • Strategic Market Insight – Anticipate market trends and position the trading desk for success.
  • Operational Excellence – Ensure flawless execution and compliance across all trading activities.
  • Revenue Leadership – Drive profitability through innovative trade ideas and client engagement.
  • Team Development – Build capability through mentorship and knowledge sharing.

DOING THE RIGHT THING: Our employees take pride in doing the right thing for customers and colleagues as well as being accountable for risk by openly exchanging ideas and opinions, elevating concerns, and following policies and procedures that protect all our valuable assets —including you​.

Fixed Income Trading - Director

At Fifth Third, we understand the importance of recognizing our employees for the role they play in improving the lives of our customers, communities and each other. Our Total Rewards include comprehensive benefits and differentiated compensation offerings to give each employee the opportunity to be their best every day.

Compensation for this position is largely incentive-based. Incentive compensation is combined with either a base salary or a draw to determine total cash compensation, and incentive compensation is based upon company, line of business and/or individual performance. More information can be obtained upon request.

Our extensive benefits programs are designed to support the individual needs of our employees and their families, encompassing physical, financial, emotional and social well-being. You can learn more about those programs on our 53.com Careers page at: or by consulting with your talent acquisition partner.

LOCATION -- Charlotte, North Carolina 28202

title: Associate Analyst – Technology and Cybersecurity Controls Testing
description:
This role is four days onsite at our Seneca One Buffalo, NY location, with the flexibility to work from home one day per week

Overview:

Assists with routine activities that support Technology and Cybersecurity Controls Testing under close supervision. The role supports the assessment of whether controls are appropriately designed and operating effectively by following clearly documented testing procedures, collecting and reviewing evidence, documenting results, and escalating questions or potential exceptions to experienced team members.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Support routine controls testing activities across Technology, Cybersecurity, and Data in accordance with clearly documented policies, procedures, testing programs, and guidance.
  • Learn and apply the controls testing lifecycle, including understanding risks, control objectives, control design, testing procedures, evidence requirements, operating effectiveness, and documentation of results.
  • Perform defined testing activities under supervision, including reviewing evidence against established testing attributes, documenting observations, and escalating questions or potential exceptions rather than independently determining final conclusions.
  • Collect, organize, and maintain complete and accurate evidence and workpapers to support control testing, audit, and management reporting requirements.
  • Participate in control walkthroughs, stakeholder discussions, evidence reviews, and other testing activities with experienced team members to develop practical knowledge of Technology and Cybersecurity risks and controls.
  • Produce accurate, clear, and concise testing documentation in alignment with Controls Testing procedures and standards, including basic workpapers, evidence summaries, observations, and supporting job aids.
  • Collect necessary information from stakeholders using defined question frameworks and follow-up procedures to support risk analysis and control testing activities.
  • Research and develop an understanding of applicable regulatory requirements, Company standards, and recognized frameworks relevant to Technology and Cybersecurity Controls Testing.
  • Support continuous improvement of testing processes, templates, and guidance based on lessons learned and feedback from completed testing activities.
  • Understand and adhere to the Company’s risk and regulatory standards, policies, and controls in accordance with the Company’s Risk Appetite, and promptly escalate risk-related issues or uncertainties to management.
  • Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand.
  • Maintain M&T internal control standards, including supporting the timely implementation and validation of internal and external audit points and issues raised by regulators, as applicable.
  • Complete other related duties as assigned.

Scope of Responsibilities:

  • Primarily interacts with individual contributors and people leaders within Technology and Cybersecurity Risk Management and with stakeholders supporting controls under review.
  • Work is closely managed and reviewed for accuracy, completeness, quality, and adherence to documented testing requirements.
  • Follows specific, outlined, and detailed instructions and escalates matters requiring judgment or interpretation to an experienced tester or manager.
  • Expected to progressively develop the capability to perform defined testing activities with greater independence through structured training, coaching, shadowing, and on-the-job experience.

Education and Experience Required:

  • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 1 years’ relevant work experience, or in lieu of a degree, a combined minimum of 5 years’ higher education and/or work experience
  • Demonstrated working knowledge of Technology and Cybersecurity risk principles



Education and Experience Preferred:

  • Prior relevant work experience, internship, coursework, or exposure in risk, audit, technology, cybersecurity, data, compliance, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with internal controls, risk assessments, audit concepts, or evidence-based testing.
  • Basic awareness of recognized frameworks such as NIST, COBIT, ISO, or similar risk and control frameworks.
  • Experience producing structured documentation or analyzing information using Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or similar tools.
  • Collaborative and team-oriented mindset, with a willingness to learn from experienced team members and contribute to shared objectives.

M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $29.90 - $49.84 (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation.

Location

Buffalo, New York, United States of America

description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

This role uses data, statistical analysis, machine learning, and predictive modeling to solve complex business problems and improve data-driven decision-making. The Senior Data Scientist designs, develops, and implements analytical and machine learning solutions, builds tools that support business decisions, and identifies and integrates data that improves modeling outcomes.


Working collaboratively with business partners and technical teams, this role translates business challenges into analytical solutions and helps integrate those solutions into business processes. The role provides opportunities to lead analytical projects, influence the direction of modeling work, explore new data and modeling approaches, and share technical knowledge with others.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, evaluate, and implement statistical, machine learning, and predictive modeling solutions that address business needs and improve data-driven decisions.
  • Work with data to identify patterns, develop features, test hypotheses, and build reliable analytical and modeling solutions.
  • Collaborate with business partners and technical teams to understand business challenges, translate them into analytical problems, and identify appropriate modeling approaches.
  • Develop analytical tools and solutions that use machine learning, predictive modeling, statistical methods, and data to support business decision-making.
  • Evaluate modeling techniques, assumptions, performance, and results, and clearly communicate findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Identify and evaluate new data sources, programming languages, tools, techniques, and analytical approaches that can improve modeling capabilities, efficiency, or business outcomes.
  • Partner with stakeholders to incorporate modeling solutions into business processes and evaluate their effectiveness.
  • Plan and manage moderately complex to complex machine learning, predictive modeling, and analytical projects, including defining tasks and delivering results within established timelines.
  • Identify opportunities to use new data, research, modeling techniques, tools, or analytical approaches to solve evolving business problems.
  • Communicate analytical findings and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership to support business decisions and help shape the direction of analytical work.
  • Share technical knowledge and best practices with team members and contribute to the development of others.

Experience:


  • 3 or more years of relevant experience preferred.
  • Master’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience developing and evaluating statistical, machine learning, or predictive models using real-world data.
  • Experience using programming and analytical tools to prepare and analyze data, develop models, evaluate results, and solve business problems.

  • Experience communicating analytical findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

title: Business Process & Quality Assurance Lead
description:
Role Purpose Lead cross-functional requirements validation, fit-to-standard process design, traceability and business acceptance across the Oracle Fusion programme, while providing independent delivery-quality assurance over design packs, configuration evidence, test readiness and phase exit criteria.
The role is a governance and quality lead, not the primary hands-on test execution resource.
Key Responsibilities · Plan and facilitate AS-IS discovery, Oracle show-and-tell, CRP1/fit-to-standard and CRP2/TO-BE workshops across business workstreams.
· Drive configuration-first decisions and challenge unnecessary customisation or extensions in line with the programme fit-to-standard approach.
· Own the cross-functional requirements traceability model and ensure approved requirements, design decisions, configuration, testing and business acceptance remain traceable end to end.
· Coordinate the RD.
011 / TO-BE solution-design pack and RTM content with functional leads; ensure decisions, assumptions, gaps, owners and acceptance criteria are explicit.
· Review workstream design and configuration deliverables for completeness, internal consistency, cross-module impacts and adherence to agreed templates and governance standards.
· Establish practical quality gates for Discovery Acceptance, Solution Design Sign-off, Build Complete/SIT Entry, UAT Sign-off and Go-Live Readiness.
· Work with the QA/Test Lead to confirm TE.
040 test coverage, scenario completeness, defect thresholds and evidence quality; support TE.
130 business acceptance without replacing test execution ownership.
· Identify cross-workstream dependencies involving Finance, Procurement, Contracts, CRM, HCM, Projects, GRC, data, security, reporting and integrations; escalate unresolved design conflicts.
· Ensure business process designs incorporate Delegation of Authority, segregation-of-duties considerations, auditability, data ownership and bilingual business requirements where applicable.
· Support Design Authority reviews and maintain decision/action closure discipline so critical design issues do not flow into build or test.
Drive business-owner readiness for formal sign-off and ensure approvals are evidence-based rather than meeting-driven.
Experience & Qualifications · 10+ years in enterprise process transformation, Oracle ERP/Fusion business analysis, quality governance or solution delivery roles preferred.
· At least 3 end-to-end Oracle Cloud/Fusion implementations strongly preferred, including discovery, design, build, SIT/UAT and go-live.
· Demonstrable experience owning process design, requirements traceability and cross-functional acceptance in complex multi-module programmes.
· Strong experience reviewing functional designs, configuration evidence, test packs and readiness gates; experience in public/semi-government or regulated UAE/GCC environments is advantageous.
· Bachelor degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering or related discipline; relevant Oracle/quality/process certifications are advantageous but not a substitute for implementation experience.
Key Delivery Outputs / Accountabilities · Approved workshop approach, decision logs and cross-functional process inventory.
· RD.011 / TO-BE Solution Design Pack coordination and controlled RTM baseline.
· Cross-workstream dependency and design-quality reviews.
· Quality-gate checklists and evidence for Discovery, Design, SIT Entry, UAT and Go-Live readiness.
· Documented design/quality findings with owners, due dates and closure evidence.
· Business acceptance readiness and sign-off support.
Candidate Success Profile A strong candidate combines consulting-grade process facilitation with disciplined QA governance.
They should be able to challenge both business and delivery teams, keep the programme aligned to standard Oracle capability, detect cross-functional gaps early, and prevent incomplete or contradictory designs from reaching build and testing.

title: Undersköterska
description:
Om oss

Capio Haga erbjuder specialiserad palliativ slutenvård för patienter med komplexa vårdbehov. Vi finns på Gamla Karolinska sjukhuset i Solna, med goda kommunikationer via pendeltåg och buss.

Hos oss arbetar läkare, sjuksköterskor, undersköterskor och paramedicinare, bland annat fysioterapeut, arbetsterapeut, dietist och kurator. Tillsammans arbetar vi för att skapa trygghet, lindra symtom och bidra till bästa möjliga livskvalitet för patienter och närstående.

Vi har ett öppet och hjälpsamt arbetsklimat där vi stöttar varandra i vardagen. Här värdesätter vi kompetens, delaktighet och möjligheten att utvecklas tillsammans.

Din roll

Som undersköterska hos oss får du ett meningsfullt arbete där du gör skillnad för patienter och närstående i en viktig del av livet.

Du arbetar inom specialiserad palliativ slutenvård och blir en del av ett engagerat tvärprofessionellt team. Tillsammans med läkare, sjuksköterskor och paramedicinare bidrar du till trygghet, kontinuitet och ett gott bemötande.

I rollen ingår bland annat att:

- ge omvårdnad utifrån patientens individuella behov och önskemål

- bidra till trygghet och kontinuitet för patienter och närstående

- observera förändringar i patientens tillstånd och rapportera till ansvarig sjuksköterska

- samarbeta med teamet och andra vårdgivare

- dokumentera enligt verksamhetens rutiner i journalsystemet Take Care.

Tjänsten innebär arbete enligt schema med dag-, kvälls- och helgtjänstgöring.


Vi erbjuder dig

- kollektivavtal, tjänstepension och försäkringar

- friskvårdsbidrag på 3 000 kronor per år

- fri sjukvård upp till högkostnadsskyddet

- kompetenta och hjälpsamma kollegor

- en arbetsplats där vi samarbetar nära varandra och lär av varandras erfarenheter

- möjlighet att vara med och bidra till en trygg och värdig vård för patienter och närstående.


Om dig

Du är utbildad undersköterska och har bevis om skyddad yrkestitel från Socialstyrelsen.

Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av ASIH, hemsjukvård, geriatrik eller palliativ vård. Erfarenhet av journalsystemet Take Care är också meriterande.

För att trivas i rollen är du trygg i din yrkesroll och kan arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra. Du kommunicerar tydligt, har ett gott bemötande och tycker om att samarbeta i ett tvärprofessionellt team. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.


Ansökan

Tjänst: Undersköterska inom specialiserad palliativ slutenvård

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning

Omfattning: Heltid, 100 %

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Lön: Enligt överenskommelse

Arbetsplats: Capio Haga, Karolinska vägen 22, plan 1, 171 64 Solna

Kontaktperson: Josefine Rudberg, josefine.rudberg@capio.se

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Annonsen kan därför tas bort tidigare än planerat, så vänta inte, skicka in din ansökan redan idag.

I samband med anställning kan bakgrundskontroll och utdrag ur belastningsregistret komma att begäras.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Publicerat: 18 november 2026

Sista ansökningsdag: 18 december 2026

Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt all direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av jobbannonser.

title: Associate Director - Legal, Compliance & WREF Domain Architect
description:
About the Team:

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Legal, Compliance & WREF Digital & Tech delivers digital solutions that support Legal & Compliance and Workplace Real Estate & Facilities (WREF). This team drives product roadmaps and manages platforms that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.


Job Purpose:

The Legal, Compliance + WREF Architect is responsible for designing, governing, and maintaining data architecture across Legal, Compliance and Workplace Real Estate & Facilities (WREF) domains, ensuring that data models, data flows, and integrations follow enterprise data and architecture standards while supporting Legal, Compliance & WREF-specific business needs. The role ensures data is structured, secure, and interoperable across products within Legal, Compliance & WREF, evaluating upstream and downstream impacts of solution changes, and guiding delivery teams on best practice. The Legal, Compliance + WREF Architect aligns domain data platforms and data products to enterprise principles, enabling trusted, scalable, and well-engineered data solutions that support analytics, operational processes, and decision-making within the domain. The role is accountable for some critical data products in Legal & Compliance aligned to Compliance Risk Analytics and Corporate Investigations.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and maintain data architecture for the Legal, Compliance & WREF Domain, including domain-specific data models, lineage, data flows, data contracts/APIs, and integration patterns across cloud and on-premise platforms.
  • Assess the architectural impact of new data sources, changes, and integrations within the Legal, Compliance & WREF domain, setting functional data architecture that aligns to enterprise standards and governance guidance.
  • Provide technical leadership for complex domain data designs, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure-by-design (e.g., privacy threat modelling, DLP, encryption policies), interoperable, and optimised for business value.
  • Ensures core Legal & Compliance data products such as Compliance Risk Analytics & Monitoring (CRAM) and data services provided for corporate investigations are modern, robust and AI ready. This includes supporting business stakeholders to increase the scope of these data platforms through new integrations/data sources
  • Ensures L&C&W data products are architected and engineered in the most cost effective way utilising enterprise hosting/cloud services.
  • Develop and maintain domain architecture artefacts, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models, lineage completeness, metadata definitions, reference architectures, and versioned API/data contracts for interoperability.
  • Partner with Data Product teams, Business Data Owners, Enterprise D&A, and Analytics teams to shape domain use cases, clarify data requirements, and support enterprise-level use cases where applicable.
  • Provide architectural guidance on the selection, configuration, and implementation of data platforms and technologies within the domain (e.g., Azure Data Services, integration tooling, MDM/metadata stacks), ensuring alignment with enterprise technical direction.
  • Support the implementation and adoption of master data and metadata frameworks within the Legal, Compliance & WREF domain, contributing to standardised definitions, stewardship, and enterprise practice alignment.
  • Define integration and data experience outcomes that support digital ecosystems, ensuring usable, reusable, and well-documented data interfaces across Products and Platforms.
  • Act as a technical advisor on domain data issues, including data quality SLAs, timeliness, reuse index, security constraints, and architectural design choices, supporting delivery teams to resolve challenges.
  • Ensure compliance with information security, data protection, and regulatory standards across all domain data designs, integrations, and contracts through security-by-design checkpoints.
  • Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.

Responsibilities:


  • 15 to 19 years’ professional experience with Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience
  • Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g., TOGAF, CDMP, Azure Solutions Architect, Data Management certifications)
  • Typically, 8–10 years’ experience in data architecture, data engineering, or enterprise information architecture roles within complex environments
  • Experience designing data models, flows, interfaces, and integration patterns within a specific functional or product domain (experience of data architecture in Legal, Compliance & Real Estate/Facilities functions). Evidence of applying enterprise data standards, rather than owning or defining them.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud and on-premise data platforms, data lakes, and integration technologies.
  • Experience collaborating with product and engineering teams to embed data architecture in delivery.
  • Understanding of information security, privacy regulations, and data quality requirements.

Preferred Skills:

  • Strong analytical and conceptual modelling skills.
  • Deep understanding of data governance, lineage, and metadata management.
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into architectural designs.
  • Familiarity with integration technologies and best practices.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills to support cross-functional delivery teams.
  • Strong understanding of security, data protection, and regulatory requirements.


Skills

Data Architecture Development, Data Engineering, General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), Information Architectures, Legal Technology, Master Data Management (MDM), Metadata, Microsoft Azure, Real Estate

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Inclusion at GSK:

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

title: Manager, Financial Reporting
description:
We Go Beyond:

At Bed Bath & Beyond, we believe that everyone should “Be You!”. Bed Bath & Beyond is a community that upholds a culture of understanding, acceptance, and respect. We believe a person’s individuality, traits, beliefs, and characteristics should be valued and embraced. Living by this ethos is essential to the success of our business. Our goal is to foster a more inclusive environment where every employee visibly demonstrates inclusive behaviors and respect for individuals.

The Manager, Financial Reporting is part of the Financial Reporting & Technical Accounting function and is responsible for the preparation, review, and accuracy of the company's external and internal financial reports. This role leads quarterly and annual reporting, research and documents technical accounting matters, and ensures compliance with GAAP and SEC requirements. The Manager partners closely with Accounting, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Legal, and Investor Relations, and supports the external audit process.


Job Responsibilities

    • Prepare and review quarterly and annual SEC filings (Forms 10-Q and 10-K), including financial statements, footnotes, and MD&A support.
    • Prepare earnings release financial tables, supporting schedules, and other external reporting materials.
    • Prepare materials for the Audit Committee and senior leadership, and support responses to SEC comment letters, as needed.
    • Maintain disclosure checklists, tie-out support, and reporting calendars to ensure accurate and on-time filings.
    • Monitor new SEC rules and FASB standards, such as segment reporting, income tax disclosures, and expense disaggregation. Assess their impact and lead implementation.
    • Manage XBRL tagging and the disclosure management platform (e.g., Workiva). Make sure tagging is accurate and current.
    • Research, analyze, and document technical accounting positions for complex and non-routine transactions.
    • Prepare consolidated cash flow statement, including cash flow variance analyses.
    • Assist with the company’s non-GAAP financial measures, including calculating and reconciling them, documenting definitions and policy and ensuring compliance with SEC guidance.
    • Maintain internal controls over financial reporting and support SOX compliance for reporting processes.
    • Serve as a key contact for external auditors during quarterly reviews and the annual audit.
    • Supervise, train, and develop financial reporting staff.
    • Identify and drive process improvements and automation in the reporting process.
    • Support finance related IT and system projects, including Oracle and disclosure management tools.
    • Provide accounting support for adhoc requests and new business activities.
    • Perform other duties as required and assigned by manager and upper management.
    • Experience hiring and leading diverse teams

Job Requirements

    • Advanced knowledge of GAAP Accounting and SEC reporting requirements (Regulation S-X, S-K and XBRL)
    • 6-10 years accounting experience. This should include time at a Big 4 or large national public accounting firm and direct SEC reporting experience at a public company
    • Hands-on experience preparing a full 10-Q/10-K and owning a public company reporting cycle. Experience with SOX 404 controls
    • Retail accounting experience preferred
    • 2+ years supervisory experience

Skills

    • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel
    • Experience with Oracle, Hyperion and disclosure management software (e.g., Workiva) preferred
    • Strong technical accounting research and memo writing skills
    • Excellent analytical, communication, and leadership skills
    • Strong attention to detail and a sharp eye for disclosure quality and consistency
    • The ability to meet tight deadlines

Education

    • BA/BS in Accounting or related field
    • CPA required

Location: Dallas, Salt Lake City or Remote

Physical Requirements:


This position requires you to sit, stand and perform general office functions. You may also be required to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally. Bending, stooping and reaching are also frequently required.

Equal Employment Opportunity:


It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and associates. This policy includes our commitment to ensure that all employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, pregnancy, veteran status (including Vietnam era veterans), age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other non-job-related characteristic protected by law.

title: Bodily Injury Adjuster - Unrepresented (EST/CST)
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

As an Unrepresented Bodily Injury Adjuster, your main focus will be investigating automobile accidents involving single or multiple vehicles, which result in property damage and/or bodily injury. You will have the convenience of working remotely from your home while efficiently handling your responsibilities. You will assess coverage, liability, and damages while providing exceptional customer service throughout your day. Customer communication will take place through different channels, including voice calls, email, and text messages. Through the utilization of innovative platforms and tools, you will engage in negotiation processes to reach fair injury settlements with customers.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of claims adjusting and bodily injury adjusting experience.
  • Previous experience in bodily injury claims handling or a related field preferred.
  • Colossus evaluation experience a plus.
  • Proficient communication skills, especially over the phone, to establish rapport and assess claims accurately.
  • Ability to work independently and remotely, while managing time efficiently.
  • Familiarity with insurance policies, coverage, and liability determination.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to evaluate and negotiate injury claims successfully.
  • Knowledge of innovative tools and platforms for effective claims evaluation.

Candidates for this role must reside in either the Eastern (EST) or Central (CST) time zones. This position is not available to residents of California, Washington, Alaska, or Hawaii.


You’ll wear a few hats to fill a few roles throughout your day that all require a level of experience:

  • The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Casualty claim. You lead with empathy, always.
  • The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate casualty (and applicable LOB (line of business)) claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.
  • The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.
  • The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.
  • The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.
  • The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Sign-On Bonus Information


  • Candidates with the active license(s) required for this role may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign-On Bonus.
  • Eligible licenses may include a Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.
  • Current employees and candidates previously employed by Allstate or its family of companies are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Remote Home-Based Work:
This position is a remote home-based role.

  • Schedule: Mon-Fri | 8:00am-4:30pm or 9:00am-5:30pm EST


Notice of Licensing Requirement:

  • As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
  • As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment. Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Allstate Benefits:


Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment. This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more. That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

  • Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.
  • Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.
  • Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.
  • Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education. reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit to learn more.


This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii, Washington, or Puerto Rico residents.
