title: Claims Specialist II
description:
Work Arrangement: On-Site
Position Overview
The Claims Specialist II investigates, evaluates, and resolves cargo loss and damage claims across multiple lines of business. This role combines analytical thinking, investigative work, customer communication, and problem-solving to ensure claims are handled fairly, efficiently, and in accordance with company policies, contractual obligations, and federal regulations.
In this position, you'll work closely with customers, agents, military representatives, national account contacts, and internal teams to gather information, determine liability, and reach appropriate claim resolutions. Success requires sound judgment, attention to detail, strong communication skills, and the ability to navigate complex situations while maintaining a customer-focused approach.
This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise in claims management while gaining exposure to various areas of UniGroup's moving and logistics operations.
What You'll Do

Evaluate and settle household goods and logistics claims across multiple lines of business
Review claims for reasonableness, accuracy, liability, and compliance with federal regulations, operating tariffs, contract provisions, and company policies
Investigate claim details and gather documentation needed to determine liability and allocate settlement responsibility to the appropriate parties
Analyze facts, supporting documentation, and claim circumstances to make fair and consistent settlement decisions
Exercise judgment and decision-making authority when evaluating settlement options and claim resolutions
Communicate extensively with agents, customers, military offices, government agencies, national account contacts, and internal departments
Maintain accurate claim documentation and case records throughout the claims process
Partner with internal stakeholders to resolve issues and ensure timely claim handling
Support department initiatives and perform additional responsibilities as assigned

What We're Looking For
Required Qualifications

High school diploma or equivalent
2 to 3 years of related professional experience
Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications

Preferred Qualifications

1+ years of claims adjusting experience
Experience reviewing documentation, determining liability, and negotiating claim resolutions
Experience working in transportation, logistics, insurance, customer service, or a related industry
Knowledge of federal regulations, contracts, tariffs, or claims administration processes

Who Thrives in This Role
You may be a great fit if you:

Enjoy investigating issues and piecing together information to reach informed decisions
Communicate professionally and confidently with a variety of stakeholders
Balance empathy with objectivity when evaluating situations and outcomes
Stay organized and focused while managing multiple claims and deadlines
Take initiative to solve problems and work through ambiguity
Adapt well to changing priorities and evolving business needs
Collaborate effectively with teammates and cross-functional partners

Why UniGroup
UniGroup is the parent company of United Van Lines and Mayflower Transit, two of the most recognized brands in the moving and logistics industry. Headquartered in the St. Louis area for more than 90 years, we support a nationwide network of agents, customers, and partners across residential, commercial, government, and specialty logistics markets.
Joining UniGroup means becoming part of a collaborative organization that values service, integrity, continuous improvement, and professional growth.
Benefits & Work Environment

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) retirement plan with company match
Generous paid time off and company holidays
Paid parental leave
Life insurance and disability coverage
Employee assistance program
Professional development and growth opportunities
Collaborative, team-oriented work environment

Work Authorization
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. UniGroup is unable to provide visa sponsorship or employment authorization support now or in the future.

title: Systemarkitekt
description:
Som systemarkitekt vil du bidra til å utforme, videreutvikle og kvalitetssikre løsninger som støtter operative beslutningsprosesser i Forsvaret og NATO.

Du vil samarbeide tett med utviklere, domeneeksperter, produkteiere og andre fagmiljøer for å sikre at løsningene møter brukernes behov og ivaretar både funksjonelle og tekniske krav. Rollen innebærer å omsette operative behov og brukerkrav til gjennomtenkte arkitekturløsninger, samt bidra til at systemene utvikles i tråd med produktets mål og overordnede systemarkitektur.

Vi har solid kompetanse innen operative beslutningsstøttesystemer og bistår samfunnskritiske aktører som Forsvaret, NATO og Politiet i deres arbeid.

Oppgaver, myndighet og ansvar

  • Utforme, videreutvikle og vedlikeholde systemarkitektur for løsninger innenfor FIRES-domenet.

  • Omsette operative behov, brukerkrav og funksjonelle krav til tekniske løsninger og arkitekturbeslutninger.

  • Sikre sammenheng mellom systemarkitektur, funksjonalitet, brukerbehov og overordnede produktmål.

  • Samarbeide tett med utviklingsteam, produkteiere og domeneeksperter for å utvikle helhetlige og robuste løsninger.

  • Bidra til tekniske vurderinger, designbeslutninger og prioriteringer gjennom hele utviklingsprosessen.

  • Identifisere forbedringsmuligheter og bidra til videreutvikling av eksisterende systemer og produkter.

  • Delta i kravarbeid, systemdesign, testing og kvalitetssikring av løsninger.

  • Bidra til teknisk dokumentasjon og dokumentasjon av arkitekturvalg.

  • Opparbeide og videreutvikle kunnskap om FIRES-domenet, operative konsepter og systemenes bruk i Forsvaret.

  • Bidra til god kommunikasjon og kunnskapsdeling mellom tekniske fagmiljøer og operative brukere.

Krav og personlige egenskaper

  • God systemforståelse og evne til å se sammenhengen mellom funksjonalitet, tekniske løsninger og operative behov.

  • Evne til å analysere komplekse problemstillinger og omsette krav til gjennomførbare arkitekturløsninger.

  • Gode samarbeidsevner og evne til å arbeide på tvers av fagområder.

  • Evne til å kommunisere tekniske problemstillinger på en tydelig og forståelig måte til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske interessenter.

  • Selvstendig, strukturert og løsningsorientert arbeidsform.

  • Evne til å ta faglige beslutninger, prioritere og følge opp tekniske problemstillinger gjennom utviklingsløpet.

  • Motivasjon for å lære nye ting og videreutvikle egen kompetanse.

  • Interesse for militære systemer, operativ beslutningsstøtte og utvikling av løsninger med høye krav til kvalitet og pålitelighet.

Kvalifikasjonskrav

  • Relevant høyere utdanning innen informatikk, datateknologi, systemutvikling, kybernetikk eller tilsvarende ingeniørfaglig retning. Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning.

  • Erfaring med systemarkitektur, programvarearkitektur, systemdesign eller teknisk utvikling av komplekse løsninger.

  • Erfaring med kravarbeid, tekniske vurderinger og samarbeid med utviklingsteam.

  • Erfaring med eller interesse for militære kommando- og kontrollsystemer er en fordel.

  • Kjennskap til FIRES-domenet og Forsvarets operative behov er en fordel.

  • Meget gode muntlige og skriftlige formuleringsevner på norsk og engelsk.

  • Må inneha sikkerhetsklarering eller kunne klareres opp til HEMMELIG og NATO SECRET.

Teknologiske krav (ikke et must men positivt)

Patterns:

- Domain Driven Design

- Hexagonal Architecture / Ports and adapters

- CQRS

- Clean architecture

- MVVM

Teknologi:

- EF CORE

- WPF

- gRPC

Hva kan vi tilby?

Vi streber etter å skape en plattform for våre ansatte der de kan utforske og utvikle seg. Hos oss har du friheten til å vokse både personlig og faglig. Vi tilbyr et positivt arbeidsmiljø med sosiale aktiviteter og engasjerte kollegaer. Kompetanse står i fokus hos oss, og vi søker kandidater som kan integrere seg i vår kultur og bidra med sine erfaringer for å berike vår organisasjon.

Om dette virker spennende, så ta gjerne kontakt for en trivelig samtale!

Denne stillingen krever norsk statsborgerskap, ettersom man trenger en godkjent sikkerhetsklarering i jobben. Du kan lese mer om sikkerhetsklareringer her.

title: Corrosion Specialist
location: Gulfport, MS, US; Mobile, AL, US; Pensacola, FL, US
description:
*To access Dayforce at its best, log in from the latest version of Chrome, Safari, Firefox, or Edge. *

*Must live within 30 miles of facility*
Boardwalk is a limited partnership operating in the midstream portion of the natural gas and natural gas liquids industry, providing transportation and storage services for our customers. Our 14,000 miles of pipeline and storage assets provide diverse market connectivity to producers and end-users who need reliable sources of natural gas for power generation, home heating or petrochemical feedstocks. We have the experience, knowledge, and flexibility to design service offerings and create system enhancements tailored to our customers’ needs throughout the 13 states in which we operate. As an organization focused on sustainability, we are committed to protecting the environment while delivering this energy source. This commitment is made to our customers, employees, and the communities in which we operate. We incorporate environmental stewardship, safety, and compliance into our day-to-day operations and seek to strengthen and support the communities we serve. Additional information about the company can be found online at www.bwpipelines.com.

We are currently looking for a Corrosion Specialist for our Gulfport, MS, Mobile, AL or Pensacola, FL location.

POSITION DESCRIPTION:

This position is responsible for managing daily activities related to corrosion control for assigned area, including, but not limited to, all facets of cathodic protection, as well as data acquisition, interpretation, and associated corrections/repairs for the same. Responsibilities also include overseeing computerized compliance documentation for assigned area, ensuring regulatory compliance with the appropriate agencies; overseeing all data necessary for effective corrosion control; and proactively recognizing and providing alternative solutions that result in optimal corrosion control in consultation with appropriate Region Corrosion Leader. Specific responsibilities also include the successful completion of all the Operator Qualification tasks assigned to the Corrosion program and some OQ tasks assigned to pipeline related O&M procedures.

In addition, this position will continually research the new technologies and best practices in the industry to be able to provide increasing efficiency to our business. This position will provide a representative view of the current corrosion scenario to the appropriate asset owners on a regular basis. Must be able to explain and inspect construction corrosion related projects within area and may occasionally assist other areas.

The successful candidate will report to the Gulfport, MS, Mobile, AL or Pensacola, FL location. Geographical responsibilities may be adjusted to better manage workload. The successful candidate must live 30 miles from their primary work location (either Gulfport Station, East Mobile Station or Pensacola Station).

REQUIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, AND EXPERIENCE:

Qualified candidates must have more than 3 years of corrosion control experience or pipeline operating experience, DOT 195 & DOT 192 knowledge and experience in compliance, as well as a basic understanding of the theory and application of corrosion control methodologies and cathodic protection as it applies to pipelines. Individual must have excellent communication skills and the ability to interact with all levels of personnel, as well as strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills and a strong ability for prioritizing and scheduling multiple projects. This individual should also have experience with Microsoft programs as well as the ability to read, comprehend, and follow Company procedures and manufacturers guidelines.

Physical requirements of the role include the ability to lift and carry 50 lbs. for a minimum of 50 feet in order to transfer tools and equipment, the ability to operate valve control wheels with a minimum of 50 turns, and the ability to work alone as required in extreme weather conditions including hot, cold, muddy, and wet environments.

The minimum education requirement is an Associate’s Degree in Corrosion Technology (or equivalent on-the-job training) and will be required to obtain NACE Corrosion Level “Tester” certification or higher as requested within one year.

PREFERRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, AND EXPERIENCE:

10 Years Gas Pipeline experience
10 Years Liquid Pipeline experience
Industry Related Electrical Experience
Industry Related Instrumentation Experience
10 Years Corrosion Experience

REQUIRED EDUCATION:

High School Diploma or Equivalent

PREFERRED EDUCATION:

Associates Degree in Corrosion or Related Field

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

Boardwalk Pipelines, LP, maintains a drug-free workplace and will require pre-employment drug & substance abuse testing before hiring.

Boardwalk Pipelines, LP, is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, religion, age, sex, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

title: Director - DWE Platform Architect
description:
Business Introduction
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Job Purpose

The Director, DWE Platform Architect owns the architecture of the Digital Workplace Experience domain, setting the target architecture, reference designs and standards across End User Computing and Mobile Device Management, Productivity & Collaboration and Global Site Experience. The role leads the architecture team, owns design assurance for the domain, and ensures the domain is coherent, secure, resilient and aligned to enterprise architecture.

The role leads architects rather than producing every design. Individual platform designs sit with the Platform Architects in the team, engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, platform roadmaps sit with the Senior Product Owners, and enterprise-level standards and technology strategy sit with the Chief Architect. This role sets the domain direction and holds designs to it, including those produced by delivery partners.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the domain target architecture, standards and reference designs, aligned to DPTF strategy and to the enterprise architecture and technology strategy owned by the Chief Architect.
  • Lead the architecture team across the domain, managing performance, capability development and the technical direction they work to.
  • Own the design assurance process for the domain, setting what must be reviewed, by whom and against which standards, and holding that standard against delivery pressure.
  • Embed AI patterns into the domain architecture, so that AI-assisted delivery and intelligent, self-healing operation of workplace services are designed in.
  • Architect for reliability, resilience, observability and cost efficiency by design, supporting the service levels the domain commits to and designing out single points of failure.
  • Ensure security, data protection and compliance, including GxP where relevant, are designed into the domain and not retrofitted.
  • Guide technology selection and modernisation across the domain, maintaining the architectural view of the estate including technical debt and lifecycle position, and measuring outcomes against architecture objectives.
  • Set the architecture standards that supplier and managed service solutions in the domain must meet, and assure partner-delivered designs against them.
  • Align the domain to enterprise architecture and technology strategy, negotiating exceptions where the domain genuinely requires them.
  • Advise the Head of Digital Workplace Experience on architectural risk, technical debt and the investment needed to address both.
  • Maintain architecture decision records for the domain, increasing pattern reuse and reducing rework, and evidencing both with measures.
  • Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architects on individual platform designs, the platform engineering teams on delivery, the Senior Product Owners on platform roadmaps, and the Chief Architect on enterprise standards.

Professional Qualifications

  • Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
  • Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or a recognised cloud or workplace platform architecture certification relevant to the domain).

Area of Specialisation

  • Domain architecture leadership, covering target architecture, standards, reference designs and design assurance governance.
  • Digital workplace architecture across end user computing, mobility, productivity and collaboration, and site technology.

Related Experience Required

  • Overall 18 Years and typically 10-12 years in technology architecture, including at least three years leading an architecture team with line responsibility.
  • Experience owning a target architecture at domain or equivalent scale, not solely at solution level.
  • Track record running design assurance governance, including holding a standard against delivery pressure.
  • Deep experience of digital workplace technologies across end user computing, mobile device management, and productivity and collaboration platforms.
  • Experience designing for reliability, resilience, observability and security in a regulated environment.
  • Experience setting and assuring architecture standards for supplier and managed service delivered solutions.
  • Familiarity with AI patterns applied to workplace services and to intelligent operations.

Desirable:

  • Deep knowledge of Digital Workplace & Experience platforms, Microsoft 365, End User Computing, Device Management, Collaboration, AI-powered workplace services, Global Site Experience Modern Architecture

  • Practical understanding of Digital Workplace & Experience AI architecture patterns AI-assisted delivery, intelligent operations, automation, and emerging AI platform capabilities.

  • Digital Workplace & Experience supplier and managed service architecture governance, experience setting standards and evaluating vendor-provided solutions.

  • Commercial and financial acumen, ability to articulate Digital Workplace & Experience technical debt, architectural risk, investment priorities, and business value to executive

Skills/Background

  • Deep technical breadth across workplace technologies, with the judgement to know where standardisation matters and where it does not.
  • Strong design assurance discipline, able to challenge a solution constructively without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Excellent communication, able to explain architectural trade-offs to audiences without a technical background.
  • Ability to lead and develop a team of architects.
  • Ability to influence engineering teams and suppliers who do not report to the role.
  • Commercial awareness, able to weigh architectural preference against cost and lifecycle risk.

#AGTech


Skills

AI Platforms, Architecture Governance, Cloud Computing, Container Orchestration, Data Center Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Technology (IT) Risk Management, Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS), Mobile Device Management (MDM), Network Design, Serverless Platforms, Service Oriented Architecture (SOA), Storage Area Network (SAN), Strategic Leadership, System Monitors, Technical Architecture, Technical Architecture Design, Virtualization, Workplace Architecture, Zero Trust Architecture

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Solution Architect
description:
SSH Communications Security protects secure access and communications between systems, applications, and people. More than 5,000 organizations worldwide, including many Fortune 500 companies, trust our PrivX, Tectia, SSH key management, and quantum-safe solutions.

Join us to work with experienced colleagues and help customers protect access to their most critical systems.

We are looking for a Solution Architect to lead the technical side of complex enterprise sales engagements across the Americas.

You will translate customer security, identity, cloud, and operational requirements into credible, scalable architectures using PrivX and other SSH technologies. As a trusted advisor, you will combine hands-on technical expertise with commercial judgment and communicate confidently with engineers, architects, security leaders, and C-level executives.

What you’ll do

  • Lead technical discovery with engineering, security, identity, operations, and executive stakeholders. Identify business drivers, risks, requirements, dependencies, and success criteria.

  • Design and present secure, highly available, and scalable architectures covering privileged access, identity security, SSH access, key and secrets management, non-human identity, hybrid cloud, and zero trust.

  • Demonstrate the value of our solutions through tailored product demonstrations, technical workshops, executive presentations, and well-scoped proofs of concept with measurable acceptance criteria.

  • Partner with Account Executives to shape opportunity strategy, assess technical fit, position SSH against alternatives, manage deal risk, and build customer consensus.

  • Serve as the primary technical contact throughout strategic engagements. Coordinate customers, partners, Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product Management, and R&D.

  • Lead technical responses for RFIs, RFPs, security questionnaires, architecture assessments, and complex customer objections.

  • Provide architectural guidance during strategic implementations and escalations.

  • Create reusable reference architectures, demonstrations, integrations, automation, and technical documentation.

  • Bring customer and field insights to Product Management and R&D.

  • Mentor customers and partners while staying current with privileged access management, identity, cloud security, non-human identity, and agentic AI.

What you’ll bring

  • Substantial customer-facing experience, typically 10+ years or a track record showing equivalent depth, as a Solution Architect, Sales Engineer, security consultant, or comparable enterprise technology professional

  • Hands-on depth in one or more of the following: Privileged Access Management, Identity and Access Management, zero trust, PKI and certificates, secrets management, or SSH access and key management

  • Strong foundations in Linux/Unix and Microsoft Windows operating systems, TCP/IP networking, authentication, authorization, and security fundamentals

  • Practical experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or OCI, and with containerized or hybrid-cloud environments

  • A record of designing, documenting, and communicating complex enterprise architectures to audiences ranging from hands-on engineers to C-level executives

  • Experience leading technical discovery, demonstrations, workshops, or proofs of concept in large, regulated, security-sensitive, or globally distributed organizations

  • Working knowledge of enterprise identity standards and technologies such as Microsoft Active Directory and Entra ID, Okta, LDAP, SAML, OIDC, and certificate-based authentication

  • Hands-on scripting or automation using at least one language or tool such as shell, Python, PowerShell, Terraform, or Ansible

  • Strong written, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills, combined with curiosity, sound judgment, personal ownership, and the ability to work independently from a home office

  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 25% on average.

Nice to have

  • Direct experience with SSH PrivX, Tectia, PrivX SSH Key Manager, or comparable enterprise-security products

  • Success presenting to CISOs, CIOs, or other senior leaders and connecting technical discovery to sales methodology and customer decision criteria

  • Knowledge of the competitive PAM, identity-security, or secrets-management market

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, non-human or workload identity, SPIFFE/SPIRE, or agentic-AI security patterns

  • Relevant education, practical experience, or security, identity, Kubernetes, or cloud certifications

Compensation & benefits

For candidates based in New York, the expected compensation range for this position is $140,000 to $180,000 USD in annual base salary, plus $20,000 to $50,000 USD in variable compensation.

Actual compensation will depend on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

title: Senior Principal - Technology Performance Manager
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.


Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.


Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Job Purpose


The Technology Performance Manager operates the DPTF performance framework, defining and maintaining the delivery, service and technology metrics through which the function measures how well it runs. The role measures delivery against commitments, tracks service performance, availability and SLA attainment, and produces the executive performance reporting on which leadership relies. Its scope is how the technology estate and its delivery are performing, distinct from whether investments have returned their expected benefit.


Improvement against the metrics is owned in the platform and product domains. This role makes performance visible, identifies trends, risks and improvement opportunities, and coaches and challenges domain leadership against the commitments they have made. It works with the Strategic Supplier Manager where services span internal teams and partner-delivered capability, and with the Portfolio Value Realisation Manager so that performance and value are read together.


Key Responsibilities


  • Define and maintain the delivery, service and technology metric set for DPTF within the performance framework, ensuring metrics measure outcomes rather than activity, with agile maturity and flow measurement owned by the Senior Principal, Agile CoE as instruments of delivery method.
  • Measure delivery performance against committed scope, dates and OKRs, making variance visible at both domain and function level.
  • Track service reliability, availability and experience using SLOs, error budgets and flow metrics across the technology estate, including services delivered by partners.
  • Produce the executive performance reporting pack for DPTF leadership, presenting a consistent and evidenced view of how the function and its domains are performing.
  • Identify performance trends, emerging risks and improvement opportunities, and bring them to the domains and to governance with supporting evidence.
  • Coach and challenge platform and domain leadership on performance, and own performance-improvement plans to closure where a metric breaches threshold, escalating to governance where improvement stalls, with delivery of actions in the domains.
  • Work with the Strategic Supplier Manager to assess end-to-end performance where delivery and service span internal teams and supplier-provided capability.
  • Ensure performance data is complete, accurate and comparable across domains, setting the measurement standards that federated Domain Portfolio Managers and platform teams apply.
  • Build and maintain performance dashboards, so leadership can self-serve current performance information.
  • Partner with the Portfolio Value Realisation Manager so that delivery and service performance is read alongside benefit realisation, not separately from it.
  • Use AI and analytics to automate performance data collection, trend detection and reporting, reducing manual reporting effort.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of the performance framework, including metric definitions, reporting standards and data quality expectations.

Experience Required


  • Overall 15+ years of exp, typically 6-8 years in technology performance management, service management, delivery assurance, or technology reporting and analytics roles.
  • Experience defining metric sets and KPIs for a large technology function, covering delivery, service and availability measures.
  • Experience tracking SLA attainment and service performance across both internally and externally delivered services.
  • Proven ability to produce executive-level performance reporting that leadership acts on.
  • Experience identifying performance trends and risks from data and presenting them credibly to senior stakeholders.
  • Experience working across a federated organisation to achieve consistent and comparable performance data.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards and reporting on enterprise reporting and analytics platforms, and familiarity with AI-enabled analytics applied to trend detection and reporting.

Skills/Background


  • Strong analytical and data skills, able to turn large volumes of performance data into a clear and defensible picture.
  • Excellent communication skills, able to present performance findings, including poor performance, factually and without apportioning blame.
  • Discipline in data quality and attention to detail, since the credibility of reporting depends on it.
  • Ability to influence and challenge senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Well organised, able to run recurring reporting cycles reliably to deadline.

#AGTech


Skills

Agile Methodology, Analytics, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Delivery Assurance, Design Thinking, DevOps, IT Performance Management, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Services Management, Software Development, Strategy Deployment, Technical Reporting, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Devops Engineering Lead, VP
description:

  • Automation and tooling: strong knowledge of the automation landscape, with ability to rapidly identify and mobilise appropriate tools to support testing, deployment etc
  • Security: understands security requirements and is able to independently drive compliance

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

title: Senior Industry Engineer
description:
Job Description

Senior Industry Engineer , Hangzhou

Join us to create change and have an impact in homes around the world

At Electrolux Group, our vision is to be the home appliance industry leader in consumer satisfaction by delivering outstanding lifetime experiences with solutions that always get better. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver more enjoyable and sustainable living.

Come, join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.

Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home!

About the role:

The Industrial Engineer is responsible for improving manufacturing productivity, operational efficiency, quality, delivery performance, and cost competitiveness through the application of Industrial Engineering principles and Lean Manufacturing methodologies.

The role leads value stream optimization, labor productivity improvement, process standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations. In addition, the role provides basic technical support for production equipment and PLC-related activities when required, working closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Maintenance, and Production teams to achieve operational excellence.

What you’ll do:

In detail, you will:

  • Primary Responsibilities
  • Industrial Engineering & Continuous Improvement
    • Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, quality, delivery, and cost performance.
    • Drive Lean Manufacturing implementation across production operations.
    • Identify and eliminate waste through structured problem-solving and process improvement methodologies.
    • Facilitate Kaizen activities and continuous improvement workshops.
  • Value Stream Management
    • Conduct Value Stream Mapping (VSM) analyses to identify opportunities for improving material flow and information flow.
    • Develop and implement future-state value streams to reduce lead time and increase operational efficiency.
    • Monitor and improve value stream performance through data-driven analysis.
  • Labor Productivity & Work Measurement
    • Conduct time studies, work sampling, and labor utilization analysis.
    • Establish and maintain standard work and standard times.
    • Support workforce planning and manpower optimization.
    • Lead line balancing activities to maximize production efficiency.
  • Process & Layout Optimization
    • Analyze and improve manufacturing processes to enhance productivity and manufacturing performance.
    • Design and optimize production line layouts, workstation arrangements, and material flow.
    • Support capacity planning and resource allocation activities.
    • Evaluate manufacturing readiness for new product introductions and process changes.
  • Performance Analysis & Cost Improvement
    • Collect and analyze manufacturing performance data.
    • Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs).
    • Identify cost reduction opportunities through process optimization and productivity improvements.
    • Prepare reports and recommendations to support management decision-making.
  • Standardization & Operational Excellence
    • Develop and maintain manufacturing standards, operational procedures, and best practices.
    • Support the deployment of Lean Manufacturing principles and operational excellence programs.
    • Ensure continuous improvement results are sustained through effective control measures.
  • PLC & Equipment Support
    • Possess basic knowledge of PLC-controlled manufacturing equipment.
    • Support troubleshooting and problem analysis related to production equipment when required.
    • Work with Maintenance and equipment suppliers to improve equipment reliability and production efficiency.
    • Participate in equipment improvement projects from an Industrial Engineering perspective.

Who you are / Your qualifications:

  • Qualifications & Skills
  • undefined
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or above in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related disciplines.
  • Experience: Minimum 3 years of Industrial Engineering experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement projects.
  • Experience in production process optimization, labor productivity improvement, and capacity planning.
  • Experience in automotive/home appliance manufacturing is preferred.

  • Required Skills & Knowledge
  • Industrial Engineering Competencies
  • Strong Industrial Engineering knowledge and hands-on application experience.
  • Proficiency in:
  • Value Stream Mapping (VSM)
  • Line Balancing
  • Time Study
  • Work Measurement
  • Capacity Planning
  • Labor Productivity Analysis
  • Workstation Design
  • Material Flow Optimization
  • Standardized Work
  • Lean Manufacturing Tools
  • Ability to identify waste and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good project management and cross-functional coordination capabilities.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and data analysis.
  • PLC & Technical Knowledge
  • Basic knowledge of PLC control systems and industrial automation principles.
  • Ability to understand machine control logic and support troubleshooting activities with equipment suppliers and maintenance teams.
  • Familiarity with sensors, actuators, HMI interfaces, and industrial control systems is an advantage.
  • Communication Skills
  • Good English communication skills, both written and spoken (Preferred).
  • Ability to communicate effectively within an international and cross-functional organization.
  • Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience in factory digitalization and manufacturing performance analysis.
  • Background in automation engineering or electrical engineering is preferred.
  • Knowledge of Power BI, MES, or other manufacturing data systems.

Where you’ll be:

You will be based at the Hangzhou Plant.


As part of Electrolux Group, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you. Electrolux Group is a leading global appliance company that has shaped living for the better for more than 100 years. We reinvent taste, care and wellbeing experiences for millions of people, always striving to be at the forefront of sustainability in society through our solutions and operations. Under our group of leading appliance brands, including Electrolux, AEG and Frigidaire, we sell household products in around 120 markets every year. Welcome to the City of Charlotte

SUMMARY

A project support position responsible for completing planning, and regulatory processes and construction inspections for compliance with Charlotte Historic District Commission Design Standards. Under general supervision, this position performs professional-level zoning, architectural/construction review, and historic preservation work. The primary focus is ensuring that all rehabilitation, new construction, and demolition activities within the city's historic districts strictly align with the local Zoning Ordinance, the Secretary of the Interior’s Standards for the Treatment of Historic Properties, and decisions made by Charlotte’s Historic District Commission. This position requires an exceptional balance of technical construction knowledge, architectural literacy, firm regulatory enforcement, and professional conflict resolution to uphold the structural and aesthetic integrity of Charlotte's historic built environment.

Major Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Conduct field inspections, document, and verify projects are constructed in compliance with approved plans and adopted historic district design standards.
  • Respond to inquiries and complaints from public.
  • Advise contractors and property owners of necessary corrective action.
  • Communicate effectively with Contractors, Owners, Developers, Engineers, and Construction Managers.
  • Conduct field meetings to review and discuss specific concerns and questions.
  • Analyze architectural and landscape drawings, including plans, sections, elevations, and details, to determine compliance with the HDC Design Standards.
  • Facilitate meetings with property owners, contractors, architects, and other parties prior to and during construction.
  • Provide support for planning and regulatory processes and projects.
  • Review and comment on development and planning related proposals.
  • Support initiatives involving the public and community groups.

  • Prepare and interpret planning reports, regulations and analyses.

  • Represent City’s planning position and policies with other agencies and the public.
  • Present planning recommendations and proposed regulations to Historic District Commission, interdepartmental teams, external stakeholder groups, and similar under supervision.
  • Facilitate and participate in meetings with staff, other departments and members of the public.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Ability to understand and interpret building construction plans, site plans, and zoning codes.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills including ability to apply conflict resolution techniques.
  • Experience working with design, development, and building construction professionals.
  • Skilled in working on multiple projects, prioritizing, organizing and fulfilling multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
  • Knowledge of planning and land development principles and practices related to construction materials and methods and historic preservation.
  • Understand and integrate a range of concerns and disciplines into planning and regulatory projects.
  • Ability to collaborate within and outside the department to achieve positive impacts on the community.
  • Ability to perform effectively and efficiently with moderate level of supervision.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree Construction Management, Historic Preservation, Architectural History, Planning, Architecture, Geography, Landscape Architecture, Engineering, Political Science, Public Administration, Social Science or related degree.
  • AICP or other certifications (AIA, GISP, LEED, PE, etc.)

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Four-Year degree in Construction Management, Historic Preservation, Architectural History, Planning, Architecture, Geography, Landscape Architecture, Engineering, Political Science, Public Administration, Social Science or related degree.

title: Senior Oracle ERP Business Process & Quality Lead (Oracle Fusion Cloud)
description:
Role Purpose


Lead cross-functional requirements validation, fit-to-standard process design, traceability and business acceptance across the Oracle Fusion programme, while providing independent delivery-quality assurance over design packs, configuration evidence, test readiness and phase exit criteria. The role is a governance and quality lead, not the primary hands-on test execution resource.


Key Responsibilities


· Plan and facilitate AS-IS discovery, Oracle show-and-tell, CRP1/fit-to-standard and CRP2/TO-BE workshops across business workstreams.


· Drive configuration-first decisions and challenge unnecessary customisation or extensions in line with the programme fit-to-standard approach.


· Own the cross-functional requirements traceability model and ensure approved requirements, design decisions, configuration, testing and business acceptance remain traceable end to end.


· Coordinate the RD.011 / TO-BE solution-design pack and RTM content with functional leads; ensure decisions, assumptions, gaps, owners and acceptance criteria are explicit.


· Review workstream design and configuration deliverables for completeness, internal consistency, cross-module impacts and adherence to agreed templates and governance standards.


· Establish practical quality gates for Discovery Acceptance, Solution Design Sign-off, Build Complete/SIT Entry, UAT Sign-off and Go-Live Readiness.


· Work with the QA/Test Lead to confirm TE.040 test coverage, scenario completeness, defect thresholds and evidence quality; support TE.130 business acceptance without replacing test execution ownership.


· Identify cross-workstream dependencies involving Finance, Procurement, Contracts, CRM, HCM, Projects, GRC, data, security, reporting and integrations; escalate unresolved design conflicts.


· Ensure business process designs incorporate Delegation of Authority, segregation-of-duties considerations, auditability, data ownership and bilingual business requirements where applicable.


· Support Design Authority reviews and maintain decision/action closure discipline so critical design issues do not flow into build or test.


Drive business-owner readiness for formal sign-off and ensure approvals are evidence-based rather than meeting-driven.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Principal / Technical Lead – Software Architecture


Lead the team. Shape the architecture. Deliver software that connects with the real world.


Some software lives entirely in the cloud. Other software has to work on a train or bus, process passenger payments, communicate with onboard devices and keep transport operations running reliably.

That's the kind of engineering challenge we're talking about here.


We are searching for a Principal / Technical Lead to lead software delivery across projects in the public transport sector.


This is a role for someone with a strong software engineering background who has progressed into technical leadership. You'll work closely with customers, lead a team of engineers and take ownership of architectural decisions and delivery.


You don't need to be coding every day to make an impact (unless you want to). Your value comes from knowing the technology, making good decisions, helping others solve problems and ensuring the team delivers the right solution.


What you'll be working on

You'll lead teams building software that supports the day-to-day operation of public transport networks, from ticketing and fare collection to onboard computers, fleet management and operational control systems.

These aren't just standalone applications. Solutions can span cloud platforms, web applications, mobile devices, hardware and third-party integrations. Reliability, security and maintainability are essential because the software supports real-world operations and needs to work for years to come.

The business has a strong track record in bespoke software development and is expanding its portfolio of standardised products and services. With new customer projects on the horizon, you'll have the opportunity to influence how solutions are designed, how teams operate and how successful delivery is achieved.


What you'll be responsible for

  • Technical leadership and architecture
  • Team leadership
  • Customer relationships
  • Delivery ownership
  • Continuous improvement


The central challenge is balancing the customer, the team and the technology. You need to keep all three moving in the right direction without becoming the person who has to do everything themselves.


The technical environment

You'll work across systems that combine software, cloud services, mobile devices and physical hardware.

Depending on the project, the technology includes:

  • Kotlin and JVM-based server-side development.
  • AWS and cloud-based services.
  • Android applications and managed devices.
  • MQTT and external system integrations.
  • Relational databases and the ELK stack.
  • React or Vue for web applications.
  • Legacy systems and integrations with physical devices.


You don't need to be an expert in every technology listed. A strong software engineering foundation, sound architectural judgement and the ability to guide technical teams are more important than ticking every box.


Who I'm looking for

You might currently be a Technical Lead, Principal Engineer, Software Architect or experienced Lead Developer. You've built your technical foundations and have moved towards leading people, shaping architecture and taking responsibility for delivery.


This is not a software development management role - You enjoy the technical side of software and will still contribute technically when needed


You'll ideally bring:

  • A strong background in software development and system architecture.
  • Experience leading or guiding software engineering teams.
  • The ability to make architectural decisions and communicate technical trade-offs.
  • Confidence working directly with customers and managing competing priorities.
  • A practical, service-minded approach to delivery and problem-solving.
  • The ability to delegate, coach and create an environment where teams can work autonomously.
  • Experience in public transport, logistics, fintech, payments, IoT or other environments where software interacts with physical assets would be useful, but it's not essential.
  • Fluent English plus Dutch or German would be useful but not essential


You don't have to be the person writing the most code in the room. You do need to be the person who can help the team make the right technical decisions and deliver successfully.


Why consider it?

You'll have real ownership of your team's technical direction and delivery, working directly with customers while shaping architecture and engineering decisions. Enjoy varied challenges across cloud platforms, connected devices and operational systems, with the autonomy to decide how your team works. You'll join a supportive business that values technical expertise, invests in professional development and offers flexible hybrid working.


  • Salary range is upto €103k including holiday
  • Laptop, phone, pension
  • 26 days of annual leave.
  • Free lunch in the office

Job Description

The Cloud Solutions Architect is responsible for designing and delivering scalable, secure, and resilient cloud architectures on Microsoft Azure. The role focuses on enabling organizations to migrate, modernize, and optimize their workloads on the cloud by defining architecture strategies, implementing cloud foundations, and enabling DevOps practices that support automated and reliable delivery.


Roles and Responsibilities


  • Architectural Design: Design end-to-end cloud architectures on Microsoft Azure supporting enterprise workloads and cloud-native applications.
  • Cloud Migration: Lead workload migration from on-premises or other cloud platforms to Azure using the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and best practices.
  • DevOps & Automation: Define DevOps and platform engineering architectures including CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps/GitHub), infrastructure automation, and release management.
  • Migration Strategy: Define migration strategies including rehost, replatform, refactor, rebuild, and replace approaches (the 5 R's).
  • Landing Zones: Design and implement Azure Landing Zones aligned with security, governance, and compliance requirements using Azure Policy and Blueprints.
  • Infrastructure Design: Architect scalable and resilient infrastructure solutions leveraging Azure services such as Azure Virtual Machines, Azure SQL, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure App Service.
  • Assessment & Planning: Lead migration assessments including application discovery, dependency mapping, and migration wave planning using tools like Azure Migrate.
  • Infrastructure-as-Code: Collaborate with engineering teams to implement IaC using tools such as Terraform or Bicep.
  • Operational Excellence: Ensure operational readiness through monitoring, logging, and reliability best practices using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics.
  • Technical Leadership: Provide technical leadership and architecture guidance throughout cloud migration and modernization programs.
  • Pre-Sales Support: Support pre-sales activities including architecture workshops and technical proposal development.
  • Capability Building: Contribute to internal capability development, best practices, and reusable architecture patterns.

Qualifications
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure engineering, or cloud consulting roles.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong experience designing solutions on the Microsoft Azure Platform.
  • Certification: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
  • Migration Leadership: Experience leading enterprise workload migrations to public cloud environments.
  • DevOps Proficiency: Experience implementing DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation.
  • Cloud Fundamentals: Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure including compute, storage, networking, and Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD).
  • Containerization: Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes (AKS preferred).
  • Tooling: Experience implementing Infrastructure-as-Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates.
  • Networking: Strong understanding of cloud networking including VNet design, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateways, and security controls.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills and ability to present architecture solutions to technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Resiliency & DR: Strong understanding of cloud network architecture including Azure Site Recovery (ASR) and replication methodologies.
  • Core Services: Deep expertise in core infrastructure services (e.g., AD DS, DNS, DHCP, ADFS).
  • Discovery Tools: Experience with automated infrastructure discovery and application dependency mapping tools.
  • FinOps: Knowledge of cloud cost management and optimization strategies, including Azure Cost Management and FinOps principles
  • Agile & DevSecOps: Familiarity with agile software development practices, DevSecOps integration, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins).
  • Databases: Familiarity with database technologies (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, SAP HANA on Azure).
  • Multi-Cloud: Additional architecture certifications in AWS or GCP (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional Architect).
  • Compliance: Knowledge of local and international compliance and regulatory frameworks (NCA, SAMA, ISO 27001).
  • Consulting: Experience in a client-facing, consulting role is highly desirable.
  • Observability: Experience with observability and monitoring platforms (e.g., Application Insights, Dynatrace, Datadog).

title: Data Validation & Quality Analyst
description:
Job Description

Vacancy Status: This posting is for a new vacancy within the organization and is open to new applications.

AI Disclosure: As part of the application process, Artificial Intelligence will be used in the hiring process for this role

This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to the Markham Elevation Centre or the Oshawa Elevation Centre at least three times per week.


The Team & Opportunity


The Enterprise Data team is responsible for supporting and modernizing the data platforms that enable analytics, artificial intelligence, customer engagement, strategic planning, and other enterprise capabilities across GM.


We are building a new team to support the existing legacy environment while migrating and transforming the architecture to a cloud-based platform. This role will help establish the engineering standards, reusable platform capabilities, delivery automation, and operational practices required for a secure, scalable, governed, and reliable cloud data ecosystem.


The ideal candidate combines strong data quality and validation fundamentals with a focus on automation and continuous improvement. They are comfortable working closely with data engineering, business analysis, governance, and business stakeholders to define quality expectations, detect and resolve data issues, and ensure enterprise data is complete, accurate, consistent, and aligned with schema requirements across legacy and cloud environments.


The Role


As a Data Validation & Data Quality Analyst, Enterprise Data, you will continuously monitor and assess the quality of data within the enterprise data warehouse. You will help ensure that data is complete, accurate, consistent, timely, and compliant with defined schema and business requirements.


This role focuses on designing, automating, and maintaining data validation and quality controls across data pipelines and warehouse environments. You will work closely with the Data Engineering team to embed checks into data workflows and with the Business Analyst to understand business rules, data definitions, and stakeholder expectations. You will investigate exceptions, coordinate issue resolution, and provide clear visibility into data quality and remediation status. The role supports both the existing legacy environment and its migration to a cloud-based implementation, which may be Azure/Databricks or Google Cloud Platform.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, automate, and maintain data-quality checks to monitor completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, uniqueness, and timeliness across enterprise data.
  • Define and implement schema validation controls to confirm that data structures, formats, data types, required fields, and constraints meet agreed requirements.
  • Build automated validation into data ingestion, transformation, and publishing workflows in partnership with data engineers.
  • Create repeatable checks for record counts, null values, duplicates, referential integrity, domain values, business rules, and cross-source reconciliation.
  • Monitor data-quality results and pipeline outputs on an ongoing basis; identify anomalies, unexpected changes, and emerging quality trends.
  • Establish alerting and exception-management processes so that data issues are detected, prioritized, communicated, and resolved promptly.
  • Investigate data-quality incidents by tracing issues across source systems, transformations, schemas, and downstream consumers.
  • Partner with data engineers to identify root causes, define corrective actions, and prevent recurring defects through improved controls and automation.
  • Work with the Business Analyst and business stakeholders to translate business rules, data definitions, and quality expectations into clear, testable validation criteria.
  • Support data migration and modernization by defining and executing validation and reconciliation plans for legacy-to-cloud data, including parallel-run comparisons where appropriate.
  • Verify that migrated data conforms to target schemas, transformation logic, and agreed business rules while supporting continuity of existing data services.
  • Maintain data-quality dashboards, scorecards, exception reports, and operational metrics that provide clear visibility into quality levels and remediation progress.
  • Document validation rules, test results, defects, root causes, remediation actions, and quality standards.
  • Support data governance practices by helping maintain data definitions, quality thresholds, ownership, lineage, and control documentation.
  • Contribute to sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, defect prioritization, demos, and continuous improvement with the data delivery team.
  • Participate in incident reviews and recommend improvements to validation coverage, monitoring, processes, and operational readiness.

Required Qualifications and Skills


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in data quality, data validation, data analysis, quality assurance, data engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience analyzing data in relational databases or enterprise data warehouse environments.
  • Experience creating and executing data validation, reconciliation, and quality tests for production or business-critical data.
  • Experience automating repetitive data checks using Python, SQL, or comparable scripting and programming tools.
  • Understanding of relational data structures, schemas, data types, keys, constraints, and data integration concepts.
  • Ability to translate business rules and data requirements into measurable and repeatable validation criteria.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, including the ability to identify patterns, isolate root causes, and assess downstream impacts.
  • Experience tracking data defects, documenting findings, coordinating resolution, and verifying corrective actions.
  • Familiarity with data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes, including how data is ingested, transformed, and delivered to consumers.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple quality issues and priorities.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience supporting data quality in an enterprise data warehouse, especially in an Oracle-based environment.
  • Experience supporting data warehouse modernization or migration to Azure, Databricks, Google Cloud Platform, or comparable cloud platforms.
  • Familiarity with data-quality automation frameworks such as Great Expectations, Soda, Deequ, dbt tests, or equivalent tools.
  • Experience using Python libraries and automation patterns to build repeatable data testing and monitoring solutions.
  • Familiarity with Databricks, Delta Lake, BigQuery, Synapse, or equivalent cloud data and lakehouse platforms.
  • Experience with data observability, anomaly detection, automated alerting, and data-quality dashboards.
  • Familiarity with data governance concepts including data ownership, metadata, lineage, classification, and quality thresholds.
  • Experience defining and monitoring data-quality metrics, scorecards, service targets, or operational controls.
  • Experience with Git, code review, CI/CD, or integrating automated tests into data pipeline delivery.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or comparable tools for defect tracking and documentation.
  • Experience working in a large, matrixed, or regulated organization with enterprise data, security, or privacy requirements.

Compensation:


The salary range for this role is $76,100 to $114,300. The actual base salary a successful candidate will be offered within this range will vary based on factors relevant to the position.

title: Operational Risk Senior Specialist (Hybrid)
description:
Overview:

This role is responsible for delivery of independent, risk-based challenge and second-line risk management support, in alignment with the Operational Risk Management Framework, applicable policies, regulatory expectations, and industry standards.

The role reports to an Operational Risk Senior Manager and supports providing independent and objective insights to guide and influence business risk management in the enhancement and implementation of their risk management practices.

The role is responsible for assessing risks, threats, and opportunities, including those arising from evolving technologies, customer-facing digital channels, data-driven decisioning, and emerging business models. The individual is expected to demonstrate strong knowledge of operational risk management principles, industry best practices, and the supported business areas, inclusive experience with technology-enabled process risk, third-party dependencies, data and model risk intersections, resilience and change management risk.

This role requires effective collaboration across risk partners, constructive engagement with key stakeholders, effective interaction with Technology and Product Owners, and meets the expectations of senior management, risk governance, and audit and regulators.

The position demands sound independent judgment, the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy in the oversight and/or execution of their role, as well as working effectively within the department, and effective integration within the broader risk organization. Given the dynamic and evolving nature of the risk landscape, flexibility is required to leverage risk concepts and tools to areas where risk management processes may be immature or not fully documented.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver complex operational risk analysis and analytical reports.
  • Prepare, review, and present clear, well‑supported risk opinions and materials for senior management and risk governance forums.
  • Perform independent oversight and critical review and challenge of risk identification, assessment, monitoring, mitigation, and reporting across assigned business areas.
  • Perform gap, control, and root cause assessments and evaluate the adequacy, effectiveness, timeliness, and sustainability of risk remediation plans. Escalate identified gaps, assessment results, and remediation plans appropriately.
  • Guide and support first line implementation of the Operational Risk Management (ORM) Framework. Monitor execution for alignment with ORM policies and guidance, as well as supervisory expectations.
  • Assess issues, control failures, or policy breaches to determine whether root cause has been adequately identified by first line and remediation plans are effective and sustainable. Escalate unmitigated risks, emerging issues, and remediation concerns through appropriate governance channels.
  • Deliver objective insights to inform and influence business risk management and the ongoing enhancement of control practices.
  • Collaborate with first‑ and second‑line partners, including technology risk, compliance, model risk, and other risk functions, to enhance risk processes, drive consistency, improve transparency, and deliver value‑added risk management outcomes.
  • Stay current on emerging risks, industry trends, and regulatory developments; engage with external peers and professional organizations to proactively inform ongoing risk oversight and monitoring activities.
  • Support change initiatives, promote adherence to internal control standards, and support audit and regulatory remediation efforts.

Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities:

No direct management but may provide guidance to others.


Education and Experience Required:

Bachelor’s degree and five years' experience in risk, compliance, legal, audit, or other relevant function,

OR in lieu of degree,

A combined minimum of nine years’ higher education and/or work experience including five years’ experience in risk, compliance, legal, audit, or other relevant function.


Proficient computer skills (including Excel, PowerPoint, and Power BI).

Analytical skills with strong written and verbal communications with all levels of management.

Working knowledge of relevant regulations and industry standards for Operational Risk Management.

M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $104,700.00 - $174,500.00 Annual (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation.

Iselin, New Jersey, United States of America
